chapters.title: Chapter 451: Huang Rong’s Fury
paragraphs: Just the hint of an E-level Medal.
This also indirectly proved that Guo Jing was already an Innate Level expert!
From previous interactions, this was apparent—his Inner Power was indeed profound, rarely seen in common men.
"Let’s go. We should step out first."

Though Guo Jing had been greatly impacted by Ding Ling, he was magnanimous and forgiving, prioritizing chivalry and loyalty. With thoughts on the matters of home and country, having Ding Ling such a strong ally was a joy to him, without a trace of envy.
He eagerly pulled Ding Ling out to meet Huang Rong and the others, to discuss imparting skills and guarding Xiangyang.

Ding Ling was versatile, skilled in military strategy and the art of chess, among other things, and Guo Jing hoped he could get along with Huang Rong and the others to exert combined efforts so that the Great Song might have hope.
As Ding Ling and Guo Jing stepped out of the inner courtyard, they saw that in the outer courtyard stood Little Dragon Girl alone, with no one else present.
Guo Jing felt puzzled.
Little Dragon Girl smiled and called out:
"Ding Ling!"

Her beautiful eyes never left the direction of the inner courtyard. The moment Ding Ling appeared, she spotted him right away. Her eyes, as cool as frost and as fluid as water, sent waves of affection as she was filled with joy.
Ding Ling’s heart swirled with tenderness as he smiled and stepped forward to hold Little Dragon Girl’s hand, whispering in her ear.
Their intimacy seemed oblivious to the world.
Truly enviable to others.

Guo Jing watched from the side, feeling slightly dazed, inadvertently recalling the time when he and Huang Rong knew, understood, and loved each other—he felt a warm stream in his heart. He chose not to disturb Ding Ling, but went alone to find Huang Rong.
On the way.

After speaking to the butler, he learned that Huang Rong went to the inner part of the courtyard. He made a few turns and arrived at the inner quarters, just as he saw Huang Rong scolding Guo Fu from a distance.
Her voice sounded stern and severe.
Clearly, she was still upset.
Guo Jing listened for a while and sighed quietly, admitting Huang Rong was doing the right thing.
Ding Ling was indeed a gifted genius. However, he was also prone to violence; upsetting him could result in unimaginable consequences!
Guo Jing certainly did not want such things to happen.
Now Huang Rong was wisely admonishing and reproaching Guo Fu for her own good, hoping she would learn her lesson.
Guo Jing did not interfere.
He simply listened on the side.
For a long while.
When Guo Fu walked out, feeling aggrieved with tears in her eyes, Guo Jing finally approached with a serious expression.
"Father."
Seeing Guo Jing, Guo Fu’s pent-up frustration and grievance surged. She couldn’t help but tear up and rush forward, tightly hugging Guo Jing, crying bitterly:
"Mother always says I’m unreasonable, that I just make trouble without cause, reckless and impetuous—do I really deserve such criticism? Father..."
She slightly raised her head to look at Guo Jing:
"Do you think your daughter is so irrational?
"Indeed."
Thinking of Ding Ling, Guo Jing did not condone Guo Fu:
"You must listen to your mother. If I find out you’re provoking Ding Ling, infuriating him, I will make you pay!"
"Father, you, you, even you say this!"
Guo Fu became even more aggrieved, saddened and hurt, crying while turning to run away.
Halfway along her path.
The more she thought about it, the more indignant she became, the angrier she felt, eventually blaming it all on Ding Ling:
"It’s all because of this jinx. If he hadn’t come suddenly, how could the Wu Brothers have been injured? How could my parents be so harsh with me!
Hmm. I want to see just how formidable he really is! I don’t believe he would dare to kill me!"
With that, she sprinted directly toward the direction of Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl’s courtyard.
Seeing her running angrily.
It was clear there would be quite a commotion ahead.
Huang Rong certainly did not anticipate that her own admonishments and repeated reminders would backfire!
Of course.
She understood her daughter, which is why she urged her countless times, fearing she might cause trouble.
However, many issues aren’t resolved merely by telling someone.

It’s like many people who know the principle, understand it within their hearts, yet still cannot follow through, still prone to making mistakes. Only those who experience pain firsthand and truly grow will understand that some things genuinely should not be done.
Guo Fu was the same.

She certainly understood her parents’ reasoning, but she hadn’t experienced the ’world’s harsh lessons,’ still a flower in a greenhouse, arrogant, naive, self-centered—not ready to truly adhere to Huang Rong’s guidance.
To endure through Huang Rong’s scolding had already required immense patience.
Upon rushing out, in her growing anger and confusion, it was normal for her to make irrational decisions.
Of course.
Huang Rong hadn’t thought of this yet, but while talking with Guo Jing, upon hearing Ding Ling described as ’quick learning and achieving perfection,’ she secretly marveled.
Guo Jing passed on to Ling the Nine Yin Scripture in its entirety.
The demonstration took quite a while.
Yet Ding Ling reached full mastery after just watching, which didn’t consume much time.
Therefore.
Huang Rong hadn’t finished scolding Guo Fu when Guo Jing approached, indicating the urgency.
Yet because Guo Jing came, after hearing what he said, Huang Rong couldn’t help but exclaim:
"Oh no. Fu’Er might be off to settle scores with Little Dragon Girl; if she confronts Ding Ling, how would that fare?!"
Guo Jing felt his heart skip a beat upon hearing this.
Who knows a daughter better than her mother!
If Huang Rong says so, it must be true?!

The two of them hurriedly rushed off and, from a distance, they heard Guo Fu angrily questioning her surroundings, surprising Huang Rong profoundly, prompting her to hastily employ her Lightweight Body Technique, Snake and Raccoon Technique, immediately zipping forward at great speed.
From afar, Huang Rong couldn’t help but shout angrily:
"Fu’Er!"
This voice, like thunder, crashed into Guo Fu’s ears.
Her body trembled, her face went pale, recalling Huang Rong’s warnings and sternness.
She couldn’t help but feel intimidated, abandoning her argument with Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl, turning to flee.
"Stop right there!"
Huang Rong’s pretty face blushed, flushed with anger, her body slightly trembling.
She realized she had underestimated Guo Fu’s lawlessness, recklessness!
Fools indeed!
Huang Rong became increasingly frustrated, regretting her past indulgence of Guo Fu.

She quickly arrived at Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl’s presence, seeing Ding Ling’s calm expression, his deep eyes revealing no emotion, in contrast to Little Dragon Girl whose brows were slightly furrowed, evidently displeased.
Huang Rong started to worry and hurried to apologize on Guo Fu’s behalf.
Guo Jing followed, also embarrassed and awkward, saying:
"Brother Ding, rest assured. My daughter is just candid and quick to speak, lacking tough lessons; once I have a moment, I’ll give her a proper scolding."
He was truly a man of his word.
Ding Ling believed it and said:
"Let’s not rush this matter. I seem to have heard the sound of gathering drums—is there a conflict occurring?"
"Indeed."
Guo Jing heard it too, his face becoming somber as he said:

"Of late, Kublai Khan has been frequently invading Xiangyang with the Mongolian Army. Whenever his Iron Cavalry arrives, the gathering drum sounds will ensue. If no surprise, it means Kublai Khan is leading his troops here.
If it were smaller units, it wouldn’t be thus."
He looked at Ding Ling with hope:
"Brother Ding, why don’t you come with me to meet General Lü and the others. They can give you a title, facilitating actions."
Guo Jing repeatedly changed his address.
This time, he directly called him Brother Ding.

chapters.title: Chapter 452: War Breaks Out! Yuwen Chengdu
paragraphs: It can be seen that Ding Ling’s status in Guo Jing’s heart is constantly rising.
He naturally values Ding Ling more and more, and undoubtedly hopes for closer ties.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t use such a term of address.
At this moment, Ding Ling heard Guo Jing say he was going to see General Lü, and knew it must be the brothers Lü Wende and Lü Wenhuan of present-day Xiangyang City.
These two brothers are the current City Defense Commanders of Xiangyang City, but they are mediocre and incompetent.
Xiangyang has been able to hold out until now.
Entirely thanks to the Guo Jing couple overseeing!
Thus, the Guo Jing couple are regarded as the pillars of Shenzhou Land by the Xiangyang City commoners.
Their fame in Xiangyang City is so high that ordinary martial arts heroes can’t compare!
This is what Ding Ling heard along the way.
It should be largely accurate.
Thus, Ding Ling had no intention of meeting the brothers Lü Wenhuan and only said:
"No need. Let’s go to the city wall of Xiangyang City to see the situation."
"That’s good."
Guo Jing thought for a moment and agreed with a nod.
Immediately the group left the courtyard, mounted their horses, and headed towards the city wall of Xiangyang City.
Little Dragon Girl followed closely by Ding Ling’s side.
Her martial arts skills have improved greatly from before.
Deeply receiving Ding Ling’s true inheritance.
Furthermore, she is intelligent, with exceptional talent, mastering martial arts at a fast pace, naturally without need to say more.
To the present.
She has far surpassed ordinary second-class generals in the External Refining Breathing Technique and, given time, reaching full level with it will not be a problem!

Precisely because she has achieved results in the External Refining Breathing Technique, her Fusion Qi is also very formidable, and when ordinary innate experts clash with her suddenly, the quality of Fusion Qi is far superior to Inner Strength.
Simply because Fusion Qi is extremely explosive, violent, and turbulent!
Not only can it enhance strength fivefold, tenfold, but it can also enhance speed!
How can ordinary innate experts who have not learned the Breathing Technique stand against it?
Da-da-da!
The group galloped swiftly.
A period of time later.
They arrived at the city wall.

Dismounting, under the soldiers’ admiring gaze, Guo Jing enthusiastically grasped Ding Ling’s hand, introducing him to the soldiers along the way, saying Ding Ling is the future War God, the hope of Xiangyang!
The soldiers looked at Guo Jing with confusion.
There were few players among them, players think Guo Jing’s side doesn’t stand a chance, unwilling to come over and die.

After all, many players know dying too much and losing levels down to zero, the aftermath will be severe, so most of them desperately improve skill levels to ensure they won’t drop to zero even if they die.
That’s why they are becoming more cautious, more stable.
What about those who are afraid to play?
Oftentimes, you can die from walking in the real world, choke while eating, so why not eat? Or walk?
For players, the Game World can enhance strength, learn martial arts, extend life!
Even without learning martial arts, the scenery in the Game World is beautiful, and some ancient maids are equally affectionate and gentle...
In short, the Game World has everything they want, so they naturally come to play.
Although players are scarce here, there are quite a few who are opportunistic or highly talented with a decent skill level, unafraid of losing levels!
Seeing Ding Ling arrive, they couldn’t help but feel at ease, each thinking:

"With Ding Ling this monster here, it’s secure now! Finally, I don’t have to fear and consider running away. If there’s a battle later, following Ding Ling to earn some exploits, wouldn’t that be easy?!"
The natives were puzzled, although they greatly respected Guo Jing, they were perplexed and questioned:
"How could this young Ding Ling be any War God?! Shouldn’t Xiangyang’s hope be Hero Guo?"
Although Ding Ling’s affair of crushing Kublai’s army is widely known, not everyone is aware.
To those who are aware, they are skeptical, guessing if Ding Ling is the rumored Ding Ling.
To those who are unaware, they are incredulous.
Ding Ling took it all in, but did not reveal it.
He stepped onto the city tower, gazing afar, seeing amidst the wailing horn sounds, smoke billowing, the Iron Cavalry coming and going, a taste of impending war permeating the Ten Directions Realm.
The country folk outside the city have retreated inside.
Seeing their eyes hold panic yet display an orderly, calm demeanor, Ding Ling knew these country folk had grown accustomed to this lifestyle.
During wartime, hiding in the city. Supporting the defense.
In peace, they set up stalls, farm, hunt...all for livelihood!
"Hero Guo!"
"Hero Guo!"
Upon reaching the wall, some soldiers intensely saluted Guo Jing, calling out one by one.
Another person stands on the city wall.
He is immensely burly! Uncommonly fierce-looking! Upon seeing Guo Jing, he is overjoyed, rushes over, grabs Guo Jing’s hand:
"Hero Guo, you finally arrived! You take charge here. I have matters at my mansion, so I won’t linger."
"General Lü."
Upon seeing this person, Guo Jing couldn’t help but hold onto him, saying:
"You came just in time. Let me introduce you to..."
He introduced Ding Ling and General Lü to each other.
Only then did Ding Ling know this person was Lü Wende.
Historically, Lü Wende was a brave General who opposed Mongolia!
But that’s history, in this Martial World, Lü Wende is a mediocre individual.
Listening to Guo Jing introduce Ding Ling, he nonchalantly cupped his hands, considering them acquainted, then left urgently.
He had no intention of developing deep relations with Ding Ling.
The courtesy to meet Ding Ling.
Most likely out of respect for Guo Jing.
"General Lü..."

Guo Jing was about to elaborate on Ding Ling’s formidable achievements to hint at Lü Wende Ding Ling’s prowess and hopes Lü Wende could take Ding Ling seriously, offering him a good job, but unexpectedly Lü Wende couldn’t stay focused, leaving Guo Jing slightly helpless, glancing at Ding Ling:
"Brother Ding, you see, this..."
"No worries. I’m here to guard Xiangyang for Elder Gang Leader Hong and Hero Guo, not for others."
Ding Ling also didn’t have great regard for Lü Wende.
A dignified Commander-in-Chief!
Entrusting battlefield defense entirely to Guo Jing, while enjoying life behind, is that reasonable?
However, for him to observe the frontline is somewhat rare.
Seeing that Lü Wenhuan didn’t even come.
One knows Lü Wende compared to Lü Wenhuan is better.
Thinking of the previous drum-beating and gathering, Ding Ling mused perhaps Lü Wenhuan was entertaining other martial heroes.
After waiting for a while.
Sure enough.
Some martial heroes also arrived one after another.
Guo Jing hurried to host them, letting the martial heroes distribute themselves across the four directions, ready to support the frontline at any time.
Ding Ling remained still.
This was his first time in Xiangyang City.
Normally, he traveled secluded mountain paths.

Thus, except for a few players present who knew him, very few recognized him, even with Guo Jing introducing Ding Ling, at first the martial heroes didn’t link Ding Ling to the rumored Ten Thousand Butcher.
After all, Ding Ling appears extremely young, not at all like a Great Demon King!
Of course.
Among them, some recognized Ding Ling but only silently, without a word, while internally confused, dubious, and somewhat encouraged, believing Ding Ling there provides some reassurance.
It seems Ding Ling’s battle in the Mount Song realm indeed earned recognition for his World’s Number One title.
Roaring!
The sound of hooves grew louder.
Ding Ling observed intently.
As many as a hundred thousand troops surged like a tide, at the front was a burly, spirited man with a full beard, looking extremely mighty.
His hair and beard were white, but his complexion was ruddy, making his true age hard to discern.
Wielding a long spear, exuding majesty, Evil Qi soaring to the sky.
Not far from this burly man was a handsome youth, wielding a Phoenix Wing Golden Mace, bold and fierce; Ding Ling recognized him, wasn’t this Yuwen Chengdu?
Ding Ling had met Yuwen Chengdu on Huashan in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, they had crossed paths but not fought.
Unexpectedly, their next encounter would be in the Divine Eagle World.

Thinking of the previous drum-beating and gathering, Ding Ling mused perhaps Lü Wenhuan was entertaining other martial heroes.
After waiting for a while.
Sure enough.
Some martial heroes also arrived one after another.
Guo Jing hurried to host them, letting the martial heroes distribute themselves across the four directions, ready to support the frontline at any time.
Ding Ling remained still.
This was his first time in Xiangyang City.
Normally, he traveled secluded mountain paths.

Thus, except for a few players present who knew him, very few recognized him, even with Guo Jing introducing Ding Ling, at first the martial heroes didn’t link Ding Ling to the rumored Ten Thousand Butcher.
After all, Ding Ling appears extremely young, not at all like a Great Demon King!
Of course.
Among them, some recognized Ding Ling but only silently, without a word, while internally confused, dubious, and somewhat encouraged, believing Ding Ling there provides some reassurance.
It seems Ding Ling’s battle in the Mount Song realm indeed earned recognition for his World’s Number One title.
Roaring!
The sound of hooves grew louder.
Ding Ling observed intently.
As many as a hundred thousand troops surged like a tide, at the front was a burly, spirited man with a full beard, looking extremely mighty.
His hair and beard were white, but his complexion was ruddy, making his true age hard to discern.
Wielding a long spear, exuding majesty, Evil Qi soaring to the sky.
Not far from this burly man was a handsome youth, wielding a Phoenix Wing Golden Mace, bold and fierce; Ding Ling recognized him, wasn’t this Yuwen Chengdu?
Ding Ling had met Yuwen Chengdu on Huashan in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, they had crossed paths but not fought.
Unexpectedly, their next encounter would be in the Divine Eagle World.

chapters.title: Chapter 453: The Deer and the Cauldron - Ao Bai
paragraphs: Yuwen Chengdu had obviously learned the Inner Power Heart Method, his eyes were extraordinarily sharp.
Ding Ling saw him.
He also saw Ding Ling, and his face couldn’t help but change dramatically. Instinctively, he pulled up his warhorse, ready to turn around and leave.
But the cavalry behind him, surging like waves, forced him to temporarily go with the flow.
However, his face grew increasingly grave.
The brawny man beside him noticed, and laughed aloud:

"Yuwen Chengdu! It’s ridiculous for you to claim to be the number one mighty general of the Sui and Tang World! Look at you cowering! Must you be so exaggerated?! It’s just Guo Jing, let me show you Ao Bai’s strength later! Open your eyes and see what the world’s number one mighty general truly is!"
Yuwen Chengdu glanced sideways, disdainful:
"Ao Bai, you know nothing! I’m not afraid of Guo Jing!"
"Then why are you acting so timid?!"
Ao Bai sneered and mocked:

"I wasn’t the only one who saw you acting like a coward just now! In front of everyone, you pulled up your horse as if you wanted to escape! What are you trying to do?! Planning to desert on the battlefield?!
Intending to become a renegade general?!"
He spat a wad of phlegm on the ground: "I think you, Yuwen Chengdu, are not fit to be a general at all!"
A flash of anger crossed Yuwen Chengdu’s handsome face, and he couldn’t help but grip his Phoenix Wing Golden Mace tightly, lifting it slightly.
Ao Bai noticed this and showed no fear, confronting him head-on:

"What, you want to hit me? Hahaha... I, Ao Bai, fear neither heaven nor earth, and certainly not you, Yuwen Chengdu. If you have the skill, come and fight me for 300 rounds, and if you can win, I’ll call you grandpa without question! But it’s a pity, coward, you don’t have what it takes!"
"Hmph!"
Originally wanting to remind Ao Bai of a few things, Yuwen Chengdu immediately gave up the idea, only snorted, and thought to himself:
"Ao Bai, you fool! Since you’re in such a hurry to die, go ahead, I won’t accompany you!"
Yuwen Chengdu was ready to run off at any moment!
He truly hadn’t expected to encounter Ding Ling in such a place.
If he had known, he would have detoured three feet away to stay far from Ding Ling!
"I joined Kublai’s camp to obtain first-class Inner Power Heart Method, and now that purpose is fulfilled, there’s no need to continue fighting and working for Kublai.
I must take this opportunity to distance myself from the Mongolian Army and avoid getting stuck."
In order to gain Kublai’s favor,
and also to obtain the top-tier Divine Skill Secret Manual.

After ascending, Yuwen Chengdu, through a series of coincidences and opportunities, joined Kublai’s army, fought several battles, won Kublai’s approval, and became the Commander-in-Chief of a ten-thousand-man iron cavalry like Ao Bai.
He had been practicing first-class Inner Power for a short period, and though the explosive power of his fusion qi was strong, it couldn’t compare to Ao Bai’s.
Ao Bai, it was unknown what opportunity he got earlier, but he had long learned a top-tier Breathing Technique and achieved the Thirteen Grand Protectors’ Cross-Training Golden Bell Shield.
Invulnerable and water and fire invincibility!
His defense was extremely formidable, extremely hard to kill!
Yuwen Chengdu had once sparred with him and was repelled, but he knew it was because he had practiced Inner Power for too short a time.
As long as he worked hard in his practice, given time, he would surely surpass Ao Bai.
"Let this old thief go fight Ding Ling. I’m definitely not getting involved in this mess again!"
Feeling resolved, Yuwen Chengdu grew calm and peaceful, looking at Ding Ling with friendliness and kindness, and even gave him a slight smile.
Ding Ling was astonished, unable to decipher what Yuwen Chengdu meant.
But since a great battle was imminent.
Any opponent in the future.
Ding Ling would not be polite.
Rumble!
The cavalry surged like a flood.
Stopping neatly at the city gate.
Ao Bai, riding at the forefront, reached below the city, waved his spear, and arrogantly challenged the martial arts heroes:
"I am Ao Bai, Commander of the ten-thousand-man cavalry under the Mongolian Army. Who here dares to come out and duel with me?!"
Ao Bai?
Ding Ling’s eyebrows twitched.
Quite puzzled.
How did this guy also join Kublai’s army?
Hai Dafu’s and others’ deaths led Ding Ling to believe that those who ascended from The Deer and the Cauldron World would stop here.
But the result was apparent, the ascendees were beyond his imagination.
"Let me test your level."
A young hero couldn’t stand Ao Bai’s provocation, jumped down the city gate tower, opened the gate, and charged out, brandishing a Guan Saber aimed heavily at Ao Bai’s head.
"Hahaha... Weak, too weak!"

Ao Bai did not evade, allowing the attack to strike his head, and it seemed to produce the sound of metal striking metal instantly. Then, as the attacker stood stunned, Ao Bai pulled back and thrust his spear, knocking the person off their horse:
"I heard that many heroes and martial arts masters have arrived in Xiangyang City recently. Is this the weakling you are? Hahaha..."
He laughed:
"From my perspective. You are all so weak, there is no point in continuing the fight, just surrender directly."
"Cease your arrogance!"
Another hero couldn’t stand it, descended from the city gate tower, galloped out, holding a spear, and thrust vigorously at Ao Bai. Bang!
Hit right on Ao Bai’s chest.
But Ao Bai remained unharmed, instead laughed and again shot the opponent dead:
"Weak, weak, weak, not a single one could be called a match!"
He looked up at the gate tower:
"I don’t know who Guo Jing is, but whoever it is, come down and fight me! If you win, I’ll leave immediately without hesitation, but if you lose, don’t blame me for taking your life!"
Guo Jing’s face flashed anger, but after thinking about it, he suppressed it.
He held back, but someone else couldn’t, going down to fight:
"Who do you think you are, daring to meet Hero Guo..."
The sentence hadn’t finished.
Ao Bai, enraged, swung his spear, and killed him from a distance.
Hit the person’s chest, killing instantly.
Easily killing three people.
Without any effort.
Besides, he was invulnerable.

Many martial arts heroes immediately felt disappointed and remained silent but couldn’t help a feeling of sadness, thinking to themselves: Just one Ao Bai coming from the Mongolian great army is this strong! How can we fight against this?!
"Damn it!"
Guo Jing could no longer contain himself and was about to descend.
Stopped by the hurriedly-arrived Huang Rong.
Huang Rong looked at Ding Ling, saying:
"Brother Ding, I know your goal. If you want a Martial Arts Secret Manual, you can lead everyone to repel this attack from the Mongolian Army. If you can repel it,
I will immediately offer all the Supreme Skills of Peach Blossom Island. No empty promises!"
"Alright."
Ding Ling came here to progress on Task 3.
And to deal with Kublai.
Kublai had issued a death order against him, how could Ding Ling ignore it?
Now hearing Huang Rong’s words, he immediately took advantage of the situation and said, "I’ll go meet this Ao Bai right now!"

chapters.title: Chapter 454: Ding Ling vs. Ao Bai
paragraphs: Ding Ling and the Little Dragon Girl were already clad in armor, and at this moment, they descended from the city tower, leaped onto their horses, and galloped out, quickly leaving the city to stand face-to-face with Ao Bai.
This time, Ding Ling wielded an exotic weapon.
It was Yuchi Jingde’s Divine Whip.

This Divine Whip was not a soft whip but a hard one, forged entirely from Divine Iron. The whip’s rod had a hexagonal shape and was uniform in thickness from end to end, with a pointed spike at the tip. The handle was forged separately, and the rod had raised tiers shaped like a tower, making it look like an iron rod!
It was just more lethal than an iron rod!
It was five or six feet long, differing from the Divine Whip’s historical length, making it very suitable to be used as a long weapon!

With one hand tightly gripping a Divine Whip, Ding Ling’s appearance exuded an intense Evil Qi, exhibiting great divine might that would make anyone instinctively feel fear, exuding an aura that dominated everything, starkly different from the martial heroes before, with a vast difference akin to a Celestial Abyss.
Ao Bai also couldn’t help but raise his brows at the sight, responding with a solemn demeanor:
"Finally, someone visually appealing has come. Let’s see if he’s just a fancy pillow with no real use."
Ao Bai grinned, sizing up Ding Ling, seeing how his cheekbones were sharp like they were chiseled, his brows ink-black, his face like a silver platter — truly a handsome man, making Ao Bai laugh:
"You appear to have an extraordinary aura, but to think you’re just a pretty boy!"
From the side of the horse, he picked up a long whip and forcefully lashed it towards Ding Ling:
"Let me first test your strength! Take one of my whips!"
Whack!

Ao Bai’s whip lashed out into the void with a series of crackling sounds, with waves faintly visible in the air. Clearly, Ao Bai put all his strength into it, driven by Fusion Qi, intending to thrash Ding Ling to death, possibly to stop.
Ding Ling saw it clearly and didn’t intend to hold back. Riding swiftly, he directly used the Divine Whip to exhibit the Dog Beating Stick Technique.
Boom!

Once the whip was lashed out, the Heaven-Pointing Technique unfolded, shadowed everywhere as stick images fell effortlessly into place, deflecting in front as one descended towards Ao Bai’s soft whip, twisting and flinging it away with a flick — Bang!
A formidable Unrivaled strength surged forth, entangling Ao Bai’s soft whip in an instant, flinging it far away.
Ao Bai, caught off guard, almost fell off the horse, utterly shocked:
"Such strength, such powerful staff technique!"
His eyes, extraordinary unlike ordinary people, saw that Ding Ling used a Divine Whip, yet wielded it like a staff, immediately shouting:
"Who are you!"
Ding Ling, too lazy to respond, rushed over with a Divine Whip raised high, close enough that he swung it down upon Ao Bai’s head.
Whack the Dog’s Head!

Again employing the Dog Beating Stick Technique, this time with seven to eight parts Fusion Qi driven, once unfolded, howling Xun winds arose from nowhere, the Divine Whip lashed down, resembling the descent of a Celestial Thunder, rumbling loudly with an exceedingly terrifying aura!
Engulfed by roaring vigorous winds, Ao Bai immediately sensed it, instinctively perceiving a crisis; how could he dare catch it head-on?
With a loud shout, he drew a saber from his back to block above.
Bam!
The Divine Whip struck the saber with a mighty force, causing Ao Bai to stagger, his hands softening, the saber falling with a loud slap, heavily hitting his head.
Crack!
The sound of his Protective Gang Qi breaking was heard.
Feeling like his head was splitting, utterly horrified, Ao Bai rolled off the horse with a slap!
Just as he fell, Ding Ling’s Divine Whip swung to strike where he just sat, with a thundering sound, breaking the sturdy horse’s back, causing it to wail and collapse, unable to rise.

Seeing this, Ao Bai gasped in shock, pupils contracting, realizing he had encountered a true master, immediately not hesitating, exerting full effort to run the Thirteen Grand Protectors’ Cross-Training Golden Bell Shield and Breathing Technique, with Fusion Qi driving, a very tough Protective Gang Qi covered his body.
Just before, he knew Ding Ling’s strength far exceeded his own, not daring to face him head-on, activating the Fusion Qi for protection, then turned and fled.
"Protect me!"
Ao Bai shouted.
Immediately, over a hundred cavalrymen charged out from the side.
These were Kublai’s elite ace cavalry forces.
A number not large, about three thousand in total.
Each had reached the level of a Second-class General.
Ao Bai brought over a hundred with him.
Showing how much Kublai relied on Ao Bai.
This cavalry formation followed closely, not far from Ao Bai’s rear. Seeing Ao Bai desperately seeking help after a fall, they dared not delay, charging forth eagerly.
Ding Ling, with a Divine Whip in hand and a cold look, rushed forward.
Dogless Under-Heaven!
The strongest Dog Beating Stick Technique unfolded, wielding left and right, stick shadows densely fell as no one was an equal, truly die at contact, wounded at touch!
Like autumn wind sweeping leaves, storm vortices rolling on the ground, Ding Ling swiftly penetrated this cavalry formation, continuing to pursue Ao Bai.
Seeing this scene, Ao Bai was more terrified, shouting uncontrollably:
"Everyone charge!"
Rumble!
Nearby cavalry formations charged aggressively.
Meanwhile, on the city walls, Guo Jing and others watched with both excitement and worry.

"Unexpectedly, Ding Ling is so ferocious, with two Divine Whips in his hands, truly unbeatable, that Ao Bai appeared very strong, his defensive Gang Qi seemingly at the Five Extremes’ level, yet Ding Ling broke it easily, Ding Ling’s strength is beyond comprehension!
But the Mongolian Army is vast in numbers.
Ding Ling only with the Little Dragon Girl and a few hundred, can they resist?! Should we go down to help."
Ao Bai’s fortuitous encounters and defensive Gang Qi driven by Fusion Qi already matched the Five Extremes, this Guo Jing discerned clearly, with even more admiration for Ding Ling’s prowess.
But the enemy’s army was immense, roughly at least a hundred thousand strong, how could Ding Ling withstand it?
Huang Rong worriedly watched Ding Ling galloping solo chasing Ao Bai into the cavalry, mentioned:

"Ding Ling’s talent is unparalleled, rare throughout history! Plus, he has had similar achievements, he’s smart and aware, surely wouldn’t do anything suicidal, we’ll see as we go, if Ding Ling can’t hold, we will charge out to rescue him."
Boom!
Bang bang bang!

Relentlessly using the strongest Dog Beating Stick Technique, Dogless Under-Heaven, Ding Ling, dissatisfied with the slow speed of horseback, leapt off, driving Fusion Qi, operating the Body Technique: Spiral Nine Shadows, dashed around the battlefield like a ghost, wielding the Divine Whip in hand.
Whack!
Whack whack!
Anyone struck by the Divine Whip would have their heads exploded, bodies pierced instantly.
Compared to the Drumming Golden Hammer’s heavy brutality, the Divine Whip was nimbler, with higher and faster enemy-killing efficiency, perfectly paired with the Dog Beating Stick Technique.
With one move of Dogless Under-Heaven, stick shadows everywhere, just a moment was enough to sweep across dozens of cavalrymen, killing them.
Pushing fiercely ahead!
Ding Ling’s enemy-killing efficiency was enough to make anyone watch with awe and fear.
Ao Bai fled quickly like a wild rabbit.
But Ding Ling was even faster, like a bolt of lightning sweeping across the battlefield.

But the enemy’s army was immense, roughly at least a hundred thousand strong, how could Ding Ling withstand it?
Huang Rong worriedly watched Ding Ling galloping solo chasing Ao Bai into the cavalry, mentioned:
"Ding Ling’s talent is unparalleled, rare throughout history!
Plus, he has had similar achievements, he’s smart and aware, surely wouldn’t do anything suicidal, we’ll see as we go, if Ding Ling can’t hold, we will charge out to rescue him."
Boom!
Bang bang bang!

Relentlessly using the strongest Dog Beating Stick Technique, Dogless Under-Heaven, Ding Ling, dissatisfied with the slow speed of horseback, leapt off, driving Fusion Qi, operating the Body Technique: Spiral Nine Shadows, dashed around the battlefield like a ghost, wielding the Divine Whip in hand.
Whack!
Whack whack!
Anyone struck by the Divine Whip would have their heads exploded, bodies pierced instantly.
Compared to the Drumming Golden Hammer’s heavy brutality, the Divine Whip was nimbler, with higher and faster enemy-killing efficiency, perfectly paired with the Dog Beating Stick Technique.
With one move of Dogless Under-Heaven, stick shadows everywhere, just a moment was enough to sweep across dozens of cavalrymen, killing them.
Pushing fiercely ahead!
Ding Ling’s enemy-killing efficiency was enough to make anyone watch with awe and fear.
Ao Bai fled quickly like a wild rabbit.
But Ding Ling was even faster, like a bolt of lightning sweeping across the battlefield.

chapters.title: Chapter 455: Victory Banquet! Power Boost
paragraphs: Like a fast ship splitting the sea, in just a moment, Ding Ling caught up with Ao Bai, and amidst his roar, launched another Dogless Under-Heaven attack, striking heavily yet lightly on various parts of his body!
Ding Ling showed no mercy.
This time, the Dogless Under-Heaven move carried the force of nine parts Fusion Qi.

Before the move was even executed, the sound of wind and thunder could be heard. Once the Dogless Under-Heaven was fully unleashed, one could clearly see the shadow of a giant cudgel capable of piercing the Celestial Palace in the Ten Directions Realm!

Such a move was unavoidable and unstoppable! Ao Bai was terrified to death, feeling trapped with no escape. Driven by desperation, he fully activated the Thirteen Grand Protectors’ Cross-Training Golden Bell Shield, wielding a large broadsword to slash heavily at Ding Ling’s face.
"If you want me dead, I’ll drag you to hell with me!"
Bang!

In the next instant, the divine whip and the broadsword collided heavily, only to stalemate for a moment before crack! The divine whip shattered the blade. With a great force, bam bam bam! Countless cudgel shadows landed on Ao Bai’s body.
In an instant.
Ao Bai’s head, chest, heart, and other vital points were all struck.
Crack!

The Protective Gang Qi shattered on the first strike from the cudgel shadows, and as the shadows fell, Ao Bai’s entire body was pierced, his head shattered on the spot, his heart punctured, and his towering figure collapsed like a falling mountain.
Ao Bai’s death was so tragic, so quick.
All the soldiers present were momentarily stunned, followed by shock, confusion, anger, and fear...
Some charged at Ding Ling on the spot, claiming vengeance for their leader!

Others hid within the Great Army, slowly retreating; Yuwen Chengdu was among them. After Ao Bai’s mount was slain, he retreated into the depths of the army, and upon witnessing this, decisively spurred his horse to flee.
No one understood just how terrifying Ding Ling was.
No one understood more than him.
Even that freak Li Yuanba met his end at Ding Ling’s hands, so how could Yuwen Chengdu dare to confront him head-on?
Bang! Bang! Bang!

And indeed, as Yuwen Chengdu anticipated, after Ding Ling killed Ao Bai, he let out a long howl, wielding two divine whips that moved like swimming dragons within the Great Army. Wherever they went, they crushed everything like dead branches, and no one could withstand a single whip from Ding Ling!
He seemed like a Celestial God with the power to hold up the sky, charging forward with two divine whips in hand, unstoppable!
"Too terrifying."
Yuwen Chengdu galloped away even faster.

Of course, there were still commanders who refused to believe in such evil, directing formations of cavalry to charge at Ding Ling repeatedly, attempting to overwhelm and drown him with sheer numbers.
But it was futile.
Ding Ling’s physique and defense were unmatched.

The Nine Yang Divine Skill was continually in motion, rendering the attacks of lower than first-class peak masters almost ineffectual against him. He made no attempts to block, charging straight through and, like a bamboo splitting, he reached each commander, bringing a divine whip down on their heads, smashing dog heads!
One strike from the Dog Beating Stick Technique crushed a commander’s head, and Ding Ling continued charging in other directions.
Little Dragon Girl led a few hundred people, clad in armor and wielding a long spear, closely following Ding Ling, handling cleanup operations.
If anyone attempted to ambush or assassinate Ding Ling, Little Dragon Girl would charge out on her horse, spear in hand, and kill them on the spot.
She killed so many.
Little Dragon Girl’s armor was stained with blood, as if she had been fished out of a Sea of Blood.
Yet even so, her cold and beautiful eyes always followed Ding Ling’s path, rushing wherever he rushed, staying close with her few hundred followers.
But inevitably, many fell behind, overwhelmed and drowned by the dense Mongolian Army.
Those who remained felt both excited and nervous, looking at Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl with fervent admiration.
Ding Ling’s strength was self-evident, and to call him the World’s Number One War God was not exaggerated.
Little Dragon Girl, a heroine of remarkable prowess, was equally rare in the world, and they were greatly awed, their worship for both growing steadily.
Bang! Bang! Bang!

Ding Ling fought with increasing courage, deploying the Dogless Under-Heaven move frequently, sweeping large areas, obliterating entire groups! Limbs and broken arms flew, reaching the utmost carnage and bloodshed where he passed!
His strength was immense, combined with the ever-operational Fusion Qi, exerting force continually, like a deity sweeping away ants, it was almost a one-sided massacre.
His endurance was formidable.
After an hour of slaughter.
He remained in perfect condition, vibrant and energetic.
However, Little Dragon Girl and her group were exhausted.
Ding Ling noticed and protected them out of the Great Army’s ranks, only to charge back in again.
Singlehandedly, he terrified a hundred thousand-strong army into retreat, backing down over ten miles in fear.

Guo Jing and others observed this with great enthusiasm, seizing the opportunity to lead their army in pursuit, chasing the Mongolian Army for dozens of miles, killing them until the blood flowed like rivers and the Mongolian Army completely collapsed and dispersed, before jubilantly returning in triumph!
On the way.
Guo Jing and his companions praised Ding Ling unceasingly.
They all said Ding Ling was the World’s Number One War God! The hope of Xiangyang! The stronghold of the Great Song!
With Ding Ling, the Great Song had a future!
And this battle.
Also completely established Ding Ling’s fame in Xiangyang.
Initially, those who didn’t know much about Ding Ling and even doubted his abilities, were now fanatically supportive to an extreme degree.
With one battle.
Ding Ling’s reputation was beginning to outshine and surpass Guo Jing.
Because Ding Ling killed so many, his stamina was so astounding, it exceeded everyone’s imagination!
Breaking a hundred thousand-strong army by himself!
Such an unbelievable feat was accomplished by Ding Ling almost singlehandedly!
How could a divine being like him not be revered by the common people of Xiangyang as a deity?
In less than a day.
Ding Ling’s deeds were spreading wildly through the streets and alleys of Xiangyang.
Even three-year-old children knew that Ding Ling was the contemporary War God! Xiangyang’s Guardian God!
Guo Fu naturally heard of it too.

After confirming the matter thrice, and especially after visiting the battlefield and seeing the tragedy and Ao Bai and others’ miserable dead appearances with her own eyes, she couldn’t help but be fainthearted.

Her fear of Ding Ling deepened, and at that moment, she finally realized that her mother’s special instructions were truly for her own good! Ding Ling was indeed as bloodthirsty as never heard or seen before!
Having realized this.
Guo Fu dared not confront or throw tantrums with Ding Ling, and didn’t even dare to look him in the eye.
Even more so for Da and Xiao Wu, who were restless with fear. With the Divine Doctor’s help, their severed hands and legs were reattached, but Wu Santong never forgot about avenging Ding Ling.
The two brothers clung to Wu Santong, pleading bitterly, and he finally came to his senses, no longer mentioning revenge.
On this day too.
The Xiangyang City Lord’s Mansion specially threw a celebration banquet for Ding Ling.
Guo Jing and Huang Rong insisted on inviting him, so Ding Ling could not refuse and went.
At the banquet, Lü Wende’s attitude completely changed from when he was on the city wall, treating Ding Ling with extreme warmth, apologizing and giving gifts.
Ding Ling saw that these gifts were Great Medicine, and there were even some Martial Arts Secret Manuals, so he accepted them.
Needless to say.
Lü Wende giving gifts in this manner was surely under the guidance of Huang Rong.
Lü Wende saw Ding Ling accept the gift and was naturally ecstatic, immediately wanting to share a drink with Ding Ling.
Regarding this kind of celebration banquet,
Ding Ling wasn’t all that interested.
After it ended,
he finished reading all the Martial Arts Secret Manuals.
Reached full level for all.
[Inner Power Value +90]
[Strength +0.5]
[Agility +0.5]
[Constitution +0.5]
Among them, there was actually a first-class Inner Power Heart Method.
It contributed 90 points to Ding Ling’s Inner Power Value.
There were also a few high-tier martial arts. Compared to Spiral Nine Shadows and the like, they were naturally much weaker, but not bad. The contributed points were quite even.
It was like getting them for free.
Ding Ling was satisfied.

However, it could also be seen from this that although Lü Wende was opportunistic, he did indeed know how to win people’s hearts, willing to spend lavishly, evident from the secret manuals—likely emptying his coffers.
As for those Great Medicines?
Ding Ling checked them too; some were a hundred years old, some were decades old, and there were even ones hundreds of years old.
The decades-old and hundred-year-old ones were basically useless to him.
Ding Ling planned to keep them for Little Dragon Girl’s medicinal baths to enhance her physical quality.
As for the other Great Medicines, Ding Ling consumed them.
He must reach the peak standard of this world as quickly as possible.
Only then could he better protect Little Dragon Girl and help her improve rapidly.
Just like Diao Chan in the Three Kingdoms World, or Qu Feiyan in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
Crunch, crunch!
Ding Ling quickly chewed and finished off dozens of Great Medicines.
With the full operation of the Five Great Breathing Techniques, these Great Medicines were rapidly refined.
They were fully refined in a matter of moments.
The four-dimensional attributes improved to:
[Strength +0.9]
[Agility +0.9]
[Constitution +0.9]
[Defense +0.9]
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel:
[Root Bone 3 (ordinary people have 1 point), Wisdom 4.2, Strength 53.2, Agility 54, Constitution 55.9, Defense 48.1, Charisma 11.7]
His Constitution was almost reaching 60 points.
Ding Ling could clearly perceive that his endurance and speed were significantly improved!
"It seems 60 points might be the limit value of this world?"
As Constitution broke through the 55-point boundary,
Ding Ling could clearly sense that he was getting closer to the world’s limit.
This mysterious feeling had also appeared in the Three Kingdoms and The Smiling, Proud Wanderer Worlds, so it likely wasn’t wrong.
But it seemed a bit illogical.
"If 60 points is the limit value, then how does Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill explain itself?"
Ding Ling was perplexed.
But then he thought about how his Fusion Qi propelled the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms to exert a force of tens of thousands of pounds.
He felt relieved.
Perhaps Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill follows the same logic?
As for the specific facts.
Perhaps he’ll only know when he witnesses this Divine Skill.
The next day.
Huang Rong proactively came to find Ding Ling, expressing wishes to teach Peach Blossom Island Martial Arts.
Ding Ling was eager for this.
So he followed Huang Rong into the inner room.

Huang Rong, being extremely clever and ingenious, seemed to know Ding Ling’s straightforward nature. Without unnecessary words, she got straight to the point and introduced the first Martial Arts of Peach Blossom Island.
Luoying Divine Sword Palm!
She asked Ding Ling whether he needed an explanation of the esoteric truth and essence.
After Ding Ling declined,
she started practicing the moves step-by-step, reciting the mantra.
Her practice took a moment.
Yet, Ding Ling mastered this palm technique to Great Perfection in an instant.
[Luoying Divine Sword Palm Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
This was a high-tier palm technique.
Upon reaching full level,

Ding Ling flipped his palm and executed the technique. Instantly, palm shadows filled all directions; sometimes five fictitious, one real, sometimes eight fictitious, one real, like falling blossoms, akin to a gust of wind sweeping through a peach blossom forest, with flowers scattering, graceful in posture, stunning in beauty!
Yet, this graceful palm technique carried sharpness, resembling an autumn wind that suddenly bursts forth with a desolate intent to kill!
Truly marvelous!
Even though Huang Rong had long known from Hong Qigong’s letters and Guo Jing’s words how incredibly fast Ding Ling learned martial arts,
witnessing it firsthand was still somewhat hard for her to accept.
Because in the past, she suffered immensely learning this Luoying Divine Sword Palm, taking a long time to hardly reach Great Perfection.
Yet Ding Ling achieved Great Perfection in an instant.
Comparing the two,
expert and intelligent as Huang Rong was, she couldn’t hide the sense of loss in her heart at this moment.
It was as if she, once considered a peerless genius, had been overshadowed by Ding Ling in seemingly effortless fashion!

chapters.title: Chapter 456: Full Level Splitting Sky Palm! Full Level Finger-Pointing Divine Technique
paragraphs: If Huang Rong is an unparalleled genius.
Then what kind of genius is Ding Ling?!
Terrifying!
Huang Rong’s heart surged with waves of shock, and it took a while to calm down.

She didn’t delay either. Upon seeing Ding Ling’s Luoying Divine Sword Palm reach full level, he looked over at her. She forcibly suppressed the turbulence in her heart and began to teach Ding Ling the second Kung Fu.
Orchid Brushing Hand!
Still, without any explanation, she merely recited the mantra according to strict rules, demonstrating the moves.
Ding Ling finished watching.
He slightly closed his eyes.
As a book in the library quickly took shape.
In an instant.
[Orchid Brushing Hand Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
This is also a high-tier martial art.

After reaching full level, Ding Ling opened his eyes, pinching his thumb and forefinger together, the remaining three fingers slightly spread, resembling an orchid. As he moved his hand forward, his fingers seemed to create a breeze out of nowhere, elegant and fierce, dazzling yet sharp, leaving observers stunned!
Huang Rong was speechless, feeling a strong sense of facing a celestial god-level scholar compared to a mere mortal-level genius!
It felt like they were not even on the same level as Ding Ling.
Crushed to the extent that not even a trace remained!
"Truly a monster. Brother Jing was not the least bit surprised after the initial shock. Has he completely given up resistance? Admitted he is a frog in a well?"
Huang Rong’s mind was unsettled, musing:

"Brother Jing said Ding Ling could easily learn the Nine Yin Scripture to perfection immediately, praising Ding Ling in unprecedented terms. Before, it was just hearsay, and although it had an impact, it wasn’t as strong as seeing it firsthand. This Ding Ling, is truly terrifying. No wonder at such a young age, he could easily kill Ao Bai, comparable to the Five Extremes."
Ao Bai’s high strength, formidable defense.
Uncommon, not inferior to the Five Extremes, yet was easily killed by Ding Ling with two Divine Whips, as if swatting a fly.
As you can imagine.
Even if the world’s Five Extremes all came together, facing Ding Ling, they would probably also meet the fate of being beaten to death.
Thinking this way.
Huang Rong felt a tightness in her heart, increasingly wanting to win over and please Ding Ling.
Such a talented person, if they assisted the Mongolian Army, Xiangyang would inevitably fall in an instant, losing hope.
And Ding Ling’s arrival could bring hope to the Great Song.
"With one’s own strength influencing the fate of the era! Such a person, even the overlords of the past could hardly compete."
Huang Rong secretly admired with envy.
If she had such talent, she wouldn’t need to toil and struggle every day, she could just fight her way out like Ding Ling, and who would dare to resist?
"Good.
Huang Rong did not spare her praise:

"As expected of the world’s number one hero, the unrivaled War God of Xiangyang City, the unparalleled genius in Elder Gang Leader Hong’s eyes. Ding Ling, your talent far exceeds the perception of us mere mortals. I won’t waste words with you. Watch closely, I shall now teach you my father’s supreme skill, Splitting Sky Palm."
She continued to demonstrate the moves and recite the mantra.
Ding Ling only needed to listen once.
In an instant.
[Splitting Sky Palm Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
This is a top-tier palm technique.
Once at full level, it can unleash a burst of palm power out of thin air, boom!
Ding Ling simply flipped his palm and slapped forward into the void. A loud bang echoed, and upon looking again, a three-inch-deep huge palm imprint had formed on the wall!
Huang Rong was stunned:
"Such palm power! Such training speed!"
She was in awe.
Her gaze at Ding Ling changed repeatedly.

Knowing the difficulty of training the Splitting Sky Palm was exceedingly rare, requiring eight iron pieces arranged into an Iron Bagua to practice, and soaking the hands in vinegar daily! A single mistake in the training process could easily damage or destroy the hands.
This palm technique’s training difficulty was such that even she struggled to perfect it, let alone achieve Great Perfection Innate Ability.
And Ding Ling?
Learned it in an instant.
"Truly inhuman!"
Huang Rong glanced at the three-inch deep palm print, realizing that if such a print hit human skin, it would undoubtedly result in instant death without any chance of survival.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You’ve won Huang Rong’s deep admiration.]

[Annotation: You easily defeated Wu Santong, repelled Guo Jing, controlled the battlefield’s outcome, single-handedly driving the Mongolian Army into hasty retreat, causing Huang Rong to tremble and quake.
Your unbelievably fast martial arts learning speed further astounds her. She genuinely respects and reveres you!]
An alert sounded.
Ding Ling gave a slight smile. Huang Rong’s Achievement Medal was particularly hard to earn.
In contrast, earning medals from Da and Xiao Wu, Guo Fu, Zhu Ziliu, and others was relatively easy after a battle.
Due to personally witnessing the battlefield’s intensity and Ding Ling’s unrivaled power.
Zhu Ziliu, Luu Youjiao, and others contributed an Achievement Medal on the spot.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You’ve earned Zhu Ziliu’s deep awe.]
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You’ve earned Luu Youjiao’s deep respect.]
Totaling several dozen in number.
One has to admit.
Displaying unrivaled might in front of a crowd is indeed the best way to earn Achievement Medals.
Ding Ling had initially returned to reality several times, consuming quite a few Achievement Medals to exchange for strength, worried about how to get another Storage Pouch.
Now, with dozens more Achievement Medals.
He had some ideas.
In the future, battling in front of a large audience seems to be more effective in instilling fear.
"Let’s continue."
Huang Rong proceeded to impart more martial arts to Ding Ling.
This time, she taught the Finger-Pointing Divine Technique.
Huang Rong hadn’t perfected this martial art either, but she knew the moves and the Heart Technique.
After explaining, she looked at Ding Ling without blinking.
As expected, Ding Ling mastered it instantly.
[Finger-Pointing Divine Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
This is a Hidden Weapon Skill.
One only needs to hold a hidden weapon or a stone to easily flick it away. Ding Ling casually picked up a pebble from the ground, flicking it with his finger, swoosh!
A gust of wind arose, the stone flew through the air at lightning speed. With a thud, it embedded deeply into the wall, piercing through it; the stone disappeared to an unknown location.
Clearly, Ding Ling’s profound skill reached an unimaginable level.
Huang Rong’s eyes twitched as she watched.
Finger-Pointing Divine Technique, such a supreme skill, was effortlessly learned by Ding Ling. It’s unbeatable.
Next.

Huang Rong kept her promise, teaching him Jade Leaking Silver Sword, Jade Flute Swordsmanship, Tornado Leaf-Sweeping Leg, Jade Sea Tide-Rising Melody, Green Wave Palm Technique, Spiritual Turtle Step, Bone-attaching Needle Technique...
Except for a few, there were dozens of high-tier skills.
Each one was extraordinary!
Far surpassing normal first-class martial arts.
And Ding Ling reached full level in an instant for each.
When demonstrated.

Sometimes, his speed was like the wind, sometimes holding a jade flute in hand, transforming it into a sword, showcasing the sublime intricacies of swordsmanship, elegant and graceful; sometimes placing it to his lips to play, as Jade Sea Tide-Rising Melody emerged, torrents seemed to rise out of nowhere, vaguely suggesting vast waves and fish leaping, whales surfacing, wind whistling and seagulls flying!

Seemingly revealing demons playing in the tide, water spirits dancing, indeed a play of transformation with hidden dangers, concealing killer moves, making listeners unknowingly fall into illusion realms, leading to mental chaos and collapse!
Huang Rong bore the brunt, struggling to endure, indicating she couldn’t take it anymore with a wave.
Ding Ling then set down the jade flute.
The jade flute was a gift from Huang Rong, meant for practicing Jade Sea Tide-Rising Melody and Jade Flute Swordsmanship, extremely sturdy in material.

chapters.title: Chapter 457: Hoduo
paragraphs: Once Ding Ling obtained the jade flute, he instantly achieved great perfection and mastery of relevant martial arts techniques like Jade Flute Swordsmanship and Jade Sea Tide-Rising Melody, and he could immediately wield this jade flute.

Ding Ling was quite satisfied with this jade flute. It seemed to be forged from hundred-year ironwood combined with millennium jade, crafted by an extraordinary artisan. Its internal structure was extremely intricate and complex, to say the least, and its hardness was rare, almost comparable to ordinary divine weapons.
This kind of jade flute, though it might not be valued at a city, was indeed invaluable!
Ding Ling understood Huang Rong’s intentions and thoughts.
She’s trying to win him over and flatter him, hoping he would contribute to Xiangyang and stand up, rather than leaving after one battle.
After all, if Ding Ling left,
the ensuing battles would undoubtedly be even more perilous.
The destruction of a hundred thousand soldiers.
Mongolia would surely send more troops over, and without a figure like Ding Ling to guard, how could they withstand it?
By then, Guo Jing would be in mortal danger.
She wouldn’t survive alone either! Perhaps considering this, she painfully offered such a precious treasure.
Ding Ling noted this in his heart, and after this battle, the progress of task 3 increased from 13% to 23%.
With that, he made up his mind.
Perhaps killing Kublai.
His task 3 could be completed.
Then casually finishing task 2, the progress of this world would probably be nearly complete.
In this world, Ding Ling’s only concern was the Little Dragon Girl.

The Little Dragon Girl was innocent and pure, though intelligent and mentally strong, yet if she were deeply in love with someone, she could also be quite vulnerable. One could say, the Little Dragon Girl’s biggest weakness right now might be Ding Ling.
Ding Ling understood this, so naturally, he had to prepare in advance.
After learning all the martial arts of Peach Blossom Island, he thought about the methods of Peach Blossom Island’s exotic divination and alchemy, and mentioned them.
Huang Rong was secretly shocked, but considering Ding Ling’s gifted learning ability, she was relieved, yet couldn’t help but admire and involuntarily feel a trace of jealousy deep in her heart.
How wonderful would it be if she had such a gift too?!
Suppressing such thoughts, Huang Rong laughed wryly and said:
"If you want to learn these techniques, you should find my father."
Ding Ling glanced sideways.
Huang Rong knew Ding Ling’s meaning and said:

"My father is as elusive as the Divine Dragon. Since my mother’s passing and my marriage here to Xiangyang, he often roams the world and rarely stays on Peach Blossom Island. Even if you go to Peach Blossom Island to find him, you might not see him."
"What a pity."

Ding Ling expressed regret. If he could learn all the techniques of Peach Blossom Island, his foundation would undoubtedly be more profound, and he would be more proficient in Array Dao, alchemy, etc.
Huang Rong was at a loss for words, admiringly glanced at Ding Ling, and said:

"I’ve heard the Little Dragon Girl mention your versatility. My father is also versatile, but not as strong as you. If you two met, my father might see you as a kindred spirit, because ordinary folks often spend a lifetime mastering a single skill. He, however, has learned innumerable skills."
Each skill has been researched to the extent ordinary people find hard to reach.

He prides himself on this, claiming to be the world’s smartest person! But if he met someone even stronger than himself, he would undoubtedly bestow the title of the world’s smartest person upon you."
Ding Ling smiled slightly, choosing not to comment.
If he had just entered this game world, back in the Three Kingdoms World, he might have blushed, feeling embarrassed, unworthy of such praise.
Now, he felt nothing at all.
He had seen through it; this divine skill automatically reaching full level was on him, he’d just take it as his natural talent!
The battle of Xiangyang.
Ding Ling’s fame began to spread across Jiuzhou.
Not only players recognized Ding Ling’s extraordinary achievements, but also many authorities were aware.
Some found it unbelievable;
Some were deeply shocked, eager to meet Ding Ling;
Some were arrogant about their own talent and martial arts and didn’t believe a young man could be so powerful;
The myriad facets of human nature, endless in variety.
Most players believed; natives were skeptical.
But there was no denying that this battle indeed made Ding Ling’s name resound widely, and as time went on, he became almost universally known.
On this day.
Someone visited Guo Mansion in Xiangyang.
Claimed to be a Mongolian prince, seeking to meet Hero Ding Ling.

Huang Rong received this person in the parlor, glanced at him, and saw him wearing a light-colored brocade robe, holding a folding fan, exuding an elegant demeanor, seeming like a nobleman, but with an arrogant face and eyes filled with malice. One glance, and it was clear this person was treacherous and cunning, surely a deceitful villain!
What kind of talent was Huang Rong?
She knew trouble was coming, and with a turn of thought, she said:
"I wonder why you want to meet Hero Ding Ling?"
"That is not convenient to discuss with Leader Huang."
The nobleman slightly shook his folding fan, a subtle smile playing on his lips, speaking nonchalantly:
"I must speak face to face with Hero Ding Ling to clarify things."
"My husband and I are friends with Hero Ding Ling. You can freely say anything.
Huang Rong’s expression remained calm, saying:
"I will surely convey your words perfectly to Hero Ding Ling."
"Heh."
The nobleman sneered:
"Legend has it Leader Huang is known for wisdom. I, however, do not quite believe you."
"Are you not afraid of being trapped?"
"Two countries at war do not harm ambassadors. I am merely a messenger, and if you dare imprison me, breaking the rules, your Great Song emperor will not forgive you."
The nobleman was quite confident:
"If you don’t allow me to see Hero Ding Ling, then there might be something disgraceful. After returning, I will surely publicize this matter, bringing shame to you and your husband."
"There’s nothing to hide,"
Guo Jing frowned, looked towards Luu Youjiao beside him:
"Would Elder Luu please go and invite Hero Ding Ling over."
Luu Youjiao left.
Soon after.
Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl arrived at the parlor, warmly hosted by the Huang couple, sat aside, looked at the nobleman, and said:
"I heard you were looking for me?"
"Indeed."
The nobleman glanced at Little Dragon Girl, a hint of admiration in his eyes, hearing Ding Ling’s inquiry, replied:
"Are you Hero Ding Ling?"
"I am Ding Ling."
Ding Ling frowned and asked, "May I know who you are?"
"I am Hoduo, Mongolian Prince! Third disciple of Mongolian Kingdom Preceptor Golden Wheel Dharma King!"
The nobleman spoke with apparent pride regarding his identity.
Ding Ling, however, was unmoved, showing no indication: "Speak then. What brings you to me?"
Seeing Ding Ling’s expression, Hoduo felt a flash of anger in his heart. Each time he declared his title, people dared not underestimate him; Ding Ling was the first!
But recalling Ding Ling’s feats,
Hoduo forcibly suppressed his resentment and said:
"This time, I have come under orders to invite Hero Ding Ling to Mongolia to serve as our National Preceptor."

chapters.title: Chapter 458: Gift
paragraphs: As soon as Hoduo finished speaking.
Guo Jing paused.
Huang Rong’s expression slightly changed, her heart tightened, and she couldn’t help but stare intently at Ding Ling, fearing that Ding Ling would agree.
The fact is, the court of Great Song is also corrupt.

They clearly know how capable Ding Ling is, and even Lü Wende has petitioned the court, but no one has rewarded Ding Ling. If Ding Ling, for the sake of becoming National Preceptor, defects to Mongolia at this moment.
Then Great Song is most likely finished!
Thinking of this.
Huang Rong couldn’t help but feel a bit indignant; she was heartbroken and angry at the inaction of the current government!
If they had acted swiftly, got ahead of Mongolia, and appointed Ding Ling as the National Preceptor of Great Song, there wouldn’t be so much trouble now?!
Even Huang Rong and Guo Jing were like this.
Zhu Ziliu, Luu Youjiao, and the others all had their expressions changed, and in an instant, the atmosphere in the hall seemed to freeze.
It was at this moment.
Some of the Martial Arts heroes who didn’t feel much started to deeply realize the importance of Ding Ling today. You could say that Ding Ling was enough to be the last straw to break Great Song!
If he sided with Mongolia, Mongolia would undoubtedly win, and Great Song would be doomed!
If he sided with Great Song, it would also be no easy feat for Mongolia to claim victory!
Ding Ling’s presence was like a weight; whichever side he fell on, that side’s status, dawn, and hope would increase substantially!
Everyone was looking at Ding Ling.
Including Hoduo, but compared to Huang Rong and the others, he was very confident, not expecting Ding Ling would refuse such lucrative conditions.
Ding Ling had been a Prince in the Three Kingdoms era, how could a mere National Preceptor tempt him?
He didn’t even raise his eyebrows, calmly saying:
"Would your Mongolian Great Khan and Princes be so kind-hearted? Aren’t they eager to see me dead?"
He stood tall, Divine Skill operating on its own, a highly oppressive aura rolled towards Hoduo like a mighty wave.
Hoduo’s breath hitched, his face changed drastically, and he couldn’t help but step back three feet, looking at Ding Ling with vigilance and hidden awe, saying:
"I’ve come with genuine sincerity, and I hope Hero Ding won’t doubt that."
He clapped his hands.
Immediately, three or four robust men carried several wooden chests inside.
Bang!
The chests were opened by the strong men.
The golden gleam was so dazzling that it almost blinded everyone in the hall.
"These gold are just a small token. To show our respect and regard for you, Hero Ding!"
The gold must have weighed in at ten thousand taels.
Slam!
Hoduo clapped again.
Another tall man carried a wooden chest inside, opened it, and inside were precious medicines aged hundreds of years!
Slam!
Clapped once more.
A pair of extremely beautiful young girls, who looked exactly alike, walked in and made a courtesy bow to Ding Ling.
"Hero Ding. These hundreds of rare medicines and this pair of the most charming flowers of the grasslands are also gifts from our Great Khan to you. We hope you will accept them."
Hoduo smiled gently, scanning the room with ease, seeing Huang Rong and her group looking extremely serious, felt smug, and couldn’t help but say:

"The respect our Great Khan has for you, Hero Ding, if not as boundless as the river’s flow, is certainly not far off. Hero Ding, the fame you gained at the Battle of Xiangyang has already spread throughout Mongolia. We all hold deep respect and awe for you. This time, we’ve come sincerely in hopes that Hero Ding will join our Mongolian side."
He said solemnly:
"Please rest assured, Hero Ding, we have absolutely no false words this time!"

Though Ding Ling didn’t understand fully, upon thinking about Hoduo’s words, they made some sense. If the Battle of Xiangyang wasn’t enough to intimidate Kublai and the rest, it would indeed be quite incomprehensible.
But he had previously promised Hong Qigong and Guo Jing to guard Xiangyang for them.
Now, asking him to break that promise and switch to Mongolia’s side.
He couldn’t do it.
Towards the enemy, Ding Ling had no qualms about not keeping promises. But towards his own people, towards people worthy of respect, he tried his best to keep his word.
Furthermore.

Kublai had issued a Death Order against him; though not known to all, the word had already spread across the Ten Directions Realm through the mouths of players, and Kublai had never denied it from start to end.
It showed the depth of the murderous intent towards him! The intensity of the killing intent!

The sudden dispatch of Hoduo to entice him with benefits made it hard to say there wouldn’t be any trap. Perhaps he might agree to become National Preceptor, only to be manipulated and suppressed by Kublai and his people right after.
How could they suppress him?
Ding Ling didn’t know, but the fact that he had slaughtered and inflicted heavy casualties on Mongolia, causing them great loss, was an undeniable fact.
What kind of trap would Kublai set for him?
Ding Ling couldn’t guess, nor did he care to guess.
Previously, when he set fire to Shaolin Temple, he was completely wrong in his judgment. If asked to guess this time, he would probably get it wrong again.

After all, the human heart is unpredictable, and Ding Ling wasn’t a tapeworm in other people’s stomachs, it was tough to know how others were plotting without meeting them. If he could meet Hoduo, through Observing People Skill and more, Ding Ling might be able to see some clues, but he couldn’t do it now.

However, through observing Hoduo’s subtle expressions, Ding Ling could broadly gauge that this matter was definitely related to enticement and conspiracy; if he couldn’t figure it out, he would capture Hoduo and interrogate him thoroughly.
Thinking of this.

Ding Ling was about to say a few words when, on the other side, Huang Rong saw Ding Ling remaining silent, her heart involuntarily raised to her throat; at this moment, she couldn’t endure it anymore, stood up, and said:
"Hoduo. Hero Ding is our Great Song’s Hero Ding, do you think you can entice Hero Ding with these beauties, gold, and medicines?!"
She looked towards Ding Ling:
"Hero Ding, please rest assured. I will definitely give you a satisfactory explanation, and will absolutely not let you suffer a loss."

Ding Ling raised his eyebrows, not understanding what Huang Rong meant, but then thought that Huang Rong had indeed been very accommodating to him recently, several times reminding Lü Wende to send him gifts.
Lü Wende’s medicines and Secret Manuals had almost been emptied by him.
Huang Rong herself also did her utmost to win him over, giving him all she could give.
Now, saying this, it goes without saying that she must be ready to speak to the Great Song Court about it!
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling nodded secretly, thinking if the Great Song Court supplied him wholeheartedly, he might soon reach the pinnacle level of this world.
Individual power, family power,
Ultimately cannot compare with the power of a nation.
"Leader Huang."
Hoduo frowned, dissatisfied:
"This is a matter between Hero Ding and me, not for you to interfere!"
He looked sincerely at Ding Ling:

"Hero Ding, our Great Khan’s affection for you, as sincere as the sun and moon bear witness, and the heaven and earth can attest! There’s absolutely no falsehood. The hope for you to become our Mongolian National Preceptor is known throughout the country, with absolutely no deceit or empty words! I hope Hero Ding you can comprehend!"
"Ding Ling..."
Guo Jing couldn’t hold back anymore: "The ambition of the Mongolian wolves is well known, if you agree, you’ll fall right into their trap. Please reconsider."
