chapters.title: Chapter 459: Swallowing the Elixirs
paragraphs: "Yes, Hero Ding. Please reconsider!"
"Hero Ding..."
"Hero Ding..."
In an instant, the hall was filled with voices of sincere and anxious hope, mixed with unease and urging!
It was very obvious.
The martial arts heroes present were all afraid that Ding Ling would agree, which would cause Great Song to lose its advantage! Each one was tense, staring at Ding Ling stiffly.
At this moment.
Ding Ling seemed to have become the center of the world.
Became the origin of the storm!

Hoduo watched on the side, becoming increasingly angry, fearing that Ding Ling would be swayed by the words and affect the plans of Mongolia, immediately furrowing his brows and looking coldly at the crowd, sneering:
"One after another using moral coercion on Hero Ding, don’t you find it despicable and vile?"
His eyes shone as he looked at Ding Ling, cupping his hands respectfully, saying loudly:
"Hero Ding. We in Mongolia admire and fear you greatly! We regard you as the new God of the Prairie! If you follow me to Mongolia as the National Preceptor,
these gifts are just a token. Our Great Khan will surely offer you the best treasures and the most beautiful women in return."
Little Dragon Girl had been listening on the side.

She had no reaction to anything else, but when she heard about the most beautiful flowers on the prairie and the most beautiful women, she couldn’t help but glance at him. She saw the pair of twin girls indeed had bright eyes, fair skin, and a clear, refined beauty.

She turned her gaze to Ding Ling, wanting to see his reaction, and upon seeing Ding Ling not even glancing at the twin beauties, she inexplicably felt a sense of calmness, as if the storm was quelled.
She didn’t care about what others were saying or discussing, only having Ding Ling in her heart and mind; as long as he was well, she felt happy.
"Haha."
Huang Rong couldn’t help but mock:
"Hero Ding is a generation hero; how could he be swayed by your petty gifts? You underestimate Hero Ding too much!"
This was openly flattering Ding Ling.
Yet it was also a fear of Ding Ling being swayed! Having said so much before, Huang Rong still felt it was not enough. Once again, she praised and flattered him under the watchful eyes of everyone.
It was apparent how high and important Ding Ling’s position was in her heart!
In an instant.
The storm raged again.
Huang Rong and Hoduo exchanged sharp words, ’going back and forth,’ refusing to yield.
Though it was a verbal dispute, the scene’s atmosphere was extremely cold and chilling.
Ding Ling saw this couldn’t continue, so he directly said:
"If any of you have the courage, tie up Hoduo and question him to see what Mongolian schemes are aimed against me."
As soon as these words fell.
Huang Rong’s eyes brightened, and without hesitation, she immediately picked up a Dog Beating Stick and rushed towards Hoduo, shouting:
"Brother Jing!"
Guo Jing immediately stepped forward, blocking Hoduo’s path.
Hoduo’s face changed dramatically; his folding fan snapped shut, readying for defense.
Watching as Huang Rong really unceremoniously came at him.
Hoduo defended while loudly saying:
"You shameless bunch. It’s against the rules to harm envoys between two warring nations; do you want to tear down the face? Do you want to ignore the tacit agreement and rules?"
Huang Rong ignored him, displaying the Dog Beating Stick Technique, the stick shadows overwhelming Hoduo instantly.
Hoduo was no match for Huang Rong.
In one move, he was knocked to the ground, and several heroes immediately rushed out from the sides, tying Hoduo up.
Hoduo continued to struggle, shouting:
"Hero Ding, Hero Ding, our Great Khan has sincere feelings for you; you can’t ignore it! Hero Ding..."
Snap!
Hoduo was directly knocked unconscious by someone, then dragged away.
Waiting for him would be some special interrogation techniques from the martial arts heroes.
"Whew."
Huang Rong saw Hoduo was really taken away, and only then did her suspended heart settle down completely. She solemnly looked at Ding Ling and said:
"Please rest assured, Hero Ding. What I promised you, I will always keep in mind! Strive to complete our promise as soon as possible."
Ding Ling didn’t answer definitively.
He, through Observing People Skill, performance skills, psychology, and other full-level skills, could somewhat see through Huang Rong’s thoughts.
She was worried he might be dissatisfied with the Great Song Court and thus defect to Mongolia.
Or be swayed by temptation and ignore the battle at Xiangyang.
"We will also give Hero Ding a satisfactory explanation for Hoduo’s matter as soon as possible."
Under everyone’s watchful eyes, Huang Rong called him Hero Ding at every turn, giving Ding Ling plenty of face. Ding Ling didn’t act proud and simply said:
"We’re so familiar, just use my name."
Huang Rong smiled slightly, feeling more relaxed:
"Alright. Ding Ling, we’re friends. Being too formal is my fault."
She looked at the gold, great medicine, and the pair of bewildered beauties, saying:
"How do you plan to deal with them?"
"I’ll take the gold and great medicine. Let the twin girls return from where they came."
"Alright."
Huang Rong nodded, immediately letting people move the great medicine and gold to Ding Ling’s room.
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate.
After returning to the room.
He immediately began consuming the great medicine.
Over a hundred plants of great medicine more than two hundred years old!
Crunch, crunch!
Ding Ling finished eating a two-hundred-year-old great medicine.
He activated the Five Great Breathing Techniques for rapid refinement.
There was no indication of four-dimensional attribute points.
Ding Ling carefully sensed it, and only felt a warm sensation flowing through his limbs before disappearing shortly, realizing he had eaten too much great medicine before.
The two-hundred-year-old great medicine no longer had much effect on him.
So he picked up the three-hundred-year-old ones to eat.
This time after eating.
Almost instantly.
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
[Defense +0.1]
The refinement of the Five Great Breathing Techniques was as uniform as ever.
Ding Ling began to sweep through.
His Qingnang Scripture and Medicine King Breathing Technique were all at full level, allowing him to clearly see the approximate age of these great medicines.
Most were two hundred years old, around fifty plants.
Three hundred years old, thirty plants.
Others were four to five hundred years old.

Clearly, those over a thousand years old were not something the Great Khan of Mongolia would bring out at this time. If Ding Ling went to Mongolia as National Preceptor, perhaps he would enjoy thousand-year-old medicine.
But perhaps he would fall into a larger trap.
Ding Ling dared not underestimate the ancients.

Kebineng teamed up with Hai Dafu, Hong Antong, and others, supporting his thousands of elite army troops, and player groups, burning down Shaolin Temple, stealing Nine Yang Divine Skill, and perfectly framing him.
From this point alone, it could be seen that the cunning and strategy of the ancients were definitely not inferior to modern people.
This was just Kebineng.
If it were Zhuge Liang, Guo Jia, Liu Bowen and the like, Ding Ling probably would have to kneel!
So Ding Ling chose to strengthen his skills as always, just like the Three Kingdoms World, where he was strong enough that Guo Jia could only ’sigh’ and ’comply obediently’!
Crunch, crunch!
All the great medicine, as soon as they entered his stomach, would be rapidly refined.
The Five Great Breathing Techniques operated simultaneously, and no medicinal power could withstand a blink’s refinement.
Therefore.
After eating.
Ding Ling’s four-dimensional attributes immediately increased:
[Strength +4.1]
[Agility +3.9]
[Constitution +2.1]
[Defense +4.1]
This was still due to the increasing resistance from eating great medicine.
As things progressed.
The effect of the four to five hundred year great medicine was constantly decreasing on Ding Ling. Three hundred years were even less worth mentioning.
After eating the great medicine.
Strength increase status:
[Root bone 3 (ordinary person is 1 point), Wisdom 4.2, Strength 59.3, Agility 60, Constitution 60, Defense 52.2, Charm 11.7]

chapters.title: Chapter 460: Conspiracy
paragraphs: Agility and constitution both reach the world’s extreme values.
Strength is just a bit away from reaching the extreme value!
Ding Ling carefully perceives his own situation.

Regardless of other bonuses, just in terms of physical defense, it’s like wearing five or six layers of leather armor. If you add the innate Gang Qi defense of the Nine Yang Divine Skill, Ding Ling’s defense is elevated once again, even a Half-Step Innate Expert would struggle to break through it!
Such power!
It’s not an exaggeration to call Ding Ling a Land God.
Standing there letting ordinary people chop or hack at him, he remains utterly unharmed!
"Aside from true experts being able to hurt me, ordinary people are like dead grass to me."
Ding Ling clenches his fist and ponders:
"Even though my defense now is quite inferior compared to when reinforced with Celestial Might, in some aspects it’s not inferior at all."
At such a level.
A torrential rain of arrows falls.
Unless the accumulated attack strength reaches the level of a Half-Step Innate Expert, it can’t break his defense.
But if it accumulates to that strength, it could breach his defense.
But Ding Ling won’t just stand there and let the enemies hit him!
Moreover, the size and area covered by the rain of arrows is limited. He is only so big; how many arrows could actually hit him?
Unless a group of First-class Experts shoot at him, some of the rain of arrows could potentially break his defense.
Arrows shot by ordinary soldiers, covering him, are likely ineffective shots.
Even if it’s waves upon waves, endless arrows.
It’s still ineffective.
Because his Nine Yang Divine Skill is always active; the recovery speed of its Gang Qi is exceptionally fast, not to mention his inherent defense, which also has strong repair abilities.
"So, right now I’m invincible."
Ding Ling smiles faintly, very satisfied.
Finally, in this aspect, he can be compared to when reinforced with Celestial Might.
It’s fair to say that he is now comparable to a Land God.
"Physical qualities are close to reaching the world’s extreme. My Inner Power cultivation level is still somewhat uncertain."
Ding Ling continues chewing on the Great Medicine.
Of the remaining two hundred years of Great Medicine, there are fifty left.
Ding Ling chooses to refine using the Nine Yang Divine Skill and Nine Yin Scripture.
Because the Nine Yang Divine Skill and others are at full level, refining is very fast.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
The Spiritual Essence and Primordial Qi within the Great Medicine are completely refined.
His Inner Power is continuously rising.
Soon after.
He finished consuming all the two hundred years of Great Medicine.
[Inner Power Value +30]
Although far from splitting True Water.
It’s somewhat better than nothing.
The power boost.
Gives Ding Ling more confidence in future battles.
In the evening.
Huang Rong comes to find Ding Ling, discussing Hoduo’s problem.
In the choice between ’choosing the Great Song not to slay the envoy’ stance or standing with Ding Ling.
Huang Rong decisively chooses to stand with Ding Ling.
And very swiftly extracted the information Ding Ling wished for from Hoduo.
Just what method did Huang Rong use?
Just how much suffering did Hoduo endure?
Ding Ling is unaware.
He only cares about the result.

"Ding Ling, Kublai’s desire to kill you is undying. This time sending you north to Mongolia as Left National Preceptor is purely for appeasement. Hoping you’d not aid Xiangyang, they also wish to use you as a knife for Mongolia.
Of course, they are prepared for the worst scenario. That is, if you refuse to cooperate, they will choose to ambush and kill you on the spot!"
"Ambush?"
Little Dragon Girl’s clear eyes widen, her face full of surprise and anger:
"Hoduo didn’t say that."
"Indeed."
Huang Rong says:
"Hoduo came with a mission this time, he couldn’t possibly reveal the truth. However, Hoduo holds a high position in Mongolia and knows quite a bit.
He knows how Kublai plans to kill you.
They have more than a dozen methods.

First: Arrange traps in your mansion bedroom, letting you fall into a prison made of Divine Iron! No matter how strong your force is, you can’t escape. Then starve you for ten days, half a month, cooperate and possibly live, otherwise starve to death. Even if you cooperate, they’ll use the deadliest poison to control you.
Second:

During negotiations, arrange traps. Surround you with Shizhi Water and Petroleum infused by Kebineng. Shizhi Water appears like regular water but is hard to extinguish once ignited. Utilizing Death Warriors to corner you, burying both you and them in that negotiating valley.
Third:
Bestow lavish gifts at a bound location, impersonating Kublai to meet you, then initiate traps, causing you to fall into a deep well, burying you alive.
Fourth..."
A total of more than a dozen techniques.
Each is heart-shattering!
Little Dragon Girl listens with tension, anxiety, furious beyond belief, gripping onto Ding Ling’s clothes tightly, afraid he might disappear any moment.
Ding Ling sighs deeply:
"It’s indeed genuine. Kublai is truly well-prepared, it’s no wonder he isn’t afraid of me."
All those methods combined.
No matter the prowess Ding Ling has, he might indeed encounter disaster.
He secretly feels fortunate. Thanks to a spur of insight, he had Huang Rong interrogate Hoduo, otherwise, he might not have thought Kublai would take such measures against him.
Indeed, quite ruthless.
But since understanding both sides are already like fire and water, incompatible.
Ding Ling says:
"Let me meet Hoduo."
"Alright."
Sometime later.
Ding Ling sees Hoduo, tortured miserably, almost not like a human.

Ding Ling raises an eyebrow, glancing at Huang Rong, seeing her unaffected demeanor, realizing, after years of war and slaughter, even Huang Rong has become hardened, the battle’s horror is far worse, she could face it calmly, and this, naturally, pales in comparison.
Ding Ling is proficient in medicine.
After spending days, he heals Hoduo and requests him to take him to Golden Wheel Dharma King.
Huang Rong is puzzled why Ding Ling is seemingly entering a trap.
Ding Ling smiles lightly:
"Relax, knowing their plans, they can do nothing to me."
This time, Ding Ling chooses to travel alone with Hoduo.
Little Dragon Girl wanted to follow, Ding Ling says:
"I’ll go alone, it’ll be quicker."
Little Dragon Girl knows Ding Ling’s Lightweight Skill is superb, afraid to slow him down, biting her lip, resolves to train harder, meanwhile saying:
"If you’re not back within seven days, I will search for you."
"Don’t worry, seven days are enough."

Ding Ling smiles and carries Hoduo, simultaneously activating Spiral Nine Shadows, Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill, Serpentine Weasel Maneuver, Cloud-Piercing Step, Golden Swan Skill, and various Lightweight Body Techniques, instantly, like a great bird spreading its wings, soaring dozens of feet into the air, dragging Hoduo, like a gust flying to the horizon, vanishing in the blink of an eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 461: A Maiden’s Heart
paragraphs: "So fast."
Huang Rong was moved:
"So high! Such lightweight skill is truly astonishing and unheard of!"
In mid-air, he leapt several tens of feet; typical city walls were only two or three feet high, and even the higher ones might just be five or six feet.
Ding Ling leaped several tens of feet high in mid-air, and there was no wall in this world that could stop his steps.
Flying high was something.
But flying extremely far, extremely fast!
In just the blink of an eye, he disappeared, this kind of lightweight skill was truly something Huang Rong couldn’t even hope to match, and she couldn’t help but be full of admiration.
"If my father were here, he would probably be extremely shocked to see such lightweight skill!"
"Indeed."
Guo Jing wholly agreed:

"I don’t even know how many lightweight skills Ding Ling has learned. Just by watching him fly through the void, one can see traces of the Spiral Nine Shadows, Golden Swan Skill, Serpent Walking Skill, and other lightweight techniques, not to mention many other lightweight techniques which I can’t even recognize."
"True."
Huang Rong looked full of awe:

"Fortunately, we stood firmly by Ding Ling’s side; otherwise, with Ding Ling’s magical lightweight skills, coming and going without a trace, it would be difficult to escape his assassins even deep within the Imperial Palace."
She looked at Little Dragon Girl:
"Little Dragon Girl, having such a husband must make others extremely envious."
Hearing this, Little Dragon Girl couldn’t help but show a brilliant smile: "I also feel that having such a husband must mean I accumulated good fortune and virtue in a past life!"
Others praising Ding Ling made her even happier than being praised herself.
Not to mention praising the couple together.
That made Little Dragon Girl involuntarily beam with joy.
"Who knows when Ding Ling will return?"
Guo Jing was a bit worried:
"Should I take a group to see?"

"Ding Ling took Hoduo along, obviously planning to use him as a guide. He shouldn’t be rash in charging ahead. Brother Jing, if you’re really uneasy, you can send someone to scout first. If there’s any activity, we’ll act accordingly."
"Alright."
Guo Jing hurriedly went to take care of it.
Little Dragon Girl thought for a moment, then went to Ding Ling’s room and began her closed-door training on the Breathing Technique.
Da and Xiao Wu had recovered during this time.
Although their injuries had healed.
They still dared not face Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl, constantly avoiding them.
Upon hearing Ding Ling had left, and Little Dragon Girl was in seclusion, they dared to invite Guo Fu out to play.
However, everywhere they went, they heard people discussing Ding Ling.
The three of them were utterly depressed, and their mood to play had waned. After returning home, Guo Fu was still there, sulking:

"My parents have defended Xiangyang much longer than Ding Ling has been around. Originally, they were regarded as the Guardian Gods of Xiangyang. How come when Ding Ling arrived, everyone’s attitude changed towards me, too? It wasn’t as good as before.

I don’t even know who spread these rumors. Someone said I cursed Ding Ling and his wife. It’s infuriating; how dare I curse them? I was just reasoning with them. Even so, I was heavily scolded by my mother. I’ve taken my punishment and suffered my hardship.
Yet behind my back, people still criticize me."
Guo Fu felt so upset that her eyes reddened.
Da and Xiao Wu fussed about, trying to comfort her.
But they dared not speak ill of Ding Ling and his wife anymore.
After their father’s madness episode, he left Xiangyang and disappeared.
The two could only keep watch over Guo Fu day and night, hoping she could marry one of them. But ever since Ding Ling arrived, Guo Fu has been constantly talking about Ding Ling.
Even if what she says isn’t very pleasant.
They felt utterly conflicted, as if their emotions had been thrown into turmoil.
But compared to Ding Ling?
They didn’t have the courage for that.
The gap was just too large.
Just thinking about that day’s fierce battlefield made their scalps tingle, Ding Ling killed so many people, they couldn’t even keep count.
On that day.
Even from afar, they seemed to smell the pungent scent of blood on Ding Ling’s body.
"Do you think Ding Ling looks down on me? Does he completely ignore me?"
Guo Fu suddenly asked.
Why bring up Ding Ling again?
Can’t you stop mentioning him!!
The Wu Brothers grumbled silently in their hearts but didn’t dare confront Guo Fu, only exhausting themselves thinking of ways to comfort her.
"He doesn’t even look at me properly! In my entire life, no one has ever treated me this way! Comparing myself to Little Dragon Girl, am I really so much worse? Am I not beautiful?!"
"Beautiful, very beautiful!"
"Who is more beautiful, me or Little Dragon Girl?"
"You are more beautiful!"
"Hmph. At least you know what’s good for you."
Guo Fu felt slightly better, pouted her lips, and started talking again:
"But Ding Ling..."
Again with Ding Ling...
The Wu Brothers felt powerless, helpless, and inept. They wanted to cry but had no tears!
Little did they know.
Ding Ling had been staying with the Guo family for some time.

Being highly valued by Huang Rong and Guo Jing, the couple often talked about and praised Ding Ling during conversations and meals. Guo Fu heard it often and couldn’t help but take note, secretly and curiously observing Ding Ling, wondering if he was really as remarkable as her parents claimed.
What an incredible discovery it was.
She found Ding Ling nearly perfect in music, chess, calligraphy, painting, and more, reaching a level her grandfather, the Master of Peach Blossom Island, couldn’t match.
The young maiden, at an age prone to emotions.

After anger and depression, being constantly exposed to such an outstanding, handsome man, she couldn’t help but be attracted. But because of past grievances, she couldn’t bring herself to reconcile with Ding Ling straight away, so she could only vent secretly, talking of her grievances with the Wu Brothers.
Adopting a mental victory strategy reminiscent of Ah Q!
Whirr!
The strong wind blew past his ears.
Sweeping through Hoduo’s eyes, making it hard for him to open them.
He watched as Ding Ling carried him, swiftly traversing and flying over, roofs flashing by beneath them, and even the tall watchtowers of Xiangyang City were left in their wake by Ding Ling’s flight.
Such astonishing lightweight skill and speed.
When had Hoduo ever seen such?
His heart surged with waves, feeling as if they might overturn him entirely:
"Hero Ding, I have something to say."
His voice was distorted by the strong wind, making it hard for others to understand.
But Ding Ling heard him clearly and looked slightly down at Hoduo, saying:
"Speak quickly!"

As he flew swiftly along, like the wind and lightning, at full capacity, his speed was indescribable. With high agility and the Fusion Qi driven by the Nine Yang Divine Skill and Five Great Breathing Techniques, Ding Ling’s speed surpassed galloping horses and his endurance far exceeded that of bears and tigers. At this moment, flying low, he flew five or six miles in one breath, lightly tapping a treetop mid-air, propelling himself like a cannonball, soaring furiously to the distance.
It could be said.
By this point.
Ding Ling was no different from an ordinary Martial God.
In terms of lightweight skill and endurance, there were almost no people in this world who could surpass him.

chapters.title: Chapter 462: Gale Thunderbolt Skill Full Level
paragraphs: "I, I want to say, can you fly a bit slower."
Hoduo looked uncomfortable:
"I feel like throwing up."
"Don’t throw up on me!"
Ding Ling’s face slightly changed:
"Otherwise, I won’t let you off!"
Hoduo had to endure it with all his might.
When had he ever seen such a strong person? Such lightweight skill, he was already scared senseless.
It was also at this moment.
He wholeheartedly believed the words of those returning soldiers.
The battle of Xiangyang.
Most of the returning soldiers were lost, their spirits shattered;
each was in a state of confusion, their hearts unsure.
Those slightly better off seemed to be extremely frightened, it took a long time for them to recover and be able to narrate what happened completely.
What they said was terrifying.
Hoduo was somewhat skeptical, but everyone said the same, he had no choice but to believe.
There were quite a few people who thought like him.
That was why he came to Xiangyang this time, he just didn’t expect Ding Ling to be so unreasonable, directly going hard and messing up many of Kublai’s plans.
Involuntarily disheartened, he even had thoughts of dying.
He also didn’t want to reveal the plan, but the enemy was too ruthless, too cunning, too deceitful, he couldn’t withstand it!
’If I had known Ding Ling was so unconventional, I’d never have come to Xiangyang City!’
Originally thought it was a good job.
He could even come to Xiangyang to select some beauties to bring back to Mongolia.
Unexpectedly, he suffered such a huge loss.
But also this could be seen.
In the hearts of Huang Rong and her husband, Ding Ling’s importance clearly surpassed that of the Great Song Court!
The power of one person, to this extent!
"Whoosh whoosh!"
Ding Ling flew forward continuously, nothing could stop his progress.
He even skimmed across a wide river.
Even while holding someone, he could fly like this.
Hoduo was astounded, unable to imagine how fast and high Ding Ling would fly alone.
Whoosh!
Ding Ling kept flying towards secluded areas, to him, paths, mountain trails, forests didn’t make much of a difference.
He was already at the point where he could touch treetops and borrow their strength to fly.
So it was at this stage.

He realized how superior Dongfang Bubai’s lightweight body technique was, undoubtedly, Dongfang Bubai must have cultivated a particularly advanced lightweight skill, otherwise, he couldn’t be so exceptional.

After Ding Ling cultivated the Spiral Nine Shadows and Golden Swan Skill, he could leap tens of meters high, but if it were the Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill or Flying Swallow Technique, he wouldn’t be able to achieve this.
The Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill was remarkable for straight paths, but not suitable for flying high, turning, or skimming.
The Flying Swallow Technique was extremely agile, other aspects were just average.
While Spiral Nine Shadows and Golden Swan Skill did not face these obstacles.
Especially Spiral Nine Shadows, it was comprehensive!
And Ding Ling, through merging vigorous qi, and simultaneously driving several lightweight body techniques, his lightweight skill level was predictably high!
And thus.
He skimmed over hills, forests, mountains, plains...
Flown over more than two hundred miles, by the time the moon was high, Ding Ling brought Hoduo to a military camp outside.
Ding Ling lightly landed on the tip of a large tree.

He grabbed Hoduo by the neck like a kitten, Hoduo was already drained from the long flight, he couldn’t believe Ding Ling had flown so far for so long and was still full of energy as if he hadn’t exerted any effort at all, horrified in his heart: Is this guy human or ghost? Or a god?!
"Is Kublai’s camp just ahead?"
Ding Ling peered towards the camp, looking sideways as he asked.
"That’s right."
Hoduo replied softly:
"But the commander is not here. It’s a decoy death warrior posing as him to lure you into the trap, which is the first setup."
"Hmm."
Ding Ling nodded, neither agreeing nor disagreeing.
"Is your master here?"
"Yes."
Hoduo replied:
"My master will coordinate with the death warrior to complete the mission. His strength is the highest, once the mission is finished, he’ll leave here immediately."
"Tell me about the cultivation techniques and moves you practice."
Ding Ling, holding Hoduo, floated down from the treetop and threw him onto the ground, looking down indifferently:
"If you don’t speak, don’t blame me for torturing you. You know I’m proficient in Medical Dao. Someone like me, if intending to torture someone, would definitely make someone unable to live nor die!"
Hoduo shivered, not daring to resist, obediently recounting his martial arts techniques.
It was a technique called "Gale Thunderbolt Skill."
After reciting the heart techniques and moves.
Ding Ling slightly recalled.
Immediately, related books emerged on the library shelves.
Then swiftly.
[Gale Thunderbolt Skill Inner Power Heart Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +80]
Ding Ling’s inner power value increased.
Simultaneously.
[Gale Thunderbolt Skill External Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Defense +0.1]
Agility and Physique had reached the world’s limit values. Their energy values were converted into defense.
Compared to before.
Ding Ling’s current conversion rate of Five Great Breathing Techniques was significantly higher.
It doesn’t waste as much.
With strength and defense enhanced a bit, Ding Ling sensed his strength was one step closer to the world’s limit.
Strength has reached 59.5.
Just 0.5 away from the limit.
This refers to the physical strength limit.
But actually, the force Ding Ling could exert was already countless tons. The force was so great, shattering mountains and rocks was effortless.
"Unexpected that Hoduo’s martial arts also comprise both internal and external skills."
Ding Ling slightly turned to look.
Although this Gale Thunderbolt Skill couldn’t compare to Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms or Toad Skill.
But it’s a first-class supreme method, extremely formidable.
Thinking how Hoduo could exchange near a thousand moves with Master Yideng’s disciple Zhu Ziliu, it’s clear of his prowess!
Ding Ling inquired about the origin of the technique.
Hoduo said it was a branch of the Esoteric Sect.
And mentioned:

"The Esoteric Sect holds many methods, many people have different cultivation techniques, mine and my senior brother Darma’s techniques are different, and even from my master, Golden Wheel Dharma King’s, it’s completely different."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling suddenly remembered about the cultivation method, hence he stopped to ask.
He initially hoped to extract some information about Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill from Hoduo.
But now it seems unrealistic.
Sure enough.
After asking, though Hoduo knew about this technique, he hadn’t practiced it, in his words, one could train for a lifetime without mastering it, why practice it?

Ding Ling understood, Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill wasn’t made for human cultivation. Training for thousands and thousands of years, even with limited lifespans, martial arts immortals would be exasperated!
Only those claiming unmatched talent dared to charge ahead, but without exception, none had reached beyond the tenth level!
Only Golden Wheel Dharma King reached the tenth level.
But now, the Golden Wheel Dharma King definitely hadn’t reached that level.
Ding Ling pondered this, then lifted Hoduo, flying up again.

sentences.text: "I, I want to say, can you fly a bit slower."
Hoduo looked uncomfortable:
"I feel like throwing up."
"Don’t throw up on me!"
Ding Ling’s face slightly changed:
"Otherwise, I won’t let you off!"
Hoduo had to endure it with all his might.
When had he ever seen such a strong person?

The battle of Xiangyang.

each was in a state of confusion, their hearts unsure.

What they said was terrifying.

There were quite a few people who thought like him.
That was why he came to Xiangyang this time, he just didn’t expect Ding Ling to be so unreasonable, directly going hard and messing up many of Kublai’s plans.
Involuntarily disheartened, he even had thoughts of dying.

He was already at the point where he could touch treetops and borrow their strength to fly.

Especially Spiral Nine Shadows, it was comprehensive!

And thus.
He skimmed over hills, forests, mountains, plains...

chapters.title: Chapter 463: Killing the Enemy with a Flick of the Finger
paragraphs: Whoosh!

Ding Ling leaped into the air, soaring more than ten zhang high, walking on air, with his clothes fluttering. Under the moonlit night, he seemed like a deity strolling through the void, exuding an unparalleled, noble and elegant demeanor.
Hoduo couldn’t help but turn his head, secretly thinking to himself:
"This Ding Ling is truly against the heavens. My Gale Thunderbolt Skill, he seemed to have mastered it just by hearing me describe it once."
Just now, after Ding Ling practiced the Gale Thunderbolt Skill to full level, the scene of Eight-direction Primordial Qi swarming towards him was witnessed by Hoduo, who was shocked beyond belief:

"No wonder this person has achieved such incredible fortune at such a young age. If I, as a prince, had such a heaven-defying talent, I would have already dominated Jiuzhou and ascended to the throne, without having to suffer here!"
He was intensely envious, jealous, and resentful of Ding Ling.
But he did not dare to show his jealousy and hatred openly, hiding it deep in his heart instead.
What kind of person is Ding Ling?
Although he was not skilled in intrigues, conspiracies, or petty schemes.

But his Observing People Skill and acting capabilities were at full level. When he observed people up close, he could see through them instantly. He knew Hoduo’s intentions, estimating that he even wanted to tear him to pieces.
Given the situation.
Ding Ling certainly had no reason to keep him around; the only reason he kept him was to use him as a guide.
Compared to others with integrity.
A petty character like Hoduo was easier to deal with. If it were someone like Xu Sheng from the Three Kingdoms, even if he died, Huang Rong wouldn’t be able to extract any information from him.
Whoosh!

Ding Ling stepped on the treetops, lightly using them as leverage. With a quick leap, he covered two or three miles, landing softly in the military camp like a drifting maple leaf, where everything was silent as the soldiers seemed to be resting.
Only on two of the watchtowers were a few soldiers still on guard.

Ding Ling flicked his fingers, and under the influence of the Finger-Pointing Divine Technique, several stones flew towards the watchtowers, accompanied by two soft popping sounds, easily taking care of those soldiers.

Ding Ling’s Finger-Pointing Divine Technique was at full level, and his Nine Yang Divine Skill was at Great Perfection, making the use of force exquisite and unmatched. These stones were thrown with just the right amount of force, causing the soldiers to collapse quietly, without disturbing anyone else.
Hoduo watched in shock, deeply impressed by this level of skill, thinking that even his master, the Golden Wheel Dharma King, would begrudgingly fall short.
He dared not be arrogant and could only obediently serve as a guide.
He had already told Ding Ling everything before.
So Ding Ling was somewhat familiar with the layout of the camp.
At this moment, he swiftly scouted around like lightning, gaining a clear understanding.
Indeed, as Hoduo mentioned.

There was a huge trap here, right at the Central Army Tent. At first glance, the soil seemed normal, but upon closer inspection, it was abnormal. It was temporarily stabilized by a mechanism, making the ground flat and solid.
However, if the mechanism were activated.
The flat ground would instantly flip, crushing anyone beneath it into a deep pit, unable to escape!
Of course.
Along with him, the entire Central Army Tent would also fall into the pit!
Stepping into the Central Army Tent was tantamount to stepping into Kublai’s well-laid deadly trap.
Such a tactic.
If he hadn’t known beforehand, how could Ding Ling have understood it?
If he wasn’t careful, he could have been doomed. Thinking about it, Ding Ling’s murderous intent towards Kublai increased significantly.
After the Death Order.
He intentionally lured him, using the Blinding Technique to set up an Illusion Array and absolute formations! If Kublai didn’t cooperate, he would be killed mercilessly!
How could there be only him, Kublai, killing others in this world?
No room for Ding Ling to retaliate?

Ding Ling ignored the Central Army Tent, continuously using the Finger-Pointing Divine Technique. Stones were abundant on the ground, and by channeling Vigorous Qi, he could grab a handful from the air. Ding Ling flicked as he walked, whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Each stone flew like an arrow through the air, striking with the force of thunder, accompanied by muffled sounds, and soldiers fell one by one.
In just a moment.
The soldiers standing guard outside the tent and those who hadn’t yet fallen asleep inside all died.
Ding Ling’s Finger-Pointing Divine Technique, boosted by Fusion Qi, could penetrate mountains and rocks easily. How could ordinary soldiers, mere mortals, withstand it?
Hoduo watched from the side, feeling terrorized.
He now had a deeper understanding of Ding Ling’s ruthless decisiveness.
Once this person had murderous intent, he would hold nothing back.
In no time.
Ding Ling arrived outside the tent where the Golden Wheel Dharma King was.
Inside the tent, an oil lamp was still lit, casting a flickering light, boom!
The tent’s entrance suddenly opened, and out strode a tall, robust man wearing a yellow robe, with a slightly dented forehead, who shouted loudly:
"What are you up to, sneaking around in the middle of the night?"
His voice was like thunder, resounding in all directions.
Some soldiers who hadn’t been killed were startled, grabbing their weapons and rushing out from the camp, shouting.
Ding Ling activated the Acupressure Chapter of the Nine Yin Scripture, casually hitting Hoduo’s acupoint, throwing him aside, with eyes fixed on the man, saying:
"Are you the Golden Wheel Dharma King?"
"Indeed."
The towering man sized up Ding Ling:
"You captured my third disciple and came to this camp alone. Besides Ding Ling, who else in the world would dare to have such courage and skill? You must be the famous Ding Ling, Hero Ding."
He spoke with certainty.
Ding Ling neither confirmed nor denied, his gaze sweeping over the surrounding soldiers gathering around.
There were quite a few soldiers, numbering five or six hundred.
Ding Ling had already killed quite a few before.

But apparently, these people who were asleep escaped death, now awakened by the Golden Wheel Dharma King’s shout, coming to kill, with bows bent and arrows ready, or holding long spears and single-edged swords, facing Ding Ling, exuding killing intent and fierce expressions.
From the look of it, these people hadn’t participated in the battle of Xiangyang and didn’t recognize Ding Ling, so there were no signs of retreat.
It was clear.
These people must have been meticulously chosen by Kublai as death warriors, solely to assist the Golden Wheel Dharma King in killing Ding Ling.
Ding Ling understood, and naturally wouldn’t show mercy. Immediately, with a hearty laugh, he shouted loudly:

"Indeed, I am Ding Ling. I came this time to meet with you, Dharma King. However, there are too many bothersome little shrimp here, obstructing the view. Let me clear them away first, and then we can have a good discussion."
Boom!

Ding Ling stomped the ground hard, causing the earth to crack. Numerous stones were shaken into the air. With a casual grab of both hands, he seized a large handful, then activated Fusion Qi, flicking his fingers continuously!
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!

Each stone flew through the air, like silk sweeping the sky and more like lightning flashing. Before many soldiers realized, they were pierced through the chest and abdomen by the stones, screaming as they fell dead to the ground.
"Kill him!"
The soldiers roared, howling.
Some shot arrows toward Ding Ling.
Others charged recklessly towards Ding Ling’s position, holding large knives high, attempting to hack Ding Ling to death.

chapters.title: Chapter 464: Ding Ling vs. Golden Wheel Dharma King
paragraphs: Ding Ling remained unmoved.
But the speed of his ten fingers flicking kept getting faster!
Whiz! Whiz!
It was like the Death God urging souls, more like Yama demanding life, calling for your death before midnight, without any chance of letting you live till dawn.
Only the dense swishing sound was heard crossing the Celestial Extreme, and upon looking again, a ground of fallen soldiers lay before them.
The Golden Wheel Dharma King was furious, without a word, he shook his hand, boom! Five wheels were simultaneously thrown towards Ding Ling’s direction.
The wheels spun incredibly fast in the void, constantly rotating, flipping, crisscrossing, perfectly coordinated like a small elite team arranged in formation.
As they sliced through on their way, one flagpole was effortlessly cut off by one of the wheels, showing the wheels’ sharpness at a glance.
The five wheels spun like lightning, directly targeting the vital spots around Ding Ling.
Ding Ling slightly raised his brows, and continued to flick the stones with one hand, while the other hand gently flipped over, but directly a palm was shot towards the five wheels.
Splitting Sky Palm!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Consecutively, five palms struck out.
Each palm was propelled with Fusion Qi, further enhanced with his inherent strength, the Palm Force so condensed that they manifested as tangible palm prints in the void!
Only a few banging sounds were heard, the palm prints of the Splitting Sky Palm hit directly on the bodies of the five wheels, and with a cracking sound, three wheels shattered on the spot.
The wheels, still mid-air, shattered into over a dozen pieces, the fragments scattering out, some even shot far enough to pierce through a soldier’s neck with mere residual force!
The Golden Wheel Dharma King, bearing the brunt, couldn’t help but stagger back more than ten steps, barely avoiding the deadly hit.
"Such strong Splitting Void Palm Force!"
The Golden Wheel Dharma King was shocked in his heart:

"Such power, how could it be cultivated without a hundred years? Your young age has such fortunes, unwilling to serve the Great Khan of Mongolia, yet attempting with your strength alone to save the Great Song, don’t you find it laughable?"
"Hmph."
Ding Ling coldly snorted, chose not to entangle with the soldiers, and in a flash, like a specter, advanced right to the Golden Wheel Dharma King’s front, striking a palm at his chest.
"Ah!"

The Golden Wheel Dharma King roared in anger, his five wheels, except for the golden and silver ones, were shattered, and even those had been knocked to the ground, making it too late to retrieve them now, so he could only muster all his lifelong power, gathering the force of the Ninth-Layer Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill into his right palm.
He also struck a palm towards Ding Ling’s direction.
Bang!

The two palms collided, producing a loud bang, Ding Ling remained unmoved, unwavering like a mountain, while the Golden Wheel Dharma King was sent flying more than ten zhang away, unable to help but spit out a stream of blood in mid-air.
"So, so strong!"
The Golden Wheel Dharma King’s heart was in turmoil, unable to calm down for a long while.
This time coming south to the Central Plains, was to witness the prowess of the Central Plains’ experts, but Ding Ling’s strength exceeded his imagination!
Totally not a match.

The recent palm clash was akin to striking a stone with an egg, a mantis trying to stop a chariot, an ant shaking a tree, filling the Golden Wheel Dharma King with a sense of powerlessness, he was shocked, terrified, incredulous as to how Ding Ling, at such a young age, could possess such profound and unfathomable power!
It made him feel incredibly small, as if facing Mount Tai or the vast sea.
The gap was this vast!
How could this be possible!
Bang!
The Golden Wheel Dharma King heavily fell to the ground, wounded upon wounded, couldn’t help but spit out another mouthful of thick blood.

His right arm was broken, unable to muster any strength, so he could only use his left hand to barely stand up, and what greeted his eyes was Ding Ling using an extremely mystical palm technique slaughtering soldiers en masse.
Roar!
In every move, dragon roars resounded in waves.

From time to time, dragon-shaped phantoms could be seen racing across the void, finally crashing into the soldiers’ ranks, it was clear, wherever Ding Ling passed, it was a bloodbath, no one could withstand a single round against Ding Ling.

With just his pair of bare palms, he kept advancing, casually striking, and a gust of palm wind surged, and dragon-shaped phantoms shot out from within, with the palm wind, sweeping across large areas.
In just a moment.
Ding Ling broke through the soldiers’ ranks.
Behind him lay a ground full of fallen soldiers.
Wrecked like dry rot!
Mount Tai crushing eggs!
Nothing more!
Whizz!
Ding Ling stood once again before the Golden Wheel Dharma King.

He stood with his hands behind him, his clothes flapping loudly in the fierce wind, he slightly lowered his head looking at the Golden Wheel Dharma King, his eyes glowed brilliantly in the night, as if a deity overlooking mortals, making one’s heart instinctively tremble with fear!
Though the Golden Wheel Dharma King wasn’t to the extent like this, he couldn’t help getting goosebumps, chilled to the bone, unknowingly breaking out in a cold sweat:
"Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms?!"
He thought of a palm technique:
"Did you receive Guo Jing’s true inheritance?
Ding Ling didn’t answer him, only said:
"Golden Wheel Dharma King, I specifically came for you this time."
"For me?"
The Golden Wheel Dharma King was taken aback, very puzzled:
"If you came for me, why cause such a massacre?! Creating needless karma?"
"If the world wants to kill me, shall I not kill, and instead carve my flesh to feed the eagle, do you think I’m the Western Heaven Buddha or the reincarnation of Bodhisattva Guanyin?"
Ding Ling’s expression was indifferent and cold:

"Golden Wheel Dharma King. I won’t hide it from you. I want your Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill. If you give me the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, I can not only teach you one of my supreme skills but also let you and Hoduo leave safely, not harming your lives in any way, what do you think?"
Hoduo, upon hearing this, was overjoyed, couldn’t help but shout loudly:
"Master, agree to his terms!"
Hoduo had been incapacitated, unable to move, but could still speak.
Having just witnessed Ding Ling’s remarkable power, killing as effortlessly as slaughtering chickens, left him terrified and his soul fled, he dared not oppose Ding Ling!
Only thinking of gaining freedom quickly, staying far away from this killer star.
Upon hearing the opportunity, how could he ignore it, he immediately shouted out:

"Master, as long as the green hills remain, there’s no worry about firewood! We are still young, the future is promising, it’s just a Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill! Giving it to Hero Ding and getting one of his supreme skills is such a profitable deal, Master..."
"Shut up!"
The Golden Wheel Dharma King glowered at Hoduo, disdainfully saying:
"A cowardly fool, having taken you as my disciple is truly the greatest misfortune in my life!"
"Master, you..."
Hoduo was dumbfounded.
"Hmph!"
The Golden Wheel Dharma King let out an angry snort, deep breath into his dantian, voice ringing out in all directions:
"In this life, there is birth, there is death, Ding Ling, if you want to kill me, just go ahead, but dreaming of getting the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, it’s impossible."
"Never thought the Golden Wheel Dharma King was so unyielding."
Ding Ling slightly tilted his head:
"Since you wish to die, I shall fulfill your wish."
The Golden Wheel Dharma King immediately closed his eyes tightly.
He certainly didn’t want to die, but to pass on the divine supreme skill to the enemy was something he could never do.

But the speed of his ten fingers flicking kept getting faster!
Whiz!
Whiz!
It was like the Death God urging souls, more like Yama demanding life, calling for your death before midnight, without any chance of letting you live till dawn.

The wheels spun incredibly fast in the void, constantly rotating, flipping, crisscrossing, perfectly coordinated like a small elite team arranged in formation.
As they sliced through on their way, one flagpole was effortlessly cut off by one of the wheels, showing the wheels’ sharpness at a glance.
The five wheels spun like lightning, directly targeting the vital spots around Ding Ling.
Ding Ling slightly raised his brows, and continued to flick the stones with one hand, while the other hand gently flipped over, but directly a palm was shot towards the five wheels.
Splitting Sky Palm!
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
Consecutively, five palms struck out.
Each palm was propelled with Fusion Qi, further enhanced with his inherent strength, the Palm Force so condensed that they manifested as tangible palm prints in the void!
Only a few banging sounds were heard, the palm prints of the Splitting Sky Palm hit directly on the bodies of the five wheels, and with a cracking sound, three wheels shattered on the spot.
The wheels, still mid-air, shattered into over a dozen pieces, the fragments scattering out, some even shot far enough to pierce through a soldier’s neck with mere residual force!
The Golden Wheel Dharma King, bearing the brunt, couldn’t help but stagger back more than ten steps, barely avoiding the deadly hit.
"Such strong Splitting Void Palm Force!"

"Such power, how could it be cultivated without a hundred years?
Your young age has such fortunes, unwilling to serve the Great Khan of Mongolia, yet attempting with your strength alone to save the Great Song, don’t you find it laughable?"
"Hmph."

"Ah!"

The Golden Wheel Dharma King roared in anger, his five wheels, except for the golden and silver ones, were shattered, and even those had been knocked to the ground, making it too late to retrieve them now, so he could only muster all his lifelong power, gathering the force of the Ninth-Layer Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill into his right palm.
He also struck a palm towards Ding Ling’s direction.
Bang!

The Golden Wheel Dharma King’s heart was in turmoil, unable to calm down for a long while.
This time coming south to the Central Plains, was to witness the prowess of the Central Plains’ experts, but Ding Ling’s strength exceeded his imagination!
Totally not a match.

The gap was this vast!
How could this be possible!
Bang!
The Golden Wheel Dharma King heavily fell to the ground, wounded upon wounded, couldn’t help but spit out another mouthful of thick blood.

Roar!

In just a moment.

Behind him lay a ground full of fallen soldiers.
Wrecked like dry rot!
Mount Tai crushing eggs!
Nothing more!
Whizz!

chapters.title: Chapter 465: Death Warrior
paragraphs: Ding Ling struck with his palm, boom! It landed beside the Golden Wheel Dharma King, leaving a palm print three inches deep!

The Golden Wheel Dharma King only heard a sound, but his body seemed motionless. He couldn’t help but open his eyes. Seeing Ding Ling standing with his hands behind his back, and noticing a palm print next to him, he clearly saw the depth of this palm print. While secretly astonished by Ding Ling’s high skill level, he couldn’t help but wonder:
"Ding Ling, why didn’t you kill me?"
"I suddenly thought of a way."
Ding Ling flicked a finger in the air, snap!
The pebble hit Hoduo’s acupuncture point directly.
Hoduo unblocked his point, and once able to move, he cautiously got up and saluted Ding Ling.
Ding Ling gestured for him to come over, pointing at the Golden Wheel Dharma King:
"Think of a way to pry the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill out of his mouth. As long as I get the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, I’ll let you go."
Ding Ling and the Golden Wheel Dharma King had become mortal enemies.
There naturally couldn’t be any clichéd scenes of mutual sympathy.
This Golden Wheel Dharma King was sent here to trap and kill Ding Ling.
He was clearly determined to kill Ding Ling.
Ding Ling knew, there’s no way to release the tiger back to the mountain.
His ascent was not a problem, but if the Little Dragon Girl remained in the mortal world, facing such an enemy, wouldn’t it be troublesome?
Furthermore, the Golden Wheel Dharma King was extraordinarily talented. If he learned the Breathing Technique, his power would greatly increase in the future, becoming even more troublesome.
It was absolutely impossible for Ding Ling to knowingly let the enemy leave.
"This..."
Hoduo hesitated.
Ding Ling said:
"If I don’t get the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, I’ll kill you."
Hoduo was, after all, a selfish and self-serving person. During his time with Ding Ling, he was subdued by Ding Ling, and upon hearing this, he shivered, and quickly said:

"Hero Ding, rest assured, even if I can’t extract key information directly from my master’s mouth, I do know that the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill is the supreme Dharma Guardian Divine Skill of the Esoteric Vajra Sect!
The Vajra Sect must have an original secret manual hidden inside. If I can’t get it here, Hero Ding can take a trip to the Vajra Sect."
"Beast, you!"
The Golden Wheel Dharma King’s expression changed slightly, and he was furious:
"You, you’re simply not human!"
"Hmph."
Hoduo, having spoken his mind, wasn’t afraid anymore. He snorted and said:

"Master, I’ve long told you, those who recognize the times are wise! If you cooperate well with Hero Ding, we can both live and even obtain an unparalleled Divine Skill Secret Manual. Isn’t that a great thing? It’s good for everyone. You refused, so don’t blame your disciple now.
Once you’re gone, your disciple will burn incense for you every year at this time, ensuring that you won’t go hungry in the Underworld...
Hoduo took the Golden Wheel Dharma King to a large tent for interrogation.
What happened during that time,
Ding Ling didn’t care, didn’t ask.
When he saw the Golden Wheel Dharma King again, he was already barely clinging to life.
He looked at Hoduo with extreme resentment and anger, staring at Hoduo intently, his eyes seemed to disregard Ding Ling’s existence.
Ding Ling looked at Hoduo.
Hoduo was terrified, kneeling on the ground, saying:
"My master just wouldn’t speak, so I had no choice but to resort to extreme measures, but he’s too stubborn, he just wouldn’t hand over the secret manual."
He was frustrated and regretful:

"If I had known you wanted to learn the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, Hero Ding, I should have chosen to study this martial art many years ago. That way, Hero Ding, you wouldn’t have had to go through all this trouble."
Ding Ling sighed.

Encountering someone like Hoduo, who cared only for his own safety and had no sense of ethics or integrity, the Golden Wheel Dharma King could be said to have terrible luck. Presumably, his heart was also filled with regret.
Ding Ling glanced at Hoduo and said:
"Give your master a quick end, stop torturing him. Then... come with me to the Vajra Sect."
"This..."
Hoduo instinctively wanted to refuse, but upon seeing Ding Ling’s cold gaze, he couldn’t help but feel fearful and forced a flattering smile:
"I’ll do as Hero Ding says. I know where the Vajra Sect is. I promise to lead the way well when the time comes."
Implying he hoped Ding Ling wouldn’t kill him.
Ding Ling neither affirmed nor denied.
Crack!
Hoduo entered the large tent, humbly offering his master a great bow, saying, ’Master, don’t blame your disciple. Blame yourself for being too stubborn!’
With that, he went up and directly broke the Golden Wheel Dharma King’s neck.
Having been hanging by a thread, the Golden Wheel Dharma King finally breathed his last.
Even in death, his eyes remained fixed on Hoduo, unwilling to rest in peace.
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel.
Though the Golden Wheel Dharma King was dead,
He had not long ago contributed an Achievement Medal in their duel.
Hoduo had also contributed one long ago.
Apart from this,
Ding Ling demolished the Central Army Tent and killed the death warrior impersonating Kublai, gaining another medal.
This death warrior was no ordinary person, surprisingly a First-class Expert cultivated from childhood within the royal family, serving as Kublai’s double!
Every move, every word, even his appearance resembled Kublai.
Hoduo said this personally.
Ding Ling, having seen this death warrior’s likeness, could also mostly imagine Kublai’s appearance.
Boom!

The Central Army Tent collapsed as Ding Ling activated the mechanism, falling at least a hundred meters deep. Standing at the mouth of the deep well, Ding Ling saw that it was indeed deep and dark, resembling an old dry well modified by Kublai into a trap.
Crack!
The mechanism activated again, sealing the deep well with a thick iron plate weighing thousands of pounds.
This made it extremely difficult for even an unparalleled expert to escape.
And Kublai, knowing Ding Ling’s formidability,
Left several openings the size of bowls on the iron plate.
These openings could also be sealed with the iron plate.
Of course, they could be used to fill the well with soil!
Ding Ling noticed a small hill of earth piled one side of the tent, his eye twitching slightly. The preparations were really thorough.
If he had gone to see Kublai in the Central Army Tent, he would likely have ended up sunk into the deep well along with the fake Kublai, then locked and buried alive!
No matter how capable he was, he would probably have perished.
"What a Kublai."
Ding Ling let out a long sigh. Though cunning and resourceful, if there’s an inside traitor, the speed of defeat accelerates.
"Hero Ding."
Hoduo brought out several wooden boxes.
Inside were Great Medicine and secret manuals displayed within.
"These were treasures meant to entice you. Just to lure you into the Central Army Tent. I found them in my master’s room, likely never deployed because our sudden arrival disrupted plans."
"Very well."
Ding Ling was quite satisfied.
He took at the Great Medicine.
They were indeed centuries-old Great Medicine.
Far superior in quality to those found in Xiangyang City.
Ding Ling opted to look at the secret manuals first.
After all, reading secret manuals directly increases Four-dimensional Attribute Points.

chapters.title: Chapter 466: Illusionary Blade Flowing Swordsmanship Full Level
paragraphs: The number of secret manuals was considerable.
There were quite a few second and third-class martial arts secret manuals, and also many first-class martial arts.
Most were obtained when Kublai led his great army to annihilate some of the major sects in the Northern Lands.

Or sometimes, instead of annihilating, he would directly lead his army to threaten and intimidate the disciples of these major sects, forcing them to hand over their secret manuals for self-preservation.
In this way,

it can be said that Kublai’s army was not lacking in secret manuals, especially with the addition of ascenders like Yuwen Chengdu and players, providing Kublai with military strategies and talents for southern and northern expeditions.
The number of schemed secret manuals continued to increase.
Kublai merely needed to pull out some copied secret manuals, which was not difficult.
Of course.
Ding Ling knew all this thanks to Hoduo’s information.
Rustle!
Ding Ling flipped through the secret manuals quickly.
Before long.

He finished reading all the second and third-class manuals to full level. Although there was no increase in the four-dimensional attribute points, the depth of his foundation was increasingly reflected in the Martial Arts Melting Furnace within Ding Ling’s sea of consciousness.
Moreover, Ding Ling’s mastery over the fusion of Qi was continuously enhancing.
Becoming more and more natural and seamless.
After finishing the second and third-class martial arts secret manuals.
Ding Ling started on the first-class secret manuals.
He quickly finished the first one.
[Frost Flow Blade Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Defense +0.1]
This was a saber technique secret manual from a major sect in the Northern Lands.
Rumored to be connected with Japan.

Its authenticity unknown, but this saber technique was indeed extraordinary. Once executed, the frost Qi flowed rampantly, transforming into a brilliant saber light that sliced down, leaving ordinary people helpless.
[Illusionary Blade Flowing Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Defense +0.1]
Similarly, this was a saber technique purportedly from Japan.

Once executed, the sword light shimmered, seemingly able to manifest countless sword lights in an instant, making it impossible to discern the true sword, then taking the chance to strike down, vanquishing the opponent in an instant.
Next.
Various first-class sword skills, saber techniques, and spear skills followed.
Ding Ling gained full mastery of them all.
After reaching full level.
Ding Ling would habitually practice them a couple of times, to become familiar with these martial arts, making it easier to switch among various martial skills during future executions.
Hoduo watched clearly from the side, utterly shocked and filled with reverence again towards Ding Ling!
In his eyes, he always considered himself a genius, but compared to Ding Ling?
There was simply no comparison.
Not to mention him,
Golden Wheel Dharma King, Darma, and others felt similarly, only left to be crushed by Ding Ling.
’The commander planning to eliminate Ding Ling was the greatest miscalculation.’
Hoduo’s heart surged turbulently, unable to calm:
"Seems like I need to plan ahead, as going down with the commander is out of the question."
Hoduo had long seen through, Ding Ling was someone who would never be manipulated.

And with Kublai being so authoritative, if Ding Ling accepted arrangements it would be fine, but if he resisted or offended, or followed instructions without commitment, the existing tensions would surely reignite, leading to a stalemate again.
And now that Ding Ling prematurely triggered these tensions, it was bound to surprise Kublai, perhaps even catching him off guard!
No one would have imagined.
Despite the generous hospitality, Ding Ling would still refuse!
Little did they know that Ding Ling’s goal was to achieve immortality with Little Dragon Girl, Diao Chan, and others; the mere position of National Preceptor couldn’t sway him?
More so, observing Hoduo’s subtle expressions, he already knew something was definitely amiss, how could he fall for it?
Although he couldn’t see through Kublai’s plans,
seeing through Hoduo up close was sufficient!
As long as he understood the enemy’s basic plan,
he wouldn’t take the bait,
nor succumb to enticement,
what recourse could Kublai possibly have?
[Strength 60]
After consecutively practicing three first-class supreme techniques,
strength reached the upper limit in this world.
Ding Ling proceeded to practice eight more first-class supreme techniques.
[Defense +0.9]
At the end, the defense was:
Not far from breaking through to 60.
As his strength reached a new stage,
Ding Ling could distinctly sense his power once again breaking a shackle, entering a new realm.
If he combined this strength with fusion Qi, it would be absolutely astounding. Not even a Martial Arts Grandmaster could withstand it.
"I wonder how much True Water a Martial Arts Grandmaster has?"
Ding Ling felt that he wasn’t far off from reaching the realm of a Martial Arts Grandmaster either.
Otherwise, how could he possibly kill Five Extremes level experts with such ease?
Besides the five-fold, ten-fold multiplication from fusion Qi, along with his enormous strength and cultivation technique being the Nine Yang Divine Skill and other top divine skills,
it also had to do with Ding Ling himself nearing Innate Perfection.
Ding Ling picked up the Great Medicine and began to consume.
Crunch, crunch!
Ding Ling bypassed the 200-year, 300-year Great Medicine, and directly ate the 400-year ones first.
Once consumed, it was refined by the Five Great Breathing Techniques.
[Defense +0.2]
Strength, agility, and physique had reached their limit and couldn’t be increased, so all energy went into defense, adding 0.2 to defense directly.
Ding Ling nodded secretly.
Quite nice indeed.
As he continuously consumed the Great Medicine, the resistance to the Great Medicine in this world was also steadily increasing.
The enhancement in physical attributes from consuming the Great Medicine was waning with the 200-year types.
The 300-year ones’ effectiveness gradually diminishing.
The 400-year ones were pretty effective.
Ding Ling went directly for the 400-year ones.
He consumed fifteen or sixteen of them in this manner.
[Defense +2.1]
As he ate more, the efficacy decreased.
Ding Ling then ate the 500-year ones, which were of superb quality and numbered around two hundred, surpassing the batch from Xiangyang.
Clearly, Kublai went to great lengths to lure him and hook him in.
But now, they all benefited Ding Ling instead.
Ding Ling ate a 500-year one, boosting his defense by 0.3 directly.
The effect was very potent.
But as he continued eating, the effects waned. Even so, after consuming more than twenty, his defense increased by 3.9 directly.
[Defense: 60]
Now defense had also reached its maximum value.
Ding Ling could distinctly feel his skin becoming increasingly resilient, to the point where ordinary blade and axe strikes wouldn’t injure him!
Comparable to wearing six layers of leather armor!
The defense level was evident.
Not to mention the Nine Yang Divine Skill’s Gang Qi protective membrane was constantly operating.
"Excellent."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
With just about forty Great Medicine consumed, he fully maximized his defense.
Ding Ling glanced at the remaining more than a hundred Great Medicines.
He immediately began consuming them.
Starting from the 200-year ones.

There were as many as a hundred and twenty 200-year ones.
He consumed them all.
[Inner Power Value +60]
Although the efficacy lessened over time,
they still provided a significant enhancement.
Subsequently, Ding Ling consumed over thirty of the 300-year ones.
After eating,
[Inner Power Value +30]
The final few remaining ones were the 600-year types, with the strongest potency.

There were quite a few second and third-class martial arts secret manuals, and also many first-class martial arts.
Most were obtained when Kublai led his great army to annihilate some of the major sects in the Northern Lands.

Or sometimes, instead of annihilating, he would directly lead his army to threaten and intimidate the disciples of these major sects, forcing them to hand over their secret manuals for self-preservation.
In this way,

it can be said that Kublai’s army was not lacking in secret manuals, especially with the addition of ascenders like Yuwen Chengdu and players, providing Kublai with military strategies and talents for southern and northern expeditions.
The number of schemed secret manuals continued to increase.
Kublai merely needed to pull out some copied secret manuals, which was not difficult.
Of course.
Ding Ling knew all this thanks to Hoduo’s information.
Rustle!
Ding Ling flipped through the secret manuals quickly.
Before long.
He finished reading all the second and third-class manuals to full level.

Although there was no increase in the four-dimensional attribute points, the depth of his foundation was increasingly reflected in the Martial Arts Melting Furnace within Ding Ling’s sea of consciousness.
Moreover, Ding Ling’s mastery over the fusion of Qi was continuously enhancing.
Becoming more and more natural and seamless.

Ding Ling started on the first-class secret manuals.
He quickly finished the first one.

[Strength +0.2]
[Defense +0.1]

Next.
Various first-class sword skills, saber techniques, and spear skills followed.
Ding Ling gained full mastery of them all.
After reaching full level.
Ding Ling would habitually practice them a couple of times, to become familiar with these martial arts, making it easier to switch among various martial skills during future executions.

There was simply no comparison.
Not to mention him,
Golden Wheel Dharma King, Darma, and others felt similarly, only left to be crushed by Ding Ling.

"Seems like I need to plan ahead, as going down with the commander is out of the question."
Hoduo had long seen through, Ding Ling was someone who would never be manipulated.

And with Kublai being so authoritative, if Ding Ling accepted arrangements it would be fine, but if he resisted or offended, or followed instructions without commitment, the existing tensions would surely reignite, leading to a stalemate again.
And now that Ding Ling prematurely triggered these tensions, it was bound to surprise Kublai, perhaps even catching him off guard!
No one would have imagined.
Despite the generous hospitality, Ding Ling would still refuse!
Little did they know that Ding Ling’s goal was to achieve immortality with Little Dragon Girl, Diao Chan, and others; the mere position of National Preceptor couldn’t sway him?
More so, observing Hoduo’s subtle expressions, he already knew something was definitely amiss, how could he fall for it?
Although he couldn’t see through Kublai’s plans,
seeing through Hoduo up close was sufficient!
As long as he understood the enemy’s basic plan,
he wouldn’t take the bait,
nor succumb to enticement,
what recourse could Kublai possibly have?

After consecutively practicing three first-class supreme techniques,
strength reached the upper limit in this world.
Ding Ling proceeded to practice eight more first-class supreme techniques.

At the end, the defense was:
Not far from breaking through to 60.

Ding Ling could distinctly sense his power once again breaking a shackle, entering a new realm.
If he combined this strength with fusion Qi, it would be absolutely astounding.
Not even a Martial Arts Grandmaster could withstand it.

Besides the five-fold, ten-fold multiplication from fusion Qi, along with his enormous strength and cultivation technique being the Nine Yang Divine Skill and other top divine skills,
it also had to do with Ding Ling himself nearing Innate Perfection.

Ding Ling bypassed the 200-year, 300-year Great Medicine, and directly ate the 400-year ones first.
Once consumed, it was refined by the Five Great Breathing Techniques.

chapters.title: Chapter 467: The Great Fire
paragraphs: But Ding Ling did not immediately consume it, instead he carefully perceived and contemplated his own changes.
He had just finished consuming a Great Medicine of three hundred years.
In Ding Ling’s Dantian, the Nine Yang True Water split once again, creating another drop.
Turning into nine drops.
[True Power Value: 9 points]
The display on the Character Panel also proved that Ding Ling had already stepped into a new level in his Inner Power cultivation.
Having reached 9 true power value, that is nine drops of Nine Yang True Water.
Ding Ling could clearly sense that he had reached a new bottleneck.
"Is this Innate Perfection?!"
Ding Ling thought to himself.
Perhaps upon reaching 10 points.
It would be Innate Great Perfection.
Then at 11 points, stepping into the Martial Arts Grandmaster Realm?
Most likely, that’s definitely the way it is.
The feeling of imminent breakthrough is too clear and apparent! It is the rules of the world acting, suppressing, when a person reaches the limit of this world, they can no longer improve.
No matter how much of a genius one is, it’s like this.
In the worlds like the Three Kingdoms, Ding Ling had experienced similar scenes, but he understood clearly, didn’t think further, and continued to consume Great Medicine.
Crunch crunch!
The six-hundred-year Great Medicine even though only had six or seven plants, the effect was extremely amazing.
Finished eating.
[Inner Power Value +90]
The average from three hundred years can only provide about 1 point of Inner Power Value.
Six hundred years directly provided more than ten points!
"Seems like I need to find a way to get more of this kind of Great Medicine."
Ding Ling asked Hoduo.
He knew there were secrets and Great Medicine in the upcoming traps.
His heart couldn’t help but move.
Increasingly determined to sweep through the Mongolian army, and charge into the Mongolian Royal Capital.
Plundering Mongolian Great Medicine for personal use, that would be the best method.
Anyway, they were mortal enemies, with no room for reconciliation.
How could Ding Ling be polite to the Mongolian side?
Whiz!

Ding Ling picked up Hoduo again, activated Spiral Nine Shadows, Golden Swan Skill, Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill, Flying Swallow Technique and other lightweight body techniques, his figure moved, like a Peng spreading its wings, soaring into the sky, leaping numerous feet while stepping lightly in the air, his whole person slid far in the void.
Another step in the air, flew far again.
Midway without touching the ground, holding a person like this, constantly stepping in the void walking, fast as wind and lightning.
Very obviously.
After Ding Ling’s strength improved, he flew faster, more steadily! Previously able to fly five or six miles in one go, now flying six or seven miles was not a problem.
Once this breath dissipates, lightly touching the treetops and water surface for leverage, again able to fly six or seven miles in one go.
Lightweight Skills so high, have reached a level that ordinary people in the secular world could only look up to!
Hoduo was already numb.
Completely regarded Ding Ling as a Ghost God level figure.
He pointed the way all along.
Ding Ling flew sixty or seventy miles and reached a new military camp.

This camp was in a valley, surrounded by Shizhi Water and Petroleum cast by Kebineng, colorless and odorless, hard to detect! Once Ding Ling stepped in, one careless move, he would be dragged to death by the death warriors here, and completely cremated!
"Kublai has indeed gone to great lengths to deal with me."
Ding Ling landed on a treetop, looking at the camp from afar, Mingyue hung high in the sky, under the hazy moonlight, Ding Ling could faintly see soldiers patrolling.

Compared to the previous camp, the alertness of the soldiers here was obviously higher, but certainly, Ding Ling’s eyesight was exceptional, able to see them faintly, yet they absolutely couldn’t see Ding Ling.
"Yes. Hero Ding."
Hoduo said flatteringly:

"Who under the heavens doesn’t know Hero Ding’s fame? Kublai is no exception. He fears you won’t agree to cooperate. Thus he does this, actually as long as Hero Ding would slightly compromise, willing to be Kublai’s saber, he definitely wouldn’t oppose you. He would even promote you to National Preceptor, although not saying with utmost respect, yet definitely with great reverence!"
Hoduo no longer said commander.
Directly called Kublai, showing he had already sided with Ding Ling.
But he really didn’t want Kublai dead, Kublai’s death benefited him not, saying if he bears the crime of treason, it would similarly be difficult to survive.
Thus tried to persuade Ding Ling again.
However, Ding Ling just looked at him with a half-smile.
Hoduo immediately closed his mouth.
How could Ding Ling not see through Hoduo’s little thoughts, but he had already become irreconcilable with Kublai, how could they coexist?
From the moment Kublai issued the death order against Ding Ling, it showed Kublai’s intention to kill Ding Ling was extremely intense.
Is it because Ding Ling killed his tens of thousands of elite troops? Or killed his heavily favored Kebineng?
Or just purely to give Mongolian a reason?
Or because Ding Ling took the Nine Yang Divine Skill that Kublai valued?
Very difficult to say clearly, last time the fire at Shaolin Temple, whether Kublai participated is unknown.

After all, such a Divine Skill like Nine Yang Divine Skill is extraordinary, and the Shaolin Temple in Northern Lands was not a stable pawn, Kublai would, under Kebineng’s strong request, remove this thorn, who could say?
Exactly how it was, Ding Ling did not know, because he killed Kebineng, did not have the chance to interrogate him, the specific answer perhaps only those involved would know.
Unfortunately, at that time, in a demonic frenzy, Hai Dafu and others were all hammered dead, beaten to death by him, he forgot to leave a few hostages.
But since the matter had reached this point, Ding Ling didn’t feel any regret.
To him, as long as the strength is enough, any intrigue, demonic creatures, he could ignore and suppress!
Ding Ling descended slightly, placing Hoduo on a branch, and he stood again at the treetop, took out bow and arrow, launched ’Burning Wood Saber Technique’, sizzling!
The arrow was set aflame.

Now Ding Ling further advanced from where he stood before! With cultivation rising, the power of Burning Wood Saber Technique was stronger, the flames emitted hotter, just in an instant, the arrow shaft was ignited.
Ding Ling bent his bow, nocked the arrow facing the distance, activating with Fusion Qi.
Tornado Arrow Skill!
Double Extreme Arrow Skill!
Boom!
Three arrows carrying three small tornado storms, shot rapidly towards the distance, quick as a fiery meteor under the night sky!
In just a moment, pierced through over a thousand meters in the void!
As the arrow shaft fully burned, about to burn out, the arrowhead with unmatched blazing Flame Qi, with a roar, struck the valley.
Then.
Like a spark falling into a pot of oil, a flame burst forth, spreading ferociously to all directions!
A moment ago, the valley was tranquil as ever!
The next instant, already ablaze eruptions in the east.
This fire, swept by the wind, engulfed the whole valley.
"Ah!"
"Help!"
Under the hazy moonlight.
Heart-wrenching cries echoed everywhere.
Accompanied by the crackling sound of charring, resonating throughout the valley, lingering endlessly.
