chapters.title: Chapter 468: Grandmaster
paragraphs: "Is it over just like that?"
Hoduo watched with a sense of loss, while being utterly shocked by Ding Ling’s archery skill.
The distance was so great.
Yet, he could hit the target directly.
And Ding Ling’s palm could conjure flames out of thin air! What kind of technique was that?!
Hoduo felt a chill down his spine, and his respect for Ding Ling grew deeper.
Ding Ling’s eyes were profound, his expression indifferent as he gazed toward the direction of the valley.
Kublai wanted to kill him.
But this sudden fire had instantly claimed the lives of the two or three thousand death warriors he had meticulously prepared!
These death warriors were all elites.
Kublai had a hard time cultivating them, and their deaths would surely cause him great pain.
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling picked up Hoduo again and set off toward the Northern Lands.
This time, he came with the conviction and purpose to decisively kill Kublai.
If he didn’t kill Kublai, his thoughts would not be clear.
Kublai outwardly showed him all sorts of favors and even wanted to appoint him as National Preceptor, while secretly laying down all kinds of sinister and vicious plans.
The purpose of which was obvious without asking.
But how could Ding Ling possibly be someone who would let others manipulate him?
In the Three Kingdoms World, on the surface, Cao Mengde was the emperor, but in reality, he was the Supreme Emperor!
Kublai tried to bind him, merely to use him as a tool!
How could Ding Ling agree?
And since he did not agree, the conflict between them was bound to erupt again.

Such a brilliant and talented person as Kublai could not possibly allow a person, who was uncontrollable and extremely dangerous, to exist beside him, and would surely implement a plan to eliminate Ding Ling decisively!
From his intricately linked ten or so plans of elimination, it was evident how detailed and energy-consuming Kublai’s plans were.
Having done so much.
How could Kublai possibly suddenly give up on his plan to encircle and kill Ding Ling?
Unless Ding Ling was very cooperative with Kublai.
But how could Ding Ling be a puppet? He would rather overthrow all the regimes of this world, recreate Heaven and Earth, than obey any authority!
He might cooperate with others, but to make him a tool? That was wishful thinking!
Then.
Under Hoduo’s guidance.
Ding Ling destroyed one elaborate setup after another.
There was the plan to drown Ding Ling on the small island in the middle of the lake!
There was the plan to poison Ding Ling in the hidden mountain paths.
And more...
Ding Ling, with profound martial prowess, having reached the Innate Perfection Realm, exhibited the grandeur of an unparalleled grandmaster with every move! A simple slash of his palm!
Even an Initial Tier Innate Expert would be killed by him!
His current strength could probably kill an Initial Tier Martial Arts Grandmaster who hadn’t cultivated the Breathing Technique!
Such mere Innate Experts.
How could they possibly be his match?!

Ding Ling strolled through the void like flowing smoke, rushing in all directions. Wherever he passed, one trap after another collapsed, one death warrior after another was either drowned by water; or poisoned by toxic fumes...
At the same time.
Ding Ling also gathered many Secret Manuals and Great Medicines.
These were all lures to entice Ding Ling to negotiate in these hidden places!
It seems Kublai, under the players’ hints, knew what Ding Ling lacked and desired.
Hoduo informed him of this.
Naturally, Ding Ling was not going to hold back.
The Secret Manuals he gathered amounted to thousands of volumes.
There were many duplicates.
But there were still over a hundred different ones in total.
80% were second or third-class.
First-class accounted for 20%.
He read them all.
Mastered them all to full level.
Among the first-class Secret Manuals, there were many excellent techniques.
Including some Inner Power Heart Methods.
[Kundong Yuan Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +90]
This was an Inner Power Heart Method from a major sect in the Northern Lands.
After reaching full level in this Secret Manual.
Ding Ling realized that this Manual was highly compatible with the previous Frost Flowing Blade Technique and Illusionary Blade Flowing Knife Technique.
He knew then. This Heart Method was most likely also from Japan.
Unexpectedly, Japanese Martial Arts were so impressive as well.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow slightly.
But didn’t ponder much more.
And there were five or six similar Inner Power Heart Methods.
Some strong, some weak.
After mastering them all to full level.
[Inner Power Value +370]
Without surprise.
Ding Ling’s strength underwent a transformation once more.
[True Power Value: 10 points]
Upon reaching the Great Perfection Innate stage.
Ding Ling could clearly sense that every move he made seemed to stir the heavens and earth, a commotion that could only be triggered at the world’s ultimate limit!
But Ding Ling felt he could possibly advance a bit further.
He chewed on Great Medicine.
As his Inner Power Value constantly increased.
Crack!
The Nine Yang True Water in his dantian split once more, producing a droplet.
[True Power Value: 11 points]
This time, he truly broke through the shackles of innateness, stepping into a new martial arts realm: Grandmaster!
Upon reaching the Grandmaster Realm.
The most noticeable thing for Ding Ling was.
The time he could traverse the void in this world had extended significantly.
He could even stand in the air for a moment without support, and at this stage, there was practically no difference between him and the Martial Dao God.
"Didn’t expect to reach the top so soon."
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, thinking:

"It seems that leveraging a nation’s strength is indeed extraordinary, just like in the Three Kingdoms. With a nation supporting the Prince’s Mansion, Diao Chan and others lacked nothing for cultivation, except time."
The same applies to this world.
Just by breaking Kublai’s schemes one after another.
Ding Ling had merely harvested a batch of lures Kublai sent forth.
It allowed him to consecutively break through the shackles of innateness and reach the Grandmaster Realm!
"It seems this world won’t hold us for long."
With Ding Ling’s physique and cultivation realm reaching the pinnacle of this world, there’s no further room to advance.
Consuming Great Medicines now was of no use to him.
So he stuffed several boxes of Great Medicines into his Storage Pouch.
The Storage Pouch, filled with the Drumming Golden Hammer, Divine Whip, short knife, and now these few boxes of Great Medicine, was brimming full.
This was because Ding Ling had earlier taken out some pots, pans, and other items; otherwise, they wouldn’t have fit.
In the end, Ding Ling even took out a short knife, securing it at his waist.
With the Divine Sword strapped on his back, it allowed him to fit the last of the herbs inside.
"These herbs can be used for Little Dragon Girl."
Ding Ling had a plan in mind.

"Now that my strength is at its peak, with unmatched defense, and upon reaching the Grandmaster Realm, the defensive Gang Qi of the Nine Yang Divine Skill rises considerably. Now, even Early Innate Experts may find it hard to breach my defense, so I am invincible in this world. What is there to fear?!"
Ding Ling’s confidence soared, his spirit exuberant:
"Since the Great Song Court is decadent and inactive and Mongolia is aggressively invading, I might as well break this Heaven and Earth and recreate the world."
Ding Ling decided that after killing Kublai this time.
He would return to consolidate an army, overthrow each Great Army, and select someone to be the emperor.
In this way.
When Diao Chan and the others ascend into this world in the future, they would have sufficient security guarantees.
Ding Ling knew that when Diao Chan and the others ascend, they would certainly be dispersed, but no matter who ascends to this world, they could all receive secure and resourceful support.
Of course.
Ding Ling hoped that Diao Chan and the others wouldn’t ascend immediately, as he planned to bring down a sufficiently potent cultivation technique for them in the future.
But the Three Kingdoms can only be returned to temporarily; now is not the time.
Besides that.

The most crucial is that Ding Ling can use the power of a nation to gather all kinds of Secret Manuals for him, enriching the foundation, accelerating the manifestation of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace.
At dawn.
Ding Ling swiftly traveled through the air, carrying Hoduo, arriving outside a sprawling military camp spanning several miles.
Kublai was here.
Ding Ling, fearless, simply sealed Hoduo’s acupuncture points, leaving him aside, then ventured forth alone, deploying Spiral Nine Shadows, storming into the camp like a gust of wind.
"Who goes there?!"
Someone noticed Ding Ling.
But Ding Ling paid no heed.
Darting left and right like a bolt of lightning, heading straight for the Central Army Tent.
Hoduo said Kublai was there.

sentences.text: "Is it over just like that?"
Hoduo watched with a sense of loss, while being utterly shocked by Ding Ling’s archery skill.
The distance was so great.
Yet, he could hit the target directly.
And Ding Ling’s palm could conjure flames out of thin air!
What kind of technique was that?!
Hoduo felt a chill down his spine, and his respect for Ding Ling grew deeper.
Ding Ling’s eyes were profound, his expression indifferent as he gazed toward the direction of the valley.
Kublai wanted to kill him.
But this sudden fire had instantly claimed the lives of the two or three thousand death warriors he had meticulously prepared!
These death warriors were all elites.
Kublai had a hard time cultivating them, and their deaths would surely cause him great pain.
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling picked up Hoduo again and set off toward the Northern Lands.
This time, he came with the conviction and purpose to decisively kill Kublai.
If he didn’t kill Kublai, his thoughts would not be clear.
Kublai outwardly showed him all sorts of favors and even wanted to appoint him as National Preceptor, while secretly laying down all kinds of sinister and vicious plans.
The purpose of which was obvious without asking.
But how could Ding Ling possibly be someone who would let others manipulate him?
In the Three Kingdoms World, on the surface, Cao Mengde was the emperor, but in reality, he was the Supreme Emperor!
Kublai tried to bind him, merely to use him as a tool!
How could Ding Ling agree?
And since he did not agree, the conflict between them was bound to erupt again.

Such a brilliant and talented person as Kublai could not possibly allow a person, who was uncontrollable and extremely dangerous, to exist beside him, and would surely implement a plan to eliminate Ding Ling decisively!
From his intricately linked ten or so plans of elimination, it was evident how detailed and energy-consuming Kublai’s plans were.
Having done so much.
How could Kublai possibly suddenly give up on his plan to encircle and kill Ding Ling?
Unless Ding Ling was very cooperative with Kublai.
But how could Ding Ling be a puppet?
He would rather overthrow all the regimes of this world, recreate Heaven and Earth, than obey any authority!
He might cooperate with others, but to make him a tool?
That was wishful thinking!
Then.
Under Hoduo’s guidance.
Ding Ling destroyed one elaborate setup after another.
There was the plan to drown Ding Ling on the small island in the middle of the lake!
There was the plan to poison Ding Ling in the hidden mountain paths.
And more...
Ding Ling, with profound martial prowess, having reached the Innate Perfection Realm, exhibited the grandeur of an unparalleled grandmaster with every move!
A simple slash of his palm!
Even an Initial Tier Innate Expert would be killed by him!
His current strength could probably kill an Initial Tier Martial Arts Grandmaster who hadn’t cultivated the Breathing Technique!
Such mere Innate Experts.
How could they possibly be his match?!
Ding Ling strolled through the void like flowing smoke, rushing in all directions.
Wherever he passed, one trap after another collapsed, one death warrior after another was either drowned by water; or poisoned by toxic fumes...
At the same time.
Ding Ling also gathered many Secret Manuals and Great Medicines.
These were all lures to entice Ding Ling to negotiate in these hidden places!
It seems Kublai, under the players’ hints, knew what Ding Ling lacked and desired.
Hoduo informed him of this.
Naturally, Ding Ling was not going to hold back.
The Secret Manuals he gathered amounted to thousands of volumes.
There were many duplicates.
But there were still over a hundred different ones in total.
80% were second or third-class.
First-class accounted for 20%.
He read them all.
Mastered them all to full level.
Among the first-class Secret Manuals, there were many excellent techniques.
Including some Inner Power Heart Methods.
[Kundong Yuan Technique Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +90]
This was an Inner Power Heart Method from a major sect in the Northern Lands.
After reaching full level in this Secret Manual.
Ding Ling realized that this Manual was highly compatible with the previous Frost Flowing Blade Technique and Illusionary Blade Flowing Knife Technique.
He knew then.
This Heart Method was most likely also from Japan.
Unexpectedly, Japanese Martial Arts were so impressive as well.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow slightly.
But didn’t ponder much more.
And there were five or six similar Inner Power Heart Methods.
Some strong, some weak.
After mastering them all to full level.
[Inner Power Value +370]
Without surprise.
Ding Ling’s strength underwent a transformation once more.
[True Power Value: 10 points]
Upon reaching the Great Perfection Innate stage.
Ding Ling could clearly sense that every move he made seemed to stir the heavens and earth, a commotion that could only be triggered at the world’s ultimate limit!
But Ding Ling felt he could possibly advance a bit further.
He chewed on Great Medicine.
As his Inner Power Value constantly increased.
Crack!
The Nine Yang True Water in his dantian split once more, producing a droplet.
[True Power Value: 11 points]
This time, he truly broke through the shackles of innateness, stepping into a new martial arts realm: Grandmaster!
Upon reaching the Grandmaster Realm.
The most noticeable thing for Ding Ling was.
The time he could traverse the void in this world had extended significantly.
He could even stand in the air for a moment without support, and at this stage, there was practically no difference between him and the Martial Dao God.
"Didn’t expect to reach the top so soon."
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, thinking:
"It seems that leveraging a nation’s strength is indeed extraordinary, just like in the Three Kingdoms.
With a nation supporting the Prince’s Mansion, Diao Chan and others lacked nothing for cultivation, except time."
The same applies to this world.
Just by breaking Kublai’s schemes one after another.
Ding Ling had merely harvested a batch of lures Kublai sent forth.
It allowed him to consecutively break through the shackles of innateness and reach the Grandmaster Realm!
"It seems this world won’t hold us for long."
With Ding Ling’s physique and cultivation realm reaching the pinnacle of this world, there’s no further room to advance.
Consuming Great Medicines now was of no use to him.
So he stuffed several boxes of Great Medicines into his Storage Pouch.
The Storage Pouch, filled with the Drumming Golden Hammer, Divine Whip, short knife, and now these few boxes of Great Medicine, was brimming full.
This was because Ding Ling had earlier taken out some pots, pans, and other items; otherwise, they wouldn’t have fit.
In the end, Ding Ling even took out a short knife, securing it at his waist.
With the Divine Sword strapped on his back, it allowed him to fit the last of the herbs inside.
"These herbs can be used for Little Dragon Girl."
Ding Ling had a plan in mind.
"Now that my strength is at its peak, with unmatched defense, and upon reaching the Grandmaster Realm, the defensive Gang Qi of the Nine Yang Divine Skill rises considerably.
Now, even Early Innate Experts may find it hard to breach my defense, so I am invincible in this world.
What is there to fear?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 469: Xianglong Fatal Strike
paragraphs: Ding Ling is here to kill Kublai and take his head.
To kill.
To kill openly and boldly!
He wants to make the Mongolian army tremble with fear!
To silence the entire Jiuzhou.
In this way.
He can reshape Heaven and Earth and recreate the world!
It will also help him collect the world’s secret manuals for his own use, accelerating the manifestation of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace!
Whizz!

Ding Ling moves as fast as the Xun Wind sweeping the ground, ordinary soldiers simply can’t react in time, even if they catch sight of Ding Ling in one instant, by the next, they can no longer trace his movement.
It makes them suspect they are seeing illusions!
The speed of Ding Ling is evident.
Whizz, whizz!

Ding Ling pushes his Helical Nine Shadows Lightness Skill to the extreme, driven by Grandmaster Level True Qi, Ding Ling is like a gentle breeze coming forth from Xu Lai, unknowingly advancing five to six miles, and even though many soldiers catch a glimpse of Ding Ling’s figure and track.
Ding Ling flashes past them in a blink.
Although he causes quite a commotion.
It doesn’t create a loud uproar.
Because only a few soldiers notice him, and even though they warn others, more soldiers, and even some generals, after careful inspection, find nothing unusual and disperse indifferently.
In the eyes of these generals.
This is a heavily armed station of the Mongolian Army.
Who dares to intrude?
Whoever does is courting death!
Even someone like the Golden Wheel Dharma King, the alleged World’s Number One, how many volleys of arrows could he withstand?
So, the generals are very confident.
Of course, there are a few generals who think of a terrifying figure like Ding Ling and feel uneasy, leading soldiers to patrol and examine carefully.
In this somewhat eerie atmosphere.
Swish!
Ding Ling stands at the center of the military camp, a dozen miles in diameter, in front of the central army tent.
This tent occupies a vast area, with two rows of soldiers stationed at the entrance, and people patrolling around continuously.
You can tell at a glance that someone of very high status must reside inside.
Ding Ling’s sudden arrival.
Startles them, each soldier holding their weapons, shouting loudly:
"Who goes there?"

Ding Ling doesn’t answer, instead taking a deep breath and unleashing a move, Prideful Dragon’s Regret, with a roar! Dragon roars resonate, and a dragon-shaped illusion emerges from his palm, soaring through the air like a Divine Dragon traversing the Mortal World. With several swishes of its tail in the void, in a booming sound, it sends a dozen soldiers flying to the ground.
The raging palm power continues forward, toppling another dozen men.
The power of one palm!
So formidable!
Truly like a Celestial God descending, all the soldiers witnessing this are stunned, their hair standing on end, pupils contracting! They are terrified beyond measure.
A general, alert, roars:
"Release the arrows, shoot him dead quickly!"
The soldiers regain their senses, pulling their bows and shooting arrows toward Ding Ling’s location.
But Ding Ling has already activated the Defensive Gang Qi Shield from the Nine Yang Divine Skill; those arrows fall on the shield but don’t damage it in the slightest!
Having reached the Grandmaster Realm, Ding Ling can only be harmed by a group of first-class peak experts shooting arrows at him; otherwise, his Gang Qi Shield cannot be broken.
"Haha..."
Ding Ling laughs heartily, activating the Lion’s Roar, and within a hundred-meter radius, his thunderous laughter bursts the eardrums of soldiers, making them collapse while screaming!
Boom!

Ding Ling abruptly stops laughing and launches another strike, Dragon Battle in the Wilderness. In an instant, dragon roars resound again, dragon-shaped illusions shoot out from his palm, knocking away over a hundred blocking soldiers in succession, and finally, with a resounding boom, smashing the entrance of the central army tent, revealing the interior Heaven and Earth.
And inside the central army tent, at the topmost position, sits a man with thick eyebrows and big eyes, exuding authority without anger, radiating nobility and overbearing aura.
This man resembles the Death Warrior expert that Ding Ling killed.
No doubt about it. It must be Kublai.
And on the left and right sides of the tent.
Sit many people.
They each have different appearances, but without exception, their auras are profound, marking them as martial arts experts.
At this moment, all of these people.
Including Kublai, look at Ding Ling with horrified eyes, as if they’ve seen a ghost.
"Protect the Marshal!"
Someone shouts angrily, leaping out and rushing towards Ding Ling:
"I am Xiaoxiangzi, who are you, and why have you intruded upon our Mongolian central army, disturbing the Marshal!"
Xiaoxiangzi, with a face like a zombie, holds a mourning staff, his hair disheveled as he charges, truly resembling a ghost seeking a soul.
Ding Ling, however, shows no fear, laughing aloud:
"Come at me!
As his voice falls.
Ding Ling swiftly moves, and under the activation of the Helical Nine Shadows, his form divides and merges, seemingly transforming into nine phantoms!
Each phantom moves to slap Xiaoxiangzi’s chest with a palm.
Roar!
It’s the Dark Clouds Without Rain from the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms!
As this palm is unleashed, palm shadows fill the sky, dragon-shaped illusions are seen everywhere, accompanied by earth-shattering dragon roars, crack!
Palm shadows imprint themselves on Xiaoxiangzi’s body and weapon.

Xiaoxiangzi channels all his inner strength, utilizing all his learned skills, vigorously wielding his mourning staff, but to no avail against Ding Ling’s move; less than half a round later, he is sent flying back even faster than he approached, his body detonating in mid-air with a bang, blown apart by powerful palm forces!
Crack, crack!
Droplets of blood rain, with wafts of blood qi, blowing towards Kublai and his group under the mighty palm wind.
Everyone changes color, filled with extreme terror!
They know very well how strong Xiaoxiangzi is!
And then?
In less than a round.
He is shattered into pieces by bare palms from this newcomer!
What kind of unimaginable palm power is this?!
"Run!"
The group, initially rushing forward to join forces against Ding Ling, shouting, ’I, Yinkexi (I, Nimo Star...) will take you on.’
Suddenly screeched to a halt, looked at each other, and without hesitation turned and ran!
Ding Ling is too strong! Strong enough to make them lose the confidence to fight!
Neither Nimo Star nor Yinkexi, both audacious individuals who aspire to compete with Golden Wheel Dharma King for the position of National Preceptor!
They fear nothing under the sky, not even the Golden Wheel Dharma King.
There’s supposedly no one in this world they fear.

Even the legendary Ding Ling, since they haven’t witnessed his prowess firsthand, remains a subject of doubt, but they are nonetheless eager to try, as humans tend to maintain skepticism about what they haven’t seen themselves.
Now, however, they have witnessed someone seemingly more terrifying than the legendary Ding Ling.
With bare palms.
In less than one move! He shattered the body of a first-class peak expert like Xiaoxiangzi!
Their combat strength is on par with Xiaoxiangzi!
The implications of this are self-evident!
"Marshal, run!"
Nimo Star, still thinking of becoming the Mongolian National Preceptor, actually runs to Kublai’s side, trying to get him to flee as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 470: The Fallen King
paragraphs: "Hahaha."
Ding Ling laughed heartily:
"Don’t even think about running!"
The group gathered around Kublai, for reasons that were obvious.
Ding Ling didn’t bother to disperse these martial arts heroes, just focused on chasing and killing Kublai!
Anyone daring to block his path along the way.
Were easily slapped to death or shattered by his bare hands.
Time Riding Six Dragons of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms!
Ang!
The sound of dragons’ roars echoed across the land.
Six dragon-shaped phantoms flew from Ding Ling’s palms, sweeping in all directions, soldiers were overturned and sent flying wherever he passed!
Many sharp-eyed individuals recognized this palm technique, and their expressions changed:
"It’s the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms! Is the person Guo Jing?!"
Someone shouted.
"How could Guo Jing be this strong!"
Yinkexi scolded the martial arts hero who shouted:
"If Guo Jing were this strong, our Mongolian army wouldn’t need to attack Xiangyang! It must be Ding Ling!"

Yinkexi, with his high nose, deep-set eyes, curly hair, and yellow beard, looked like a barbarian but was dressed in Han attire, with a bright pearl hanging from his neck, resembling a wealthy merchant. Yet at this moment, he was also shocked and terrified. Hearing the shouts of the martial arts heroes, a flash of insight struck his mind, and he couldn’t wait to shout:
"If it really is Ding Ling, there’s no point fighting. Run immediately, have the commanding generals surround him!"
Upon hearing that it was likely Ding Ling,
Everyone was moved! Terrified!
Everyone had heard of Ding Ling’s strength, but no one had seen it!

"The rumor is that Ding Ling uses the Drumming Golden Hammer and two Divine Whips! Now, this person has a short knife at the waist and a Divine Sword on the back, it doesn’t look like Ding Ling at all!"
Someone questioned:
"Yinkexi, don’t mislead people here."
"Ma Guangzuo, you fool!"
Yinkexi, seeing the person speaking was a tall and mighty man, immediately got angered and retorted:
"Believe it or not!"
In truth, he was also uncertain and hesitant.
But since the words were already spoken, how could he take them back?
Besides, having one Ding Ling in this world was already amazing, but if another person more terrifying than Ding Ling appeared, it would be unimaginable.
Yinkexi and Ma Guangzuo ran far away and looked back.
Ang!

Amidst the sound of dragon’s roars, one could clearly see an elegant yet overbearing figure, his hands constantly striking out in all directions, dragon-shaped phantoms shooting from his palms, sweeping everything before him, no one could stop him. It was like breaking dead wood, everywhere the dragon-shaped phantom passed, countless people were overturned and sent flying.
As six, dozens of dragon-shaped phantoms appeared, the surroundings exploded, and screams were endless, countless were dead or wounded.
Yinkexi, Ma Guangzuo, and their group of martial arts heroes were terrified, their scalps tingled, their guts wrenched, and their spirits flew! They all turned and ran again.
Completely losing the will to fight Ding Ling!
Ding Ling alone forcefully created the momentum of ten thousand iron cavalries breaking through a frozen river!
Charging forward alone!
No one could match him in a single move.
His bare hands sometimes slapped left, sometimes right, sometimes pushed forward.
Dragon Battle in the Wilderness!
Double Dragon Takes Water!
Time Riding Six Dragons!
Dark Clouds Without Rain!

Each move of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms was executed masterfully by Ding Ling, under the Fusion Qi’s urging, the palms’ explosive power was fully displayed, like tornadoes or bombs sweeping the land. Anyone daring to obstruct him was instantly shattered by the Palm Power!
Those behind would also be sent flying, overturned and killed on the ground!
Further behind, people would be slightly less injured but still overturned by the surging Palm Power!
Under Ding Ling’s full exertion, he truly seemed like a War God descended to the mortal world.
He fought more courageously, growing wilder!
Heroic aura burst forth.
With a long howl.
Spiral Nine Shadows activated, whoosh! Like the wind, he charged straight to Nimo Star and Kublai, then his bare palms slammed towards Nimo Star!
"Ah!"

Nimo Star, by nature brave and arrogant, with martial skills unparalleled in his homeland, wielded a snake-shaped iron whip, having killed and injured countless people. Seeing Ding Ling’s palms coming at him, although terrified, his ferocity arose! With a roar, he struck a heavy whip directly at Ding Ling!
Ding Ling neither dodged nor evaded!
Nimo Star was overjoyed, thinking ’Once my iron whip hits, even metal will shatter, how can your mortal flesh withstand it?’
The next instant, snap!
The iron whip hit like it struck the Celestial Palace, no reaction at all, and at the same time, his body was struck by Ding Ling’s palm.
Bang!
A massive force came from his chest and abdomen.
Nimo Star could hardly control his body, only watching Ding Ling and Kublai grow farther away. Then he heard booming sounds.
Then his vision went black, knowing nothing more.
In the last moment before annihilation, a shred of consciousness told him.
He too was exploded by Ding Ling.
Without an intact corpse!
At this thought, Nimo Star was both frustrated and regretful! If only he hadn’t been greedy to rescue Kublai! He should have run like Ma Guangzuo and the others.
Unfortunately, Nimo Star, under greed and foolishness, became a ghost under Ding Ling’s palm!
Whoosh!
The rolling Palm Wind, like overwhelming waves, descended on Kublai.
Kublai’s guts wrenched, spirits fled, with unprecedented fear, despair, terror, confusion, and helplessness flooding his mind, almost instinctively, he pleaded and shouted:
"Good sir, hero, let’s talk this out..."
Bang!
Ding Ling remained indifferent, slamming a palm down on Kublai’s chest.
A heavy sound.
Kublai was sent flying over ten zhang away, spurting blood mid-air. Within two blinks, the Palm Power erupted in his internal organs, and amidst explosions, his body was blown into fragments!
A future Great Khan, the founding emperor of the Yuan Dynasty!
Thus was slain by Ding Ling with a palm!
All around was dead silent!
Except for some semi-conscious groaning soldiers.
Some heavily injured but conscious soldiers who witnessed this were suffocated, holding their breath speechless.
Everyone felt like being hit by a sledgehammer, minds buzzing.
They had only one thought:
"The commander is dead?!"
"The commander is actually dead!"
"Surrounded by hundreds of thousands of soldiers, killed by one man with bare hands?!"
Silence like a ’mute’ button was pressed.
Until Kublai’s death warriors shouted for ’revenge for the commander.’

sentences.text: "Hahaha."
Ding Ling laughed heartily:
"Don’t even think about running!"
The group gathered around Kublai, for reasons that were obvious.
Ding Ling didn’t bother to disperse these martial arts heroes, just focused on chasing and killing Kublai!
Anyone daring to block his path along the way.
Were easily slapped to death or shattered by his bare hands.
Time Riding Six Dragons of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms!
Ang!
The sound of dragons’ roars echoed across the land.
Six dragon-shaped phantoms flew from Ding Ling’s palms, sweeping in all directions, soldiers were overturned and sent flying wherever he passed!
Many sharp-eyed individuals recognized this palm technique, and their expressions changed:
"It’s the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms!
Is the person Guo Jing?!"
Someone shouted.
"How could Guo Jing be this strong!"
Yinkexi scolded the martial arts hero who shouted:
"If Guo Jing were this strong, our Mongolian army wouldn’t need to attack Xiangyang!
It must be Ding Ling!"

Yinkexi, with his high nose, deep-set eyes, curly hair, and yellow beard, looked like a barbarian but was dressed in Han attire, with a bright pearl hanging from his neck, resembling a wealthy merchant.
Yet at this moment, he was also shocked and terrified.
Hearing the shouts of the martial arts heroes, a flash of insight struck his mind, and he couldn’t wait to shout:
"If it really is Ding Ling, there’s no point fighting.
Run immediately, have the commanding generals surround him!"
Upon hearing that it was likely Ding Ling,
Everyone was moved!
Terrified!
Everyone had heard of Ding Ling’s strength, but no one had seen it!
"The rumor is that Ding Ling uses the Drumming Golden Hammer and two Divine Whips!
Now, this person has a short knife at the waist and a Divine Sword on the back, it doesn’t look like Ding Ling at all!"
Someone questioned:
"Yinkexi, don’t mislead people here."
"Ma Guangzuo, you fool!"
Yinkexi, seeing the person speaking was a tall and mighty man, immediately got angered and retorted:
"Believe it or not!"
In truth, he was also uncertain and hesitant.
But since the words were already spoken, how could he take them back?
Besides, having one Ding Ling in this world was already amazing, but if another person more terrifying than Ding Ling appeared, it would be unimaginable.
Yinkexi and Ma Guangzuo ran far away and looked back.
Ang!

Amidst the sound of dragon’s roars, one could clearly see an elegant yet overbearing figure, his hands constantly striking out in all directions, dragon-shaped phantoms shooting from his palms, sweeping everything before him, no one could stop him.
It was like breaking dead wood, everywhere the dragon-shaped phantom passed, countless people were overturned and sent flying.
As six, dozens of dragon-shaped phantoms appeared, the surroundings exploded, and screams were endless, countless were dead or wounded.
Yinkexi, Ma Guangzuo, and their group of martial arts heroes were terrified, their scalps tingled, their guts wrenched, and their spirits flew!
They all turned and ran again.
Completely losing the will to fight Ding Ling!
Ding Ling alone forcefully created the momentum of ten thousand iron cavalries breaking through a frozen river!
Charging forward alone!
No one could match him in a single move.
His bare hands sometimes slapped left, sometimes right, sometimes pushed forward.
Dragon Battle in the Wilderness!
Double Dragon Takes Water!
Time Riding Six Dragons!
Dark Clouds Without Rain!

Each move of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms was executed masterfully by Ding Ling, under the Fusion Qi’s urging, the palms’ explosive power was fully displayed, like tornadoes or bombs sweeping the land.
Anyone daring to obstruct him was instantly shattered by the Palm Power!
Those behind would also be sent flying, overturned and killed on the ground!
Further behind, people would be slightly less injured but still overturned by the surging Palm Power!
Under Ding Ling’s full exertion, he truly seemed like a War God descended to the mortal world.
He fought more courageously, growing wilder!
Heroic aura burst forth.
With a long howl.
Spiral Nine Shadows activated, whoosh!
Like the wind, he charged straight to Nimo Star and Kublai, then his bare palms slammed towards Nimo Star!
"Ah!"
Nimo Star, by nature brave and arrogant, with martial skills unparalleled in his homeland, wielded a snake-shaped iron whip, having killed and injured countless people.
Seeing Ding Ling’s palms coming at him, although terrified, his ferocity arose!
With a roar, he struck a heavy whip directly at Ding Ling!
Ding Ling neither dodged nor evaded!
Nimo Star was overjoyed, thinking ’Once my iron whip hits, even metal will shatter, how can your mortal flesh withstand it?’
The next instant, snap!
The iron whip hit like it struck the Celestial Palace, no reaction at all, and at the same time, his body was struck by Ding Ling’s palm.
Bang!
A massive force came from his chest and abdomen.
Nimo Star could hardly control his body, only watching Ding Ling and Kublai grow farther away.
Then he heard booming sounds.
Then his vision went black, knowing nothing more.
In the last moment before annihilation, a shred of consciousness told him.
He too was exploded by Ding Ling.
Without an intact corpse!
At this thought, Nimo Star was both frustrated and regretful!
If only he hadn’t been greedy to rescue Kublai!
He should have run like Ma Guangzuo and the others.
Unfortunately, Nimo Star, under greed and foolishness, became a ghost under Ding Ling’s palm!
Whoosh!
The rolling Palm Wind, like overwhelming waves, descended on Kublai.
Kublai’s guts wrenched, spirits fled, with unprecedented fear, despair, terror, confusion, and helplessness flooding his mind, almost instinctively, he pleaded and shouted:
"Good sir, hero, let’s talk this out..."
Bang!
Ding Ling remained indifferent, slamming a palm down on Kublai’s chest.
A heavy sound.
Kublai was sent flying over ten zhang away, spurting blood mid-air.
Within two blinks, the Palm Power erupted in his internal organs, and amidst explosions, his body was blown into fragments!
A future Great Khan, the founding emperor of the Yuan Dynasty!
Thus was slain by Ding Ling with a palm!
All around was dead silent!
Except for some semi-conscious groaning soldiers.
Some heavily injured but conscious soldiers who witnessed this were suffocated, holding their breath speechless.
Everyone felt like being hit by a sledgehammer, minds buzzing.
They had only one thought:
"The commander is dead?!"
"The commander is actually dead!"
"Surrounded by hundreds of thousands of soldiers, killed by one man with bare hands?!"
Silence like a ’mute’ button was pressed.
Until Kublai’s death warriors shouted for ’revenge for the commander.’

chapters.title: Chapter 471: Crushed the Entire Army
paragraphs: This camp finally seemed to come alive!
In an instant.
Chaos reigned as chickens flew and dogs ran amok.
The clamor was unending!
Martial arts heroes fleeing for their lives!
The warriors organized a battle array, angrily charging towards Ding Ling.
In the distance, cavalry troops galloped in formation, and farther away, rows and rows of archers organized to approach...
Hundreds of thousands of troops!
Mobilized!
In dense masses, overwhelming in force, they charged towards Ding Ling!
Ding Ling was not afraid in the slightest. With a long howl, he rushed into the Mongolian Army, his hands continuously striking.
The Dragon Emerges from the Field!
Hidden Dragon, Do Not Use!
Shocking Hundred Li!
Sheep Butting Against the Fence!
Time Riding Six Dragons!

All eighteen styles of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms were wielded by Ding Ling to perfection, at the Great Perfection Innate Level, as a supreme divine technique. Under the driving force of Fusion Qi, virtual dragon forms charged into the great army, continuously exploding and swinging their tails, breaking through the formations!
A single dragon form could easily lift and knock down dozens of people!
Ding Ling moved like the wind, often able to strike five or six palms in an instant!
Dragon forms shot out from his palms in every direction, madly attacking with the Divine Dragon’s Tail Swing, the Divine Dragon’s Roar and Charge, the Divine Dragon’s Mouth Opening for Consumption...
The visible power unleashed by the dragon forms was overwhelmingly strong!
No one could withstand it!
Ding Ling charged through, cutting down soldier after soldier and general after general, all falling under his palms.
His combat power was astounding, his endurance superb! His stamina extraordinary!
This massacre, this charge.
Lasted for several hours.

Until he had slain tens of thousands of troops, the ground littered with corpses, blood flowing like rivers, Ding Ling fought more intensely, his eyes turning red, seeming like a mad demon, laughing wildly as he chased the Mongolian army!
Boom, boom, boom!
Another hit with Time Riding Six Dragons sent dozens or even hundreds of soldiers flying!
The Mongolian Army could no longer withstand. More than half the army began to scatter and flee.
"Too terrifying! He’s not human!"
"Arrows rain down on him, yet he remains unharmed!"
"This man is possessed! Run away!

The Mongolian Army was not all elite, seeing Ding Ling’s unstoppable courage and invincibility, killing people as easily as killing chickens. Even their commanders, usually so high in their eyes, were easily slapped to death by Ding Ling, long losing their resolve!
Seeing Ding Ling kill and maim tens of thousands of people, yet still so vigorous and ferocious, everyone was filled with terror, their hearts and minds trembling!
Some martial arts heroes watching from afar were scared out of their wits, inhaling sharply at the sight.
Ma Guangzuo murmured:
"This is... can we be sure this guy is human?!"
"He’s too strong."
A cold sweat broke out on Yinkexi:
"Lucky I ran quickly, or I would’ve been easily slapped to death by this guy."
There were players among Kublai’s army.
Someone had already shouted out Ding Ling’s name.
So Yinkexi and his group at this moment also confirmed that the person killing enemies with the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms was indeed Ding Ling.
"His mere hands have reached such a frightening level, truly like deities!"
A man with grey-white hair and beard, hunchbacked, left foot crippled, and leaned on a cane under his shoulder came out from the military’s blacksmith shop.

He was none other than Huang the Herbalist’s disciple Fengh Mofeng, conscripted into the Mongolian Army as a blacksmith. At this moment, he was also watching the battle, witnessing scenes of Ding Ling with a pair of bare hands fighting enemies on all sides, killing them in rivers of blood and causing the enemy forces to scatter, leaving him in awe and shock!
But also with boiling blood:
"A man should be like this! If I, Fengh Mofeng, could also reach this level of martial arts prowess, able to sweep through the Mongolian army, then I would have no regrets!"

There was also Gui Xinshu, the Divine Fist Invincible ascending from The Deer and the Cauldron World, a disciple of Divine Sword Immortal Ape Mu Renqing, who initially intended to avenge his master’s death.

But now, upon seeing Ding Ling’s prowess, he was utterly shaken, his legs trembling, unable to decide, how could he still speak of revenge, only wanting to quickly leave this terrible and horrifying scene.
There were also famous generals from other worlds and martial arts heroes all watching sharply, either with great vigor, full of reverence, longing, or in immense awe...
The myriad states of the human condition were vast and varied.
But undeniable was that this battle truly made Ding Ling’s fearsome reputation resound far and wide and would likely spread throughout Jiuzhou.
"Roar!"

Wherever Ding Ling passed, it was a scene of blood and carnage, he periodically unleashed Ghost Realm’s Howling Wind, Lion’s Roar, and Sound Wave Skill to show his might, often causing headaches within hundreds of meters, significantly reducing combat effectiveness, allowing Ding Ling’s twin palms to easily strike them down.
This rampage.
Who dared to stand against?
Even the Mongolian soldiers filled with fury and murderous intent could no longer hold up and had already begun to scatter, at this moment fully collapsing, fleeing in all directions!
"Run away quickly!"
"That guy is not human!"

"Blades can’t cut him, arrows can’t pierce him! We have absolutely no way to deal with him, and he can easily kill us, how is this even a fight! More critically, despite all the killing up to now, he remains full of energy, only getting more vicious, his combat power skyrocketing; we stand no chance against him!"
Roar!

Ding Ling’s eyes were red, killing until there was no one left on the entire battlefield, then he panted heavily, the Qingnang Scripture running almost instinctively, clearing his mind. As soon as he cleared his mind, Ding Ling quickly circulated Buddha Qi.
Sizzle!
Streaks of glaring and obvious Blood Evil were expelled.
Ding Ling watched, his heart pounding, not anticipating how much Evil Qi he had absorbed this time, so thick that he almost went berserk without realizing it.
"Thankfully, my abilities are profound now, with the constantly running Qingnang Scripture keeping me sane, preventing true madness!"
Buddha Qi is hard to run with martial arts during combat.
But Qingnang Scripture can.
After the battle, by rapidly expelling Evil Qi with Buddha Qi, Ding Ling realized the gap between himself and those born as War Gods.
"Seems I must endeavor to enhance Buddha Qi. Or practice similar techniques like Qingnang Scripture more diligently."
Ding Ling pondered, surveying the entire field.
This time, the number of people he killed or wounded might have reached seventy to eighty thousand.
The efficiency in killing was astounding, as expected.
With a mere strike of his bare hands, he could often easily overturn dozens or even hundreds of people at once!
Because these Mongolian troops were so densely packed, a single Time Riding Six Dragons move could easily achieve great success!
"Using Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms to kill ordinary soldiers is even more efficient than the Drumming Golden Hammer."
The palm power of Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms, driven by Fusion Qi, truly exploded like bombs sweeping the ground.
Ordinary people simply couldn’t withstand it.
"It’s over now."
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel.
[Achievement Medal Obtained: You stunned Ma Guangzuo.]
[Achievement Medal Obtained: You stunned Yinkexi]
[Achievement Medal Obtained: You stunned Xiaoxiangzi]
[Achievement Medal Obtained: You stunned Nimo Star.]
[Achievement Medal Obtained: You stunned Darma]

[Note: Your god-like presence, with the power of subduing dragons, has impressed all who witnessed this battle! Heroes who saw your fight surrendered to your overpowering might, fearing you from the depths of their hearts!]
[E-level Medal Obtained: Defeated an Army of Three Hundred Thousand!]
[Note: You single-handedly routed an army of three hundred thousand Mongolian soldiers! You’re worthy of being called the number one in Jiuzhou World!]
Countless notifications filled Ding Ling’s view.
He obtained twenty-eight Achievement Medals in one go.
Clearly, many notable individuals from various planes met the criteria.

chapters.title: Chapter 472: Boiling Over
paragraphs: Kublai Khan, Darma, Nimo Star...
All are among them.
All have become figures on the medal list.
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel:
[Achievement Medals: Ordinary 93, E-level 12]
Simply exchanging the strength of the four-dimensional attributes back to reality, Ding Ling spent a total of 27 achievement medals.
The exchange of inner power attributes also cost 15 medals.
Exchanging about one point of True Power Value requires 3 ordinary achievement medals.
The exchange of four-dimensional attributes is 3 points requiring one medal.
Ding Ling’s physique and other four-dimensional attributes have now reached 60 points. Approximately 80 points need to be redeemed back to reality.
In addition, wisdom and charm have also improved.
So a total of 27 medals were spent.
"There are still too few E-level medals. Not enough to even exchange for a Tier Four Mortal Storage Pouch."
Ding Ling also planned to exchange a storage pouch upon ascension this time.
After all, one storage pouch is really not enough!
This time he intends to exchange for a larger one.
But can’t even exchange for Tier Four?
How can the others be exchanged?
"So this time, leading the army to conquer Jiuzhou and sweep the world, it is estimated that a lot of E-level medals can be obtained."
Breaking through an army of 300,000 can obtain E-level.
It’s imaginable that if battling all over the world, surely many E-level medals can be amassed!
Just like in the Three Kingdoms World.
Ding Ling also obtained many E-level medals through various battles.
But it seems that these E-level medals must have limitations, because defeating the same army, some may get E-level, while some may only get ordinary.
Ding Ling is clear about this.
He also knows this must be related to historical trajectory and fame, among other factors.
Like this time breaking through the 300,000 Mongolian army, naturally, E-level can be obtained. Whereas if it were the Japanese army, it might only earn ordinary achievement medals.
"It’s time to go."
Ding Ling activated the Spiral Nine Shadows, moved swiftly, and soon arrived at the area where Hoduo had previously been hidden.
He had been acupressured by Ding Ling and hidden in this secret thicket. At this moment, Ding Ling grabbed him, finding him still visibly shaken.
Just now the scene was too chaotic.

Ten thousand horses galloping, the sound of killing shaking the sky and earth, arrows flying everywhere; he, unable to move, nearly got shot several times, but fortunately, most of the arrows were headed towards the center of the battlefield!
He avoided several deadly catastrophes because of this!
Though through some gaps in the bushes and the furious roars, he could still vaguely speculate what happened.
Now, picked up by Ding Ling, he glanced around the battlefield, wincing, body trembling in horror and unable to speak.
It was too tragic!
Blood flowed profusely, corpses scattered everywhere, and wherever he looked, it was all fragments!
How many people have died here?
Hoduo’s gaze at Ding Ling changed over and over; this time, it carried tenfold more reverence! Any small thoughts he had before completely vanished.
"Let’s go!"
Ding Ling picked up Hoduo and headed back to Xiangyang.
His speed was incredibly fast.
This thrilling battle seemed to have unblocked some of Ding Ling’s fine meridians, making his Five Great Breathing Techniques and Nine Yang Divine Skill run faster!
Driven by Fusion Qi, Ding Ling flew tens of miles in one breath as if it were nothing!
Truly like an immortal!
He walked on air, untouched by land, soaring with ease, watching the green mountains and rivers pass beneath him.
Ding Ling, moving with the speed of wind and lightning, occasionally saw some scattered martial arts heroes and Mongolian soldiers.
Ding Ling couldn’t be bothered to go down and kill them.
Seeing Ding Ling, they all turned pale, speechless, only standing passively to await their fate. But seeing Ding Ling ignore them, flying away like a Martial God.
They couldn’t help but be ecstatic, thrilled to have cheated death.
To survive beneath Ding Ling’s hand, how lucky must one be?!
If it were before.
Someone ignoring them would certainly enrage them.
But now, they’re only thankful!
Only because their opponent is an entity like gods and demons: Ding Ling!
A figure whose mere thought is enough to make them tremble in body and spirit!
Ding Ling returned to Xiangyang City.
Round trip.
It took only a day or two.
Even the news from the battlefield hadn’t reached Xiangyang yet.
Ding Ling planned to wait here for the commotion.
Once the news spread everywhere.
He would propose to Guo Jing to organize an iron-blooded army, marching north to reclaim lost lands.
If Guo Jing doesn’t act.
Ding Ling would choose others to do it.
Great Song does not lack heroes, and moreover, many brave warriors have ascended from various plane worlds!
Once he sweeps Jiuzhou, leaving only Xiangyang, what can Guo Jing do then?
Ding Ling ignored worldly conflicts, staying at the Guo Mansion, wholeheartedly instructing Little Dragon Girl.
With various great medicines brought back and Ding Ling, a Supreme Grandmaster, wholeheartedly guiding her.
Coupled with Little Dragon Girl’s extraordinary talent, arguably unique in the world, a true daughter of heaven!
Her breathing technique progress soared rapidly day by day.
Physical fitness improved daily.
In just a few days.
The External Refining Breathing Technique leaped forward a step, advancing to a complete level, nearing mastery.
It was also on this day.
Ding Ling killed Nimo Star, slapped Kublai to death with one palm, single-handedly broke through the 300,000 Mongolian army, causing their rout, and the event reached Xiangyang.
Then spread like wildfire, quickly ’burning’ in all directions, to every household.
All of Xiangyang boiled over!
The civilians rushed to the long streets, beating drums or loudly calling out Ding Ling’s name.
Undoubtedly.
On this day.
At this moment.
Ding Ling became the true god of Xiangyang.

Guo Fu, Da and Xiao Wu were playing outside, saw this scene, couldn’t help but be shaken, and ran back home, just in time to see Huang Rong, Guo Jing, Zhu Ziliu, and others in ecstatic conversation with Ding Ling and his wife.
Guo Fu listened intently, hearing nothing but ’Worthy as the Guardian God of Xiangyang!’ ’Ding Ling, you’re the light of Great Song!’ ’With you here, Xiangyang can rest easy!’

Guo Fu felt waves of emotions surging within her, couldn’t help but secretly glance at Ding Ling, seeing his sword-brows and starry eyes, tall and dignified, a blend of nobility, overbearing aura, and sacredness, like a deity fallen to the mortal world, a Dragon Child playing among people, leaving Guo Fu dazzled.
Da and Xiao Wu nearby felt a bitter twinge in their hearts but didn’t have the courage to question Ding Ling.
Only because Ding Ling’s battle at Xiangyang had already proven his martial prowess and unparalleled skill.
This time, entering the enemy camp alone, killing a grand marshal like Kublai.
Further proving Ding Ling’s incredible nature.
Da and Xiao Wu were like this.

Huang Rong, Guo Jing, Luu Youjiao, Zhu Ziliu, and others were without exception, faces flushed with joy, praising Ding Ling to the utmost! Wishing to pile all the most splendid, most beautiful, most melodious words in the world onto Ding Ling.

sentences.text: Kublai Khan, Darma, Nimo Star...
All are among them.
All have become figures on the medal list.
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel:
[Achievement Medals: Ordinary 93, E-level 12]
Simply exchanging the strength of the four-dimensional attributes back to reality, Ding Ling spent a total of 27 achievement medals.
The exchange of inner power attributes also cost 15 medals.
Exchanging about one point of True Power Value requires 3 ordinary achievement medals.
The exchange of four-dimensional attributes is 3 points requiring one medal.
Ding Ling’s physique and other four-dimensional attributes have now reached 60 points.
Approximately 80 points need to be redeemed back to reality.
In addition, wisdom and charm have also improved.
So a total of 27 medals were spent.
"There are still too few E-level medals.
Not enough to even exchange for a Tier Four Mortal Storage Pouch."
Ding Ling also planned to exchange a storage pouch upon ascension this time.
After all, one storage pouch is really not enough!
This time he intends to exchange for a larger one.
But can’t even exchange for Tier Four?
How can the others be exchanged?
"So this time, leading the army to conquer Jiuzhou and sweep the world, it is estimated that a lot of E-level medals can be obtained."
Breaking through an army of 300,000 can obtain E-level.
It’s imaginable that if battling all over the world, surely many E-level medals can be amassed!
Just like in the Three Kingdoms World.
Ding Ling also obtained many E-level medals through various battles.
But it seems that these E-level medals must have limitations, because defeating the same army, some may get E-level, while some may only get ordinary.
Ding Ling is clear about this.
He also knows this must be related to historical trajectory and fame, among other factors.
Like this time breaking through the 300,000 Mongolian army, naturally, E-level can be obtained.
Whereas if it were the Japanese army, it might only earn ordinary achievement medals.
"It’s time to go."
Ding Ling activated the Spiral Nine Shadows, moved swiftly, and soon arrived at the area where Hoduo had previously been hidden.
He had been acupressured by Ding Ling and hidden in this secret thicket.
At this moment, Ding Ling grabbed him, finding him still visibly shaken.
Just now the scene was too chaotic.

Ten thousand horses galloping, the sound of killing shaking the sky and earth, arrows flying everywhere; he, unable to move, nearly got shot several times, but fortunately, most of the arrows were headed towards the center of the battlefield!
He avoided several deadly catastrophes because of this!
Though through some gaps in the bushes and the furious roars, he could still vaguely speculate what happened.
Now, picked up by Ding Ling, he glanced around the battlefield, wincing, body trembling in horror and unable to speak.
It was too tragic!
Blood flowed profusely, corpses scattered everywhere, and wherever he looked, it was all fragments!
How many people have died here?
Hoduo’s gaze at Ding Ling changed over and over; this time, it carried tenfold more reverence!
Any small thoughts he had before completely vanished.
"Let’s go!"
Ding Ling picked up Hoduo and headed back to Xiangyang.
His speed was incredibly fast.
This thrilling battle seemed to have unblocked some of Ding Ling’s fine meridians, making his Five Great Breathing Techniques and Nine Yang Divine Skill run faster!
Driven by Fusion Qi, Ding Ling flew tens of miles in one breath as if it were nothing!
Truly like an immortal!
He walked on air, untouched by land, soaring with ease, watching the green mountains and rivers pass beneath him.
Ding Ling, moving with the speed of wind and lightning, occasionally saw some scattered martial arts heroes and Mongolian soldiers.
Ding Ling couldn’t be bothered to go down and kill them.
Seeing Ding Ling, they all turned pale, speechless, only standing passively to await their fate.
But seeing Ding Ling ignore them, flying away like a Martial God.
They couldn’t help but be ecstatic, thrilled to have cheated death.
To survive beneath Ding Ling’s hand, how lucky must one be?!
If it were before.
Someone ignoring them would certainly enrage them.
But now, they’re only thankful!
Only because their opponent is an entity like gods and demons: Ding Ling!
A figure whose mere thought is enough to make them tremble in body and spirit!
Ding Ling returned to Xiangyang City.
Round trip.
It took only a day or two.
Even the news from the battlefield hadn’t reached Xiangyang yet.
Ding Ling planned to wait here for the commotion.
Once the news spread everywhere.
He would propose to Guo Jing to organize an iron-blooded army, marching north to reclaim lost lands.
If Guo Jing doesn’t act.
Ding Ling would choose others to do it.
Great Song does not lack heroes, and moreover, many brave warriors have ascended from various plane worlds!
Once he sweeps Jiuzhou, leaving only Xiangyang, what can Guo Jing do then?
Ding Ling ignored worldly conflicts, staying at the Guo Mansion, wholeheartedly instructing Little Dragon Girl.
With various great medicines brought back and Ding Ling, a Supreme Grandmaster, wholeheartedly guiding her.
Coupled with Little Dragon Girl’s extraordinary talent, arguably unique in the world, a true daughter of heaven!
Her breathing technique progress soared rapidly day by day.
Physical fitness improved daily.
In just a few days.
The External Refining Breathing Technique leaped forward a step, advancing to a complete level, nearing mastery.
It was also on this day.
Ding Ling killed Nimo Star, slapped Kublai to death with one palm, single-handedly broke through the 300,000 Mongolian army, causing their rout, and the event reached Xiangyang.
Then spread like wildfire, quickly ’burning’ in all directions, to every household.
All of Xiangyang boiled over!
The civilians rushed to the long streets, beating drums or loudly calling out Ding Ling’s name.
Undoubtedly.
On this day.
At this moment.
Ding Ling became the true god of Xiangyang.

Guo Fu, Da and Xiao Wu were playing outside, saw this scene, couldn’t help but be shaken, and ran back home, just in time to see Huang Rong, Guo Jing, Zhu Ziliu, and others in ecstatic conversation with Ding Ling and his wife.
Guo Fu listened intently, hearing nothing but ’Worthy as the Guardian God of Xiangyang!’ ’Ding Ling, you’re the light of Great Song!’ ’With you here, Xiangyang can rest easy!’

Guo Fu felt waves of emotions surging within her, couldn’t help but secretly glance at Ding Ling, seeing his sword-brows and starry eyes, tall and dignified, a blend of nobility, overbearing aura, and sacredness, like a deity fallen to the mortal world, a Dragon Child playing among people, leaving Guo Fu dazzled.
Da and Xiao Wu nearby felt a bitter twinge in their hearts but didn’t have the courage to question Ding Ling.
Only because Ding Ling’s battle at Xiangyang had already proven his martial prowess and unparalleled skill.
This time, entering the enemy camp alone, killing a grand marshal like Kublai.
Further proving Ding Ling’s incredible nature.
Da and Xiao Wu were like this.
Huang Rong, Guo Jing, Luu Youjiao, Zhu Ziliu, and others were without exception, faces flushed with joy, praising Ding Ling to the utmost!
Wishing to pile all the most splendid, most beautiful, most melodious words in the world onto Ding Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 473: On Becoming Empress
paragraphs: Little Dragon Girl stood aside, smiling brightly, her eyes filled with pride and joy.
This is her husband!
On this day, Ding Ling proposed forming an army to march northward.
Guo Jing naturally agreed.
With Ding Ling at the helm,
The lands lost by the Great Song would soon be reclaimed!
He was very excited.
However, Huang Rong seemed to have seen something, and she sighed inwardly, and after this meeting, she privately approached Ding Ling, saying:
"The Great Song Court is utterly corrupt, and the rewards for you have been variously deducted and embezzled. The rewards that reached Xiangyang City were less than a thousand taels of Silver."
She felt ashamed:
"I failed to do what I promised you; it’s my dereliction."
"It’s not your fault."
Ding Ling remained calm and composed.
This was the late Southern Song.
The court being corrupt was normal.
According to the usual course of history, the complete annihilation of the Southern Song was only about thirty years away.
Guo Jing and Huang Rong would also perish in the future with the fall of Xiangyang.
One family’s strength was no match for a nation’s might.

Unless they reached Ding Ling’s Grandmaster Realm! With Fusion Qi driving forward, invincible to those who came near, then there might be a chance to turn the tide, otherwise, it’s just wishful thinking!
How strong is Ding Ling’s Martial Arts Grandmaster?

He could leap forward over ten miles in one breath! He could ignore attacks from anyone below the Initial Tier Innate! Protected by the Nine Yang Divine Skill’s Gang Qi along with his own Defense, even an ordinary rain of arrows from mortal men would be useless, unless a group of first-class peak masters besieged him with arrows!
In addition to that, his endurance was extremely strong, maintaining peak combat strength, fighting continuously for five days and nights without the slightest problem!
Defense, attack, speed, stamina!
He possessed them all!
Moreover, his resistance to poison was equally strong, ordinary poison couldn’t kill him at all!
So capable, asked who in the world dared confront him? Who could stop him?!

Huang Rong extracted a lot of real information about Ding Ling from the mouths of the super homebody, super naive Little Dragon Girl, and coupled with various pieces of information from all directions, she roughly inferred Ding Ling’s current combat power, realizing that Ding Ling already possessed the capability to easily influence the entire world’s direction and layout with his own strength!
Such a Divine Being!
What choice would Huang Rong make?
Her mind turned, she said:
"Ding Ling, what exactly do you want? If it doesn’t go against your original intention, our entire family will fully support you."
"Do you want to become the empress?
Ding Ling suddenly asked.
Huang Rong was stunned, somewhat baffled, but soon, she didn’t know what to think of, her face reddened like an apple, looking at Ding Ling in disbelief:
"You, you, you..."
"Don’t get the wrong idea."
Ding Ling’s mouth curved slightly:
"I’m asking whether you intend to make Guo Jing the emperor. If so, I will cooperate with you."
He sighed deeply:

"I won’t stay long in this world. After restoring the mountains and rivers and settling Little Dragon Girl, I will ascend and leave, so I can’t be the emperor. Observing this Jiuzhou Territory, there are really too few righteous, upright, meticulous people like Guo Jing and Hero Guo, who are willing to act as a spokesperson for the people!
As it is so.
Why can’t a suitable person be made emperor? Wouldn’t you agree?"
Ding Ling looked at Huang Rong:

"You are extremely clever, you should know that without me stepping up, with your Guo family’s ability, how long can you hold Xiangyang on your own? After all, the Great Song Court is so corrupt. Without subsequent support, how long can you hold on relying solely on your family?!
By then, if the family dies in battle? Don’t you find it a pity, pathetic, lamentable, hateful, painful?
You are fighting for the people.
It’s for the people of Jiuzhou.
And not for that high and mighty, utterly corrupt court.
Huang Rong. Many people call you the Female Zhuge. I’ve said this much, how to choose. You decide for yourself."
"This, this, I, I..."
The Female Zhuge, like Huang Rong, was also dumbfounded by what Ding Ling had said!
She originally came to probe Ding Ling’s thoughts and tried to persuade him.
She never expected Ding Ling was actually thinking of helping Guo Jing become emperor, and making her the empress!
Empress...
Huang Rong’s heart skipped a beat.
Calm, witty, astute, cunning as she was, she was now in a daze, bewildered.
She couldn’t even remember how she bid farewell to Ding Ling or returned to her chamber!
There was only one thought in her mind.
’Should she become the empress?!’
"What’s wrong with you?!"
Guo Jing eyed her, perplexed, concerned:
"Did something happen with Ding Ling?
He had matured greatly.
The trials of blood and fire had made him see through many people and events.
The only thing that hadn’t changed was his noble, patriotic nature for the country and the people.
Huang Rong glanced at Guo Jing, thinking to herself:

"Ding Ling was not wrong at all. If things continue like this, Brother Jing, Fu’Er, and even including the child in my belly might all die untimely. This is absolutely unacceptable. I must prepare in advance, not let things develop this way."
Before, there was no turning point.
Nor was there any help from a benefactor.
They could only resist with all their might, ready to sacrifice their lives!
Now there was a turning point, and help from a benefactor.

Huang Rong felt a great sense of relief, as if the clouds parted and the sky cleared, the whole world seemed to become entirely different, where previously she was confined to the realm of Xiangyang, she could now see across Jiuzhou, even the world!
She thought:
"The court is corrupt like a terminally ill patient, even if barely saved, it wouldn’t last many years, we might still be secretly executed due to high achievements once Ding Ling leaves.
In history, there have been many examples of the elimination of the useful immediately after winning!
With such a corrupt court now, can we expect them to be magnanimous and treat meritorious officials generously? Isn’t that like expecting pigs to climb trees, or wild dogs to fly in the sky?!"
With a clear mind.
Huang Rong had a plan in her heart.
Of course, she also knew that talking to Guo Jing about such matters now wouldn’t be settled immediately.
They could only plan step by step.
After thinking it through.
Huang Rong immediately felt clear and bright inside, her entire being became vibrant, rejuvenated as if in the second spring of her life.
Guo Jing looked on, puzzled, and said directly:
"Rong’Er, just a moment ago you were in a daze as if sleepwalking, how in the next moment are you so radiant?"
Huang Rong simply smiled and said:
"Brother Jing, this matter cannot be explained to you clearly immediately, I’ll just ask you one thing, do you trust me?"
"Of course, I trust you. If I don’t trust you, who else can I trust?"
"That’s good. Since you trust me, you must trust Ding Ling. Follow him, whatever he tells you to do, just do it."
"Oh?"
Guo Jing was puzzled, but seeing Huang Rong’s serious tone, he could only suppress his inner confusion.
Starting from that day.
Ding Ling, Guo Jing, Huang Rong, Little Dragon Girl, Zhu Ziliu, and others all donned armor, mounted their horses, and headed towards the Northern Lands.
