chapters.title: Chapter 474: Ding Ling vs. Eastern Evil
paragraphs: Huang Rong is pregnant, so when it comes to real battles, it’s not her turn. She sits in the rear to coordinate various matters.
Because of this.
She even called her father, Huang the Herbalist, over.
Huang the Herbalist also missed Huang Rong’s family, came to visit, and was conveniently roped in by Huang Rong to act as ’labor.’
Huang Rong didn’t hide anything from him and told him Ding Ling’s plan.
Huang the Herbalist wasn’t surprised but rather delighted, laughed heartily, and said:

"I’ve long heard of Ding Ling’s name and never had the chance to meet him. Didn’t expect him to be such a wonderful person, well done, well done! Someone like Guo Jing is really too stubborn, too dull!
Man is born between heaven and earth and should live joyfully, freely, carefreely, and leisurely!
Where is Ding Ling? I want to have a good chat with him."
Huang Rong also felt relieved in her heart. She didn’t expect to gain support from Brother Jing now, but having her father’s support was also a great joy for her. She then charmingly said:
"Ding Ling is with Brother Jing, Hoduo, Luu Youjiao, and others breaking into the city. I estimate it won’t be long before they return."
"Won’t be long?"
Huang the Herbalist glanced sideways: "How many troops do you have?"
"Just over three thousand."
Huang Rong’s face flushed slightly, but thinking of Ding Ling’s capabilities, she immediately spoke confidently:

"But along the way, Ding Ling’s city-breaking speed is truly unparalleled. He alone is worth a million troops! With him around, all obstacles and little rogues will be quickly cleared away. We just need to follow behind him for cleanup and coordination."
Huang the Herbalist looked doubtful: "Could the rumors about Ding Ling be all true?!"
"Absolutely true!"
Huang Rong spoke assuredly: "It can only be stronger than the rumors, not weaker."
Huang the Herbalist’s expression changed slightly upon hearing this, said somewhat unnaturally:
"How could there be such a strong person in the world?! From what you say, even the combined Five Extremes aren’t worth one of his fingers?!"
"That’s pretty much what I mean."
Huang Rong spoke calmly and peacefully.
Huang the Herbalist was speechless, somewhat displeased: "How old is Ding Ling, even if he started training from the womb, he wouldn’t be this strong."
"People are not comparable."
Huang Rong looked at Huang the Herbalist in surprise: "Father, isn’t this what you often say to me? Saying that among all the fools in the world, only you are the world’s number one smartest."
Huang the Herbalist was momentarily speechless, snorted and said:

"I, Huang the Herbalist, have trained to this point over many years. If Ding Ling can surpass me in Martial Dao, I can only say his talent in the Martial Dao is remarkable. But he might not surpass me in other areas?!"
"That’s not necessarily true."
Huang Rong said crisply: "Father, if you meet Ding Ling, you will definitely be affected by him. Oh, by the way."
She seemed to remember something:
"Do you remember the contents of the family library?"

"Of course. Your father is well-versed in astronomy and geography, Five Elements and Eight Trigrams, Qimen Dunjia, Music, Chess, Calligraphy, and Painting, Agricultural Water Control, Economic and Military Strategy, knows it all, excels in all! I am just a living, walking library!"
Huang the Herbalist said proudly.
"That’s good. When you meet Ding Ling later, if you are free, pass all these onto him. I’ve already taught him the martial arts of Peach Blossom Island."
Huang the Herbalist glanced sideways.
Huang Rong immediately explained further, particularly emphasizing Ding Ling’s speed in learning martial arts.
Huang the Herbalist was shaken, stroked his beard, and said:
"Then I am somewhat looking forward to meeting Ding Ling."
Two hours later.
Ding Ling returned with his team.
Zhu Ziliu was left to oversee the surrender of the City Lord, warriors, and the people’s livelihoods.
Zhu Ziliu previously served as Prime Minister of the Dali Kingdom, so dealing with this posed no problem.
Add to this, Ding Ling had Huang Rong and Zhu Ziliu post many recruitment notices in the captured city pools, attracting numerous players, ancients, and ascenders.
Furthermore, among the surrendering figures were quite a few truly talented individuals, so there was no immediate shortage of talent.
Ding Ling’s goal is to quickly flatten this world.
So he only focuses on warfare; livelihood, talent management, talent recruitment, and city management are all entrusted to Huang Rong, Zhu Ziliu, and others.
After strategizing a city, he took Hoduo, Little Dragon Girl, and others to the residence for rest.
And met Huang Rong who was looking for him.
She said her father wanted to meet him.
Ding Ling felt a bit surprised, but didn’t think too much about it. His fierce reputation had spread in the north, and his fame was well-known in the Great Song!
It’s only reasonable that Huang Laoxie would want to meet him.
Under Huang Rong’s guidance, Ding Ling met Eastern Evil Huang the Herbalist, a person of refined and elegant appearance!
In terms of looks, build, and demeanor, he was extraordinary, making one instantly know that he must be a person of boundless talents.
His eyes were as deep as the stars and the universe, and his demeanor was transcendent, as if he were hovering above the clouds.
A person with such aura is truly rare.
Little did they know.

In Huang the Herbalist’s eyes, Ding Ling was also a rare person amalgamating nobility, overbearing aura, and divine presence; thus, at their first glance, both steadied themselves mentally, not daring to underestimate the other.
Encouraged by Huang Rong’s warm hospitality.

Huang the Herbalist seemed intent on testing Ding Ling, discussing ancient and modern affairs, pointing out the rivers and mountains, and passionately engaging in literary dialogues! Astronomy, geography, music, chess, calligraphy, and painting, he couldn’t help but showcase them one by one.
However, in this aspect, Ding Ling, who possessed the abilities of several worlds, had already reached an unsurpassable level, so how could he lose to him?
Indeed, the waves of the Yangtze River push forward, overwhelming Huang the Herbalist.
Huang the Herbalist, surprised and astonished, couldn’t help but take out a jade flute and play the Jade Sea Tide-Rising Melody.
Ding Ling smiled slightly and also took out a jade flute, but he played The Smiling, Proud Wanderer!
Both had formidable proficiency in the Sound Wave Skill.

Ding Ling had mastered several sound wave skills, all to the full level, and at this moment, playing The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, he slightly activated Fusion Qi, crushing the surging sound of waves from Huang the Herbalist as if Mount Tai were crushing an egg!
"Amazing!"

Although Huang the Herbalist was arrogant, unrestrained, and unconventional, he was an upright person. At this moment, seeing Ding Ling’s proficiency in the Sound Wave Skill far surpassing his own, he couldn’t help but put down the jade flute that was near his mouth, feeling a sense of admiration, he exclaimed:
"What melody is this? It really excites and inspires one!"
"The Smiling, Proud Wanderer."
"Could you teach me?"
"No problem.
"Haha..."
Huang the Herbalist laughed:
"I heard from Rong’er that you want to learn my Qimen Dunjia and Alchemy and Bagua Skill. Is that true?"
"Of course it’s true."
"Good. I can teach you. But before that, I want to test your Martial Arts Creation."
"Sure."
Having agreed, they immediately leapt outside the room, into the courtyard, and set up their stances.
"You first, elder."
Ding Ling assumed the starting stance of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms.
"Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms?"
Huang the Herbalist’s eyes flickered slightly, then he unhesitatingly used the Splitting Sky Palm towards Ding Ling:
"Come, try my Splitting Void Palm Force!"
Pa!
Bang bang bang!
As soon as the two exchanged blows, they immediately plunged into an intensive state.
One had the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms, each move surrounded by dragon-shaped phantoms, with dragon roars shaking the heavens and earth.

The other moved like the wind, with divine grace, with a hand wielding Splitting Void Palm Force, causing the void to ripple constantly. When they started, the entire courtyard seemed to stir up a tornado.
Others couldn’t stand steadily, having to retreat three feet.
But it was only after a moment.
Huang the Herbalist leapt out of the battle circle, looked at Ding Ling with a complex expression, waved his hand, and said:
"No more, no more."
He sighed deeply:

"I didn’t expect that in Huang the Herbalist’s life, nearing old age, I would encounter a young man who could crush me in every aspect. Truly too unexpected, too pleasant, too shocking. Indeed, there’s always someone better, and it makes me understand not to be too arrogant or arrogant.
Even if I think myself the world’s number one, Heaven immediately sends someone stronger to open my eyes, to make me realize that one must remain humble, refrain from over-pride.
Huang the Herbalist may say this, but after saying it, he still let out a long laugh, saying:
"Though I am defeated by you, I won’t easily admit defeat! The days are long, I will definitely further research Martial Dao, striving to catch up with your footsteps."
What kind of person is Huang the Herbalist?
Once they exchanged hands.
He perceived that Ding Ling was holding back.

This made him feel deeply ashamed, but even when he used all his strength and various methods, he couldn’t harm Ding Ling in the slightest. Instead, Ding Ling with just a slight exertion, forced him to retreat by three feet.
After a few rounds.
Huang the Herbalist felt somewhat disheartened, naturally not wanting to continue fighting.
He now suddenly understood the feelings of those contemporaries or predecessors he had crushed, feeling incredibly unpleasant!
Being beaten by a young man to the point of having no temper.
This truly was a first in his life!

sentences.text: Huang Rong is pregnant, so when it comes to real battles, it’s not her turn.
She sits in the rear to coordinate various matters.
Because of this.
She even called her father, Huang the Herbalist, over.
Huang the Herbalist also missed Huang Rong’s family, came to visit, and was conveniently roped in by Huang Rong to act as ’labor.’
Huang Rong didn’t hide anything from him and told him Ding Ling’s plan.
Huang the Herbalist wasn’t surprised but rather delighted, laughed heartily, and said:
"I’ve long heard of Ding Ling’s name and never had the chance to meet him.
Didn’t expect him to be such a wonderful person, well done, well done!
Someone like Guo Jing is really too stubborn, too dull!
Man is born between heaven and earth and should live joyfully, freely, carefreely, and leisurely!
Where is Ding Ling?
I want to have a good chat with him."
Huang Rong also felt relieved in her heart.
She didn’t expect to gain support from Brother Jing now, but having her father’s support was also a great joy for her.
She then charmingly said:
"Ding Ling is with Brother Jing, Hoduo, Luu Youjiao, and others breaking into the city.
I estimate it won’t be long before they return."
"Won’t be long?"
Huang the Herbalist glanced sideways: "How many troops do you have?"
"Just over three thousand."
Huang Rong’s face flushed slightly, but thinking of Ding Ling’s capabilities, she immediately spoke confidently:
"But along the way, Ding Ling’s city-breaking speed is truly unparalleled.
He alone is worth a million troops!
With him around, all obstacles and little rogues will be quickly cleared away.
We just need to follow behind him for cleanup and coordination."
Huang the Herbalist looked doubtful: "Could the rumors about Ding Ling be all true?!"
"Absolutely true!"
Huang Rong spoke assuredly: "It can only be stronger than the rumors, not weaker."
Huang the Herbalist’s expression changed slightly upon hearing this, said somewhat unnaturally:
"How could there be such a strong person in the world?!
From what you say, even the combined Five Extremes aren’t worth one of his fingers?!"
"That’s pretty much what I mean."
Huang Rong spoke calmly and peacefully.
Huang the Herbalist was speechless, somewhat displeased: "How old is Ding Ling, even if he started training from the womb, he wouldn’t be this strong."
"People are not comparable."
Huang Rong looked at Huang the Herbalist in surprise: "Father, isn’t this what you often say to me?
Saying that among all the fools in the world, only you are the world’s number one smartest."
Huang the Herbalist was momentarily speechless, snorted and said:
"I, Huang the Herbalist, have trained to this point over many years.
If Ding Ling can surpass me in Martial Dao, I can only say his talent in the Martial Dao is remarkable.
But he might not surpass me in other areas?!"
"That’s not necessarily true."
Huang Rong said crisply: "Father, if you meet Ding Ling, you will definitely be affected by him.
Oh, by the way."
She seemed to remember something:
"Do you remember the contents of the family library?"
"Of course.

Your father is well-versed in astronomy and geography, Five Elements and Eight Trigrams, Qimen Dunjia, Music, Chess, Calligraphy, and Painting, Agricultural Water Control, Economic and Military Strategy, knows it all, excels in all!
I am just a living, walking library!"
Huang the Herbalist said proudly.
"That’s good.
When you meet Ding Ling later, if you are free, pass all these onto him.
I’ve already taught him the martial arts of Peach Blossom Island."
Huang the Herbalist glanced sideways.
Huang Rong immediately explained further, particularly emphasizing Ding Ling’s speed in learning martial arts.
Huang the Herbalist was shaken, stroked his beard, and said:
"Then I am somewhat looking forward to meeting Ding Ling."
Two hours later.
Ding Ling returned with his team.
Zhu Ziliu was left to oversee the surrender of the City Lord, warriors, and the people’s livelihoods.
Zhu Ziliu previously served as Prime Minister of the Dali Kingdom, so dealing with this posed no problem.
Add to this, Ding Ling had Huang Rong and Zhu Ziliu post many recruitment notices in the captured city pools, attracting numerous players, ancients, and ascenders.
Furthermore, among the surrendering figures were quite a few truly talented individuals, so there was no immediate shortage of talent.
Ding Ling’s goal is to quickly flatten this world.
So he only focuses on warfare; livelihood, talent management, talent recruitment, and city management are all entrusted to Huang Rong, Zhu Ziliu, and others.
After strategizing a city, he took Hoduo, Little Dragon Girl, and others to the residence for rest.
And met Huang Rong who was looking for him.
She said her father wanted to meet him.
Ding Ling felt a bit surprised, but didn’t think too much about it.
His fierce reputation had spread in the north, and his fame was well-known in the Great Song!
It’s only reasonable that Huang Laoxie would want to meet him.
Under Huang Rong’s guidance, Ding Ling met Eastern Evil Huang the Herbalist, a person of refined and elegant appearance!
In terms of looks, build, and demeanor, he was extraordinary, making one instantly know that he must be a person of boundless talents.
His eyes were as deep as the stars and the universe, and his demeanor was transcendent, as if he were hovering above the clouds.
A person with such aura is truly rare.
Little did they know.

In Huang the Herbalist’s eyes, Ding Ling was also a rare person amalgamating nobility, overbearing aura, and divine presence; thus, at their first glance, both steadied themselves mentally, not daring to underestimate the other.
Encouraged by Huang Rong’s warm hospitality.
Huang the Herbalist seemed intent on testing Ding Ling, discussing ancient and modern affairs, pointing out the rivers and mountains, and passionately engaging in literary dialogues!
Astronomy, geography, music, chess, calligraphy, and painting, he couldn’t help but showcase them one by one.
However, in this aspect, Ding Ling, who possessed the abilities of several worlds, had already reached an unsurpassable level, so how could he lose to him?
Indeed, the waves of the Yangtze River push forward, overwhelming Huang the Herbalist.
Huang the Herbalist, surprised and astonished, couldn’t help but take out a jade flute and play the Jade Sea Tide-Rising Melody.
Ding Ling smiled slightly and also took out a jade flute, but he played The Smiling, Proud Wanderer!
Both had formidable proficiency in the Sound Wave Skill.

Ding Ling had mastered several sound wave skills, all to the full level, and at this moment, playing The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, he slightly activated Fusion Qi, crushing the surging sound of waves from Huang the Herbalist as if Mount Tai were crushing an egg!
"Amazing!"
Although Huang the Herbalist was arrogant, unrestrained, and unconventional, he was an upright person.

At this moment, seeing Ding Ling’s proficiency in the Sound Wave Skill far surpassing his own, he couldn’t help but put down the jade flute that was near his mouth, feeling a sense of admiration, he exclaimed:
"What melody is this?
It really excites and inspires one!"
"The Smiling, Proud Wanderer."
"Could you teach me?"
"No problem.
"Haha..."
Huang the Herbalist laughed:
"I heard from Rong’er that you want to learn my Qimen Dunjia and Alchemy and Bagua Skill.
Is that true?"
"Of course it’s true."
"Good.
I can teach you.
But before that, I want to test your Martial Arts Creation."
"Sure."
Having agreed, they immediately leapt outside the room, into the courtyard, and set up their stances.
"You first, elder."
Ding Ling assumed the starting stance of the Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms.
"Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms?"
Huang the Herbalist’s eyes flickered slightly, then he unhesitatingly used the Splitting Sky Palm towards Ding Ling:
"Come, try my Splitting Void Palm Force!"
Pa!
Bang bang bang!

This made him feel deeply ashamed, but even when he used all his strength and various methods, he couldn’t harm Ding Ling in the slightest.
Instead, Ding Ling with just a slight exertion, forced him to retreat by three feet.
After a few rounds.
Huang the Herbalist felt somewhat disheartened, naturally not wanting to continue fighting.
He now suddenly understood the feelings of those contemporaries or predecessors he had crushed, feeling incredibly unpleasant!
Being beaten by a young man to the point of having no temper.
This truly was a first in his life!

chapters.title: Chapter 475: All That Huang the Herbalist Learned in His Life
paragraphs: Although that is the case.

Huang the Herbalist found himself increasingly fond of Ding Ling the more he looked at him, feeling as though he saw his younger self. Without caring about others’ views, he grabbed Ding Ling and said:

"Brother Ding, the moment I saw you, I felt a connection as if we were destined to meet. Let’s not mind the opinions of worldly people. If you don’t mind, would you consider becoming close friends with me, what do you think?"
"If a senior says so, how could I refuse?"
"Eh?"
Huang the Herbalist frowned:
"I said we’re to be close friends, I call you Brother Ding, so how could you refer to yourself as junior? You can call me by name or call me Isle Master Huang."
Ding Ling immediately cupped his hand and called him Isle Master Huang.
Huang the Herbalist laughed heartily, stroking his beard in satisfaction, he said:

"It’s rare to find a true friend in life. Brother Ding, come, come, come, let me see how quick-witted you are. Rong’Er always praises your rapid progress in Martial Arts, I must see it with my own eyes."
Ding Ling did not object.
He had always intended to learn all that Huang the Herbalist knew.
Now that Huang the Herbalist took the initiative to teach him.
Ding Ling naturally could not be more pleased.
The two of them then went to one side, one began instructing, the other listening attentively.
Indeed, Huang the Herbalist was one of the top figures in the world, with virtually no weaknesses, mastering everything!
It’s hard to imagine.
How a person in just a few decades, could become self-taught and learn so many skills and Martial Arts.
To say Huang the Herbalist’s life was like having cheat codes, is not an exaggeration.
It’s as if he was comparable to Wang Chongyang and Huang Shang, both geniuses who created their own Martial Arts.
Huang Shang created the Nine Yin Scripture, renowned throughout the world, showcasing his extraordinary talent and intellect.
Overall.
Huang the Herbalist was not inferior to Huang Shang, although his martial skills were inherited from ancient people, his other skills were indeed self-taught.
Can an ordinary Martial Artist, after getting a Martial Arts Secret Manual, learn it to the stage of Mastery?
Huang the Herbalist could!
And every skill he learned reached Mastery.
Though not as vast and varied as Ding Ling’s studies, the plethora of skills he grasped were readily available, and he was proficient in any of them, an exceptional talent indeed.
Yet, such a talent, now looked at Ding Ling with eyes as if seeing a prodigy.

This was because every skill he taught, just after explaining, Ding Ling immediately reached Great Perfection Innate Ability, learning at such a rapid speed that it could not be comprehended by conventional wisdom!
Even though Huang the Herbalist was mentally prepared, witnessing it himself was still utterly astonishing.
Thus he imparted various Secret Techniques to Ding Ling.
Seeing Ding Ling master each one to Great Perfection.
He couldn’t help but feel a storm of emotions within, unable to calm down.
He prided himself on his extraordinary genius, but today saw himself utterly overrun by this young brother Ding Ling!
So strong!
Such talent.
Absolutely unparalleled in history! Unbeatable, incomparable, unsurpassable!
Just think, Ding Ling could learn and master a skill, a Secret Technique in an instant!
What genius could break such an instant record?!
"Remarkable, utterly remarkable."
After passing all Secret Techniques and Skills to Ding Ling.
More than ten hours had passed.
Huang the Herbalist, after those many hours, was deeply shocked, but having been astonished for so long, he grew numb, looking at Ding Ling with the same eyes he would use to look at a monster.
He once again deeply understood the complicated expressions of other scholars whenever he learned something much faster than them during learning together in the past!
Back then he showed disdain for them, considering them fools!
Now he wondered, did Ding Ling look at him that way?

Upon careful observation, he saw Ding Ling showed no abnormalities, still expressing great admiration for him, he couldn’t help but heave a sigh of relief, thinking ’though I, Huang Laoxie, am far inferior to Brother Ding, I am still far superior to common folk, Brother Ding’s appreciation of me is understandable. His mindset, however, is so much better than mine.’
Huang the Herbalist felt inferior.
When he had overpowered others, he never appreciated them this way, revealing Ding Ling’s broad-mindedness, generosity, and tolerance, indeed transcending ordinary people.
The more he thought about it, the more he admired and recognized Ding Ling.
[Received E-level Achievement Medal: You’ve earned high recognition from Eastern Evil Huang the Herbalist!]

[Note: Throughout his life, Huang the Herbalist has never conceded to anyone! Even at the battle atop Huashan Peak, although Wang Chongyang defeated him, at most he only expressed admiration for Wang Chongyang’s Martial Arts. In other aspects, he still felt he could overpower Wang Chongyang.
But you are the only person to completely overpower him in every aspect.
Filling him with a sense of powerlessness and astonishment.
He was deeply impressed, amazed, and appreciated you highly!]
Hearing a notification sound.
Ding Ling smiled slightly.
During this time.
His Martial Arts Melting Furnace became increasingly clear.
This was because he had already learned dozens of skills from Huang the Herbalist,
[Alchemy Skill: Full Level]
This included the method to craft the precious Nine-Flower Jade Dew Pill.
[Five Elements Grand Transformation Array: Full Level]
This is the foundation of Peach Blossom Island’s Array Map. Involving various transformations.
After reaching Full Level, Ding Ling could use it as a basis to lay out the Five Elements Grand Transformation Array.
[Bamboo Stake Array: Full Level]
One hundred and thirteen bamboo stakes set in quadrilateral formation to form an array.
[Chaotic Stone Array: Full Level]
A formation with a total of thirty-six transformations, having similarities with Eight Array Map.
[Alchemy Skill: Full Level]
[Five Elements and Eight Trigrams Knowledge: Full Level]
Skills such as Music, Chess, Calligraphy, and Painting, Qimen Dunjia, and Agricultural Water Control, were all imparted to Ding Ling by Huang the Herbalist in one go.

At first, he was worried Ding Ling would learn slowly, but later found that as long as he uttered the explicit knowledge, Ding Ling could instantly achieve Mastery, thus he spoke faster and faster, teaching more and more.
Finally, emptying all his knowledge and skills.
Seeing that Ding Ling learned everything.
Feeling as though he had been drained.
Finally stopping.
His admiration for Ding Ling increased tremendously, calling him Brother Ding repeatedly, and drinking happily with him till the next day at dawn.
Then the gathering dispersed.
And he said:

"Brother Ding, thank you for your regard for Rong’Er, and that silly boy Guo Jing! Rest assured, I fully support you in this matter and stand on your side. If in the future, Guo Jing dares to not cooperate with you, I will make him pay."
Having seen Ding Ling’s unrivaled talent and versatile genius.

Huang the Herbalist admired and appreciated Ding Ling to the highest degree, thinking of Guo Jing, slow and muddle-headed, learning everything terribly slowly, naturally found it somewhat annoying, but as his son-in-law, despite calling him a silly boy, the care and protection for him were clearly seen by Ding Ling.
He just smiled, not saying much.
If Huang the Herbalist could manage Guo Jing, then Guo Jing wouldn’t be Guo Jing.
On this earth, if there were anyone who could manage Guo Jing, it might only be Huang Rong.
After bidding farewell to Huang the Herbalist.
Ding Ling once again donned his armor with Hoduo, Little Dragon Girl, and others and set off northward to the next city.
With Huang Rong’s side having Huang the Herbalist joining in.
Handling some logistic, livelihood, and other affairs, improved dramatically in efficiency and speed!

chapters.title: Chapter 476: Long Qie and Zhangg Han
paragraphs: It can only be said that Huang the Herbalist is truly extraordinary.
Combined with his martial arts reaching the Innate Realm, his energy is vigorous, and he handles various matters with ease.
Initially, perhaps due to being ’unfamiliar with the business,’ he was slower, but after guidance from Zhu Ziliu and others, he executed tasks effortlessly, incomparable to others.
This is what geniuses are like.
They cannot be judged by common sense!
Using an ordinary person’s perspective to gauge a genius? It’s unreasonable.
One must know that it’s remarkable for an ordinary person to master just one skill in a lifetime.
And how about Huang the Herbalist?
This does not account for the time spent traveling, visiting family, competing in martial arts, sleeping, etc.
Calling Huang the Herbalist a top-tier genius is definitely not an exaggeration.
Such a person in martial arts is among the Five Extremes.
In literature, he’s a Champion Scholar!
On the battlefield, he’s a Grand General; in court, he’s a Prime Minister!
Indeed, he can stabilize the world with a pen, and conquer Heaven and Earth from horseback!
With Huang Rong, Zhu Ziliu, and others safeguarding the rear, it was already quite stable. With this person joining, it became as stable as Mount Tai.
Ding Ling entrusted recruiting talent, gathering surrendered armies, stabilizing public sentiment, and other matters to Huang Rong, Huang the Herbalist, and others.
He continued his aggressive advance northward.
Charging ahead with unstoppable force!
No one could stand in his way.
Ding Ling, leading a team, captured city after city.
[Achievement Medal: Single-Handedly Conquered Ten Cities]
[Achievement Medal: Single-Handedly Conquered One Hundred Cities]
Achievements were attained one after another.
Besides the achievement medals for conquering cities,
there were also those for public welfare, gathering surrendered armies, defeating enemies, beheading generals, capturing passes, intimidating major figures in Mongolia, and others.
Altogether,
more were earned.
On this day,
Ding Ling’s northern advance reached a major city.
This was the Royal Capital of Mongolia!
Where the next Great Khan of Mongolia, Mengge, resided.
It was Mengge whom, in ’history,’ Yang Guo and the Little Dragon Girl killed sixteen years later.

The current Great Khan is Güyüg Borjigin. Originally, Güyüg wasn’t supposed to ascend for a few more years, but with the influx and support of players, along with Ding Ling’s brutal campaigns, the history of this world has already been disrupted.
Güyüg Borjigin prematurely became the Great Khan of Mongolia through the Kurultai Assembly.
And Mengge,
is the essential defensive line assigned by him to guard the Royal Capital, resisting Ding Ling’s invasion.
Ding Ling learned this from some players who defected and told Huang Rong.
Then Huang Rong informed Ding Ling.
Huang Rong and Huang the Herbalist, undeterred by convention, recruited anyone who met their selection criteria into their operational system.
This naturally included quite a number of players.

Just like how people in a country may vary in character. Players include good ones and bad ones, some who love traveling, some who are obsessed with the Martial Dao, and others who especially love being officials.
As long as they could swiftly assist in unifying Jiuzhou,

Ding Ling did not oppose the players’ inclusion and cooperation. Of course, due to various reasons, unless a player was exceptionally outstanding, it was difficult to reach the peak of the pyramid within Huang Rong’s system.

The peak positions are not numerous, reserved for truly top-notch talents, with Huang the Herbalist, Huang Rong, Zhu Ziliu, already occupying several seats. The arrival of Zhangg Han and Long Qie also took up two seats.
Zhangg Han is a renowned general from the Late Qin period. If it weren’t for Zhao Gao holding him back, or if he had met a truly wise ruler, his life would have been more glorious and splendid.
Long Qie is also a distinguished general from the Late Qin and early Han periods, with countless achievements, equally remarkable.

After ascending to the Divine Eagle World, the two had witnessed Ding Ling amidst three hundred thousand troops, galloping through them with ease, reaching a peak state of admiration and awe towards Ding Ling.
How often had they seen such a master?
They estimated that even if Xiang Yu came, he wouldn’t withstand Ding Ling’s palm!
A man who could subdue Xiang Yu with a flip of his palm!
Suddenly announced the recruitment of talent!

They naturally joined without hesitation! Subsequently, there was no doubt that they were always the first in battle due to their bravery and were noticed by Ding Ling. Upon inquiry, realizing they were renowned figures, he immediately placed them in extremely important Commander-in-Chief positions.
As of now,
due to capturing so many cities and gathering so many surrendered armies,
both had become Grand Generals commanding two hundred thousand troops!
Though they commanded surrendered armies, their tactics were exceptional, and they could still achieve merit through the use of these armies.
They and Ding Ling split their forces in three directions.
Ding Ling led a few thousand elite troops, targeting difficult targets such as the Northern Capital.
They led forces to capture other regions.
The northern lands are too vast.

If Ding Ling were to conquer it alone, it would take a long time! Having previously done this in the Three Kingdoms, Ding Ling naturally didn’t want to repeat it. Having people to help share the burden was indeed a great thing.
And to avoid missing famous generals,

Ding Ling specifically instructed Huang Rong on this matter, arranging for some players to assist in handling it. With players involved, the chances of missing historical figures or Plane experts dropped to zero.
As of now,
a substantial number of renowned Ascenders joined Ding Ling’s side, some out of admiration for Ding Ling, others for the Great Medicine, Cultivation Techniques, etc.
The world is bustling with people seeking benefits, and people pursue benefits in turmoil.
Ding Ling was clear about this,
and did not investigate further but left it to Huang Rong and Huang the Herbalist to handle.
"Ahead is the Royal Capital."
Hoduo, with a complicated expression, still respectfully addressed Ding Ling:
"Marshal, do you need me to shout a few words?"
Along the way,
Hoduo was responsible for shouting, mostly repeating these phrases: ’Even I, a Mongolian Prince, have surrendered to Marshal Ding Ling! Why are you still hesitating here?! Do you want to die?!’
’Kublai was struck dead by the Marshal with a single palm! Do you think you are stronger than Kublai?!’
’Mongolia is at the end of its rope, its day is over, and it’s about to fall! Why don’t you quickly surrender?!’

Hoduo’s shouts struck straight to the heart, just like the final straw that broke the camel’s back. Often, many people, seeing they couldn’t possibly win against Ding Ling, would follow the trend and surrender.
However, there were also some hard-headed individuals who cursed Hoduo, calling him a scourge of the nation, a traitor who turns traitor, and a treacherous betrayer!
Throughout his journey, Hoduo indeed heard a lot of such words, to the point where his face turned green.
The only consolation for him was that these stubborn individuals were all beaten to death while he was still alive!
Each time he thought of this, he became increasingly grateful for his choice.
Surrendering and submitting to Ding Ling,
was better than being killed.
He was still young, and he didn’t want to die!
Therefore, he was very proactive in his tasks, just like now, where he was ready to shout even before Ding Ling spoke.
Ding Ling shook his head and said:
"Forget it."

chapters.title: Chapter 477: Breaking Through the Royal Capital
paragraphs: This time, Ding Ling prepares for a direct assault!
Reaching this point now.
With Fusion Qi driving him, his speed is unmatched, his stamina extraordinary, his defense impenetrable by arrow storms, and his attack power the utmost in strength and ferocity!
Dealing with mere common soldiers is incredibly simple.
Boom!

Ding Ling leaps from his horse, and in mid-air, the Spiral Nine Shadows and Golden Swan Skill unfold, allowing him to soar up dozens of feet in an instant. His entire being seems to fly effortlessly like a wild goose, easily reaching over twenty feet high. Walking on air, he swiftly flies over the region like lightning and arrives in moments above the Royal Capital’s city.
He gazes down at the Lower Realm, like a deity on the clouds looking down on mortals.
"Fire!"
"Shoot the arrows quickly!"
Standing on the city wall, the Mongolian fierce warriors on full alert are utterly shocked by this sight! Terrified beyond their senses, they can only unleash hysterical roars!
Boom!
Ignoring the rain of arrows, Ding Ling descends from high altitude, his bare hands striking toward the fierce warriors’ position, with Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms’ Flying Dragon in the Sky!
Roar!

A dragon’s shadow shoots out from between his palms, transforming into a Divine Dragon diving into the soldiers’ ranks. Wherever it passes, soldiers are flipped and knocked away, with countless casualties. In mere moments, it reaches the fierce warrior in front, under his horrified eyes, boom!
The dragon shadow crashes into his chest, sending him flying off the city wall and slamming heavily onto the ground, bones fractured, dead beyond dead.
Roar!

Ding Ling flips his hand and unleashes another hit of Time Riding Six Dragons. Under the drive of Fusion Qi, six dragon shadows flash out between his palms, dashing toward every direction. In an instant, the sound of explosions is endless, and the screams resound throughout the sky.
Ding Ling charges forward like a whirlwind, sweeping through the elite troops in mere moments.
"Impressive."

Even though Hoduo has witnessed such scenes many times, each time he sees it, his heart is still stirred, and his fear of Ding Ling remains undiminished, increasingly ingrained in his bones, without any thought of resistance.

Little Dragon Girl is also watching, her cold eyes just follow Ding Ling’s movements. Her face is as beautiful as an immortal, and the battles in these days have added a heroic aura to her, making her increasingly stunning and unparalleled.
Boom!
Ding Ling surges forward, the Qingnang Scripture running constantly, preventing demonic influence.
But as the killing continues, his eyes turn red, and Evil Qi swirls around him, resembling a Demon King descending upon the mortal world.
He laughs loudly, crashing into the deepest part of the Royal Capital, standing against tens of thousands of the most elite Mongolian Army alone.
The Mongolian Army includes Sword Shield Soldiers, Cavalry, Spear Soldiers, and others.
Everyone has reached the level of a Third-class General and above!
Tens of thousands of elites are enough to sweep through a nation.
Kublai’s absolute elite elite cavalry forces number three thousand, and each individual’s level is at least Second-class General.
Whereas Mengge has tens of thousands of powerful elite troops formed of at least Third-class General level troops.
In terms of battle array power, these tens of thousands far surpass the three thousand elite units!
"Charge!"
"Ha!"
"Kill!"
Watching Ding Ling rampage with bloodshed, shattering entire units with his bare hands, their hearts tremble with shock and fear.
However, with Marshal Mengge’s presence overseeing the field.
With the Marshal holding his ground, how could they retreat?
Under Mengge’s command.
They rush towards Ding Ling, shouting in unison.
"Haha..."

Ding Ling laughs, unconsciously activating Ghost Realm’s Howling Wind, and with his laughter, Lion’s Roar erupts, causing the soldiers to rupture their eardrums, and fall to the ground clutching their heads in pain before even approaching.
Boom!
With red eyes, Ding Ling charges in, his bare hands striking left and right!
Time Riding Six Dragons!
Flying Dragon in the Sky!
Dragon Battle in the Wilderness!
The Flight of the Wild Goose!
Dive into the Abyss!

When Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms is pushed to its limit, roar! Countless dragon shadows leap out from Ding Ling’s palms, countless crashing into the army, tails sweeping, charging, sweeping, and exploding!
Visible to the naked eye.
Companies of soldiers are flipped and knocked to the ground.
With red eyes, Ding Ling slays enemies, surpassing madness, ignoring his own defense, bulldozing and smashing soldiers by speed and physique alone.
He strikes like lightning deep into the rear, and under Mengge’s fearful, horrified, bewildered, and helpless gaze, his palms strike down heavily.
Roar!
Boom!
A dragon’s roar cleaves the earth, and Mengge’s figure is sent ten feet skyward by the palm power, and in mid-air, with a thunderous boom, his body bursts apart.
His death is too easy.
In his final moments, Mengge was filled with unwillingness, fear, and shock.
He truly did not expect that there would actually be such a strong person in the world, so powerful that it defies logic!
The deities of the human realm might be just like this.
How can a mortal win against a deity?!
"Marshal is dead?!"
"Marshal is dead!!"

After the remaining warriors were stunned and shocked, they felt horrified, and then completely disbanded, scattered, a chaotic scene of fleeing soldiers who were throwing away their helmets and armor, crying and howling.
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: Defeated Five Hundred Thousand Army]
[Commentary: With one battle, you made Mongolia’s five hundred thousand troops flee! Your name shakes the world, and people of Northern Mongolia can stop a child’s crying by mentioning you!]
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: Defeated Mongolia’s Three Elite Forces.]

[Commentary: Mongolia’s three elite forces are composed of masters above third-class general level. Each elite unit, when deployed, can easily sweep through any Western nation, but all of them fell by your hand.]
[Obtained E-level Medal: Destroyed Mongolian Royal Capital!]
[Commentary: As the capital city of Mongolia. Its destruction forecasts Mongolia’s complete downfall!]
[Obtained Achievement Medal: Intimidated Mengge]
Notification sounded.
Ding Ling shivered, quickly maneuvered Buddha Qi, dispelled Evil Qi, then let out a long sigh.
He did not pursue the fleeing soldiers.
He just maneuvered his lightweight body technique, reached the city gate, and opened the gates of the Royal Capital.
Thud, thud, thud!
Hoduo and others immediately rode in.
To prevent uncontrollable rage from harming their own people.
Whenever there was a large-scale war, Ding Ling would have Little Dragon Girl and others wait in the rear, and only let them enter the city after he finished fighting.
After Hoduo entered the city.
Witnessing the tragic scene inside the city, feeling sorrowful, he couldn’t help but shout loudly:
"I am Mongolian Prince Hoduo, those who don’t want to die, get out and surrender!"
"Surrender and you’re one of us! Don’t resist stubbornly!"
"Being able to surrender to Marshal Ding is your fortune, don’t be unwise!"
Hoduo’s voice gradually faded away.
Ding Ling paid no attention.
In this battle, he harvested 3 E-level Achievement Medals. 5 Ordinary Achievement Medals.
It was somewhat beyond his expectations.
He looked at it.
Defeated three elite forces.
It should include the time he destroyed Kublai’s elite cavalry force earlier.
Upon seeing this information, Ding Ling also understood that matters of medals can accumulate over time.
"Where to go next?"
Little Dragon Girl’s almond-shaped eyes were like water, just staring unblinkingly at Ding Ling, she looked at him with concern:
"If you keep going like this, can your body take it?"
"I’m as vigorous as a dragon or tiger, fighting for days and nights is no issue at all."
Ding Ling smiled and held Little Dragon Girl’s hand:
"You don’t need to worry about me. Even for you, I will keep myself safe and healthy."
"Mm-hmm."
Only then did Little Dragon Girl seem slightly relieved:
"No matter where you go. I hope you can take me with you."
"In this world, there’s no problem."
Ding Ling seemed like he wouldn’t stay much longer in this world, yet couldn’t make more promises.

Little Dragon Girl seemed to understand, amidst her grief, she secretly encouraged herself, decided to ascend to the pinnacle of Martial Dao as soon as possible, so that she can stand behind Ding Ling and help him kill enemies, not just watch helplessly, unable to do anything.
Ding Ling fought fiercely all the way.
After defeating Mengge.
He headed straight to the Royal Court where the Great Khan of Mongolia resided.
His defense was unrivaled, his combat power invincible.
No matter how the Great Khan of Mongolia tried, gathering millions of troops from both the West and East.
Still, Ding Ling single-handedly smashed through them.
Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique!
Ding Ling used Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms against ordinary soldiers, used Drumming Golden Hammer against top fierce generals.
A single heavy blow from the Drumming Golden Hammer often easily killed, crushed, shattered a fierce general!

He fought alone, hammering a river of blood, finally soared mightily, flew hundreds of meters, ignored the arrow storm’s attack, reached the position above the Great Khan of Mongolia, swooped down, and heavily struck with his hammer at the Great Khan.

chapters.title: Chapter 478: War God
paragraphs: Boom!
The Great Khan of Mongolia was directly hammered to death on the spot with the Drumming Golden Hammer, becoming a pulp!
Borjigin Guyuk, who had just ascended to the position of Great Khan through the Kurultai Assembly, had not yet warmed his seat before he died and his soul dissipated.
If he had known it would end like this.
He would have readily abandoned the title of Great Khan and turned to lead troops westward, or elsewhere, which would have been much better than facing Ding Ling, such a Demon God, in the east.
"The Khan is dead!"
"The Khan is dead!!"
Panic-stricken cries echoed in all directions.
The millions of troops were in chaos!
Boom!
And as Ding Ling lifted the Drumming Golden Hammer and charged into the army formation, one Commander of Ten Thousand after another was hammered to death.
The army began to collapse, scatter, and flee in all directions!
In the distance.
Huang Rong, Huang the Herbalist, Zhu Ziliu, and others watched these scenes with their blood boiling, yet were more shocked, astonished, and incredulous:
"For one person to reach such a level! Saying Ding Ling is an Earth Immortal is not an exaggeration!"
"Too fierce, even the Thunder God descending wouldn’t be much more!"

"His endurance and physical strength are truly unfathomable. He has been fiercely fighting for several hours, confronting countless experts in the army, yet still maintaining peak combat power. Truly formidable!"
"Meeting Ding Ling is bad luck for these Mongolian troops!"

When Huang the Herbalist and his party knew that Ding Ling was about to confront the Great Khan of Mongolia, they all handed over their tasks to their subordinates and then followed Ding Ling to the front of this Royal Court.
All just to witness this final battle!
This battle was destined to be recorded in history, and Huang the Herbalist and others did not want to miss it.
At this moment, their wish was fulfilled.
Huang the Herbalist’s hand, which was stroking his beard, trembled slightly:
"You all said Ding Ling was extremely strong before. I had a sense of it, but nothing compared to the reality of this moment!"
"Indeed."
Guo Fu also watched in a daze. Ding Ling, who she already had a pretty good impression of, was completely overshadowed by the image of an overbearing, iron-blooded War God at this moment.
She was more and more dazzled and heart-trembling towards Ding Ling, and it was hard to say for sure whether it was admiration, affection, or worship?
A maiden’s feelings are full of poetry.
Guo Fu didn’t understand herself either, only that her perception of Ding Ling had undergone a 180-degree transformation. It was an undeniable fact.
She never would have thought that the Ding Ling she met in Xiangyang would turn out to be such an earth-shattering War God-level figure!
With his own strength.
He reversed Heaven and Earth!
Crushed who knows how many Mongolian armies and fortresses.
"He truly is a divine being."
Da and Xiao Wu watched with trembling hearts, increasingly in awe and fear of Ding Ling.
"No wonder it’s Ding Ling!"
Hong Qigong, after dealing with the Five Uglies of Tibet, wandered all over, astonished upon hearing of Ding Ling’s exploits, hardly believing that his little brother Ding Ling would be so strong!
At first, he thought it was someone else.
But after meeting Huang Rong and Huang the Herbalist, he confirmed that this Ding Ling was indeed that Ding Ling!
Witnessing with his own eyes Ding Ling’s great divine power, he was so shocked that his eyes widened, feeling as if he had fallen into a dreamlike world:
"Can a person practicing the Martial Dao reach such a level?!"
He looked towards Huang the Herbalist, clearly wanting to discuss some Martial Arts.
Huang the Herbalist’s expression was somewhat unnatural:

"In theory, it’s impossible. But not long ago, Ding Ling imparted two Breathing Techniques to me. One internal and one external, showcasing the essence of Martial Arts! If mastered, reaching the Realm of Great Perfection, one’s physical qualities would improve significantly. Coupled with Great Medicine, physical qualities could be greatly enhanced.
If physical qualities really reach Ding Ling’s level.
Combine Breathing Techniques with the Inner Power Heart Method, and the power of detonations could manifest. Perhaps indeed, one could reach Ding Ling’s level."
"Breathing Techniques?!"
Hong Qigong looked askance:

"I’ve fought against many Ascenders, each possessing explosive abilities. Even though their realm and cultivation aren’t higher than mine, that explosive Vigorous Qi is terrifying, and I have to retreat."

"When Ding Ling returns, let him teach you the Breathing Techniques. With your talent and capabilities, Hong Qi, and the guidance of Grandmaster Ding Ling, it shouldn’t take long for you to step into the Entry Level of Breathing Techniques."
Saying this, Huang the Herbalist was quite satisfied:

"After being guided by Ding Ling, my progress in Breathing Techniques has been rapid, incomparable to before! I can say that now, I can suppress any Central Divine Technique West Poison single-handedly!"
Even without a teacher, Huang the Herbalist could intuitively reach Mastery.
After receiving Ding Ling’s high-level, pointed guidance, it was as if his Ren and Du Meridians had been unblocked. The progress in Breathing Techniques surpassed even Little Dragon Girl’s.
Indeed, there was a trend of surpassing him later.
This is the talent!
A legendary figure as if scripted, unimaginable, and incomprehensible to ordinary people!

Hong Qigong was speechless, somewhat disbelieving, but after Huang the Herbalist slightly mobilized Fusion Qi and exchanged a double palm strike with him, he realized he was far from being Huang the Herbalist’s match.
Fusion Qi could magnify power fivefold or tenfold.
It’s like fighting five or ten Huang the Herbalists!
How can one fight this?!
"It seems I must keep up with the times as well."
Hong Qigong gazed into the distance:
"What will Ding Ling do after this battle ends? Return this vast territory to Great Song?"
"Haha."
Huang the Herbalist sneered:
"Impossible! I stay away from the court not just because I love freedom, but also because my nature couldn’t stand the flatterers, fraudsters, and lowly people in court!
I support Ding Ling in purging the unbearable and corrupt chaos within Great Song!"
"You mean..."
Hong Qigong was stunned, and his hand holding his beard froze.

"Hong Qi. I know you are righteous, but in matters of great significance like this, I hope you can be rational and clear-minded. You must know, should those decadent riffraff hold the court, only the common people will suffer.
If we want to eliminate the chaos and reduce the number of beggars and increase the number receiving fair treatment.
We must change the heavens!"
"Change the heavens?!"
Hong Qigong’s eye corners twitched:
"Does Ding Ling want to be emperor?
"No."
Huang the Herbalist stated it clearly:
"It’s Guo Jing."
Hong Qigong’s jaw seemed ready to drop to the ground:
"This, this, this..."
"Haha."
Huang the Herbalist chuckled and said:
"Do you think Ding Ling is working in vain? Working hard only to hand the throne to Guo Jing, an outsider? But Ding Ling is different from us.
He is thinking about the future, about long-term things. His ambitions are not here..."
Huang the Herbalist explained a bit.
Hong Qigong was relieved but had mixed feelings.
Huang the Herbalist then continued to speak with Hong Qigong.

With exceptional eloquence, and knowing the truth in what he said, Hong Qigong understood that Great Song was indeed as decayed as a piece of wood about to break, and the transformation of dynasties happened every so often, quite normal indeed.
Moreover.
The emperor would be Guo Jing, the empress Huang Rong...
How could he refuse?!
How could he deny it?!
No one knew better than he did what kind of people the two of them were.
Thinking of this.
Hong Qigong scratched his beard and could only nod in agreement to cooperate with Huang the Herbalist.
Huang the Herbalist laughed heartily:
"With you on board, the chances of that simpleton Guo Jing agreeing to cooperate will increase significantly."
Guo Jing didn’t come today.
So, after the two walked to one side, they could talk freely.
But to prevent Da and Xiao Wu from misreporting, their voices varied.
Outsiders had no idea what they were saying.
The key battle in the Northern Lands.
Quickly spread across the world!
Ding Ling became the true hero of Great Song!
Everywhere, they were singing praises of Ding Ling.
Xiangyang and other places were dancing and singing, streets were empty, all to catch a glimpse of Ding Ling returning triumphant!
Countless young ladies heard their elders passionately recounting Ding Ling’s feats, became enraptured, and were stirred with the urge and impulse to see Ding Ling for themselves.
Since ancient times, heroes love beauty.
Beauty also loves heroes!
Without a doubt.
Ding Ling became the first War God and unrivaled hero in the eyes of Xiangyang’s people!

chapters.title: Chapter 479: Guo Jing Ascends the Throne
paragraphs: Ding Ling rode the Ferghana Horse and galloped into Xiangyang City, surrounded by a crowd of people.
Everywhere he looked.
A sea of people.
"Ding Ling!"
"Hero Ding!"
The moment he appeared, an earth-shattering cheer erupted throughout the entire venue.
Guo Jing, Huang Rong, and others followed closely behind, and upon seeing this, they couldn’t help but reveal bright smiles.
The great victory they had longed for was easily achieved in Ding Ling’s hands.
Thinking back now.
It all felt like a dream.
Upon entering the Guo Family residence.
Ding Ling rested for just one day before taking action against Lü Wende, and as expected, Lü Wende and Lü Wenhuan surrendered.
As they put it.
Ding Ling was so strong.
The glorious Mongol Kingdom was single-handedly defeated by Ding Ling!
How could Xiangyang possibly resist?
Why would the Great Song Court think Ding Ling would obediently follow orders from the high and mighty emperor?!
Now that the time has come.

The commendation order from the Great Song Court arrived, but it only awarded Ding Ling a position as a military general and hoped Ding Ling would guard the frontier while handing over the vast territories he captured.
As for Huang Rong, Guo Jing, and others, they weren’t even mentioned.
It’s obvious.
The people in the court didn’t think much of these martial artists from Jianghu.
In their eyes, these people were all savages.
Huang Rong, Huang the Herbalist, and others clearly saw through this and had already taken action.
But Ding Ling couldn’t be bothered with all that.

Sitting high in the imperial hall, the emperor probably didn’t even know the details of how Ding Ling had crushed the Mongol Kingdom, because the court was dominated by a group of traitorous officials who would never allow Ding Ling to have so much power.
If Ding Ling weren’t so incredibly powerful!
There would certainly be no talk of titles or guarding the frontier.
The fate of the cunning rabbit’s death and the hound’s cooking would be Ding Ling’s only outcome!
Even the loyal and eternally famous Yue Fei was killed by traitorous officials.
If it weren’t for Ding Ling’s unparalleled martial power, how could he withstand the backlash from these traitorous officials?

Ding Ling directly had Lü Wende lead the way, stormed into the capital city single-handedly, toppled the Imperial Guard, and pressured the emperor to abdicate the throne to Guo Jing, threatening to execute him if he didn’t comply.
At the same time.
Zhangg Han, Long Qie, and other generals led a massive army past Xiangyang and other places, cutting through mountains and bridging waters, unstoppable and invincible wherever they went.
Southern Song.
War broke out!
Faced with the massive army led by Long Qie, Zhangg Han, and other generals, how could the already decayed Southern Song resist?
Consistent defeats.

Guo Jing was persuaded by Huang Rong, Huang the Herbalist, and Hong Qigong for half a month; after receiving letters from various states and regions of the Southern Song reporting major defeats, especially the news that the traitorous officials of the court had been bloodily purged by Ding Ling, and the emperor was about to abdicate to him.
He was completely befuddled.
"This, this, this..."
He felt it was too childish!
Like a dream.
Is he really going to become the emperor?!
Is the emperor of the Great Song really going to abdicate to him?!
Isn’t this just a fairy tale?!
"Brother Jing, it’s true."
Huang Rong’s mind was in turmoil; he truly didn’t expect the army led by Zhangg Han, Long Qie, and Yuwen Chengdu, after crossing the Xiangyang territory, would be so overwhelmingly destructive.
Truly unstoppable.
Indeed. Yuwen Chengdu went with the flow, responded to the ’call’, and also joined Ding Ling’s great army, becoming a commander and following the army in their southern and northern conquests.
There were indeed quite a few who were as sensible and pragmatic as he was.
"I still find it hard to believe."
Guo Jing looked bewildered, panicked, and uneasy:
"You want me to become this emperor?! Is it appropriate?! I’m just an ordinary person, I should serve the country and the people, how can I..."
"Jing’Er!"
Ke Zhen’e scolded Guo Jing:

"Serving the country and the people requires understanding the situation. If this continues, do you think your wife and children will be safe?! Would you only be happy if your wife and children died with you?"
"Master, I..."
"Stop the hesitations. Be decisive if you’re a man; listening to you dawdling like this annoys me."
Ke Zhen’e said angrily:

"Hero Ding has done everything for you. The path is laid out. Just waiting for you to step up and truly serve the country and the people. Yet you’re here dithering, dithering for what?! Hurry up and go to the capital city!"
Huang Rong, Huang the Herbalist, Hong Qigong chimed in occasionally.
Moreover.
The decision was made.
If he didn’t become emperor, once Ding Ling ascended and left, the emperor would likely execute his entire family; thinking of how Huang Rong was already nearly ten months pregnant.
Guo Jing let out a long sigh and had no choice but to accept the assignment.

Just as Rong’Er and others said, to serve the country and the people? Even if he became emperor, he could still serve the country and the people, and if he were fair and incorruptible, he could serve them even better!
Half a month later.
Guo Jing ascended the throne.
Becoming emperor.
The country was renamed ’Ming’!
With a vow to serve the country and the people, wholeheartedly wishing for peace and prosperity under the heavens! Only wanting national peace and security!
Hoping that all Jiuzhou would be covered in the brilliance of Ming, with the people’s hearts filled with the sun, moon, and hope!
After Guo Jing’s ascension.
He diligently, wisely appointed capable people, being benevolent and magnanimous, modest and frugal, and loving the people!
With Huang Rong, Huang the Herbalist, Zhu Ziliu, and others assisting in internal affairs;
With Yuwen Chengdu, Zhangg Han, Long Qie managing the army.
There was no great turmoil.

He governed with diligence and wisdom, remained cautious and humble, treating the people with leniency internally and demonstrating might externally, leading the Ming Dynasty under his rule to flourish, with national strength rising and the people living in peace and happiness.
In just ten short years.
He once again led Jiuzhou into a golden age!
Known in history as the ’Great Ming Kaiyuan Prosperity!’
And as the founder of all this, Ding Ling.
Was vividly and heavily chronicled by historians in history books!
With various Chapters, overflowing with praise and embellishment.
Depicting Ding Ling as an unparalleled pioneer of an era, a true Martial Dao God!
And the name of Ding Ling spread worldwide, celebrated for thousands and millions of years, becoming a sage revered by countless future figures in this world!
Even because Ding Ling’s story was too legendary.
Many historians known for their rigor raised numerous questions about it.
Such as:
"Why could one person’s martial power be so formidable! It defies common sense!"
"To change heaven and earth single-handedly is too absurd! I highly suspect this is the ancients’ embellishment of this sage Ding Ling!"
Just like modern people questioning whether there was a Divine Dragon in ancient times.
If modern people were told there was a dragon in ancient times, many would have their doubts.
And the existence of Ding Ling was like the legend of the Divine Dragon, baffling and shocking countless people into disbelief.
Of course.
These things happened in the future.
At present, Ding Ling decisively didn’t know about these things.
After Guo Jing ascended.
He began to utilize the power of the nation.
To collect the secret manuals of Jiuzhou.
While ordering Long Qie, Yuwen Chengdu, and others to conquer Japan, the West, and various other realms.
Ding Ling wanted to unite the entire world!
Wherever the Great Sun shines!
Shall be the territory of the Great Ming!

With a vow to serve the country and the people, wholeheartedly wishing for peace and prosperity under the heavens!
Only wanting national peace and security!
Hoping that all Jiuzhou would be covered in the brilliance of Ming, with the people’s hearts filled with the sun, moon, and hope!
After Guo Jing’s ascension.
He diligently, wisely appointed capable people, being benevolent and magnanimous, modest and frugal, and loving the people!
With Huang Rong, Huang the Herbalist, Zhu Ziliu, and others assisting in internal affairs;
With Yuwen Chengdu, Zhangg Han, Long Qie managing the army.
There was no great turmoil.

He governed with diligence and wisdom, remained cautious and humble, treating the people with leniency internally and demonstrating might externally, leading the Ming Dynasty under his rule to flourish, with national strength rising and the people living in peace and happiness.
In just ten short years.
He once again led Jiuzhou into a golden age!
Known in history as the ’Great Ming Kaiyuan Prosperity!’
And as the founder of all this, Ding Ling.
Was vividly and heavily chronicled by historians in history books!
With various Chapters, overflowing with praise and embellishment.
Depicting Ding Ling as an unparalleled pioneer of an era, a true Martial Dao God!
And the name of Ding Ling spread worldwide, celebrated for thousands and millions of years, becoming a sage revered by countless future figures in this world!
Even because Ding Ling’s story was too legendary.
Many historians known for their rigor raised numerous questions about it.
Such as:
"Why could one person’s martial power be so formidable!
It defies common sense!"
"To change heaven and earth single-handedly is too absurd!
I highly suspect this is the ancients’ embellishment of this sage Ding Ling!"
Just like modern people questioning whether there was a Divine Dragon in ancient times.
If modern people were told there was a dragon in ancient times, many would have their doubts.
And the existence of Ding Ling was like the legend of the Divine Dragon, baffling and shocking countless people into disbelief.
Of course.
These things happened in the future.
At present, Ding Ling decisively didn’t know about these things.
After Guo Jing ascended.
He began to utilize the power of the nation.
To collect the secret manuals of Jiuzhou.
While ordering Long Qie, Yuwen Chengdu, and others to conquer Japan, the West, and various other realms.
Ding Ling wanted to unite the entire world!
Wherever the Great Sun shines!
Shall be the territory of the Great Ming!

chapters.title: Chapter 480: One Breath of Vast Energy! One Yang Finger Full Level
paragraphs: Nominally, Guo Jing is the Emperor.
But Ding Ling compares to the Supreme Emperor, with every word and action carrying supreme authority.
Huang Rong deeply admires and reveres Ding Ling. Although she became Empress, she still strives to fulfill and cooperate with Ding Ling’s commands without the slightest negligence or delay.

When Ding Ling said he wanted copies of the secret manuals from the major sects, Huang Rong immediately ordered the sects to send the copies. For some particularly stubborn sects that refused, Huang Rong used gold, secret techniques, and other means to obtain them.
Moreover, Ding Ling’s notorious name spread across Jiuzhou.

Huang Rong only needed to slightly let out the word that Ding Ling wanted secret manuals. Most of these stubborn sects would agree, considering the gold, great medicine, secret techniques, and other benefits.
Unless they truly wanted to die.
Otherwise, how could they dare to oppose Ding Ling, who had crushed an empire?!

In addition, the founding of Great Ming saw the famous Hero Guo become Emperor, with the Female Zhuge, Huang Rong, as Empress. Those who disregarded the Emperor and Empress were prepared to live lives of hardship and constant restriction!
No one wanted to be an enemy of Guo Jing and Huang Rong.

The majority of the stubborn chose to adapt to the situation, and for the minority who were truly unwilling, Huang Rong did not force them; she merely employed slight methods, ensuring their future days would be filled with difficulties!
Daring to openly challenge Huang Rong.
How could there possibly be a good outcome?

Even if Huang Rong wasn’t quick to kill, just as fish cannot inhabit pure water, within any sect where fish and dragons are mixed, it’s impossible for everyone to be upright, without greed or violence.
The stubborn sects caught having killed.
Often don’t meet a good end.
Regarding these matters.
Ding Ling remains unaware.
He only needs to see the results.
And the results are.
Every day, secret manuals and great medicine are sent to his ’Prince’s Mansion’ without cease.
Indeed.
Ding Ling was enfeoffed by Guo Jing as ’First-Rank Prince’, ’Jiuzhou Guardian God’, ’World’s Number One War God’ among others.
Too many honorary titles.
Causing Ding Ling’s achievements medals in this aspect to be maxed out.
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: You became First-Rank Prince!]

[Note: Guo Jing’s feelings towards you are quite complex. He knows his climb to the throne was all due to you. Unable to repay, he can only give his all to bestow ’honors’ upon you, elevating you to First-Rank Prince still feels insufficient to him. Perhaps he will give you more in the future.]
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: You became a Martial Arts Myth]
[Note: From the world of martial arts, you altered the destinies of major empires single-handedly, founding a new dynasty! You have become a myth, a legend in the hearts of all martial arts heroes!]
[Obtained Achievement Medal: You became the current Grand General]
[Obtained Achievement Medal: You became the current Border War God]
These are recent achievement medals received.
There are two E-level ones.
Eight ordinary ones.
Previously received:
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: Collapsed Great Song Court.]
[Note: Making ministers helpless. Making the Emperor abdicate. Accomplishing this by oneself, unprecedented!]
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: Collapsed Mongol Kingdom.]
[Note: Toppling a vast empire single-handedly, worthy of enduring acclaim.]
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: Crushed millions of Mongolian Army!]
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: Destroyed over a hundred elite Mongolian units.]
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: Created a new era! Leading the establishment of the Great Ming Kingdom!]
[Obtained Achievement Medal: Intimidated Great Khan of Mongolia]
Previously, there were five E-level ones.
Sixteen ordinary ones.
[Achievement Medals: Ordinary 150, E-level 23]
The above totals all of Ding Ling’s medals.
Gaining great benefits.
Apart from the medals received.
Ding Ling’s greatest gain was the various secret manuals.

Knowledge manuals and books related to astronomy and geography, five elements and eight trigrams, music, chess, calligraphy, and painting, medical dao, buddhist dao, famous family, agrarian family, and others were all sent to Ding Ling’s mansion.
The phrase ’overflowing with volumes’ is insufficient to describe the abundance of books stored in Ding Ling’s mansion.
The bookshelves are densely packed with secret manuals.
Ding Ling is immersed in a sea of books every day.
No pain.
Only joy.
Because he can feel himself progressing every minute and second.
He enjoys and cherishes this feeling!
As he swiftly completes and masters each secret manual.
[Mo Family series books at full level]
[Military School series secret manuals at full level]
[Confucian School series secret manuals at full level]
[Daoist Family series secret manuals at full level]
[Wisdom +0.8]
He’s read countless related secret manuals and books.
Ultimately, wisdom increased only by 0.8.
Ding Ling sighed deeply.
He discovers that the difficulty of increasing wisdom becomes significantly higher as time goes on.
It appears he struggles to closely bond with high intelligence.
Perhaps when he cultivates immortality and unlocks divine intelligence, his wisdom will soar?
The answer is unknown.
Ding Ling does not understand either.
The reason he thinks so is entirely because, before crossing worlds, he read many similar cultivation novels!
Just like the tale of the storage pouch.
He also read similar cultivation novels about storage pouches, but the usage was completely different. Who would have thought that the storage pouch actually requires inner strength to open?
Perhaps when he truly comes into contact with cultivation, Ding Ling might discover many things different from his current understanding.
"Although my wisdom increased by only 0.8, my memory and reaction speed have become stronger."
Ding Ling realized that many forgotten memories were gradually resurfacing in his mind.
He pondered:
"Could it be that people like Zhuge Liang have wisdom attributes reaching 20? 30? 40?!"
His current wisdom attribute points have reached 5 points.
Yet he still doesn’t have the photographic memory feeling.
"It seems the game’s attribute setting is really unique. Those players with naturally high intelligence might possess high wisdom attributes as soon as they enter the game world."
Ding Ling shook his head, not thinking much about it.
He chose the Path of the War God.
As long as he’s strong enough.
He can overcome everything.
What conspiracy and trickery? Should he care? Dare to plot against him? He would dare to suppress and kill them!
He continued burying himself in his sea of books.
One secret manual after another was finished by him.
The Buddha Qi flowing through his meridians surged several times after reading tens of thousands of Buddhist scriptures!
Ding Ling felt:
"With such Buddha Qi protecting me, the probability of going astray will be reduced again."
Every time Ding Ling charged and killed enemies.
After being covered by Blood Evil, he would easily become wildly aggressive, growing more crazed!
If not for the strong Buddha Qi, capable of quickly washing away Blood Evil, he might really become a demon knowing only slaughter.
Besides Buddhist scriptures.
Dao Scriptures, Confucian Classics, and others were read countless times by him.
In his heart, he cultivated a bit of pure Vast Righteous Qi.
If not used it’s nothing, but once activated, Blood Evil retreats—not able to dissolve or expel Blood Evil, but capable of protecting the body from letting Blood Evil invade the heart.
Ding Ling placed this Vast Righteous Qi deep within his heart to guard it from invasion by sinister evils.
Rustle!
One book after another was completely read.
All reached full level.
On this day.
Ding Ling just finished breakfast with Little Dragon Girl, continued burying his head among the bookshelves of Martial Arts Secret Manuals, casually picked one up.
"One Yang Finger!"
The three majestic characters made Ding Ling’s eyebrows jump.
Did Huang Rong actually manage to acquire One Yang Finger!
Did she negotiate collaboration with Master Yideng?
Or negotiate with Zhu Ziliu, Da and Xiao Wu?
Whatever the reality.
Ding Ling didn’t care, nor would he ask—he only wanted the result.
Now it seems.
The result is evidently excellent.
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
As he quickly finished reading the secret manual.
[One Yang Finger Full Level]
Swoosh!
Ding Ling’s index finger, like a sword, pointed forward, in a swooshing sound, a streak of finger force shot out, bang! It hit one side of the wall, easily penetrating over an inch into the wall.
This was with Ding Ling not exerting force, had he gone all out, he would definitely easily penetrate the wall.
"A very impressive finger technique."
Ding Ling nodded in appreciation.
This One Yang Finger is an absolutely top-notch finger technique.
Divided into nine grades.
Highest is First Grade, ordinary people reaching Fourth Grade can have the qualification to practice Six Meridian Divine Sword.
But even for Dali Duan Family individuals, aiming to reach Fourth Grade is extremely challenging, often requiring decades of arduously learning.
Those with exceptional talent might shorten the years but still counted by years.
Ding Ling, in an instant, reached the mastery stage of Great Perfection at First Grade.
If Master Yideng and others knew, who knows what they would think.
Ding Ling continued reading Martial Arts Secret Manuals.
There are far too many secret manuals here.
Various sects and factions.
Even second-rate and third-rate manuals piled up to fill several dozen bookshelves.
Ding Ling was thrilled at heart.
After finishing these Martial Arts Secret Manuals.
His Martial Arts Melting Furnace will likely manifest even more clearly.
Ding Ling quickly flipped through.
As he completed one Martial Arts Secret Manual after another.
Ding Ling could distinctly sense the Martial Arts Melting Furnace continuously manifesting.
Gradually transitioning from a vague, hardly visible shadow to an extremely clear image.
