chapters.title: Chapter 481: Quest Progress! Full Level Left-Right Mutual Struggle
paragraphs: "Very good."
Ding Ling chose to press on.
He had a premonition.
Perhaps once he finished reading all these Martial Arts Secret Manuals, the Martial Arts Melting Furnace would undergo a qualitative change.
As he started reading.
He didn’t rest.
For several days.
Several days later.
The Martial Arts Melting Furnace became extremely clear!
And at this moment, Ding Ling had also finished reading all the Secret Manuals.
He took a deep breath and thought:

"Indeed, the power of a nation far exceeds that of an individual, attempting to search for so many books and secret manuals by myself would consume an indescribable amount of time, energy, and spirit.
Yet now, I only need to utter a word.
Diao Chan and the others will take care of it for me. Sitting at home, I can see one secret manual after another! Very good. If it’s reasonable in the future, I can continue this way."
Ding Ling nodded silently.
The Little Dragon Girl also doesn’t lack Great Medicine anymore.
Soaking in medicinal baths every day.
Her physical fitness is rising day by day!
Coupled with her extremely high Martial Arts talent and strong bones, the progress of her Breathing Technique is visibly increasing.

Ding Ling had long taught the Little Dragon Girl a Breathing Technique for both internal and external use. He clearly explained the key secrets; once she feels ready in the future, she can naturally practice the Inner Refining Breathing Technique.
Ding Ling believes that with his guidance, the Little Dragon Girl will surely succeed.
Ding Ling stood up and checked the task progress.
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane World experts: 125/20.]
It was 47 before.
Later, after consecutively defeating dozens of First-class Experts. Among them, dozens of First-class Experts from the Mongol Kingdom were beaten and killed by him.
These First-class Experts, including the pinnacle of First-class, also the most ordinary of First-class.
And even the most ordinary First-class experts held positions as commanders of tens of thousands in the Mongolian army, there were too many such commanders that Ding Ling killed or defeated.
This is why his count skyrocketed from 125 this time.
Of course, he also chose the right time to defeat Hong Qigong and Guo Jing under the guise of sparring.
And that counts too.
[3: You must make your title as the World’s Number One reverberate throughout the entire Plane World. 100%/100%]
It was 23% before.
Without a doubt.
After Ding Ling single-handedly crushed the Mongol Kingdom and word of this spread throughout Jiuzhou,
His title as the World’s Number One was undisputed.
Even so.
He still hasn’t completed the second task.
"Need to defeat Zhou Botong?"
Ding Ling pondered.
Some say the first expert in the Divine Eagle World is Guo Jing.
Some say it’s Zhou Botong.
Others say it’s Ouyang Feng, or Yang Guo.
But as it stands, it certainly isn’t Guo Jing. Because Ding Ling has already defeated Guo Jing without receiving a task completion prompt.
Therefore, the game’s setting is likely that the first expert in the Divine Eagle World is Zhou Botong.
This is Ding Ling’s understanding.
Though Ouyang Feng is insane, even if he succeeded in reversing the Nine Yin Scripture, he still barely drew against Hong Qigong. Naturally, he can’t be the World’s Number One.
Yang Guo is a future expert, yet to reach full potential.
Actually, in Ding Ling’s view, Guo Jing should’ve been the World’s Number One, but the game world setting, or the setting of this plane, doesn’t recognize Guo Jing as first.
Ding Ling has no choice.
He can only choose to seek out Zhou Botong, to see if he can find and defeat him.
Ding Ling glanced at his character panel:
[Left-Right Mutual Struggle Full Level]
[Void Clarity Fist Full Level]
[Yue Girl Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Golden Dragon Whip Technique Full Level]
[Demon Suppression Staff Technique Full Level]
Guo Jing’s Martial Arts were all learned by Ding Ling.

Knowing Ding Ling wanted the Martial Arts Secret Manual, Guo Jing, being an emperor, didn’t care whether to teach Ding Ling all he knew. After consulting Ke Zhen’e, who didn’t object and even showed support,
Guo Jing wrote down everything he learned and sent it to Ding Ling among many Martial Arts Secret Manual books.
During Ding Ling’s reading period.
He casually finished what Guo Jing sent and leveled up to full as well.

"Left-Right Mutual Struggle and Void Clarity Fist are regarded as Zhou Botong’s signature skills, now that I’ve learned them, next time I meet Zhou Botong, I should be able to defeat him in one move."
Ding Ling was indifferent to this.
He knew he wasn’t staying in this world for long.
He has already sent Hoduo and Yuwen Chengdu with a joint force to the Esoteric Sect to obtain ’Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill’ and other Secret Manuals.
Tens of thousands of troops went with them!
Except for a heaven-defying Grandmaster like Ding Ling who can single-handedly crush millions of armies,
ordinary Innate Experts, when faced with thousands upon thousands, can only surrender! Or flee!
Head-on confrontation would most likely lead to death.
And in this world,
there currently seems to be no Grandmasters.
Because a Grandmaster is the world’s limit.
As facts have shown.
Even someone as gifted as Huang the Herbalist couldn’t reach this world’s limit based on his own supreme skills.
This is why Ding Ling is like a cheat.
Otherwise, common supreme geniuses taking the Path of the War God, even upon task completion, would still struggle to reach this world’s limit.

Simply because the difficulty of reaching the world limit is exceedingly high. Much like how in the Three Kingdoms World, attempting to achieve Celestial Human Realm level across all four-dimensional attributes is similar!
Just imagine!
How difficult it is!
Ding Ling entirely cheated, forcibly breaking into the world’s limit!
While Zuo Ci managed, it was through piled-up fateful encounters, but even then, his four-dimensional attribute points didn’t break into the Celestial Human Realm as Ding Ling did.
To achieve all four dimensions breaking into the Celestial Human Realm, this era’s Three Kingdoms World perhaps has only Ding Ling.
And reaching the limits of Inner Power and the four-dimensional limit in the Divine Eagle World,
is even harder than reaching the four-dimensional limits in the Three Kingdoms World.
Because the Three Kingdoms have no Inner Power!
"This world is about to come to an end. Once I receive the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill and other techniques, it’s time to leave."
Ding Ling hasn’t forgotten about some opportunities in this world.
The ruins of Celestial Mountain Piaomiao Palace!
Dugu Qiubai’s Sword Tomb.
The hiding place of the Pusique Snake!
He’s sent people to explore each location.
It’s undeniable.
The power of the masses is great!
Under collective brainstorming,
even the Pusique Snake began being reared in a certain valley.
In this vast Great Ming Kingdom, among the martial arts community, aside from Ouyang Feng, there are plenty of other heroes who know how to rear snakes.
Gather these heroes and have them rear the snakes.
It’s extremely convenient.
And the Pusique Snake’s gallbladder can enhance Inner Strength and physical fitness, even more effectively than Great Medicine because it can be directly consumed!
While Great Medicine can also be directly consumed.
Without reaching full level, it can’t be perfectly refined and can only be absorbed through medicinal baths.
The snake gall, however, can be directly consumed for enhancement, showcasing its heaven-defying effects.
Ding Ling, now having reached the world’s limit, doesn’t benefit from consuming it.
But the Little Dragon Girl benefits greatly from it!
To help the Little Dragon Girl grow quickly, Ding Ling made several trips to ’Snake Valley’ where Pusique Snakes are reared and brought back numerous snake galls for her to consume.
Now, the Little Dragon Girl’s physical fitness is vastly different from before.

Especially since she mentioned the Breathing Technique refining the snake galls working exceptionally well, further utilizing these snake galls pleased Ding Ling, deciding to significantly cultivate these Pusique Snakes!
To have them reproduce abundantly.
This way.
In the future in the Three Kingdoms, The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, or even in the Divine Eagle World, his own people could quickly grow by consuming snake galls, which would also aid him.
Through numerous wars, Ding Ling realized.
Though he can swiftly crush everything.
Without Huang Rong, Huang the Herbalist, and others handling civil affairs, management, etc. at the rear, any land he conquers will crumble quickly!
Being a lone hero without help is not feasible.
Especially when Ding Ling needs to gather all the world’s manuals for his use.
With help, the efficiency is incredibly high.
Moreover, with a large force in place, should his people ascend to the Divine Eagle World in the future, they can also swiftly rise, which is highly beneficial.
Ding Ling is very satisfied, regardless of which world he ascends to next.
The foundation in this world is already secure.
The future extent of conquered territories depends on the skills of Guo Jing, Huang Rong, and Huang the Herbalist.
Ding Ling will no longer care.
He doesn’t have the energy or time to manage it.
This world is vast.
To unite it entirely into one cohesive unit.
Will certainly take years.
Ding Ling is still planning to embark on the path of immortality with Diao Chan, the Little Dragon Girl, and others in the future!
He wouldn’t spend too much time in this world.
The goal is to complete task 2.
And upon acquiring the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill and other manuals, to ascend and leave.

sentences.text: "Very good."
Ding Ling chose to press on.
He had a premonition.
Perhaps once he finished reading all these Martial Arts Secret Manuals, the Martial Arts Melting Furnace would undergo a qualitative change.
As he started reading.
He didn’t rest.
For several days.
Several days later.
The Martial Arts Melting Furnace became extremely clear!
And at this moment, Ding Ling had also finished reading all the Secret Manuals.
He took a deep breath and thought:

"Indeed, the power of a nation far exceeds that of an individual, attempting to search for so many books and secret manuals by myself would consume an indescribable amount of time, energy, and spirit.
Yet now, I only need to utter a word.
Diao Chan and the others will take care of it for me.
Sitting at home, I can see one secret manual after another!
Very good.
If it’s reasonable in the future, I can continue this way."
Ding Ling nodded silently.
The Little Dragon Girl also doesn’t lack Great Medicine anymore.
Soaking in medicinal baths every day.
Her physical fitness is rising day by day!
Coupled with her extremely high Martial Arts talent and strong bones, the progress of her Breathing Technique is visibly increasing.
Ding Ling had long taught the Little Dragon Girl a Breathing Technique for both internal and external use.
He clearly explained the key secrets; once she feels ready in the future, she can naturally practice the Inner Refining Breathing Technique.
Ding Ling believes that with his guidance, the Little Dragon Girl will surely succeed.
Ding Ling stood up and checked the task progress.
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane World experts: 125/20.]
It was 47 before.
Later, after consecutively defeating dozens of First-class Experts.
Among them, dozens of First-class Experts from the Mongol Kingdom were beaten and killed by him.
These First-class Experts, including the pinnacle of First-class, also the most ordinary of First-class.
And even the most ordinary First-class experts held positions as commanders of tens of thousands in the Mongolian army, there were too many such commanders that Ding Ling killed or defeated.
This is why his count skyrocketed from 125 this time.
Of course, he also chose the right time to defeat Hong Qigong and Guo Jing under the guise of sparring.
And that counts too.
[3: You must make your title as the World’s Number One reverberate throughout the entire Plane World.
It was 23% before.
Without a doubt.
After Ding Ling single-handedly crushed the Mongol Kingdom and word of this spread throughout Jiuzhou,
His title as the World’s Number One was undisputed.
Even so.
He still hasn’t completed the second task.
"Need to defeat Zhou Botong?"
Ding Ling pondered.
Some say the first expert in the Divine Eagle World is Guo Jing.
Some say it’s Zhou Botong.
Others say it’s Ouyang Feng, or Yang Guo.
But as it stands, it certainly isn’t Guo Jing.
Because Ding Ling has already defeated Guo Jing without receiving a task completion prompt.
Therefore, the game’s setting is likely that the first expert in the Divine Eagle World is Zhou Botong.
This is Ding Ling’s understanding.
Though Ouyang Feng is insane, even if he succeeded in reversing the Nine Yin Scripture, he still barely drew against Hong Qigong.
Naturally, he can’t be the World’s Number One.
Yang Guo is a future expert, yet to reach full potential.
Actually, in Ding Ling’s view, Guo Jing should’ve been the World’s Number One, but the game world setting, or the setting of this plane, doesn’t recognize Guo Jing as first.
Ding Ling has no choice.
He can only choose to seek out Zhou Botong, to see if he can find and defeat him.
Ding Ling glanced at his character panel:
[Left-Right Mutual Struggle Full Level]
[Void Clarity Fist Full Level]
[Yue Girl Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Golden Dragon Whip Technique Full Level]
[Demon Suppression Staff Technique Full Level]
Guo Jing’s Martial Arts were all learned by Ding Ling.
Knowing Ding Ling wanted the Martial Arts Secret Manual, Guo Jing, being an emperor, didn’t care whether to teach Ding Ling all he knew.
After consulting Ke Zhen’e, who didn’t object and even showed support,
Guo Jing wrote down everything he learned and sent it to Ding Ling among many Martial Arts Secret Manual books.
During Ding Ling’s reading period.
He casually finished what Guo Jing sent and leveled up to full as well.

"Left-Right Mutual Struggle and Void Clarity Fist are regarded as Zhou Botong’s signature skills, now that I’ve learned them, next time I meet Zhou Botong, I should be able to defeat him in one move."
Ding Ling was indifferent to this.
He knew he wasn’t staying in this world for long.
He has already sent Hoduo and Yuwen Chengdu with a joint force to the Esoteric Sect to obtain ’Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill’ and other Secret Manuals.
Tens of thousands of troops went with them!
Except for a heaven-defying Grandmaster like Ding Ling who can single-handedly crush millions of armies,
ordinary Innate Experts, when faced with thousands upon thousands, can only surrender!
Or flee!
Head-on confrontation would most likely lead to death.
And in this world,
there currently seems to be no Grandmasters.
Because a Grandmaster is the world’s limit.
As facts have shown.
Even someone as gifted as Huang the Herbalist couldn’t reach this world’s limit based on his own supreme skills.
This is why Ding Ling is like a cheat.
Otherwise, common supreme geniuses taking the Path of the War God, even upon task completion, would still struggle to reach this world’s limit.
Simply because the difficulty of reaching the world limit is exceedingly high.
Much like how in the Three Kingdoms World, attempting to achieve Celestial Human Realm level across all four-dimensional attributes is similar!
Just imagine!
How difficult it is!
Ding Ling entirely cheated, forcibly breaking into the world’s limit!
While Zuo Ci managed, it was through piled-up fateful encounters, but even then, his four-dimensional attribute points didn’t break into the Celestial Human Realm as Ding Ling did.
To achieve all four dimensions breaking into the Celestial Human Realm, this era’s Three Kingdoms World perhaps has only Ding Ling.
And reaching the limits of Inner Power and the four-dimensional limit in the Divine Eagle World,
is even harder than reaching the four-dimensional limits in the Three Kingdoms World.
Because the Three Kingdoms have no Inner Power!
"This world is about to come to an end.
Once I receive the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill and other techniques, it’s time to leave."
Ding Ling hasn’t forgotten about some opportunities in this world.
The ruins of Celestial Mountain Piaomiao Palace!
Dugu Qiubai’s Sword Tomb.
The hiding place of the Pusique Snake!
He’s sent people to explore each location.
It’s undeniable.
The power of the masses is great!
Under collective brainstorming,
even the Pusique Snake began being reared in a certain valley.
In this vast Great Ming Kingdom, among the martial arts community, aside from Ouyang Feng, there are plenty of other heroes who know how to rear snakes.
Gather these heroes and have them rear the snakes.
It’s extremely convenient.
And the Pusique Snake’s gallbladder can enhance Inner Strength and physical fitness, even more effectively than Great Medicine because it can be directly consumed!
While Great Medicine can also be directly consumed.
Without reaching full level, it can’t be perfectly refined and can only be absorbed through medicinal baths.
The snake gall, however, can be directly consumed for enhancement, showcasing its heaven-defying effects.
Ding Ling, now having reached the world’s limit, doesn’t benefit from consuming it.
But the Little Dragon Girl benefits greatly from it!
To help the Little Dragon Girl grow quickly, Ding Ling made several trips to ’Snake Valley’ where Pusique Snakes are reared and brought back numerous snake galls for her to consume.
Now, the Little Dragon Girl’s physical fitness is vastly different from before.

Especially since she mentioned the Breathing Technique refining the snake galls working exceptionally well, further utilizing these snake galls pleased Ding Ling, deciding to significantly cultivate these Pusique Snakes!
To have them reproduce abundantly.
This way.
In the future in the Three Kingdoms, The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World, or even in the Divine Eagle World, his own people could quickly grow by consuming snake galls, which would also aid him.
Through numerous wars, Ding Ling realized.
Though he can swiftly crush everything.
Without Huang Rong, Huang the Herbalist, and others handling civil affairs, management, etc. at the rear, any land he conquers will crumble quickly!
Being a lone hero without help is not feasible.
Especially when Ding Ling needs to gather all the world’s manuals for his use.
With help, the efficiency is incredibly high.
Moreover, with a large force in place, should his people ascend to the Divine Eagle World in the future, they can also swiftly rise, which is highly beneficial.
Ding Ling is very satisfied, regardless of which world he ascends to next.
The foundation in this world is already secure.
The future extent of conquered territories depends on the skills of Guo Jing, Huang Rong, and Huang the Herbalist.
Ding Ling will no longer care.
He doesn’t have the energy or time to manage it.

Will certainly take years.

And upon acquiring the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill and other manuals, to ascend and leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 482: Lu Wushuang and Hong Lingbo
paragraphs: This day.
Someone reported seeing the figure of Zhou Botong near Valley of Heartless.
Ding Ling took Little Dragon Girl to Valley of Heartless.
The Valley is north of Xiangyang.
Ding Ling traveled north all the way, without riding a horse.
At his current level, True Qi is endless, his stamina so strong that maintaining peak combat power for several consecutive days and nights is not a problem.
Therefore, he chose to use Lightweight Skill for faster travel.
Ding Ling imparted the Nine Yin Scripture, Spiral Nine Shadows, Golden Swan Skill, and other Techniques to Little Dragon Girl.
Now Little Dragon Girl has successfully switched from practicing the Yu Girl’s True Scripture to the Nine Yin Scripture.

The Yu Girl’s True Scripture requires two people to practice together, and although it is formidable, for Ding Ling, it is somewhat useless, so he preferred that Little Dragon Girl switch to the stronger Nine Yin Scripture.

Ding Ling had switched to multiple Divine Skills before, and although his switches were passive, his experience in this area is rich, making guiding Little Dragon Girl through the switch not an issue.
After successfully switching, Little Dragon Girl’s current Inner Strength is now remarkable. With the Breathing Technique, few in this world can threaten her anymore.
Whiz whiz!
Ding Ling pulled Little Dragon Girl as they flew through the void.
One is a tall, imposing, majestic Martial Arts Grandmaster;
The other, a serene and graceful maiden akin to an Immortal.
Stepping through the air, they truly seemed like a pair of divine lovers.
Along the way, many players witnessed their movements, many exclaiming Ding Ling’s name aloud.

It’s quite challenging for players to feel awe towards Ding Ling, this ’Prince,’ as many are unruly. Little Dragon Girl saw this, and though she slightly frowned, she wasn’t bothered by the alien visitors’ typical behavior and just kept her eyes on Ding Ling.
Whiz!
They flew past, their feet not touching the ground, soaring through dozens of miles in an instant, vanishing from the players’ sight, leaving them astounded and tongue-tied:
"Oh my goodness! Has Ding Ling become immortal?! He’s flying now! It’s unbelievable!"
"Heard he could fly in the Three Kingdoms World, but not as gracefully as this. Seems he has grown stronger."
"This guy is truly a freak! I wonder if he’s as strong in reality as in the Game World. If he’s equally strong... wow, can’t even imagine!"

Players discussed fervently, mixed with admiration, jealousy, and hatred towards Ding Ling. Of course, mostly they were frenzied. Tourist-loving players who saw this scene were envious and thrilled to the extreme.
Immediately, they joined various sects to learn Inner Power.
They won’t stop until they’ve achieved something noteworthy.
Upon reaching near Valley of Heartless.
Naturally, someone came to guide Ding Ling into the mysterious, dreamlike Valley of Heartless.
"It’s truly the Prince."
Two beautiful, graceful maidens appeared.
One of them had delicate eyebrows and almond-shaped eyes, with a face like a peach blossom, dressed in white, she was truly a beauty.
The woman beside her was also quite beautiful, but standing next to her, she was overshadowed.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, her bright almond eyes lit up, she hurriedly walked two steps to stand before Ding Ling, walking with a limp but still energetically, clearly bursting with joy:
"Greetings, Prince!"
The other quickly moved forward to pay her respects.
Ding Ling was puzzled:
"Who are you?"
He did not expect Zhou Botong to be discovered by such two charming ladies.
"I am Lu Wushuang."
The stunning beauty introduced herself with a gleaming smile, then pointed to the woman beside her:

"This is my senior disciple sister Hong Lingbo. We admired you, Prince, and joined the Embroidered Guard of the Great Ming Dynasty, taking on a small official position. Upon hearing that you, Prince, were searching for Zhou Botong, we volunteered to take on this mission, and indeed, we found traces of him nearby."
Ding Ling’s eye twitched.
He truly did not expect Lu Wushuang and Hong Lingbo to be in such a situation!
It seemed that Lu Wushuang’s destiny had wholly changed. With Hong Lingbo, a helpful and kind-hearted girl, at her side, her path was evidently smoother.
As for the Ming’s Embroidered Guard?

There were players serving as officials in the court, and Huang Rong endorsed the idea of the Embroidered Guard since she was the queen and frequently advised Guo Jing, having significant influence in court, so female officials in the guard were not lacking.
Though Lu Wushuang and Hong Lingbo’s martial arts were lacking compared to Innate Experts, they were much stronger compared to ordinary soldiers.
The reason Lu Wushuang was so warm and proactive towards Ding Ling was because he avenged her blood debt.
Li Mochou was killed by Ding Ling.
This was known by Huang Rong and others; Cheng Ying was Huang the Herbalist’s disciple and had been working with him in the court recently, so she naturally knew about it.
Cheng Ying knew.
Lu Wushuang naturally couldn’t be ignorant of it.

Cheng Ying and Lu Wushuang have always been grateful to Ding Ling, wanting to find an opportunity to properly thank him. But unfortunately, after Ding Ling started being with Little Dragon Girl, the super recluse, he too became a recluse, staying at the Prince’s Mansion all day without coming out. Even if he did come out, it was a fleeting appearance, disappearing without a trace.
How could they have a chance to meet with Ding Ling?
Furthermore, they did not want to intrude upon the beautiful life of this divine couple.
They could only wait for a good chance to show their gratitude in the future.
Later, Ding Ling mentioned wanting the Secret Manual and expressed a desire to find Zhou Botong.
They have silently been assisting Ding Ling all along.
But Ding Ling was unaware of this.
At this moment, seeing Lu Wushuang’s somewhat delighted appearance, he felt puzzled — was he really that popular?
As he traversed the Jianghu, most people he met were in awe, rarely showing such joy.
His ferocious reputation precedes him.
He is famously known as the Ten Thousand Butcher!
Though people admire him greatly, when they actually see him in person, many are scared stiff.
However, Ding Ling follows the principle of "if others don’t provoke me, I don’t provoke them.
Seeing people behaving like this, he had no interest in interacting and wouldn’t engage in conflicts; he wasn’t that idle.
So he continued moving northward.
Ding Ling moved very quickly, even when he stopped for meals. He and Little Dragon Girl sat quietly together, not interacting with others.
Little Dragon Girl greatly enjoyed this two-person world, showing more smiles recently, with happiness evident in her eyes for anyone to see.
"Take me to see Zhou Botong."
Ding Ling communicated with Lu Wushuang and Hong Lingbo.
He found Hong Lingbo had a pure and good nature, truly a good woman. Thinking of her description in the original work, Ding Ling considered, ’Perhaps the current situation is a blessing for her.’
Lu Wushuang, lively and energetic, exhibited her cleverness in many aspects.
Though she limped, in front of Ding Ling, whom she highly esteemed, she appeared cheerful, open, active, and happy.
Ding Ling noticed but did not reveal her facade of resilience.
He simply followed her.
Entered the Valley of Heartless.
Looking around.
Indeed, it was a scene like a painting of Immortal dreams.

Patches of flower gardens shrouded in light mist extended to the end; occasionally, young women, in the prime of their youth, could be seen walking through the gardens, picking flowers, laughing as they departed. Such a scene, resembling the palatial chambers of Celestial Flower Fairy.
"Is that the Love Flower?"
Ding Ling glanced at it without lingering; the Love Flower was so poisonous, it should not exist in the mortal world!
Yet Ding Ling had no intention of destroying them at the moment.

As long as the antidote "Heartless Pill" can be made, the Love Flower would not be toxic. Moreover, Ding Ling thought of trying, once he ascends to the Upper Realm, to use the Love Flower’s poison against some cultivators in this Divine Eagle World — would it be effective?
It was hard to say.
But Ding Ling guessed it probably wouldn’t work against Immortals; he didn’t plan that far ahead, just hoping it could affect cultivators would be good enough.
"Prince, follow me. That is the Love Flower; absolutely must not touch..."
Lu Wushuang hurriedly walked, occasionally explaining to Ding Ling.
She was evidently very familiar with the Valley of Heartless.
Clearly, she hadn’t spared any effort to seek Zhou Botong.
A moment later.
She led Ding Ling to a beautiful valley.
Here were many bees.
Little Dragon Girl was surprised:
"These are my Jade Bees."
She had raised some Jade Bees at Xiangyang Guo Family, just not on this scale.
Ding Ling was also puzzled.
How did Zhou Botong learn to raise these Jade Bees without encountering Little Dragon Girl?
But thinking of so many players.
Some players were adept at beekeeping, or people from other worlds were skilled at it. Not a surprise.
Those aware of Zhou Botong’s prowess would find ways to curry favor with him, seemingly understandable.

chapters.title: Chapter 483: Zhou Botong
paragraphs: It’s possible that these players or ascenders have already gained significant benefits from Zhou Botong.
As for how they acquired the Jade Bee?
There are many of these Jade Bees beside the Ancient Tomb on Zhongnan Mountain.
The Little Dragon Girl couldn’t take them all, only a small portion.
With a bit of effort, it’s not hard to catch some of the remaining ones, yet it truly is amazing that these people figured out how to keep Jade Bees.
One could say that there is no shortage of smart people in this world.
Just like the Dugu Sword Tomb, the treasured swords inside have long been dug up by players, with the Profound Iron Heavy Sword and others naturally falling into their hands.
The only thing that comforted him was that the Pusique Snakes, these monstrous snakes, are extremely powerful, leaving the players helpless, thus benefiting Ding Ling.
As for the Divine Eagle?
Somehow, the players managed to persuade it away.
Anyway, Ding Ling hadn’t seen it.

We can only say that players who’ve experienced the information flood of the information age can come up with all sorts of strange methods. So, the Divine Eagle being persuaded away was surprising to Ding Ling, but not entirely unexpected.
This was why Ding Ling felt relieved after seeing the mountain full of Jade Bees.
"Zhou Botong, Zhou Botong..."
Lu Wushuang ran into the valley shouting.
Judging by her familiarity, it seemed their knowledge of Zhou Botong was more than just sightings.
Sure enough.
Before long.
An old man, with a youthful glow and lively eyes, ran out from the flower bushes on the side, clutching his hair and yelling:
’Alright, alright, no need to shout, I’m not deaf, I can hear you!’
"Zhou Botong, come over here, the Prince wants to see you."
Seeing the old man, Lu Wushuang was overjoyed and waved at him enthusiastically—it wouldn’t be surprising if they were friends.
The old man, none other than Zhou Botong, was curious but ran like the wind to stand before Lu Wushuang:
"I say, you mischievous girl, why do you keep bothering me? I still have bees to tend and honey to eat!"
"After meeting with the Prince, I’ll help you with that!"
"Really~"
Zhou Botong’s eyes brightened, grinning as he spoke:
"You said it, no backing out on your word!"
"No backing out."
Lu Wushuang dragged Zhou Botong along, leading him in front of Ding Ling, and said with a touch of pride:
"Prince, this is Zhou Botong."
Saying this, she gave Zhou Botong a slight push forward.
Zhou Botong raised his eyebrows, sizing Ding Ling up and down:
"You’re the Prince? The newly established Prince of the Great Ming?"
"That’s right."
Ding Ling respectfully greeted him, neither humble nor overbearing, and said:
"Junior Ding Ling, greets the elder."
"So you’re Ding Ling?!"
Zhou Botong was startled, leaping aside like a frightened rabbit:
"The Ten Thousand Butcher Ding Ling, the one who single-handedly defeated millions of soldiers?!"
"I am indeed Ding Ling."
Ding Ling’s face involuntarily twitched twice, wondering who had filled Zhou Botong’s head with such fear-inducing rumors about him.
This was the carefree, fearless Zhou Botong!
"You’re too terrifying. I don’t want to play with you."
Zhou Botong shook his head and turned to leave.
"Hey. Zhou Botong. Don’t go."
Lu Wushuang was anxious:
"The Prince is very agreeable."
"I don’t see it that way."
Zhou Botong glared at Lu Wushuang:
"You troublesome girl, why bring a Murderous Demon King to me? Almost scared me to death! If this happens again, I won’t entertain you anymore!"

Lu Wushuang was momentarily speechless but clearly she was used to dealing with Zhou Botong, knowing he was innocently charming, like a child, unable to keep secrets. Without taking offense, she simply said:

"Those are mere slanders—throwing mud at my Prince. You’ve seen yourself. My Prince, majestic and extraordinary, clearly an unmatched figure! How could he ever be a Murderous Demon King? That’s just the world’s misunderstanding of him!"
Zhou Botong, you’re a smart man, how can you misjudge my Prince like the others?!"
She even said "my Prince" outright.
It was apparent Lu Wushuang frequently fantasized about things with Ding Ling in her mind.
Now finally meeting Ding Ling, after some conversation, even if the Little Dragon Girl was present, it seemed she could not suppress her emotions.
"Oh?"
Zhou Botong blinked his eyes in response, unable to resist yet another glance at Ding Ling.
Lu Wushuang seized the opportunity to say:
"If he’s truly a ruthless killer, upon seeing you, my Prince would surely have attacked without saying a word. But look at his politeness. How could he possibly be that kind of brutal person."
"That makes sense."
Zhou Botong suddenly realized, scratching his head as he approached Ding Ling and said with a grin:

"Your Highness, my apologies. I’ve heard too much about your Ten Thousand Butcher reputation. I even saw the aftermath of your battle against millions—it was a dreadful sight. It haunts my dreams at times!"
He glanced sideways at Ding Ling:
"Those millions, you truly defeated them, right?"
"That’s right."
"Then why does Lu Wushuang say you’re not the Ten Thousand Butcher!"
Zhou Botong widened his eyes.
Apparently, once he realized the truth, he wasn’t as afraid of Ding Ling but still seemed slightly apprehensive.
Ding Ling replied:
"It was a battle between two nations. Mongolia slaughtered many of our Central Plain’s fine sons. I was just returning the favor."
"Precisely, precisely."
Lu Wushuang quickly chimed in:

"This is a national war! We martial arts people can’t define such a war by Jianghu standards and rules! Just think of the countless years of battles between the Northern Song, Southern Song, and the countries of the Northern Lands, how many of us have died? Zhou Botong, you’re not a pedantic man, surely you’re not nitpicking like some out-of-touch scholars about this matter?"
Hong Lingbo occasionally echoed supportive comments from the side.
Zhou Botong was overwhelmed by the two women, and he could only nod repeatedly like a chicken pecking at grains:
"Alright, alright. I get it, your Prince is a hero."
He looked at Ding Ling:
"This Prince, you’ve come from far and wide to find me, what exactly is this about?"
"I want to spar with you a bit."
Ding Ling smiled and said:
"I have some very interesting martial arts. If you find them intriguing, I can teach you one later."
Ding Ling had so many martial arts that they were countless.
Taking out one or two was no big deal for him.
"Really?"

Throughout his entire life, Zhou Botong loved learning martial arts. When he heard these words, he couldn’t contain his joy, immediately forgetting the information others had fed him about ’Ding Ling being extremely terrifying’ and so forth. He also forgot about the bloody battle scenes he had witnessed earlier, only looking at Ding Ling with anticipation and said:
"Then let’s hurry to the side and spar."
Ding Ling had no objections.
A moment later.
Ding Ling assumed a stance and began sparring formally with the eager Zhou Botong.
Ding Ling fought barehanded against Zhou Botong.

Sometimes he used his hands as a spear, performing Ghost Prison Spear Technique, Breaking Army Spear Skill, Human Emperor Spear Technique, Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique, and others one by one. In the void, spear qi crisscrossed, and Zhou Botong shouted excitedly, repeatedly exclaiming ’Amazing, amazing, truly great spear technique!’

Sometimes he used his fingers as a sword, employing Calm Wind Swordsmanship, Moon Shadow Swordsmanship, Howling Moon Sword Technique, and others. Sword qi surged, and sword shadows filled the void, making Zhou Botong excited and joyful ’Great sword technique, truly wonderful!’
Sometimes he used his palms as a saber, casually performing Slaughter Void Saber Technique and Burning Wood Saber Technique, catching Zhou Botong off guard, yet he occasionally shouted with delight.
It was apparent that Ding Ling was restraining himself.
After a short while.
Zhou Botong couldn’t resist conceding defeat, rubbing his ears and massaging his cheeks:
"Prince, what kind of kung fu is this? Many I’ve never seen before, really fun. Can you teach me?"
"We can teach each other."
Ding Ling could see that Zhou Botong understood many techniques.
Evidently, while wandering the Jianghu, he learned every interesting martial art he saw.
So Ding Ling taught him Ghostly Spear Technique and Flying Bear Breathing Technique.
Beyond that.
He wouldn’t be able to digest it all at once.

Zhou Botong, on the other hand, had a vast, diverse, and complex set of skills, but Ding Ling mastered each one to full level immediately. Regardless of how Zhou Botong racked his brain to bring out more advanced and difficult martial arts for Ding Ling to learn, Ding Ling reached full level instantly.
Zhou Botong was astonished and shocked:
"You, you, you, you this..."
"You are truly the Prince."
Lu Wushuang and Hong Lingbo watched from the side, deeply moved.
When Zhou Botong taught Ding Ling martial skills, he did so openly, allowing them to watch. However, they simply couldn’t grasp one skill before forgetting another, not knowing which one to learn.
And Ding Ling?
Without comparison, there was no harm!
Instantly, Ding Ling’s image in their hearts and eyes became increasingly mysterious, towering, majestic, and vast.
"Are there any more martial arts?"
Ding Ling smiled and said:
"We can exchange them all."
Zhou Botong was innately intelligent and simple-minded, without too many complicated thoughts. Therefore, although he learned many styles, each was relatively pure.
Altogether, there were three or four dozen styles.
There were more than a dozen first-class ones.
Second and third-class ones were the majority.
Once all were mastered to full level, the lid of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace seemed to move towards substantialization!
"No more, no more!"
Zhou Botong sat down in a heap, looking at Ding Ling like a deity:

"You, you... No wonder you’re so strong at such a young age. I now understand. Truly unimaginable that there could be a genius like you in the world. If my senior brother were here, he would be so surprised he wouldn’t know what to say."
He said this with some embarrassment, scratching his head:
"About the breathing technique you mentioned earlier, I still don’t understand many parts. Can you teach me again?"
Ding Ling nodded, without avoiding Lu Wushuang and Hong Lingbo, and started teaching right on the spot.
To Ding Ling.
This Flying Bear Breathing Technique was known by many; there was no need to hide it.
Moreover, Lu Wushuang and Hong Lingbo were Great Ming Female Officials, essentially part of his circle now. If they became stronger, Ding Ling would feel gratified.
However, these principles.
They were unaware, intending to avoid suspicion, but Ding Ling indicated there was no need, leaving them deeply moved, making up their minds to find ways to repay the Prince.
Seeing Ding Ling begin his explanation.
They also calmed their complex and exciting feelings, listening attentively, unwilling to miss such a chance.
Ding Ling stayed in the valley for two days.
In that period, he confirmed Task 2 completed.
After discovering how easy it was to get along with Ding Ling, Zhou Botong excitedly shared everything with him.
Of course, some secrets deeply buried he would never reveal.
After Ding Ling understood the situation, he prepared to leave.
It was as he had suspected.
Zhou Botong’s Beekeeping Skill was indeed taught to him by a collaboration between players and an Ascender, in exchange for Zhou Botong’s Void Clarity Fist and other techniques.
Except for the Nine Yin Scripture, which couldn’t be exchanged.
Common techniques, he willingly exchanged.
This showed his innocent nature.
Ding Ling wouldn’t want to disturb him any longer.
After completing the task.
He bid farewell with cupped hands.

Lu Wushuang had to fulfill her promise to Zhou Botong, staying to help him raise Jade Bees for a while. Naturally, Hong Lingbo followed Lu Wushuang, so the two of them couldn’t accompany Ding Ling on his journey, only bidding farewell to Ding Ling and then returning to the valley.
Da-da!
Just after Ding Ling and his wife left Valley of Heartless, a fierce horse charged forth, with a person sitting upright on its back.

This person wore a precious blue satin robe, with a handsome face and some short beard under his chin. He seemed surprised to find people at the entrance of the Valley of Heartless, and as he attempted to rein in the horse, he prepared to run straight into them.

chapters.title: Chapter 484: Valley Master of Heartless
paragraphs: Ding Ling frowned slightly, looking at the visitor. Without thinking, he reversed his hand and struck out with a palm.
Prideful Dragon’s Regret!
Roar!
A dragon’s roar arose as a dragon form phantom shot out from his palm. With a flick of its tail, boom! It easily toppled both the fiery horse and the rider to the ground.
"Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms!"

The knight, seemingly not lacking in vision and insight, rolled on the ground; his complexion changed drastically as he swiftly scanned Ding Ling. Upon seeing Little Dragon Girl, his eyes showed a trace of infatuation and amazement.
But he quickly collected himself, not daring to look at Little Dragon Girl again, and stood up, cupped his fists in greeting:
"I’m Gongsun Zhi, Valley Master of Valley of Heartless. Are you the First-Rank Prince and Queen couple?"
"You’re Gongsun Zhi?"
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows.
"That’s right."
Gongsun Zhi said anxiously and uneasily:
"I inadvertently offended you just now, I ask Prince to not count the mistake of a humble man!"
Gongsun Zhi was aware of the changes happening outside.
He even guessed Ding Ling’s true identity at a glance.
It shows Valley of Heartless is not isolated from the world.
Or perhaps, with various players intruding, Valley of Heartless might have turned into chaos now.
The purpose of Ding Ling’s trip was to complete Task 2.
After confirming Task 2 progress was 100%.
Having honored the agreement with Zhou Botong.
He chose to leave, without delving into Valley of Heartless.
However, before leaving, he used a short knife to cut a Love Flower and pulled out a Poisonous Plant.
Planning to go back and figure out how to make ’Heartless Pill.’
As long as Heartless Pills can be mass-produced, the Love Flower’s poison would no longer be toxic.
By then, using it against enemies could have miraculous effects.
Unexpectedly.
Just after leaving the valley, he encountered Gongsun Zhi!
"Did you just try to run me over?"
Ding Ling asked.
Gongsun Zhi’s face changed drastically, retreated two steps, slightly bent over, cupped his hands, and gave a respectful salute:
"I absolutely didn’t mean to, I ask Prince to spare me this time."
So sensible.
Ding Ling no longer had the desire to compete with him, waved his hand, about to say a few words, but suddenly thought of something, then said:
"If you want me to forgive you, it’s easy, hand over your family’s Kung Fu and weapons."
It would have been fine not to encounter Gongsun Zhi.
Encountering him, Ding Ling thought of the pair of Gentleman and Lady Sword, which were famous swords!
Plus, the martial arts in Valley of Heartless seemed not to have been handed over to Huang Rong by Gongsun Zhi, who was quite a stubborn representative!
This is secondary.
The main reason: Gongsun Zhi tried to run him over, some compensation is reasonable. Besides, he’s the Prince, attempting royal murder is a big crime!
"Prince."
Gongsun Zhi suddenly raised his head to look at Ding Ling:
’You shouldn’t bully people too much!’
He let out a long howl.
Rustle!
A troop of men ran out from behind him.
These men held fish nets, quickly forming a Fish Net Array, trapping Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl in the center.
The fish nets were covered with Love Flowers and sharp blades!
At this moment, these Fish Net Arrays were closing in towards the center, obviously trying to catch Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl.
Gongsun Zhi laughed:
"Prince, you refuse the toast and want punishment. I called myself humble before you! So humbly! You’re still so aggressive, then don’t blame me for being merciless."
He stared intensely at Little Dragon Girl:

"Queen is as beautiful as a Celestial Immortal. Truly makes me feel pity. Prince, why don’t you enjoy your life at the Prince’s Mansion with such a beautiful Queen, taking her around everywhere? Aren’t you afraid of regretting in the future?"
Ding Ling ignored Gongsun Zhi, just furrowing his brows and reaching for his sword hilt.
Gongsun Zhi retreated two steps, his face gloomy, said:

"Prince, rumors about you are flying everywhere outside. I dare not underestimate you. But this Fish Net Array has been passed down for generations in my family; even the most powerful person can’t break it, I advise you..."
Boom!
His voice hadn’t fallen yet.

Ding Ling had already drawn the Heaven-Swaying Sword from his back, using Fusion Qi to activate Dugu Nine Swords. In an instant, countless sword shadows could be seen, accompanied by a sizzling sound cutting through Celestial Extreme.
Dozens of wide and tough fish nets were all cut by Heaven-Swaying Sword.

Ding Ling’s attack was like lightning; the sword followed him as he moved, activating Spiral Nine Shadows. His silhouette sometimes dissipated, sometimes split into nine, sometimes condensed into one. After swiftly circling the scene, he already had his sword against Gongsun Zhi’s neck, slightly exerting force, hiss!
Streams of blood flowed down the blade.
Gongsun Zhi’s pupils widened, unbelievable!
He looked at the blood on the sword, sweating profusely, his scalp tingling, chuckled dryly:
"Prince, just now I was joking with you, definitely didn’t mean to make things difficult for you or covet the Queen!"
Just two blinks weren’t even complete.
Fish Net Array was broken.
Dozens of elite disciples were killed.
He was also controlled.
The attack speed was so fast!
The enemy wiping efficiency was so high.

It was simply as if a Ghost God, Gongsun Zhi had never seen such a figure before, couldn’t help but be scared senseless, his heart jumped to his throat, he regretted deeply, had he known Ding Ling wasn’t afraid of Fish Net Array, would he dare to choose to compete head-on?!
"Now when I ask you to hand over your cultivation technique and weapons, will you?"
"I’ll definitely hand them over."
"Speak."
Ding Ling didn’t tolerate Gongsun Zhi, looked at him indifferently:
"Right now, tell me the heart techniques you know."
"Right here."
"Will you speak? Or not?"
Ding Ling slightly exerted force, sending a sharp pain through Gongsun Zhi’s neck. Startled, he quickly said:
"I will speak, I will speak!"
"Go ahead."
Ding Ling sheathed his sword:
"While speaking, demonstrate the moves. I warn you in advance, if I find you’re being perfunctory or deceiving me, you’ll be asking for trouble!"
How despicable and lustful could Gongsun Zhi be?
It’s shown everywhere in TV shows and novels.

Ding Ling’s perception of him stayed at the novels and dramas, originally had no good impression, collided from the start, then refused some compensation, wouldn’t kill if he didn’t want to! Even tried to loot Little Dragon Girl?!
Ding Ling had Full Level Observing People Skill, how could he not see the lustful intent Gongsun Zhi harbored for Little Dragon Girl.
Couldn’t help but be enraged.
Also wondered, knowing Ding Ling could topple millions of troops, why would he dare use the Fish Net Array to trap him?
How confident was he in the Fish Net Array to make such a foolish move!
This was a perception bias.
In Gongsun Zhi’s eyes, the Fish Net Array was always successful, no martial arts expert was unbeatable; family records clearly indicated its invincibility.
Gongsun Zhi also used this trick to lure and kill many strong figures!

His perception was the Fish Net Array once executed, even top experts could only die with regrets! Plus, without witnessing Ding Ling’s battlefield prowess, assumed Ding Ling’s strength was within human limits. As long as he’s human, Fish Net Array could kill!
But he didn’t know Ding Ling had reached Grandmaster Realm, with Fusion Qi activating, crushing gold and stones was no problem.
The trivial Fish Net Array?
How could it trap him?
Now, Gongsun Zhi realized, but it was too late, Ding Ling wouldn’t give him a second chance.
His regret and remorse needn’t be mentioned.
Now facing Ding Ling’s sword, he could only nervously and timidly say the heart method mantra while demonstrating.
Initially.
He first taught Ding Ling Iron Palm Technique, an extremely difficult technique he learned from Iron Palm Lotus Qiu Qianchi.
Very hard to learn.
He slightly altered a few characters, attempting to pass off.
But could Ding Ling’s cheats allow him to do so?

A dragon’s roar arose as a dragon form phantom shot out from his palm.
With a flick of its tail, boom!
It easily toppled both the fiery horse and the rider to the ground.
"Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms!"
The knight, seemingly not lacking in vision and insight, rolled on the ground; his complexion changed drastically as he swiftly scanned Ding Ling.
Upon seeing Little Dragon Girl, his eyes showed a trace of infatuation and amazement.
But he quickly collected himself, not daring to look at Little Dragon Girl again, and stood up, cupped his fists in greeting:
"I’m Gongsun Zhi, Valley Master of Valley of Heartless.
Are you the First-Rank Prince and Queen couple?"
"You’re Gongsun Zhi?"
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows.
"That’s right."
Gongsun Zhi said anxiously and uneasily:
"I inadvertently offended you just now, I ask Prince to not count the mistake of a humble man!"
Gongsun Zhi was aware of the changes happening outside.
He even guessed Ding Ling’s true identity at a glance.
It shows Valley of Heartless is not isolated from the world.
Or perhaps, with various players intruding, Valley of Heartless might have turned into chaos now.
The purpose of Ding Ling’s trip was to complete Task 2.
After confirming Task 2 progress was 100%.
Having honored the agreement with Zhou Botong.
He chose to leave, without delving into Valley of Heartless.
However, before leaving, he used a short knife to cut a Love Flower and pulled out a Poisonous Plant.
Planning to go back and figure out how to make ’Heartless Pill.’
As long as Heartless Pills can be mass-produced, the Love Flower’s poison would no longer be toxic.
By then, using it against enemies could have miraculous effects.
Unexpectedly.
Just after leaving the valley, he encountered Gongsun Zhi!
"Did you just try to run me over?"
Ding Ling asked.
Gongsun Zhi’s face changed drastically, retreated two steps, slightly bent over, cupped his hands, and gave a respectful salute:
"I absolutely didn’t mean to, I ask Prince to spare me this time."
So sensible.
Ding Ling no longer had the desire to compete with him, waved his hand, about to say a few words, but suddenly thought of something, then said:
"If you want me to forgive you, it’s easy, hand over your family’s Kung Fu and weapons."
It would have been fine not to encounter Gongsun Zhi.
Encountering him, Ding Ling thought of the pair of Gentleman and Lady Sword, which were famous swords!
Plus, the martial arts in Valley of Heartless seemed not to have been handed over to Huang Rong by Gongsun Zhi, who was quite a stubborn representative!
This is secondary.
The main reason: Gongsun Zhi tried to run him over, some compensation is reasonable.
Besides, he’s the Prince, attempting royal murder is a big crime!
"Prince."
Gongsun Zhi suddenly raised his head to look at Ding Ling:
’You shouldn’t bully people too much!’
He let out a long howl.
Rustle!
A troop of men ran out from behind him.
These men held fish nets, quickly forming a Fish Net Array, trapping Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl in the center.
The fish nets were covered with Love Flowers and sharp blades!
At this moment, these Fish Net Arrays were closing in towards the center, obviously trying to catch Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl.
Gongsun Zhi laughed:
"Prince, you refuse the toast and want punishment.
I called myself humble before you!
So humbly!
You’re still so aggressive, then don’t blame me for being merciless."
He stared intensely at Little Dragon Girl:
"Queen is as beautiful as a Celestial Immortal.
Truly makes me feel pity.
Prince, why don’t you enjoy your life at the Prince’s Mansion with such a beautiful Queen, taking her around everywhere?
Aren’t you afraid of regretting in the future?"
Ding Ling ignored Gongsun Zhi, just furrowing his brows and reaching for his sword hilt.
Gongsun Zhi retreated two steps, his face gloomy, said:
"Prince, rumors about you are flying everywhere outside.
I dare not underestimate you.
But this Fish Net Array has been passed down for generations in my family; even the most powerful person can’t break it, I advise you..."
Boom!
His voice hadn’t fallen yet.
Ding Ling had already drawn the Heaven-Swaying Sword from his back, using Fusion Qi to activate Dugu Nine Swords.
In an instant, countless sword shadows could be seen, accompanied by a sizzling sound cutting through Celestial Extreme.
Dozens of wide and tough fish nets were all cut by Heaven-Swaying Sword.
Ding Ling’s attack was like lightning; the sword followed him as he moved, activating Spiral Nine Shadows.
His silhouette sometimes dissipated, sometimes split into nine, sometimes condensed into one.
After swiftly circling the scene, he already had his sword against Gongsun Zhi’s neck, slightly exerting force, hiss!
Streams of blood flowed down the blade.
Gongsun Zhi’s pupils widened, unbelievable!
He looked at the blood on the sword, sweating profusely, his scalp tingling, chuckled dryly:
"Prince, just now I was joking with you, definitely didn’t mean to make things difficult for you or covet the Queen!"
Just two blinks weren’t even complete.
Fish Net Array was broken.
Dozens of elite disciples were killed.
He was also controlled.
The attack speed was so fast!
The enemy wiping efficiency was so high.

It was simply as if a Ghost God, Gongsun Zhi had never seen such a figure before, couldn’t help but be scared senseless, his heart jumped to his throat, he regretted deeply, had he known Ding Ling wasn’t afraid of Fish Net Array, would he dare to choose to compete head-on?!
"Now when I ask you to hand over your cultivation technique and weapons, will you?"
"I’ll definitely hand them over."
"Speak."
Ding Ling didn’t tolerate Gongsun Zhi, looked at him indifferently:
"Right now, tell me the heart techniques you know."
"Right here."
"Will you speak?
Or not?"
Ding Ling slightly exerted force, sending a sharp pain through Gongsun Zhi’s neck.
Startled, he quickly said:
"I will speak, I will speak!"
"Go ahead."
Ding Ling sheathed his sword:
"While speaking, demonstrate the moves.
I warn you in advance, if I find you’re being perfunctory or deceiving me, you’ll be asking for trouble!"
How despicable and lustful could Gongsun Zhi be?
It’s shown everywhere in TV shows and novels.
Ding Ling’s perception of him stayed at the novels and dramas, originally had no good impression, collided from the start, then refused some compensation, wouldn’t kill if he didn’t want to!
Even tried to loot Little Dragon Girl?!
Ding Ling had Full Level Observing People Skill, how could he not see the lustful intent Gongsun Zhi harbored for Little Dragon Girl.
Couldn’t help but be enraged.
Also wondered, knowing Ding Ling could topple millions of troops, why would he dare use the Fish Net Array to trap him?
How confident was he in the Fish Net Array to make such a foolish move!
This was a perception bias.
In Gongsun Zhi’s eyes, the Fish Net Array was always successful, no martial arts expert was unbeatable; family records clearly indicated its invincibility.
Gongsun Zhi also used this trick to lure and kill many strong figures!
His perception was the Fish Net Array once executed, even top experts could only die with regrets!
Plus, without witnessing Ding Ling’s battlefield prowess, assumed Ding Ling’s strength was within human limits.
As long as he’s human, Fish Net Array could kill!
But he didn’t know Ding Ling had reached Grandmaster Realm, with Fusion Qi activating, crushing gold and stones was no problem.
The trivial Fish Net Array?
How could it trap him?
Now, Gongsun Zhi realized, but it was too late, Ding Ling wouldn’t give him a second chance.
His regret and remorse needn’t be mentioned.
Now facing Ding Ling’s sword, he could only nervously and timidly say the heart method mantra while demonstrating.
Initially.
He first taught Ding Ling Iron Palm Technique, an extremely difficult technique he learned from Iron Palm Lotus Qiu Qianchi.
Very hard to learn.
He slightly altered a few characters, attempting to pass off.
But could Ding Ling’s cheats allow him to do so?

chapters.title: Chapter 485: Iron Palm Full Level! Farewell, Yinkexi
paragraphs: Noticed the mantra was fake.
Ding Ling, furious, struck with his sword.
Puff!

One of Gongsun Zhi’s ears was sliced off. The sword was so fast that at first, he didn’t feel it. When a wave of sharp pain hit, he couldn’t help but let out a scream, covering his ear, and looked at Ding Ling with a face full of grief and indignation:
"Prince, you, you..."
"Try deceiving me again, and see if I won’t tear you to pieces,"
Ding Ling said coldly.

Gongsun Zhi’s breath hitched, instinctively feeling guilty, and momentarily forgot to question further, just feeling bewildered. He had only changed a few words in the whole mantra technique, how did Ding Ling notice?!
This was too incredible.
Could it be that Ding Ling was just testing him?
That’s what he thought, but no matter what, he dared not gamble with his life anymore. After stopping the bleeding with a seal, he practiced honestly again.
Before long.
[Iron Palm Inner Power Heart Method Full Level]
[Iron Palm External Skill Full Level]

After reaching full level in Iron Palm, a unique and fierce Qi emerged, coursing through his limbs and bones. Although Ding Ling had already reached the pinnacle of this world and couldn’t enhance his inner strength and True Qi anymore,
this full level of Iron Palm still somewhat enhanced his meridians and such.
Especially his palms.

Ding Ling slightly flipped, and a dark aura faintly appeared on his hands. He struck the void with his palm, the clanging sound of gold and iron resonated and quivered through the space, persisting for a long time.
This was indeed an extremely fierce and sharp palm technique.
In some aspects, it was not inferior to Toad Skill at all.
Thinking about Qiu Qianren’s fame of Iron Palm Water Floating, one could understand a little.
In those years, Qiu Qianren relied entirely on this Iron Palm to dominate the Jianghu, rarely meeting a match in the martial arts world, it could be said to be extremely powerful!
Ding Ling reached full level in an instant, which stupefied Gongsun Zhi standing opposite.

He had been cultivating Iron Palm for years, yet still far from perfection, naturally understanding how difficult this palm technique was. To reach Great Perfection was nearly impossible unless one had extraordinary talent and devoted themselves to arduous study day and night for decades, perhaps achieving the pinnacle.
And Ding Ling?
He just said it and instantly achieved Great Perfection Innate Ability.
Is this really a human?!
"Continue."
Ding Ling looked at Gongsun Zhi.

Gongsun Zhi’s heart trembled in awe at Ding Ling, yet his soul increasingly quivered, obviously scared out of his wits. He grew even more regretful, knowing full well how terrifying Ding Ling was, no, he knew how terrifying Ding Ling was!
Unfortunately, he was overly confident in his Fish Net Array!
Indeed...
He was just a frog in a well, shallow and overly self-confident!
"Won’t you speak?"
Ding Ling’s voice came through.
Gongsun Zhi instinctively became afraid, immediately opened his mouth, and continued to speak the mantra technique, practicing the moves carefully on the side.
This time.
He was more obedient and dared not mess around recklessly.

At this point, he understood thoroughly. Ding Ling could cultivate Iron Palm, such a divine skill, to Great Perfection in an instant, so naturally, he could see through the authenticity of the heart technique quickly.
After some time.
[Yin Yang Inversion Blade Technique Full Level]
[Sealing Skill Full Level]
[Heartless Inner Power Skill Full Level]
Altogether three techniques.
All extremely top-tier.

After mastering the Yin Yang Inversion Blade Technique to Great Perfection, one could perfectly transform a saber into a sword, a sword into a saber, using saber techniques with a sword and sword techniques with a saber naturally and flawlessly, making it impossible for others to fend off!
Sealing Skill was even more remarkable.
Before Great Perfection, one couldn’t consume any animal products, or the effort of decades could be broken instantly, making it an exceedingly difficult skill to master.
But after Great Perfection, there was no such worry.
Once Great Perfection is achieved, one can control and seal the acupoints freely, rendering enemy techniques like acupoint sealing ineffective!
With this skill, there’s no need to worry about sudden sneak acupoint attacks.

As for the Valley of Heartless’s Inner Power Heart Technique, it’s also a first-class true skill. After reaching full level, a strand of vigorous Qi traversed through his meridian Dantian, greatly enhancing Ding Ling’s foundation.
Ding Ling glanced at the Martial Arts Melting Furnace.
With the infusion of these few heart techniques,
it seemed like quantitative change led to qualitative change.
The visibly clear top cover of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace suddenly became solid, looking incredibly real and no longer having a sense of illusion!
"Is this... the Martial Arts Melting Furnace successfully manifested?!"
Ding Ling was overjoyed in his heart.
But thinking it was only a cover,
the rest of the furnace body and three legs had not manifested either. He could only steady himself, preparing to continue collecting various secret manuals, skills, and martial arts.
"Is there anything else besides these?"
Ding Ling looked at Gongsun Zhi.
Gongsun Zhi was completely stunned; his entire heart was overwhelmed by raging waves. He truly did not expect that the prince before him was actually a Martial Dao God!
Any martial arts technique he hears, he can master it to Great Perfection in an instant!
This can only be described as Ding Ling being a god.
Gongsun Zhi couldn’t think of a better comparison or vocabulary than this.
"Also."
Gongsun Zhi grew increasingly respectful and awed towards Ding Ling, and said with utmost reverence:

"My talent is limited, my aptitude is dull, so I dare not learn too many Kung Fu skills. However, there are quite a few martial arts books hidden in the Valley of Heartless. If the prince is interested, you can take a step to have a look."
"Lead the way."
’Yes, Prince!’
Gongsun Zhi picked up his severed ear and guided the way, not daring to look at Little Dragon Girl again for fear of provoking Ding Ling to slash at him with his sword once more.
[Achievement Medal earned: Astonished Gongsun Zhi]

[Note: Gongsun Zhi is despicable and licentious! He is heartless and selfish! He never knows what fear is, even if he did fear at one moment, he would find an opportunity later to retaliate. You are the only one who temporarily made him unable to see the dawn of victory.
But he won’t give up just like that; he might use Love Flower against you and Little Dragon Girl.]
Seeing this.
Ding Ling’s eyebrows slightly raised, and in his heart, he had already sentenced Gongsun Zhi to death.
If it weren’t for needing him to lead the way.
How could Ding Ling spare him?
He conveniently glanced at the character panel:
[E-level Achievement Medal earned: You gained Zhou Botong’s high recognition.]

[Note: Zhou Botong was completely won over by your Martial Dao talent, and attracted by your various astonishing martial arts. After you taught him the Breathing Technique, his favorability towards you skyrocketed.]
[Achievement Medal earned: You gained Lu Wushuang’s deep recognition.]
[Achievement Medal earned: You gained Hong Lingbo’s deep recognition.]
These are the achievement medals earned in the past two days.
Zhou Botong is an Innate Expert, undoubtedly.
Moreover, he focuses wholeheartedly on Martial Dao, practicing martial arts every day, and his passion for Martial Dao far exceeds Guo Jing.
Guo Jing, being devoted to his country and people, is defending Xiangyang, and now has to manage national affairs, thus lacks the time to focus on martial arts every day.
That Zhou Botong’s martial arts surpass Guo Jing in this world’s definition seems to make sense.
Upon entering the Valley of Heartless.
Ding Ling found the disciples here very fearful and wary of Gongsun Zhi. It seemed that to avoid suspicion, they would take a detour whenever they saw him.
Gongsun Zhi’s face looked very unpleasant, but with Ding Ling beside him, he didn’t dare to speak much.
He only continued to smile sheepishly along the way.
Upon Ding Ling’s inquiry about the reason.
He didn’t dare to lie, only said:

"Aliens joined forces with several martial arts experts to rescue that vile woman Qiu Qianchi, and suddenly they joined together to drive me out of the valley. Caught off guard, I wasn’t their opponent, so I had to retreat temporarily. I was prepared to come back for revenge, but unexpectedly, ran into you, Prince."
Gongsun Zhi wore a dejected expression, the words ’Laozi is very unlucky’ were carved on his face and eyes.
Ding Ling ignored him.
Gongsun Zhi didn’t dare to express more.
Only when leading Ding Ling to a mountain villa, several sturdy Great Han men holding weapons appeared at the entrance:
"Private territory, proceed with caution."
Before Ding Ling could speak.

Gongsun Zhi was already enraged and charged forward, wielding a saber in one hand and a sword in the other, performing the Yin Yang Inversion Blade Technique. Amidst the sounds of sword and saber clashing, several Great Han men had already fallen into pools of blood.
After killing them.
Gongsun Zhi suddenly realized, and hurriedly looked at Ding Ling with fear and trepidation, saying:
"Prince, I, I..."
"Enough."
Ding Ling waved his hand: "Let’s go."
But after walking a few steps.
A pretty and beautiful young girl who resembled a fine jade pushed a two-wheeled cart out.
On the two-wheeled cart was an elderly woman with sparse hair, vicious face, and was unbearable to look at directly.
Ding Ling, having grown this much, had never seen such an ugly woman, momentarily, couldn’t help but glance sideways.
This elderly woman slumped in the wheelchair, looked menacingly at Gongsun Zhi and Ding Ling’s group, grinned and said:
"Gongsun Zhi, you vile person, don’t think that by finding a few helpers, you can do anything to me. You’re not the only one with helpers; I have them too."
She coughed a few times.
A group of people emerged from behind her.
This group contained old and young, men and women.
Among them, Ding Ling recognized two, none other than Ma Guangzuo and Yinkexi.
These two, upon seeing Ding Ling, were so frightened that their legs went weak, and without another word, they knelt on the ground, performing a grand gesture of obeisance:
"Commoner Ma Guangzuo (Yinkexi) pays respects to the prince!"

chapters.title: Chapter 486: Gentleman and Lady Sword
paragraphs: "Prince?!"
The old woman was stunned, looking Ding Ling up and down:
"Where are you a prince from?"
"Mother."

The beautiful girl, seeing the group of extraordinary people behind her following Yinkexi and Ma Guangzuo in kneeling, was also taken aback. Suddenly, she seemed to remember something, her heart greatly moved, and couldn’t help but carefully scrutinize Ding Ling twice before whispering to the old woman:
"If I’m not mistaken, the visitor should be the First-Rank Prince of the Great Ming Dynasty, the Jiuzhou War God who single-handedly toppled the Mongol Kingdom!"
"What?!"
The old woman changed color, somewhat unable to believe there could be such a person in the world:
"The Mongol Kingdom, what a formidable and great nation, how could it be overthrown by one person. What does he rely on?"
"He relies on his personal martial power!"
The beautiful girl, seeing the old woman speaking unabashedly and loudly, felt quite embarrassed:
"Mother, with the prince present, we should pay our respects first."
"Humph."
The old woman snorted but considering the strength of Mongolia, if her daughter wasn’t mistaken, the frightening ability of the person before them must be beyond imagination.
She was not a foolish person, so she swallowed her dissatisfaction and nodded towards Ding Ling as a gesture of respect.
The beautiful girl, however, followed Yinkexi and the others in kneeling to pay homage.
The old woman was both angry and further convinced of one thing: the young man before them must be extraordinary!
She understood that Gui Xinshu, Yinkexi, and others were fearless martial heroes, not afraid to kill even if an emperor traveled incognito.
But now, upon seeing Ding Ling, their faces turned pale, and their bodies trembled, clearly terrified.
The old woman became more apprehensive, realizing she dared not confront Ding Ling aggressively, lowering herself, she said:
"I didn’t know the prince was visiting. I’m unable to stand due to crippled limbs. I beg the prince’s pardon."
"Enough."
Ding Ling waved his hand:
"Rise, all of you."
"Thank you, Prince."
Yinkexi and the others wiped the cold sweat from their foreheads, standing obediently to one side, not daring to move.
Oh heavens.
They had hidden in the remote Valley of Heartless.
Who knew they would meet Ding Ling, the bringer of death!
It’s terrifying!
Ding Ling didn’t care how these people saw or thought of him, instead signaling Gongsun Zhi with his eyes, who immediately nodded and deferentially led Ding Ling forward.
The old woman saw Ding Ling had no intention of talking much with her, merely letting Gongsun Zhi lead the way, filled with rage and hatred!

Already strong-willed, after over a decade in the endless darkness of the Earth Realm, her temperament became increasingly peculiar, extreme, and venomous. Ding Ling’s lack of conversation was taken as provocation and insult!
She felt Ding Ling was despising and ignoring her!
Moreover, Ding Ling had dealings with Gongsun Zhi.
Thinking Ding Ling was a prince of the Great Ming Dynasty, she asked the beautiful girl about Great Ming.

Upon hearing the beautiful girl say that Huang Rong was the empress and Guo Jing the emperor of the Great Ming Dynasty, a murderous rage surged within her! Her hatred and intent to kill Ding Ling rose sharply.
Watching Ding Ling’s retreating figure, she thought:

"Huang Rong and I share an unending blood feud; I cannot let it go unavenged! That Gongsun Zhi dog villain ruined my life. If I don’t kill them, I, Qiu Qianchi, swear I am not human. Since this Ding Ling is an accomplice to Huang Rong and Guo Jing, their top general, I’ll kill him first!"
Faced with the formidable Ding Ling.
Blinded by anger, hatred, and a desire for revenge, Qiu Qianchi felt no fear and made a plan, calling the beautiful girl over to give instructions.
The beautiful girl, distressed and sorrowful, reluctant to go through with it, was scolded by Qiu Qianchi:
"If you dare disobey, then don’t call yourself my daughter!"
The beautiful girl trembled but still refused to comply.
Qiu Qianchi, trembling with rage, finally called a disciple to complete the task.
Ding Ling was reading in the library of the Valley of Heartless.
This library occupied a vast area!
The bookshelves were densely packed, at least over a hundred.
Although many books Ding Ling had already read, there were plenty of rare secret manuals.
Ding Ling quickly flipped through them.
One by one, all to the full level.
The Furnace Body of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace was beginning to show substantial transformation.
Ding Ling nodded silently, realizing that to fully materialize the Furnace Body, more secret manuals would be needed.
After finishing all the secret manuals from this world and adding those from previous worlds,
the Martial Arts Melting Furnace clearly manifested, condensing and bursting forth with a top cover.
But to completely condense the Furnace Body, Ding Ling estimated it would take tens or hundreds of thousands of secret manuals.
Though there were many secret manuals here,
there were probably only a few thousand left that he hadn’t seen. That’s a generous estimate.
Still, better than nothing, going through these few thousand also provided substantial foundation, potentially increasing progress by 1%.
The progress of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace is not listed.
But Ding Ling could vaguely sense the level of progress.
He stayed in the library, immersing himself in books.
He read for an entire day and night.
Only upon finishing, it did the Furnace Body’s progress increase by about 1%.
The implication was clear; he needed to visit 99 more libraries like this.
Ding Ling’s eye twitched twice, increasingly determined that upon the next ascension, he must unite Jiuzhou and gather Jiuzhou’s secret manuals to enrich himself!
Otherwise, relying on himself to search would consume unimaginable time and effort.
"Prince, this is the Gentleman and Lady Sword."
Gongsun Zhi, who had been waiting nearby, saw Ding Ling finish with the secret manuals and immediately brought out the family’s two Divine Weapons.
Ding Ling took them.
Examined carefully.
The swords were of excellent material, though the material was unknown, they were quite heavy.
Ding Ling grasped the hilt, unsheathed the sword, and a burst of cold struck, making the room feel like a frosty day.
Ding Ling secretly marveled, focusing his gaze.

The Treasure Sword’s blade was pitch black, without a hint of gloss, resembling a piece of ebony. Drawing the other sword, it was the same; both had rounded tips and blunt edges, no sharp blade, but when Ding Ling infused a bit of Fusion Qi, he found the Gentleman’s Sword was exceptionally compatible with it. A slight swing.
A stream of Qi shot from the blade, thwack!
Effortlessly cutting a small crack on the ground.
"Good sword!"
Ding Ling praised.
Though unaware of the material, its hardness and high compatibility with Fusion Qi led Ding Ling to conclude that the Treasure Sword was indeed a precious artifact!
In future cultivation, this Treasure Sword might even be used as a flying sword.
Of course, what the future holds is uncertain.

But it was the first time Ding Ling encountered such a sword compatible with Fusion Qi, naturally, he was fond of it and immediately wore the Gentleman’s Sword on his waist, giving the Lady’s Sword to the Little Dragon Girl.
Having one such sword was enough, as using both simultaneously would cause them to magnetically attract each other, which was inconvenient.
Thus, one sword per person was perfect.

The Little Dragon Girl had been watching intently from the side, seeing the swords as a pair, one gentleman, one lady. With Ding Ling taking the Gentleman’s Sword and giving her the Lady’s Sword, the intention was obvious.
Her heart involuntarily filled with sweetness.
"Let’s go."
What needed to be obtained in the Valley of Heartless was already acquired.
There was no longer any need for Ding Ling to stay.
