chapters.title: Chapter 487: Gongsun Lu’e
paragraphs: Ding Ling grabbed Little Dragon Girl’s hand and was about to leave the library.
However, before reaching the door, they saw piles of Love Flowers stacked everywhere in the corridor and at the entrance.
These Love Flowers piled up to the ceiling, as high as a mountain, completely blocking the exit. Ding Ling also noticed that the air was filled with a toxic gas.

He, with the Nine Yang Divine Skill, was impervious to all poisons, and having consumed the Five Immortals Rejuvenating Wine, plus possessing the Medicine King Breathing Technique, Qingnang Scripture, Medical Saint Breathing Technique, could say that ordinary poisons couldn’t harm him.
But Little Dragon Girl didn’t have the same fortune and encounters as Ding Ling; upon smelling the toxic air, she felt dizzy and grabbed onto Ding Ling’s shirt.
Ding Ling, filled with rage, looked at Gongsun Zhi and saw that he had the same expression as Little Dragon Girl, realizing that someone else was behind this scheme.
He was indeed puzzled. Everyone knew he was a Prince of the Great Ming Dynasty!
The one who could overthrow the Mongol Kingdom single-handedly.
Yet they still dared to act against him?
Were they fed up with life?

Ding Ling swiftly drew the Gentleman’s Sword from his waist, channeled all his strength into it, and unleashed the Dugu Nine Swords, producing sword shadows that filled the void, slashing through obstacles like cutting thorns and brambles, and akin to a sea god parting the waves. In a few swift moves, he cut open a large breach in the blockade of Love Flowers.
"Go."
Ding Ling gestured for Gongsun Zhi to lead the way.
Gongsun Zhi was terrified but dared not resist, only clutched his knife and sword tightly, gathered his energy, and charged forward.
Ding Ling followed closely behind.
Just as they dashed out of the door.
They saw teams of Valley of Heartless disciples holding some peculiar weapons.
Somewhat akin to Heavy Rain Pear Blossom Needles.
At the moment they saw Gongsun Zhi and Ding Ling.
Accompanied by a rough, ear-piercing shout, "Fire!"
Swish, swish, swish!

The Valley of Heartless disciples simultaneously raised their weapons, and soon, amidst Gongsun Zhi’s overwhelming fear, a barrage of "flying needles" poured down upon Ding Ling and Gongsun Zhi’s location.
Ding Ling, protected by Divine Skill, could ignore these flying needles, but Little Dragon Girl could not.

He shielded Little Dragon Girl behind him, wielding the Gentleman’s Sword, effortlessly employing various sword skills to create an impenetrable defense, ensuring that neither water nor needles could pass through.
Little Dragon Girl also remained unscathed within this defensive circle.
"Fire!"
"Shoot them!"
The hoarse, piercing voice echoed continuously.
Following the voice, Ding Ling saw an old woman in a wheelchair looking fiercely at him, her eyes filled with intense malice.
"Mother!"
The beautiful girl behind the old woman looked at her in disbelief:
"You, you killed Father.
Gongsun Zhi, covered entirely by "flying needles," had already collapsed lifeless on the ground.
Ding Ling saw it clearly.
Gongsun Zhi’s face was an ashen green, his pupils dilated and lifeless, clearly poisoned to death.
Needless to say,
these flying needles must have been coated with venom, very likely a mix of poisons! This was a place full of Love Flowers; these needles were probably poisoned with Love Flower toxic!
Thinking of this.
Seeing the endless barrage of flying needles from his opponents, Ding Ling was infuriated.
He immediately wrapped his arm around Little Dragon Girl’s slender waist, while gesturing for her to hold on tight, and wielding the Gentleman’s Sword, charged out.
Spiral Nine Shadows!

Driven by Fusion Qi, Ding Ling transformed into nine shadows, and with a leap, advanced thirty meters, effortlessly confronting a group of disciples, then his hand moved as swiftly as lightning, swish, swish!
Sword light flashed through the void, accompanied by muffled groans, and upon looking again, a dozen people had already fallen to the ground.

Ding Ling moved swiftly through the courtyard, his feet barely touching the ground, with nine shadows separating and converging in all directions, appearing as if nine people were striking simultaneously.
In less than two breaths.
All fifty to sixty elite disciples of the Valley of Heartless were killed.
Swish!

After slaying everyone, Ding Ling, with a natural motion, flung his Gentleman’s Sword, piercing the old woman’s heart. The sword went through her chest, protruding from her back, but Ding Ling, with a gesture, exerted a force that locked the sword’s blade, and the Gentleman’s Sword spun in the air, flinging away blood droplets and stains, returning to Ding Ling’s hand as smoothly as if it were a freshly forged Treasure Sword.
It remained spotless.
[Achievement Medal: You Intimidated Qiu Qianchi.]

[Note: Qiu Qianchi accurately predicted that you would stay in the library for at least one day. Thus, she decisively launched a new plan. She trapped the door with a massive quantity of Love Flowers. Then, she began releasing poison mists mixed with Love Flower toxin and attempted to use Bone-Dissolving Powder and other toxic liquids on flying needles to kill you and Gongsun Zhi!
These three,
connected steps.
To Qiu Qianchi, even ten masters like her brother Qiu Qianren couldn’t withstand this. And, no matter how formidable you are, it’s impossible to surpass ten Qiu Qianrens.
But the truth is, her assumptions were entirely wrong! She died in shock, disbelief, and resentment, cursing you to the end.]
[Achievement Medal: You Intimidated Gongsun Lu’e.]
[Note: Witnessing her parents’ tragic deaths before her eyes, Gongsun Lu’e was overwhelmed with grief and sadness. Toward you, her admiration mixed with a few complex emotions.]
Seeing this, Ding Ling couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows slightly.
He glanced at the kneeling beautiful girl, holding the old woman, tears streaming from her eyes.
Needless to say,
This girl must be Gongsun Lu’e.
He had previously guessed this.
But now,
He had nothing more to say; he held Little Dragon Girl, and with a powerful leap, like a Flying Cloud Arrow soaring through the air, disappeared from the scene in the blink of an eye.
Gongsun Lu’e, in a brief moment, lost both parents, nearly fainted from sobbing.
"Father, Mother..."
Gongsun Lu’e looked in the direction where Ding Ling vanished, filled with confusion and incomprehension:
"Why did you provoke the Prince of all people?!"
She had tried to persuade Qiu Qianchi.
But Qiu Qianchi was stubborn, and whenever she insisted too much, she would end up scolded.
Reflecting on how chaotic and unpeaceful their home had been recently,
Gongsun Lu’e, holding back her sorrow, called Fan Yiweng and said:
"Once we’ve taken care of my parents’ funeral, let’s seal off the Valley of Heartless and cut off all contact with the outside world."
Fan Yiweng hesitated for a moment, then nodded:
"From today on, Miss, you are the Valley Master of the Valley of Heartless. You call the shots. I will follow your lead."
Gongsun Lu’e sighed deeply:
"I have no interest in being the Valley Master, but there are so many sisters in the Valley of Heartless. I do not wish for my actions to drag them back into the blood-soaked Jianghu."
We should withdraw from Jianghu and live in seclusion forever."
Ding Ling was unaware of the subsequent events of the Valley of Heartless.
But in the original history, Gongsun Lu’e died due to the internal struggle between Gongsun Zhi and Qiu Qianchi.
Judging by Gongsun Zhi’s aggressive and prepared demeanor earlier,
it’s likely that if their conflict continued, the outcome would not have been favorable.
Most probably, it would have resulted in a mutual destruction, and Gongsun Lu’e, caught in between, would have died tragically.
Her nature destined her for such a fate.
Now, Ding Ling inadvertently spared Gongsun Lu’e from this deadly ordeal by eliminating these two sinister figures.
Gongsun Lu’e remained unaware of this.
Only when Ma Guangzuo and others reminded her did she realize.
However, expecting her to have fond feelings toward Ding Ling? Gratitude?
It’s extremely difficult.
Ding Ling didn’t concern himself further with the affairs of the Valley of Heartless.
After leaving the Valley of Heartless,
he performed Lightweight Skill, swiftly flying back to Xiangyang.

chapters.title: Chapter 488: Yang Guo Arrives! Huang Rong’s Proposal
paragraphs: The task has been completed.
However, Little Dragon Girl and he were both poisoned by the toxic miasma of the Love Flower.
Ding Ling’s medical skills were unparalleled at the time.
Now his medical expertise is a fusion of the essences from several worlds!
Along with the Medicine King Breathing Technique, Medical Saint Breathing Technique, Qingnang Scripture, and other aids.
Knowing that the Poisonous Plant could detoxify, Ding Ling took merely three days to create the Heartless Pill, perfectly dissolving the poison affecting both himself and Little Dragon Girl.
With the Heartless Pill.
Ding Ling gave the pill formula to Little Dragon Girl for future emergencies.
As for why the Love Flower has toxic miasma?

It should be asked of the Ascenders and player groups. These people meddle in the Valley of Heartless, creating the Heavy Rain Pear Blossom Needle, and naturally, using the abundant Love Flowers to craft some toxic miasmas and poison smoke follows logically.
[Congratulations Player Ding Ling, you have completed all tasks on the Path of the Glory War God!]
[Task over-achieved! Would you like to redeem the Glory Medal now? Proceed to a higher-level Martial Hero Plane World?]
Ding Ling looked at the character panel.
He thought for a moment.
Yet still did not click confirm.
Because the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill was not yet in hand!

This Esoteric Sect is indeed representative of obstinate bravery, not only ignoring Huang Rong’s commands but also directly beheading the Dynasty Envoy sent there, such daring; who knows what they rely upon?
"If Hoduo and Yuwen Chengdu can’t handle it, I’ll personally make a trip to the Esoteric Sect."
Ding Ling stood with hands behind his back, glanced toward the West, then turned around to accompany Little Dragon Girl.
Little Dragon Girl has the Cold Jade Bed, Great Medicine, Pusique Snake’s snake gall, and other aids.
With Ding Ling as a Grandmaster to guide her.
She, naturally gifted and single-minded, progressed smoothly in her cultivation.
Ding Ling, seeing Little Dragon Girl’s continuous progress and growth, felt quite gratified in his heart.
On this day.
Someone reported that Yang Guo had arrived.
Ding Ling rejoiced inwardly and asked for Yang Guo to be brought in.
Yang Guo was subsequently led to meet Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl.
His expression was dazed, and upon seeing Little Dragon Girl and Ding Ling, he appeared stunned and disbelief.
"Is this true?!"
"What?"
Ding Ling asked with a smile.
It’s been a long time since seeing Yang Guo.
Upon seeing him again.
Ding Ling noticed he had matured quite a bit and his powers had deepened considerably.
Presumably, he’s undergone some extraordinary encounters.
"D-Ding Ling, y-you really became the First-Rank Prince of the Great Ming Dynasty?! And was titled as King of Qi?!"
Yang Guo’s mouth gaped, his eyes and face etched with shock:
"My Uncle Guo could ascend to the Emperor’s Seat, also because of you?!"
"You already have the answer in your heart, don’t you?"
Ding Ling replied, smiling.
"Moreover..."
Yang Guo swallowed hard:
"You and Aunt..."
"Indeed."
Little Dragon Girl interrupted Yang Guo, nodding:

"Guo’Er, you really came at the right time. I promised Granny Sun to take good care of you for a lifetime. From now on, stay in the Prince’s Mansion, don’t go anywhere else. Focus on cultivating martial arts and techniques. Someday with skills achieved, equipped to protect yourself, both your uncle and I will be at ease."
"Uncle..."

Yang Guo’s teeth showed as he grinned, viewing Ding Ling as a hero idol, suddenly realizing the idol had become a relative, such a fiercely emotional tide was to be expected, but quickly followed by sheer joy, excitement, and elation.
Having a hero idol become a relative!
What could be more joyous than that?!
Yang Guo was no exception.
He suppressed the joy in his heart and began exchanging conversations with Little Dragon Girl and Ding Ling.
After mutual exchange of information.

Though Yang Guo had long learned the general conditions from the mouths of various martial arts heroes, upon receiving the detailed specifics from Little Dragon Girl, with her face filled with pride and honor, he was still significantly shaken.
"Uncle, Uncle really single-handedly overturned the Mongol Kingdom?!"
"Naturally, it’s true."
Little Dragon Girl’s gaze was full of love as she looked at Ding Ling, and when speaking to Yang Guo, there was a touch of pride and more joy and honor:
"Your Uncle is unrivaled in the world, incomparable by anyone. Him achieving it isn’t surprising at all."
Yang Guo was rendered speechless, looking to the heavens.
To have achieved such a defiant feat yet still considered not surprising?!
As expected of his ever serene Aunt!
"Did you know your godfather nearly harmed your Aunt?"
Ding Ling said calmly:
"I hope a similar incident won’t happen next time, otherwise, I won’t be lenient!"
Yang Guo still feeling fear, hurriedly apologized, saying his godfather Ouyang Feng was mad and lost in mind, not to be bothered with a crazed elder.
Ding Ling remained silent.
Little Dragon Girl was someone easy to talk to. Upon hearing Yang Guo say this, she immediately said to let the matter drop.

Yang Guo heaved a sigh of relief, but seeing Ding Ling’s silence, his heart couldn’t help but skip a beat. He immediately raised his hand to swear that if such a thing happened again, he would never forgive himself! Without needing Uncle to say anything, he would punish himself! Or even perish together with the one who harmed Aunt!
"Perishing together is not necessary."
Ding Ling gave Yang Guo a deep look, rose to his full height, and said:
"Your aunt promised Granny Sun to take good care of you for a lifetime. You don’t want your aunt to break her promise, do you? Train well, don’t run around. In addition..."
Ding Ling took out three secret manuals and gave them to Yang Guo:

"Here are two top-level breathing techniques, one internal and one external. There’s also the Nine Yin Scripture. Once you learn them, you’ll be able to surpass your godfather. Learn well, ask me if you don’t understand. I’ll be staying at the Prince’s Mansion for a while, but later it might not be certain."
Ding Ling admired Yang Guo’s character.
Moreover, since he was Little Dragon Girl’s disciple, he was essentially Ding Ling’s disciple, so teaching some widely known breathing techniques and the Nine Yin Scripture wasn’t a big deal.
"Yes. Thank you, Uncle."
Yang Guo was a smart person, quick to change his address appropriately.
And subsequently, he also showed Ding Ling the prowess of a genius.
Yang Guo was indeed a martial arts genius, grasping concepts immediately, learning quickly!
The fact that he could create such a top-tier palm technique like Desolate Soul-Devouring Palm showed this clearly.
Like Ding Ling?
He couldn’t create such things.
He himself felt lacking in creativity in this area.
But creating martial arts relates to wisdom, talent, bone structure, comprehension, among other factors.
Ding Ling happened to be mediocre in all these aspects.
What could he do?
He could only continue using cheats!
Among billions in the world, true martial arts geniuses are one in ten thousand, even one in a hundred thousand or a million!
Ding Ling was an ordinary member of the common crowd, as normal as could be.
But he was luckier than others.
He had the Divine Skill Automatic Full Level cheat!
Perhaps because both Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl were geniuses, Ding Ling’s role as a ’teacher’ instructing them was also very relaxed.
Moreover, the Prince’s Mansion was not short of Great Medicine, Snake Gall from Pusique Snake, and so on.
Both Yang Guo and Little Dragon Girl progressed by leaps and bounds.
On this day.
News came from the Imperial Palace.
Guo Xiang’s hundred-day banquet had arrived.
Ding Ling was invited to attend.
He went together with Little Dragon Girl and Yang Guo.
Because this hundred-day banquet was a family gathering.
So although many people were invited, they were all close ones.
Guo Jing and Huang Rong, rarely putting aside their imperial demeanor, relaxed and chatted with Little Dragon Girl and Ding Ling.
Talking about Yang Guo and Guo Fu.
The Guo Jing couple still wished to make a match between the two.
Ding Ling glanced at Yang Guo and Guo Fu, seeing them exchange glances, his eye twitched but he said nothing.
Before he traveled through time.
He had read many online comments.

Many netizens said Little Dragon Girl died, with reasons of all sorts. And the reason Guo Xiang couldn’t find Yang Guo was probably because Yang Guo married Guo Fu, so he deliberately hid from Guo Xiang.
Otherwise, there’s no reason not to meet this little sister, one meeting wouldn’t be fatal.
But avoiding.
Probably Guo Fu didn’t want to or was embarrassed to face Guo Xiang, knowing her sister loved Yang Guo deeply, yet snatched him away herself. How could she face Guo Xiang like this?
As for the specifics of reality?
Ding Ling was not sure, after all, these were just netizens’ speculations.
He just observed that after the two exchanged glances, they both snorted, involuntarily looked at him, feeling peculiar, thinking: Why are you looking at me? Looking at me, I can’t decide either.
Thinking this, Ding Ling then said:
"Let Guo Fu and Yang Guo handle this themselves. If they have no problem, I have no problem either."
Da and Xiao Wu also came.
Upon hearing this, they looked bitter.
After exchanging a glance, the brothers began pouring drinks for each other, drinking in silence.

Guo Fu was extremely conflicted in her heart, unknowingly having the shadow of Ding Ling there, especially as the Prince’s Mansion wasn’t far from where she lived, although Ding Ling was reclusive, she often visited with her mother, Huang Rong, so they met quite frequently.
Seeing much of Ding Ling’s overbearing aura and stature.
Hearing much of Ding Ling’s heroic deeds.
Moreover, Ding Ling particularly showed no color to her, treating her very differently from others.
Guo Fu’s girlish heart became increasingly strange and defiant.
In the past, others always pampered her, accommodated her, cherished her, loved her...
Ding Ling was the only one who didn’t indulge her, even ignored her.
A girl’s emotions are always poetic.
After repeatedly being impacted by Ding Ling’s actions, naturally, a shadow of Ding Ling occupied a corner of the girl’s heart.
But as for love?
Not necessarily.
Like?
Perhaps not even?
Guo Fu couldn’t understand herself, she just compared Ding Ling and Yang Guo after hearing her parents and Ding Ling’s remarks.
Instantly feeling that the extraordinary Yang Guo was far inferior to Ding Ling in every aspect.

chapters.title: Chapter 489: The End of the Divine Eagle World! Guo Xiang
paragraphs: Guo Fu was distressed. For a moment, she didn’t know what decision to make.
She couldn’t understand her own heart.
Just like she couldn’t understand why Ding Ling was so strong? So versatile!
And why would he ignore such a beautiful girl who was loved by everyone?!
"The words of the parents and the matchmaker. They’re all grown up, so they should listen to us."
Guo Jing made the decision directly:
"Just let them choose a day to get married."
Da and Xiao Wu seemed struck by lightning, their faces turned pale, almost fainting to the ground.
Yang Guo remained expressionless, his eyes darting around, but no one knew what he was thinking. However, judging from his non-opposition, it was clear he accepted the idea of marrying Guo Fu.
Guo Fu looked at Ding Ling, then at Yang Guo, and finally at Huang Rong and Guo Jing. She pursed her lips and said nothing.
She knew herself.
A perfect and flawless man like Ding Ling might be one of a kind in this world.
Comparing Yang Guo with Ding Ling was unfair to Yang Guo.
But she was unwilling.
Why could Little Dragon Girl marry such a perfect and remarkable hero like Ding Ling!
Yet Guo Fu couldn’t marry such a hero?!
After all,
It was still unwillingness, dissatisfaction, feeling suffocated, and having a heartache!
If Ding Ling had treated her a bit better, she might not have had such complex, tumultuous, distressed, and unwilling emotions.
Some daughters of heaven are like this: the more exceptional a person is, the more they ignore her, the more curious she becomes about them.

Without a doubt, Ding Ling was considered one of the most exceptional people in the world. Naturally, he would attract her attention and focus, leading to all kinds of complex emotions, like a flipped five-flavor bottle, with mixed feelings beyond words.
Of course, Ding Ling did not know that Guo Fu’s heart had already turned upside down.
He didn’t pay attention to Guo Fu either, because he didn’t like her; for things or people he didn’t like, Ding Ling generally chose to ignore them.
Thus, he didn’t notice the changes in Guo Fu’s expression.
He took the baby girl passed to him by Little Dragon Girl and looked down at her.
Her eyebrows were lovely, and her demeanor was beautiful. Although she was just a little girl not yet a hundred days old, it was evident that she would grow into an extremely beautiful lady.
"Yiya yiya."

The baby girl couldn’t speak yet, and she was looking at Ding Ling with her big, dark eyes full of curiosity. Seeing Ding Ling looking at her, she babbled "yiya yiya," reaching out her chubby white hand to grab Ding Ling’s chin, occasionally giggling.
"Do you like children?"
Little Dragon Girl’s cold eyes seemed shy but unblinkingly watched Ding Ling as she softly said:
"If you like, we can also have one."
Ding Ling shook his head, returning the baby to Little Dragon Girl:
"Let’s talk about having children later."
Having children.
Ding Ling was not considering it now.
What he thought about now was the matter of the Immortal Dao for immortality, not daring to want children before achieving immortality?!
"Is she the Guo Xiang?"
Yang Guo moved closer:
"She’s very cute."
"Yes. Her name is Guo Xiang. And the one being held in Lady Guo’s arms is named Guo Polu. They are twin siblings."

Guo Jing walked over. He had been Emperor for some time, and there was a faint overbearing aura about him, but he still remained gentle and generous as always. He smiled and patted Yang Guo on the shoulder:

"Guo’Er, your uncle-in-law truly is an extraordinary person. When Lady Guo was pregnant, we had already decided what to name the children. Guo Xiang and Guo Polu are related to Xiangyang and defeating Mongolia. We hope that after a hundred years, they can also inherit our wishes and continue the struggle.
But it seems unnecessary now.
Since these names were decided long ago, Lady Guo and I had no intention to change them.

We think it’s fine this way. Looking at the two of them, Lady Guo and I are reminded of who the founders of the Great Ming Dynasty were. They constantly remind and urge us not to fail our mission, not to fail the people, not to fail this Jiuzhou land, and not to fail your uncle-in-law’s great expectations for me!"
Guo Jing was evidently extremely respectful to Ding Ling.
The admiration, recognition, praise, and commendation in his words were evident to anyone who heard them.
Yang Guo was no exception. He felt quite proud, for this was his uncle-in-law!
Guo Xiang’s hundred-day banquet ended peacefully.
The second meeting between Ding Ling and Guo Xiang ended just as hastily.
Although the meeting time was longer than the first, it was still limited.
Time flew by.

Ding Ling finally received the news that Yuwen Chengdu and Hoduo led their army to break through the Esoteric Sect and occupied a large territory, raising the Great Ming Dynasty’s flag over the Western Plateau!
Shortly after he received the news,
Hoduo personally brought a batch of secret manuals to the Prince’s Mansion.
Among them was the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill that Ding Ling had been longing for.
Ding Ling glanced at Hoduo.
He was dusty and travel-worn, with a face full of fatigue, clearly having suffered many hardships along the way.
At this moment, he was browbeaten and obsequiously looking at Ding Ling, a far cry from his demeanor the first time they met.
Ding Ling paused, took the secret manual, and returned to his bedroom without looking back.
Hoduo stood there, somewhat at a loss, after a while, turned to Yang Guo, and said, "If the Prince or Queen has any instructions, feel free to call me in the front yard. I’m at your service anytime."
A sycophantic servant-like demeanor.
Yang Guo watched with disgust, but genuinely admired him in his heart. This was once a Mongolian Prince, and now, just to survive, he had even lost all dignity.

Among them was the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill that Ding Ling had been longing for.
Ding Ling glanced at Hoduo.
He was dusty and travel-worn, with a face full of fatigue, clearly having suffered many hardships along the way.
At this moment, he was browbeaten and obsequiously looking at Ding Ling, a far cry from his demeanor the first time they met.
Ding Ling paused, took the secret manual, and returned to his bedroom without looking back.
Hoduo stood there, somewhat at a loss, after a while, turned to Yang Guo, and said, "If the Prince or Queen has any instructions, feel free to call me in the front yard.
I’m at your service anytime."
A sycophantic servant-like demeanor.
Yang Guo watched with disgust, but genuinely admired him in his heart.
This was once a Mongolian Prince, and now, just to survive, he had even lost all dignity.

chapters.title: Chapter 490 - 489: The End of the Divine Eagle World! Guo Xiang_2
paragraphs: He didn’t say much, just nodded.
At the same time, he secretly admired Ding Ling in his heart.

He became even more aware of the law of the jungle in this world: "To realize that someone as powerful as uncle-in-law can indeed make the heroes helpless! To make a prince willingly act as a dog! It seems I must redouble my efforts, so as not to let down uncle-in-law’s and aunt’s high expectations!"
In the bedroom.
Ding Ling quickly flipped through the Secret Manuals.
There were at least a hundred books.
All were kung fu from the Esoteric Sect.
Many were first-class Techniques.
Ding Ling quickly finished reading them, and they all quickly reached Full Level.
What surprised him a bit was.
He saw the Divine Skill ’Flame Saber’ among them.
"Flame Saber also originates from the Esoteric Sect?"
There are several sects in the Western Plateau region.
The Esoteric Sect is also divided into several factions.
Perhaps the Flame Saber and Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill were obtained by different factions.
As for how they were obtained?
Yuwen Chengdu and other fierce generals led hundreds of thousands of Great Army there.

Just because Yuwen Chengdu and other top generals had all practiced the Breathing Technique and Inner Power, each of them possessed the explosive power of a five to tenfold increase, which ordinary Innate Experts could hardly withstand!
Not to mention there were hundreds of thousands of Great Army too.
The Esoteric Sect was broken down and defeated, and in order to survive, it seemed reasonable for them to offer the Secret Manuals.
Ding Ling read the secret letter.
He knew what Yuwen Chengdu and his party had done.
The Esoteric Sect was almost crippled!
In the end, to preserve the legacy and protect some elite young disciples of the Sect, some sensible elders of the Esoteric Sect surrendered and voluntarily handed over the Secret Manuals.
Of course, they could have chosen mutual destruction.
But obviously.
They didn’t do so.
Ding Ling didn’t ask about the specific process, he only wanted the result.
Now it seems that Hoduo and Yuwen Chengdu did quite well.
Ding Ling quickly flipped through one Secret Manual after another.
[Great Hand Seal Full Level]
[Flame Saber Full Level]
[Flaming Saber Internal Power Heart Method Full Level]
All were read to Full Level.

Ding Ling flipped with his left hand, while his right hand continuously practiced various moves in the void, occasionally manifesting a Yin Yang Grinding Disc, at other times shooting out a Flame Saber over three feet.
The Flame Saber was almost tangible.
More refined, domineering, and fierce compared to the fire manifested by the Burning Wood Saber Technique!
The fire of the Burning Wood Saber Technique was more gentle, pure, and easier to control.
The Flame Saber, however, was not.
If one was not cautious, it could injure the internal organs and meridians.
The high difficulty of the practice could be well imagined.
Only at Full Level can one control it freely.
Now that Ding Ling reached Full Level, he could slash the Flame Saber Qi through the air, which was extraordinary.
"I wonder how this Flame Saber compares to the Six Meridian Divine Sword?
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows and continued reading.
Very soon, he finished all of it.
The progress bar on the Furnace Body of the Martial Arts Melting Furnace also increased a bit.
Ding Ling continued to read the last book, Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill.
Soon he finished it.
Ding Ling, however, showed no reaction.
He glanced at the library in his Sea of Consciousness.
He found that the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, like other Breathing Techniques that hadn’t integrated into his body and organs, was flashing with an uncertain light.
"It seems either my body doesn’t allow me to instantly reach Full Level with this Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill."
"Or this world doesn’t allow it."
Not denying other possibilities.
But for Ding Ling, these were the two most likely.

"But since it has been collected into the library, there’s no need to worry. In the future, whenever the time is right, I’ll surely reach Full Level instantly. I just wonder how strong I’ll become once this Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill reaches Full Level instantly?!"
Ding Ling was quite expectant.
This is a Divine Skill rumored to be practiced for thousands or tens of thousands of years!
And Ding Ling now has a foundation as deep as a mountain.
His Martial Dao knowledge is also quite extraordinary.
He carefully looked over the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill several times.
He discovered this Cultivation Technique.
Indeed, it became harder the further it went.
Especially the eleventh level!
The gap with the tenth level was like a Celestial Abyss! Almost impossible to cross!
If the first ten levels still had the possibility of being successfully practiced by ordinary people.
Then the eleventh level almost had no such possibility.
To be precise.
The gap between the tenth layer and the ninth layer is actually enormous, but not so exaggerated as a Celestial Abyss, so there is still a slight chance of mastering it!
As for the eleventh layer, it leaves no chance for mortals to succeed.
Not to mention the twelfth and thirteenth layers.
"Indeed, this is not a Kung Fu for mortals to cultivate."
Ding Ling felt relieved.

"However, for the Golden Wheel Dharma King to cultivate up to the tenth layer, it is definitely a phenomenal talent. Perhaps after practicing up to the tenth layer, he never fully unleashed the true power of this Divine Skill. Otherwise, with the full activation of the tenth layer’s power, it would be enough to dominate the world."
Ding Ling had seen this Divine Skill.
The high physical qualities of the tenth layer are already enough to be an insurmountable benchmark for ordinary people.
Coupled with this Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, which comes with an Inner Power Heart Method, once mastered, not only would physical qualities elevate, but Inner Strength would also be inexhaustible!
The gap between the tenth layer and eleventh layer is immense, like an insurmountable chasm, a Celestial Abyss!
If one were to successfully practice the eleventh layer, it would almost immediately reach the pinnacle of a Grandmaster, if not fully achieving it.
Ding Ling compared a little.
He couldn’t help but twitch his eyelids twice.
The eleventh layer is the pinnacle of a Grandmaster.
Then the twelfth layer, perhaps, is the ultimate peak of a Grandmaster.
And the thirteenth layer?!
No wonder the Golden Wheel Dharma King couldn’t cultivate the eleventh layer; the world’s limit is around the Initial Tier of a Grandmaster.
How could he possibly break the shackles of the world to reach the pinnacle of a Grandmaster?!
"Perhaps when I reach a suitable world, this Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill will instantly reach Full Level, achieving a state beyond imagination?"
Ding Ling was quite expectant.
What he hoped most now was that the next Plane World would be a High Martial World.
That way, the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill could instantly reach Full Level.
He could also gather more and stronger Cultivation Techniques.
"Having obtained the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill. It’s time to leave this world.
Ding Ling exhaled deeply.
He got up to talk with the Little Dragon Girl.
After explaining everything clearly.
Ding Ling took Little Dragon Girl, Yang Guo, and the others and flew swiftly to the outskirts of Chang’an City.
He glanced at the Little Dragon Girl, seeing her face full of reluctance, and sighed in his heart.
Without lingering, he turned to look at the Character Panel.
[Task over-completed! Redeem the Glory Medal now? Proceed to a higher Martial Hero Plane World?]
He clicked ’Yes’!
[Redemption successful!]
[Task 1. Defeat more than 20 Plane experts 130/20. Earn 1 Glory Medal. Glory Bonus 650%. Final Glory Medal around 7 pieces.]
Originally it was 125; subsequently, he defeated Zhou Botong, Gongsun Zhi, and Qiu Qianchi, making it 128.
Considering this Glory Medal calculation rounds up.
Ding Ling later defeated two more palace experts, making it 130.
This could be considered exploiting a loophole in the game.
[2. You must defeat the Plane’s strongest. Prove you are the World’s Number One in name and in fact. Progress 100%]
[Task 2. Earn 1 Glory Medal]
[3: You must let your name as the World’s Number One resound throughout the entire Plane World. 100%/100%]
[Task 3: Earn 1 Glory Medal]
Final total of Glory Medals earned: 9 pieces.
[Glory Medals settlement completed.]
[Open the Path of Glory now?]
Ding Ling clicked ’Yes’!
[The Path of Glory is about to open. Please select where to place the Path of Glory.]
[Friendly Reminder: The Path of Glory is a path connecting to the heavens...]
It was the same kind of notification message.
Ding Ling didn’t look much, selected directly, and clicked down.
[Confirm selecting the ancient pavilion outside Chang’an City?]
Confirm!
[Selection completed. Cannot be changed!]
Boom!
In the next instant.
Thunder roared. Dark clouds covered the sky!
Heaven and Earth were in disarray! Ice rivers descended! An overwhelming cold surge swept in, as if the world was entering an apocalypse at this moment.
"Familiar rhythm, familiar scene."
Ding Ling remained calm.
He was too familiar with such scenes.
At most, it was just the ’Special Effects’ turned up a bit.
You’ll get used to it!
Boom!
The Celestial Ladder broke through all darkness, ice rivers, and shock waves, descending with a rumble to Ding Ling’s feet.
Ding Ling took one last look at the Little Dragon Girl.
"Ding Ling."
The Little Dragon Girl stepped forward two steps, wanting to follow Ding Ling together.
But it seemed she was bounced back by the power of the Celestial Ladder.

chapters.title: Chapter 491 - 490: New World Choices! Root Aptitude Upgrade
paragraphs: It is obvious.
When Ding Ling ascended, he was not allowed to bring anyone along.
Ding Ling sighed deeply, but he was focused on the future. Considering the future, a temporary separation was necessary. He looked at the Little Dragon Girl and said:
"I’ve told you everything I needed to say. You should cultivate well. If all goes well, I will descend to the lower realm to find you again in the future!"
"Then, I’ll wait for you."
The Little Dragon Girl’s cold eyes slightly reddened, and her voice carried a slight tremor:
"Don’t forget, in this world, you also have a Queen. She’s still planning to have a child with you."
"I won’t forget."
Ding Ling took a deep breath and glanced at Yang Guo.
Yang Guo immediately stepped forward:
"Uncle."
"You should also cultivate well. Remember to strengthen the guards of the Prince’s Mansion. Don’t let any miscreants disturb your aunt’s cultivation and life."
"I will."
Yang Guo solemnly promised.
Ding Ling nodded, looked at the Little Dragon Girl one last time, and then stepped onto the Celestial Ladder.
Whoosh!
The Dharma Conch sounded, the Heavenly Dao chanted, amidst a sky full of golden flowers and flying rain.
A golden light shot through the void like a ribbon, wrapping around Ding Ling and whisking him away towards Heaven’s Edge, disappearing in an instant.
"Ding Ling..."
The Little Dragon Girl’s eyes became slightly misty.
This parting.
She didn’t know when she would see Ding Ling again.
But she would keep her promise.
She would wait for his return.
Even if it took until her youth had passed and her hair was all white, she would continue to wait.
She just hoped that time could come sooner.
After all...
She still remembered he liked children.
She wanted to have a child with him.
Ding Ling once again saw the Gate of Glory.
He proceeded as he had before.
Glancing at the character panel:
[Congratulations to player Ding Ling for being the first to clear the portal to the second layer of the Martial Hero Plane!]
[As the first to clear the second layer of the Martial Hero Plane, you will receive the following rewards:]
[1: A Martial Hero Plane World that only you can access!]
[2: An opportunity to return to the World of Divine Condor once.]
[3: The right to freely choose the third layer of the Martial Hero Plane! Note: Besides the first person to clear the Plane World, no one else gets this reward.]
[4: The ability to bring ascension items: four weapons, four sets of clothes, four mounts, four hundred taels of gold. Note: Other Ascenders can only bring one weapon and one set of clothes.]
Ding Ling was speechless.
As expected, the rewards were nearly identical.
He had grown somewhat accustomed to the patterns and rhythm of this game world.
This time, it was still just a small upgrade in rewards.
The weapons he chose: the Heaven-Swaying Sword, the Giant Que Sword, the Drumming Golden Hammer, the Gentleman’s Sword,
Fortunately, he was mentally prepared for this.
He had previously given the Divine Whip of Yuchi Gong, the short blade of Hai Dafu, and the jade flute given by Huang Rong to the Little Dragon Girl.
These three weapons were also Divine Weapons of immense value, but Ding Ling estimated he could only choose four weapons. As expected, he guessed right.
It’s almost like he’s exploiting a loophole in the game world, this rhythm was too familiar.
For clothes, he chose an Upper-Class Celestial Silkworm Treasure Armor, two sets of luxurious attire, and one set of white clothes.
For mounts, Ding Ling chose two Ferghana Horses.
Bringing two was sufficient.

Bringing too many seemed unnecessary to Ding Ling. He would bring the two Ferghana Horses because he had spent a long time with them and they had become familiar. These two horses were also quite intelligent and easy to care for.

Additionally, from novels and movies, Ding Ling knew that there seemed to be many rare Spiritual Treasures and Spiritual Objects in some worlds that only mounts could consume. If the horses were fed such things, they might become extremely powerful. He brought them just in case.
"It’s just that this time they awarded another Martial Hero Plane World. I’m going alone."
Ding Ling decided to explore it.
[Tip 1: The rewarded Plane World can only be accessed once. There’s no time limit. Because the player chose the Path of the Glory War God, the rewarded Plane World will also activate a quest list.]
[Tip 2: The rewarded Plane can be accessed at any time and place. Player Ding Ling, do you wish to enter the rewarded Martial Hero Plane World now?]
Ding Ling thought for a moment.
Still did not go.
Especially after seeing Tip 2.
He immediately had an idea:

"If I go to the Super God Worlds like Journey to the West or Divine Enthronement in the future and face powerful beings like Daluo Immortals or Quasi-Saints who can easily destroy the world, if I can’t defeat them, can I escape to these Plane Worlds?"
Ding Ling wasn’t sure if he could escape.
But since the rules of the game world were set that way, it seemed possible to escape.
No matter how powerful Daluo Immortals and Quasi-Saints are, they’re still part of the game world! So it should be fine.
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling’s spirits lifted.
If this really works.
Then it’s equivalent to having an extra life-saving card! He could escape anytime, anywhere, run when he couldn’t win, hide for a while, then come out again. Perfect!
"It seems this is the correct way to use the personal Plane World reward!"
Ding Ling nodded to himself.
He dismissed the prompt.
He didn’t want to use his personal reward Plane World yet; it would be better to save it for when he encounters a crisis in the future.
He continued to look further.
[Third layer of the Martial Hero Plane: Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, The Generation’s Twin Heroes, Celestial Dragon Eight Books. Please choose one of the three.]
Ding Ling was speechless.
He thought this layer would contain worlds like Fengyun or Great Tang Double Dragons, relatively higher-level martial worlds.
But as it turns out.
The world really follows step-by-step progression.
It goes without saying.
The world limits of the next layer are likely around Initial Tier Grandmaster.
The layer after that should be the Void Shattering Level.
Ding Ling was deep in thought.
Since the situation had reached this point.
Ding Ling could only think:
"Given my current combat power, if I cultivate a bit longer and improve a little more, I could definitely sweep through those worlds."
Ding Ling decided that after going to these worlds, he would increase his Four-dimensional Attributes and True Qi Attributes.
His goal, after all, was to increase his strength.
He could go to any world for that purpose.

However, he was relatively more inclined towards the Celestial Dragon Eight Books, because this world had Secret Manuals like the Six Meridian Divine Sword, North Nether Divine Skill, Small Faceless Skill, Eternal Youth Technique, and others.

These Secret Manuals were highly remarkable, and if the Martial Arts Melting Furnace were to manifest successfully in the future, absorbing their essence, it would surely give birth to an incredibly extraordinary Martial Arts Secret Manual!
[Choice completed. The choice cannot be changed.]
[Would you like to spend 10 Achievement Medals and 1 Glory Medal to open the Gate of Glory?]
[Note 1: Once the Gate of Glory is opened, it cannot be reversed.]
Yes!
At the moment of selection, accompanied by an ethereal sound brushing past the ear.
Eleven dazzling rays of light suddenly erupted from Ding Ling’s body.
Exactly the same as what happened in other worlds.
Ten silver light medals and one golden light medal combined into a strange array imprint, rotating and imprinting onto the Gate of Glory.
Crack!
The Gate of Glory opened.
In front of his eyes appeared three extremely familiar Heaven-Reaching Dao paths.
Suspended above the paths were golden words with dragons flying and phoenixes dancing.
From left to right, those golden words clearly read: Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, The Generation’s Twin Heroes, Celestial Dragon Eight Books
Ding Ling was rolled up by the golden light and dropped in front of the path belonging to the Celestial Dragon Eight Books.
Along with him were two Ferghana Horses.
"This process, these special effects, this rhythm is truly unchanged."
Ding Ling remained very calm.
The two Ferghana Horses seemed to have gone through several experiences and became particularly calm. They didn’t make any noise, just quietly standing beside Ding Ling.
[Player is about to enter the Plane World of the Celestial Dragon Eight Books.]
[Would you like to choose to exchange treasure before entering?]
’Yes.’
Zoom!
In just an instant, Ding Ling once again saw that familiar Seven-Colored Glazed Chaos Counter.
He walked forward for a look.
Sure enough.
No change compared to before.
"It seems other player contestants are really poor; none of them can afford these things."
Ding Ling pondered silently.
He was cheating, and even then, earning Glory Medals was this difficult. One can imagine how it is for other players.
Even if Achievement Medals were a bit easier.
But it seems still very hard to earn enough medals to buy these treasures, even if earned, they are used to exchange for strength to return to reality.
Generally, people would directly choose to exchange for strength rather than save to buy treasures!
Only Ding Ling, with plenty of medals, could use them to exchange for treasure.
He directly looked at the first counter.
’True First-Order Pill: 5 Glory Medals’
’True Second-Order Pill: 10 Glory Medals’
This time, his goal was clear.
He once again selected a True Second-Order Pill.
His current savings:
[Achievement Medals: Ordinary 145, E-level 23]
[Glory Medals: 12]
Originally had 13 Glory Medals. Opening the Gate of Glory consumed one.
Now, after buying the True Second-Order Pill.
Only two were left.
Looking at the pill in his hand, Ding Ling’s emotions were complex, returning once again to the era of the poor.
But when the old goes, the new comes.
Ding Ling also took it easily and directly swallowed the pill into his belly.
Whoosh!

A powerful special Dao Rhyme force tore through Ding Ling’s bones; just as he felt pain, a pure and vast restorative Qi appeared, washing over him, making him feel warm and comfortable, from head to toe.
After a moment.
Ding Ling felt something different about himself, as if he became lighter, as if he broke free from a shackle, becoming more in tune with the Heavenly Dao.
Ding Ling was secretly amazed.
He looked at the character panel.
[Root Bone +2]
[Root Bone 5]
Indeed.
This Second-Order Pill directly improved his Root Bone by 2 points!
Ding Ling was moved.
He knew very well how challenging it was for Root Bone to grow.
Yet just unknowingly, he had improved by 2 points in Root Bone; this True Second-Order Pill was truly extraordinary.
If second-order is like this, then what about third, fourth, ninth order?
If he were to consume these pills.
Could he become like Huang the Herbalist, Little Dragon Girl, these super geniuses?!
The thought was quite exciting.
"It seems I need to earn more Glory Medals."
Ding Ling felt very clear.
With Root Bone reaching 5.
He had thoroughly gotten rid of labels such as mediocrity and waste.

He felt an unspeakable sense of clarity! A sense of transparency! As if he had been carrying a heavy chain, bearing a mountain before, but now, the mountain was removed, feeling unspeakably relaxed and comfortable.
"Root Bone at 5 is already like this. I can’t imagine what talents with Root Bone at 10 or 20 would be like."
Ding Ling shook his head, continuing to exchange for a Storage Pouch.
Ding Ling still couldn’t afford a Tier Five Storage Pouch.
He could only buy a Tier Four one.
Spent 80 Ordinary Achievement Medals.
E-level Medals.
Savings sharply reduced.
Ding Ling’s eye twitched a couple of times.
Looking at the dingy Storage Pouch in his hand, he opened it with Inner Strength to inspect it.
Indeed, it was exactly the same as his first Storage Pouch, both around 8 cubic meters.
"Now with two Storage Pouches, it should barely be enough."
Ding Ling put the Storage Pouch into his embrace.
Turning, he stepped onto the Heaven-Reaching Dao leading to the Celestial Dragon Eight Books World.
[Player is about to enter the Celestial Dragon Eight Books Plane. Please prepare yourself.]
[Countdown.]
Boom!
Golden light like a drill, instantly lifted Ding Ling and the two Ferghana Horses, rolled to the end of the Dao, broke through a plane barrier, and sent them inside.

sentences.text: It is obvious.
When Ding Ling ascended, he was not allowed to bring anyone along.
Ding Ling sighed deeply, but he was focused on the future.
Considering the future, a temporary separation was necessary.
He looked at the Little Dragon Girl and said:
"I’ve told you everything I needed to say.
You should cultivate well.
If all goes well, I will descend to the lower realm to find you again in the future!"
"Then, I’ll wait for you."
The Little Dragon Girl’s cold eyes slightly reddened, and her voice carried a slight tremor:
"Don’t forget, in this world, you also have a Queen.
She’s still planning to have a child with you."
"I won’t forget."
Ding Ling took a deep breath and glanced at Yang Guo.
Yang Guo immediately stepped forward:
"Uncle."
"You should also cultivate well.
Remember to strengthen the guards of the Prince’s Mansion.
Don’t let any miscreants disturb your aunt’s cultivation and life."
"I will."
Yang Guo solemnly promised.
Ding Ling nodded, looked at the Little Dragon Girl one last time, and then stepped onto the Celestial Ladder.
Whoosh!
The Dharma Conch sounded, the Heavenly Dao chanted, amidst a sky full of golden flowers and flying rain.
A golden light shot through the void like a ribbon, wrapping around Ding Ling and whisking him away towards Heaven’s Edge, disappearing in an instant.
"Ding Ling..."
The Little Dragon Girl’s eyes became slightly misty.
This parting.
She didn’t know when she would see Ding Ling again.
But she would keep her promise.
She would wait for his return.
Even if it took until her youth had passed and her hair was all white, she would continue to wait.
She just hoped that time could come sooner.
After all...
She still remembered he liked children.
She wanted to have a child with him.
Ding Ling once again saw the Gate of Glory.
He proceeded as he had before.
Glancing at the character panel:
[Congratulations to player Ding Ling for being the first to clear the portal to the second layer of the Martial Hero Plane!]
[As the first to clear the second layer of the Martial Hero Plane, you will receive the following rewards:]
[1: A Martial Hero Plane World that only you can access!]
[2: An opportunity to return to the World of Divine Condor once.]
[3: The right to freely choose the third layer of the Martial Hero Plane!
Note: Besides the first person to clear the Plane World, no one else gets this reward.]
[4: The ability to bring ascension items: four weapons, four sets of clothes, four mounts, four hundred taels of gold.
Note: Other Ascenders can only bring one weapon and one set of clothes.]
Ding Ling was speechless.
As expected, the rewards were nearly identical.
He had grown somewhat accustomed to the patterns and rhythm of this game world.
This time, it was still just a small upgrade in rewards.
The weapons he chose: the Heaven-Swaying Sword, the Giant Que Sword, the Drumming Golden Hammer, the Gentleman’s Sword,
Fortunately, he was mentally prepared for this.
He had previously given the Divine Whip of Yuchi Gong, the short blade of Hai Dafu, and the jade flute given by Huang Rong to the Little Dragon Girl.
These three weapons were also Divine Weapons of immense value, but Ding Ling estimated he could only choose four weapons.
As expected, he guessed right.
It’s almost like he’s exploiting a loophole in the game world, this rhythm was too familiar.
For clothes, he chose an Upper-Class Celestial Silkworm Treasure Armor, two sets of luxurious attire, and one set of white clothes.
For mounts, Ding Ling chose two Ferghana Horses.
Bringing two was sufficient.
Bringing too many seemed unnecessary to Ding Ling.
He would bring the two Ferghana Horses because he had spent a long time with them and they had become familiar.
These two horses were also quite intelligent and easy to care for.
Additionally, from novels and movies, Ding Ling knew that there seemed to be many rare Spiritual Treasures and Spiritual Objects in some worlds that only mounts could consume.
If the horses were fed such things, they might become extremely powerful.
He brought them just in case.
"It’s just that this time they awarded another Martial Hero Plane World.
I’m going alone."
Ding Ling decided to explore it.
[Tip 1: The rewarded Plane World can only be accessed once.
There’s no time limit.
Because the player chose the Path of the Glory War God, the rewarded Plane World will also activate a quest list.]
[Tip 2: The rewarded Plane can be accessed at any time and place.
Player Ding Ling, do you wish to enter the rewarded Martial Hero Plane World now?]
Ding Ling thought for a moment.
Still did not go.
Especially after seeing Tip 2.
He immediately had an idea:

"If I go to the Super God Worlds like Journey to the West or Divine Enthronement in the future and face powerful beings like Daluo Immortals or Quasi-Saints who can easily destroy the world, if I can’t defeat them, can I escape to these Plane Worlds?"
Ding Ling wasn’t sure if he could escape.
But since the rules of the game world were set that way, it seemed possible to escape.
No matter how powerful Daluo Immortals and Quasi-Saints are, they’re still part of the game world!
So it should be fine.
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling’s spirits lifted.
If this really works.
Then it’s equivalent to having an extra life-saving card!
He could escape anytime, anywhere, run when he couldn’t win, hide for a while, then come out again.
Perfect!
"It seems this is the correct way to use the personal Plane World reward!"
Ding Ling nodded to himself.
He dismissed the prompt.
He didn’t want to use his personal reward Plane World yet; it would be better to save it for when he encounters a crisis in the future.
He continued to look further.
[Third layer of the Martial Hero Plane: Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, The Generation’s Twin Heroes, Celestial Dragon Eight Books.
Please choose one of the three.]
Ding Ling was speechless.
He thought this layer would contain worlds like Fengyun or Great Tang Double Dragons, relatively higher-level martial worlds.
But as it turns out.
The world really follows step-by-step progression.
It goes without saying.
The world limits of the next layer are likely around Initial Tier Grandmaster.
The layer after that should be the Void Shattering Level.
Ding Ling was deep in thought.
Since the situation had reached this point.
Ding Ling could only think:
"Given my current combat power, if I cultivate a bit longer and improve a little more, I could definitely sweep through those worlds."
Ding Ling decided that after going to these worlds, he would increase his Four-dimensional Attributes and True Qi Attributes.
His goal, after all, was to increase his strength.
He could go to any world for that purpose.

However, he was relatively more inclined towards the Celestial Dragon Eight Books, because this world had Secret Manuals like the Six Meridian Divine Sword, North Nether Divine Skill, Small Faceless Skill, Eternal Youth Technique, and others.

These Secret Manuals were highly remarkable, and if the Martial Arts Melting Furnace were to manifest successfully in the future, absorbing their essence, it would surely give birth to an incredibly extraordinary Martial Arts Secret Manual!
[Choice completed.
The choice cannot be changed.]
[Would you like to spend 10 Achievement Medals and 1 Glory Medal to open the Gate of Glory?]
[Note 1: Once the Gate of Glory is opened, it cannot be reversed.]
Yes!
At the moment of selection, accompanied by an ethereal sound brushing past the ear.
Eleven dazzling rays of light suddenly erupted from Ding Ling’s body.
Exactly the same as what happened in other worlds.
Ten silver light medals and one golden light medal combined into a strange array imprint, rotating and imprinting onto the Gate of Glory.
Crack!
The Gate of Glory opened.
In front of his eyes appeared three extremely familiar Heaven-Reaching Dao paths.
Suspended above the paths were golden words with dragons flying and phoenixes dancing.
From left to right, those golden words clearly read: Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, The Generation’s Twin Heroes, Celestial Dragon Eight Books
Ding Ling was rolled up by the golden light and dropped in front of the path belonging to the Celestial Dragon Eight Books.
Along with him were two Ferghana Horses.
"This process, these special effects, this rhythm is truly unchanged."
Ding Ling remained very calm.
The two Ferghana Horses seemed to have gone through several experiences and became particularly calm.
They didn’t make any noise, just quietly standing beside Ding Ling.
[Player is about to enter the Plane World of the Celestial Dragon Eight Books.]
[Would you like to choose to exchange treasure before entering?]
’Yes.’
Zoom!
In just an instant, Ding Ling once again saw that familiar Seven-Colored Glazed Chaos Counter.
He walked forward for a look.
Sure enough.
No change compared to before.
"It seems other player contestants are really poor; none of them can afford these things."
Ding Ling pondered silently.
He was cheating, and even then, earning Glory Medals was this difficult.
One can imagine how it is for other players.
Even if Achievement Medals were a bit easier.
But it seems still very hard to earn enough medals to buy these treasures, even if earned, they are used to exchange for strength to return to reality.
Generally, people would directly choose to exchange for strength rather than save to buy treasures!
Only Ding Ling, with plenty of medals, could use them to exchange for treasure.
He directly looked at the first counter.
’True First-Order Pill: 5 Glory Medals’
’True Second-Order Pill: 10 Glory Medals’
This time, his goal was clear.
He once again selected a True Second-Order Pill.
His current savings:
[Achievement Medals: Ordinary 145, E-level 23]
[Glory Medals: 12]
Originally had 13 Glory Medals.
Opening the Gate of Glory consumed one.
Now, after buying the True Second-Order Pill.
Only two were left.
Looking at the pill in his hand, Ding Ling’s emotions were complex, returning once again to the era of the poor.
But when the old goes, the new comes.
Ding Ling also took it easily and directly swallowed the pill into his belly.
Whoosh!

A powerful special Dao Rhyme force tore through Ding Ling’s bones; just as he felt pain, a pure and vast restorative Qi appeared, washing over him, making him feel warm and comfortable, from head to toe.
After a moment.
Ding Ling felt something different about himself, as if he became lighter, as if he broke free from a shackle, becoming more in tune with the Heavenly Dao.
Ding Ling was secretly amazed.
He looked at the character panel.
[Root Bone +2]
[Root Bone 5]
Indeed.
This Second-Order Pill directly improved his Root Bone by 2 points!

chapters.title: Chapter 492 - 491: Brand Slogans
paragraphs: Not long after Ding Ling’s Ascension.
A master was seen dashing up the Celestial Ladder with rapid steps.
Little Dragon Girl stared blankly at the sky’s horizon, unmoving, standing there from day to night. Yang Guo could not help himself any longer, took two steps forward, and softly advised:
"Auntie. Uncle is a man of his word. We just need to follow his instructions. I believe one day, he will surely come down from the Upper Realm to see us."
"Hmm."
After a long while, Little Dragon Girl gently uttered a soft yet resolute note.
The news of Ding Ling’s Ascension caused a great upheaval in Jiuzhou.
Guo Jing and Huang Rong sighed deeply in their hearts.
Without this Prince, who had crushed the Mongol Kingdom, to guard the Great Ming Dynasty, they immediately felt that the dynasty seemed to be shaking and unstable.
They, of course, understood that it was the ’lack of security’ at play.
With Ding Ling around, it was like having a Stabilizing Needle; there was no need to worry about any tricky issue arising!
Whenever Ding Ling took action, any scoundrel would be easily swept into the dustbin of history.
But with Ding Ling gone,
The Great Ming Dynasty, missing this Stabilizing Needle, would inevitably stir up waves; it was entirely expected.
Fortunately, Huang the Herbalist and others were still around, so the court remained relatively stable.
Huang the Herbalist even privately told Huang Rong:
"If it weren’t for the newly established Great Ming Dynasty, I would certainly follow Ding Ling to the Upper Realm to have a look!"
The implication of his words was clear.
Once the Great Ming Dynasty is entirely stable, he will undoubtedly follow in Ding Ling’s footsteps to seek a stronger Martial Dao!
In this world,
After mastering the Breathing Technique, Huang the Herbalist saw no more road ahead.
He could only accelerate the progress of the Breathing Technique, striving to reach the level of Great Perfection Innate Ability as soon as possible.
Huang Rong glanced at Guo Xiang in her arms.
She sighed inwardly.
As the Mother of the Kingdom, as a mother,
Even if she wanted to go,
She felt helpless.
She could only pin her hopes on the next generation.
"Xiang’Er, your Martial Dao talents are exceptional. I hope you can see Ding Ling’s silhouette in the future."
She didn’t expect Guo Xiang to catch up with Ding Ling.
Because that was unrealistic.
But as long as she could see Ding Ling’s silhouette and not be left so far behind that she couldn’t even touch its edge,
Huang Rong would feel greatly comforted.
Many had similarly complex feelings like Huang Rong and Huang the Herbalist.
Some took immediate action to head towards the Celestial Ladder Path.
Others silently prepared themselves.
The myriad forms of human behavior were limitless.
But for the players,
This day was equally worth remembering.
Because they knew,
A day later, they could choose to enter a new Plane World again.
Especially since new players had more initial options.
To this, veteran players had no other words besides envy and jealousy.
Entering the game early had its benefits, enabling more years of training, more exposure to Breathing Technique, Inner Power, etc.
While entering the game late offered more choices.
But it was undeniable.
Ding Ling’s recent moves once again stirred up a monstrous wave on the actual network.
Many newly adult players openly expressed their admiration for Ding Ling! They found Ding Ling to be a blessing for new players!
As for veteran players,
Besides exclaiming "Ding Ling, this guy, not human!" "Unbelievably powerful," they only had envy, jealousy, and hatred.
In the online world, Ding Ling’s popularity rose again.
Major platform streamers, big stars, and others were all eclipsed.
He alone dominated the top three spots on video platforms, forums, and other hot search lists!
Astonishingly, the top ten were all more or less related to him.
Only outside the top ten were there any specific news about other players and stars!
The level of demand reached a point where, flooding in like smoke, merchants were asking Ding Ling for endorsements, to star in TV dramas, movies, advertisements, etc.
But Ding Ling’s Divine Concealment was impenetrable!
They simply couldn’t find him.
And could only express their frustration.
Some crafty merchants bought flashy ads in apparent places like game forums to show their sincerity to Ding Ling.
Accompanying text read:
[Ding Ling, Fashionable Brand V is waiting for you!]
[Hero Ding! The Martial Hero World awaits your endorsement!]
[God Ding! Ice and Snow King’s World wishes to bestow the crown of the era upon you! Please, do not refuse!]
Many players, watching these scenes, started to ridicule:
Merchants have no bottom line when they become shameless!
Then Fashionable Brand V and others promptly stated: "We only do this for Ding Ling. Because Hero Ding, he deserves it!"
The players felt frustrated.
It felt like venting into the void.
Because indeed, these brands had only done such things for Ding Ling.
They couldn’t help but marvel at Ding Ling’s terrifying popularity, so much so that these merchants were willing to put aside their face to seek cooperation.
For some big stars, this was unimaginable.

Because, without exception, these brands were top domestic brands, and any star receiving such a prominent collaboration ad in the past would be extremely excited and happy, as it represented earnings, reputation, traffic, and status!
But now, Ding Ling’s fame and traffic had clearly surpassed big stars, spreading overseas and even to the whole world!
Saying Ding Ling is world-renowned!
He’s the world’s top celebrity!
Is no exaggeration!
It’s precisely because Ding Ling is a global top celebrity!
If any merchant secures a cooperation agreement with Ding Ling, establishes a partnership with him, it would almost place their company in front of everyone’s eyes worldwide.
This exposure?
This level of highlight?!
Can one comprehend it? Can it be imagined?
This is why many merchants are willing to do whatever it takes for a partnership with Ding Ling.
Because Ding Ling is worth their efforts!
In this regard,
Ding Ling was completely unaware.
His goal was immortality, to be invincible under the heavens.
He was no longer particularly interested in money!
Had this been said earlier, he would have scorned himself, for that would be too pretentious.

But now, he genuinely felt little inclination towards money; the interest was not absent, but it was certainly less passionate and intense than before when it seemed having money was having everything.
Now Ding Ling deeply realized the power of strength.
In his view,
As long as one is strong enough, everything will come, and no one dares to take it away!
Otherwise, no matter how much money, without the power to protect it, it’s futile.
Thus,
For today’s Ding Ling, as long as the money suffices for his needs, fills his stomach, it’s enough.
The same applies to reality.
In the Game World, it was much the same, with Ding Ling having more interest in gold and silver only when it was needed.
In the Game World,
Clatter!
A sound brushed past his ear.
Ding Ling opened his eyes, quickly surveying the surroundings.
He stood on a path barely two meters wide.
On both sides were vast mountains, endlessly eerie.
He glanced ahead and behind.
This path seemed like a winding Snake Dao, with no beginning or end in sight.
"Neither a village ahead nor an inn behind."
Ding Ling utilized his Body Technique, unleashing the Spiral Nine Shadows, whoosh! With a leap, he soared twenty yards in mid-air, gently landing atop a treetop.

chapters.title: Chapter 493 - 492: Overlord Breathing Technique Full Level! Zhong Ling
paragraphs: Standing here to look.
You can see the left side is the sprawling mountain range resembling a dragon.
The right side is endless and eerie for about seven to eight miles before it too becomes cloud-covered mountains.
Walking forward or backward seems to lead into the depths of the mountains.
Ding Ling shook his head, leaped down, landed on the horse’s back, and let the Ferghana Horse go forward freely.
He didn’t know which part of the Celestial Dragon Eight Books world this area was.
After all, it’s ancient times.
Some mountain areas not being developed is quite normal.
However, there is a path in the mountains here, which shows that following the road forward, one can indeed walk out.
Thinking thus, Ding Ling glanced at the character panel:
[Character: Ding Ling
Age: 27 years old
Race: Human
Faction: Late Eastern Han Dynasty World (Great Wei Kingdom) The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World (None) World of Divine Condor (Great Ming Dynasty)
Occupation: Late Eastern Han Dynasty World (First-Rank Prince) The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World (Hero) World of Divine Condor (First-Rank Prince)
Level: 4 (Note: Congratulations to the player for leveling up! Only qualified levels can continue to open the way to other worlds.)
Strength: [Bone Roots 5 (ordinary people have 1 point), Wisdom 5, Strength 60, Agility 60, Physique 60, Defense 60, Charm 11.7. True Power Value: 11 points]

Just ascended to the Upper Realm and became stronger.
He had nothing to do.

Just calmly sat on the horse’s back, slightly closed his eyes, channeled the Divine Skill, absorbed the spiritual vitality and primordial Qi from all directions, whoosh whoosh! Due to the Nine Yang Divine Skill full level, absorption speed is very fast, primordial Qi congregating in.
Ding Ling’s True Qi was gradually increasing.
Don’t know how long had passed.
Ding Ling suddenly heard a crisp voice sound beside his ears.
"Hey, big brother, are you lost?"

Ding Ling jolted awake from a training state, he opened his eyes, looked towards the sound, only to see a cute young girl standing by the roadside not far in front, blinking her big, moist eyes with a face of curiosity looking at him.
This girl seemed around sixteen.
Face as rosy dawn, eyes like autumn water, skin like coagulated fat, lips like painted, so radiant and lovely, a pure and charming maiden.
Ding Ling just felt his eyes light up, couldn’t help but slightly smile:
"Why do you say so?"
His Observing People Skill was full level.
Just by the girl’s eyes as clear as water, expressions, he knew she indeed purely had inner curiosity, goodwill actuated.
Since his full-level Observing People Skill broke through, meeting face to face rarely missed.
"Isn’t it obvious?"
The girl pointed forward, crisply saying:
"Letting your horse walk forward, you’re heading for a dead-end. There’s no road ahead."
She looked Ding Ling up and down twice, the more she looked the more curious:
"Looking at your noble and graceful appearance. Like some inexperienced rich family scion who ran away from home. I recently met one, didn’t expect so coincidentally meeting another. Hehe."
She covered her mouth with a light laugh, seemingly thought of some interesting person or matter, her lotus face revealed two shallow dimples:
"Seems like I’m fated to meet people like you."
She straightened her back, staring with big watery eyes at Ding Ling:
"My name is Zhong Ling. What’s your name?"
"I’m Ding Ling."
Ding Ling hearing the name Zhong Ling, couldn’t help but slightly raise his eyebrows.
This name was familiar.
Wasn’t she known for her naive, pure, adorable nature, daughter of Duan Zhengchun and charming yaksha Gan Baby?
Also the adopted daughter of Laurel Valley’s Valley Master Zhong Wanchou!
"Ding Ling?"
Zhong Ling tilted her head looking at Ding Ling, blinked her eyes, said:
"Never heard of it. Besides, surnamed Ding seems rare in this area compared to Duan. Listening to your accent, seems like not from here. Where did you come from?"
"From the Central Plains."
Ding Ling slightly smiled:
"Is this Wuliang Mountain?"

chapters.title: Chapter 494 - 493: Zhong Ling’s Interrogation
paragraphs: It turns out that just now Ding Ling had already deduced the time and place he would appear.
Zhong Ling.
The surname is Duan.
Not long ago, a wealthy young man who ran away from home was met...
A few points combined, a slight deduction can tell, this must have happened after Duan Yu and Zhong Ling met.
And now Zhong Ling has come out alone.
Most likely, Duan Yu is already entangled with Mu Wanqing.
At this point in time, it should be the time when Mu Wanqing, Duan Yu, and the Shennong Sect are confronting each other, when Mu Wanqing threatens Zhong Ling to leave first.
Ding Ling had an idea in mind but watched Zhong Ling saying crisply:
"This is the terrain of Wuliang Mountain. You don’t even know which mountain range this is, yet you dare to venture inside. You’re truly bold!"
Zhong Ling widened her eyes and looked at Ding Ling:
"Don’t you know how many poisonous creatures are in these desolate ancient paths? One mistake and you get bitten. Where would you find someone to save you?! You’re not afraid of dying?!"

Her voice was crisp and sweet like a silver bell, melodious and pleasant to the ear. At this moment, she seemed overly surprised and worried, her speech carrying the unique charm and liveliness of a young girl.
Ding Ling smiled lightly:
"Of course, I’m afraid of dying."
"Then why did you run away from home alone?"
Zhong Ling puzzled: "You don’t seem as brainless as a Duan family young master. Why are you thinking this way?"
"I unintentionally wandered in here."
"Oh?"
Zhong Ling blinked her eyes as clear as water and said crisply:
"Then I’ll take you out of the mountain later."
Zhong Ling volunteered, cheerfully saying:
"I’m idle anyway. By the way."
She suddenly exclaimed, clapped her hands slightly, looked up at Ding Ling, and said:
"Brother Ding, have you seen my Lightning Mink?"
"Lightning Mink?"
"It’s palm-sized, gray-white all over, and runs like lightning..."
She roughly described the appearance of the Lightning Mink.
Ding Ling shook his head, indicating he hadn’t seen it.
Zhong Ling drooped her head, very disappointed and upset:
"I’ve kept that mink for a long time."
Ding Ling considered the fate of the Lightning Mink: It seems to have been poisoned to death by the Scarlet Venom Toad!
And such a King of Ten Thousand Poisons like the Scarlet Venom Toad is extremely rare!
Having journeyed through several worlds, Ding Ling hadn’t seen the Scarlet Venom Toad, nor heard of any related news!
It shows that the birth of the Scarlet Venom Toad must be legendary!
It’s possible that the one mentioned in the Celestial Dragon Eight Books is the only one in the world.
Thinking that the Scarlet Venom Toad combined with some herbs and poisons could create pills that make one immune to all poisons, once consumed, no poison would harm or invade!
Ding Ling felt a surge of excitement.

Although he drank the Five Immortals Rejuvenating Wine and was unafraid of even hundreds of poisons, and had the Nine Yang Divine Skill, Qingnang Scripture, and Medicine King Breathing Technique to protect him, ordinary poisons couldn’t bother him.
But when encountering rare deadly poisons, he could only bemoan helplessly, passively awaiting death!
Regarding poison.
Ding Ling is apprehensive because he had a similar experience, and if not for the Five Immortals Rejuvenating Wine and other precautions, he might have succumbed to poison!

Precisely because he knows well that traveling through Jianghu, one can’t be too careful, a moment’s carelessness and dying from poison are common occurrences, Ding Ling has always coveted the trait of being immune to all poisons.
But alas, he had never had the opportunity.
Now, hearing Zhong Ling mention the Lightning Mink, Ding Ling thought of the Scarlet Venom Toad and decided to strike first, to see if he could obtain it.
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling said:
"Do you know of a bottomless ravine in Wuliang Mountain?!"
Ding Ling remembered Duan Yu being pushed down a ravine by Yue the Third and then swallowing the Scarlet Venom Toad.
"Bottomless ravine?"

Zhong Ling was evidently familiar with this terrain in Wuliang Mountain. Since the Valley of Ten Thousand Tribulations wasn’t far from here, and considering the Lightning Mink only eats venomous snakes, Zhong Ling surely had run over here many times, as this is where poisonous creatures abound.
At this moment, she just bowed her head in thought, then suddenly raised her head to look at Ding Ling, saying crisply:
"I know of two such places. Brother Ding, do you want to go?!"
A clever, resourceful girl.
Understanding the music by hearing the tune.
Appearing innocent and pure, yet also lively, witty, and smart.
"Indeed."
Ding Ling said:

"If you want to find the Lightning Mink, why not start with these two places? Isn’t there a saying that the abyss contains many poisonous creatures? Perhaps your Lightning Mink went there to seek food?"
"That makes sense."
Zhong Ling’s eyes brightened, smiling lightly as two dimples appeared on her face:
"Brother Ding, let’s go now."
Zhong Ling seemed rather impatient:
"This is the first time I’ve been apart from my mink for so long. I miss it so much."
"Then mount the horse."
Ding Ling whistled, and a Ferghana Horse ran up to Zhong Ling according to Ding Ling’s signal:
"Lead the way."
"Brother Ding, you also understand Beast Taming?!"
Zhong Ling was amazed that Ding Ling could command two Ferghana Horses, suddenly feeling a sense of kinship, she laughed and said:
"There aren’t many people in the world who understand Beast Taming."
"I know a little."
Ding Ling laughed and said:
"But probably not as well as you."

After achieving full level in Horse Taming Skill, Horse Selection Skill, Beekeeping Skill, Tiger Subduing Skill, and other related skills, Ding Ling is indeed deeply versed in Beast Taming, but his forte is controlling horses.
The other skills aren’t so proficient.
"Hehe."
Zhong Ling’s sadness came and went quickly, always cheerful, full of sunshine, innocence, and brightness:
"Brother Ding is modest. Your Horse Taming Skill is better than mine."
After she finished speaking, she puffed out her chest, somewhat proudly saying:
"But I’m very close with my Lightning Mink as well. When I find it, I must show it to Brother Ding."
"Hmm. I’m looking forward to it."
The two chatted, galloping along the way.
Midway, they took several detours, going through different treacherous mountain paths.
Looking at this.

Ding Ling suddenly realized that before when he was letting the horse run freely, the Ferghana Horse indeed went down a dead end, and if he had taken another route, he might have already left this region.
However, though that’s the case, if he really went out, he likely wouldn’t have encountered Zhong Ling searching for the Lightning Mink in the mountains.
The two met for the first time.
But Zhong Ling was innocent and lively, cute and active, curious and friendly, and during their interaction with her babbling and questioning.
The two unknowingly became friends.

Zhong Ling called him Brother Ding so familiarly, as if they were lifelong friends, making Ding Ling have to marvel that wherever Zhong Ling goes, with her communication skills and emotional intelligence, she absolutely cannot fare poorly!
