chapters.title: Chapter 495 - 494: Cloud Crane of the Four Great Evils
paragraphs: Dada!
Two Ferghana Horses galloped, one before the other, across mountain paths, about to dash out of the forested realm into the opposite desolate earth realm.
Suddenly, a person stumbled out from the dense forest, holding a sword, wandering right into Zhong Ling’s galloping mount’s path.

Zhong Ling was greatly shocked and instinctively tightened the reins, neighing! The Ferghana Horse reared up, its hooves striking twice in the void, then heavily landed on the ground, coming to a precarious stop right in front of this person, just inches apart. If Zhong Ling had reacted a bit slower, this person might have been thrown by the Ferghana Horse or crushed to death.
Zhong Ling’s pretty face turned white, feeling a lingering fear, patted her chest, and instinctively glanced at the person on the ground.
She saw the person was lithe, wearing a tilted bamboo hat revealing her face, with curved willow eyebrows and apricot eyes like black pearls, clearly an exceptionally beautiful woman.
But right now, her face was weary and frostbitten.
Her shoulder was still bleeding, her figure swaying, seemingly unable to hold on.
"Brother Ding."
Seeing this, Zhong Ling hurriedly jumped down, reaching out to support the woman but was refused. Unperturbed, she turned to Ding Ling and asked:
"What should we do? This sister is seriously injured."
Ding Ling said nothing.
In his eyes.
This woman’s heroic spirit was overwhelming and extremely aloof!
She seemed to carry an aura of ’strangers keep away,’ even with her frosty face, yet her face flushed, and her apricot eyes held unusual ripples, suppressing something with effort.
Who is this woman?
Ding Ling wondered.

He was not surprised Zhong Ling leapt off the horse to save her, as the girl was clever and lively yet kind-hearted and pure, seeing the woman lacked harmful ability, would think of aiding her, which was absolutely normal. If not, she wouldn’t be Zhong Ling.
He opened his mouth, about to respond to Zhong Ling.
Whoosh!
A gentle breeze swept in.
The air seemed filled with a peculiar scent.
"Don’t, don’t breathe..."
The heroic woman clearly couldn’t hold on, panting and falling to the ground, her hat rolling aside, ignoring it, instead anxiously warning Ding Ling and Zhong Ling:
"Quick, run!"
"Hahaha..."
Suddenly, a loud, wild, fiery laughter echoed from the sky over the mountain paths:
"Unexpectedly encountering a big and small pair of top-grade beauties here in the wilderness. Hahaha, my Cloud Crane’s fortune must be blessed by the Bodhisattva today!"
With the voice’s drop.
Suddenly, a ghost-like figure flashed out from the forest.
Ding Ling’s eyes were remarkably sharp.
He clearly saw.

This person was extremely tall, yet extremely thin, with a horse-like face, their figure like wind and lightning, stepping on a dead branch without submerging, showing their Lightweight Skill was incredibly advanced, remarkably extraordinary.
Now, Cloud Crane held an iron claw and steel staff in one hand, wiping his mouth corner with the other, laughing gleefully:

"Wonderful! Quite evidently, the big one holds grand charm, while the small one is sprightly, the greatest joy in life is indulging and reveling with beauties amidst the mountains and waters. Just wait, once the potion takes effect. I shall certainly make you obediently call me grandpa! Haha..."
Speaking thus.
He couldn’t help but laugh jovially skyward, clearly excited beyond measure.
"You, you, you’re one of the Four Great Evils in the world, the utterly vile filthy thief Cloud, Cloud Crane?!"
At some point. Zhong Ling had already run to Ding Ling’s side, fearfully watching towards Cloud Crane’s position while sneakily handed Ding Ling a map, whispering:
"Brother Ding, this is my family’s map. Hurry, call my parents to save me. I will block him shortly. You must go!"
However.

Her trick was fully seen by Cloud Crane from his elevated vantage point, unable to resist a contemptuous snicker, suddenly leaping down from the branch like the wind, the iron claw and steel staff seemingly like a Mountain-Opening Axe intending to smash Ding Ling down.
"You pretty boy, I’ve despised you for a long time, sending you to Western Heaven, saving the elder from being bothered while enjoying!"
"No!"
Zhong Ling rushed forward, intending to block the iron claw and steel staff.
Her power was low.
If she forcefully blocked.
She might be severely injured immediately.
Yet she could unhesitatingly jump out to shield Ding Ling from the iron claw and steel staff.
Such pure benevolence.
Ding Ling was moved, casually pointing a finger, One Yang Finger!
A vigorous qi shot across the void, striking the iron claw and steel staff, instantly a mighty force seemingly collided with them, causing Cloud Crane to lose grip, sending them flying.
Ding Ling seized the chance to point again, swish!

A finger force shot out like thunder, striking Cloud Crane’s shoulder like a flying sword, whoosh! At once, the finger force pierced Cloud Crane’s shoulder, forcefully tearing out a large chunk of flesh.
Cloud Crane screamed, incredulous:
"Dali Duan Family’s One Yang Finger! You belong to Duan Family!"
Spoken with certainty.
Obviously in his view.
One Yang Finger was a secret of the Duan Family.
Apart from Dali Duan Family, others couldn’t possibly learn.
Ding Ling didn’t answer, merely pointed twice in mid-air. Cloud Crane couldn’t evade, stiffly stood frozen in place, unable to move.
His face showed horror, eyes rolling, lips trembling as if wanting to say something, but he was struck dumb, unable to speak temporarily.
And more.

He was also struck itchy and painful, all at once feeling utterly itchy and painful, but unable to make sound, involuntarily trembling all over, feeling unbearably uncomfortable to the extreme, nearly about to explode.
Ding Ling disregarded his discomfort.
Just swiftly dismounted, directly coming forward to rummage through his body.
Sure enough.
Found a lot of bottles and jars, and a Secret Manual.
Ding Ling slightly delighted.
An unexpected gain, not bad. He spared Cloud Crane’s life, fancying his Lightweight Body Technique, aiming to extract the Heart Method Mantra, practice essentials before killing him.
Now it seems unnecessary?
Ding Ling casually flipped through the Secret Manual "Hongfei Inner Power Heart Method"
It turned out to be Inner Power Heart Technique.

Ding Ling slightly frowned. The intention to immediately kill Cloud Crane faded. He had clearly seen earlier. Cloud Crane’s inner power was immensely high, an outstanding Lightweight Skill in the world. Learning it for Ding Ling would undoubtedly make traveling more convenient.
Also, it could serve as resources for the Martial Arts Melting Furnace.

chapters.title: Chapter 496 - 495: Ling Yanqiu of Dragon Gate Flying Armor
paragraphs: Not only that, it can also enhance the foundation, preparing for the synthesis of a top-notch lightweight skill for the future Martial Arts Melting Furnace.
Zhong Ling stared at Ding Ling, eyes wide and mouth agape; the shock was so overwhelming, even her tongue seemed tangled:
"Ding, Ding, Brother Ding, you, you, you..."
"What’s wrong?"
Ding Ling looked at the bottles and jars in his hands and started experimenting one by one.
He was also oblivious at first; when he smelled the unusual scent in the air, he realized the air was poisoned, but by then it was too late.
Fortunately, Cloud Crane brought about his own doom.
Came right to him to be ’killed’.
He managed to subdue him and obtain the antidote.
If the time had prolonged, he might have been restricted by it.
Yet, Ding Ling quickly analyzed that the poison was a combination of two deadly toxins.
One was odorless and tasteless, he couldn’t smell it; it was only after the toxin invaded his organs that he realized it.

And this toxin he can temporarily resist and dispel later. His ability to withstand poison is exceptionally strong, combined with the Medicine King Breathing Technique, Qingnang Scripture, Nine Yang Divine Skill, all possessing miraculous detoxifying and anti-poison effects, this poison was indeed hard to resist. However, for Ding Ling, it wasn’t an unsolvable problem.
The most troublesome was the other type of deadly poison.
This poison penetrated deep into his organs.

Ding Ling felt a burning heat throughout his body. Fortunately, his martial prowess was extremely high; with the constant operation of Nine Yang Divine Skill and Qingnang Scripture, this poison couldn’t harm him immediately.

However, even after searching through the bottles and jars, Ding Ling couldn’t find the antidote for this burning poison. His heart skipped a beat, and as he was about to interrogate Cloud Crane, he suddenly heard Zhong Ling’s voice and turned towards her, seeing her watching him with a shocked and bewildered expression. He couldn’t help but suppress the irritation in his heart and gave a slight smile:
"I possess formidable martial arts. Did I scare you?"
"No, no, no, not at all!"
Zhong Ling finally untangled her tongue and spoke swiftly and smoothly:

"I’m just too shocked. I originally thought you, a noble young master, would be like the young masters of the Duan Family, unfamiliar with martial arts. But surprisingly, your martial arts are so impressive!
To think that this is one of the infamous Four Great Evils in the Jianghu Martial Arts! You subdued this great evil so easily. You’re amazing, so incredible!"
Zhong Ling looked at Ding Ling with admiration:
"Far more impressive than my parents. Oh, right."
She seemed to recall something, tilting her head with curiosity as she looked at Ding Ling:
"The great evil said you are part of the Dali Duan Family; is that true?
"My surname is Ding."
Ding Ling laughed:
"What do you think?"
"Of course, that’s a lie."
Zhong Ling also started laughing, her dimples faintly visible:
"I don’t believe the words of the great evil. I believe Brother Ding."

As she spoke, her vision suddenly went dark, her body softened, nearly stumbling onto the ground. Ding Ling hurried forward to support her, but she was limp and rapidly losing strength, uncontrollably collapsing into Ding Ling’s embrace.
Held in such a way by a man.
Smelling the unique scent on Ding Ling.
Zhong Ling’s face turned red, her heart pounding uncontrollably; she felt a burning heat throughout her body and couldn’t help but say, "Brother Ding, I, I feel so uncomfortable."
"Here, smell this first."
Ding Ling, mastering Medical Dao, didn’t need Cloud Crane to speak, he found an antidote among the bottles and jars and let Zhong Ling smell it.
Zhong Ling sniffed twice, feeling nauseated, abruptly jumping out of Ding Ling’s embrace:
"Ah, it smells so bad."
"See, now you can move."
"Yes."
Zhong Ling moved her limbs, visibly pleased:
"I’m fine now. Thank you, Brother Ding."
Ding Ling handed Zhong Ling a bottle and gestured towards the spirited lady.
Zhong Ling soon took it and walked towards the spirited lady, speaking crisply:
"Sister, Brother Ding asked me to give you the antidote."
Squatting down in front of the lady, Zhong Ling let her smell the bottle’s contents. Once the lady gained the strength to stand, Zhong Ling sealed the antidote and said with a playful smile:
"Sister, my name is Zhong Ling, and Brother Ding’s name is Ding Ling. We’re quite the pair, aren’t we? Our names both have ’Ling’ in them."
Although this ’Ling’ is not the same as that ’Ling’.

But Zhong Ling was still delighted, especially after experiencing such an adventure, feeling increasingly that Ding Ling was fated to be with her, thus when speaking to the woman, she couldn’t help but express with a slight sense of pride, as if knowing Ding Ling was something remarkable.
The woman heard her, smiled without commenting.
"By the way, sister, what’s your name?
"I’m called Ling Yanqiu."

The woman didn’t hide it, clearly recognizing Ding Ling’s superior martial arts, a skill she couldn’t match. If Ding Ling truly intended to attack her, escape was impossible, and Zhong Ling, being innocent and kind-hearted, was warm and enthusiastic towards her, making Ling Yanqiu gradually lower her defenses as she spoke:
"I’m pursuing someone and climbed the Celestial Ladder, unexpectedly falling into the eerie depths. Coincidentally, I encountered this filthy thief assaulting a woman."
She glanced at Cloud Crane, her eyes filled with undisguised disdain and resentment:
"I immediately stabbed him with a sword. However, this filthy thief’s body technique was so advanced, he dodged instantly and began fighting me.
Initially, we were evenly matched. But somehow, this filthy thief used poison.
Unaware, my body began to feel numb and weak, my inner strength could barely manifest.
If not for learning the Breathing Technique, I would surely have died here; and wouldn’t have met you two."
Speaking of this.
She solemnly bowed deeply to Ding Ling and Zhong Ling:
"Thank you, benefactors! I will always remember your lifesaving kindness and will repay you abundantly."
"I don’t need repayment."
Zhong Ling laughed, waving her hand:
"I almost collided with you. If you don’t blame me, how can I ask for repayment? Moreover, I didn’t save you. I was just watching the entire time.
If you want to thank someone, you should thank Brother Ding."
"Young Master Ding certainly needs thanks. Miss Zhong deserves it too."

Two beauties, one tall and one short, stood beneath the lush shade, their allure like peach and plum blossoms, complemented by the scenery around them, forming a lively picture of beauties appreciating the scenery.
Ding Ling felt a slight surprise within.
He didn’t expect to encounter Ling Yanqiu here.
Encountering Cloud Crane was normal. Because at this point in time, the Four Great Evils seemed to have all gathered around Wuliang Mountain.
Meeting Ling Yanqiu, however, was quite unexpected.

Ling Yanqiu is one of the female protagonists in Dragon Gate Flying Armor, and now she unexpectedly appeared here. She mentioned following someone up the Celestial Ladder, so during the time Ding Ling activated the Celestial Ladder.
Ling Yanqiu and the person she was pursuing might have been near Chang’an City at the same time, both subsequently entering the Celestial Ladder.
Because players entered, the plot of Divine Condor was ’completely changed’.
The Dragon Gate Flying Armor world probably followed suit.

chapters.title: Chapter 497 - 496: Grieving Butter Clear Wind
paragraphs: Although it is so, Ling Yanqiu actually learned the Breathing Technique, it seems she either made a deal with the players or has a good relationship with some other Ascenders.
As for what exactly happened in Dragon Gate Flying Armor’s world.
Such that the Celestial Ladder just descended on the world of Dragon Gate Flying Armor, and they successively set foot on the Celestial Ladder?
Ding Ling couldn’t tell.
Now it’s also inconvenient to inquire about the specific situation.
When he saw Ling Yanqiu and Zhong Ling talking, he walked over to Cloud Crane and flicked his fingers twice in the air, plap plap!
Cloud Crane’s acupoints were unsealed, and he immediately fell to the ground, sweat pouring like rain.
He looked at Ding Ling with a face full of fear and horror:
"You, you, who on earth are you?!"
Ding Ling instead asked:
"What kind of poison did you just use?"

Cloud Crane’s eyes rolled as he was about to scheme. Ding Ling’s Observing People Skill and acting were all at Full Level, and at such a close distance, Cloud Crane still wanted to play tricks under his eyes?
Ding Ling immediately tapped his acupoints again.
Then continued to tap various acupoints like the itching acupoint and pain acupoint.
All of a sudden.

Cloud Crane only felt as if his body was being bitten by ants, unbearable pain and itchiness, wanting to scream, but having been muted, he couldn’t call out, cold sweat pouring down his forehead and his body started convulsing, within just a moment, his eyes rolled back, and he foamed at the mouth.
Clearly, he was tortured beyond words.
Ding Ling was proficient in Medical Dao, and with the assistance of the One Yang Finger to point acupoints, ordinary people falling into his hands could neither seek life nor death.
Ding Ling didn’t know how powerful the Life and Death Talisman was.
But in his view.
With his Medical Dao paired with the One Yang Finger and other Techniques, it was enough to let villains feel the taste of life worse than death.
Plap!
Plap!

Ding Ling saw it was about time, flicked twice in the air again, and Cloud Crane’s acupoints were unsealed, instantly as if he returned to the shore from the bottom of the lake, he couldn’t help but start gasping for air, like someone nearly drowned, his whole body soaked, and the terror in his eyes almost overflowed from his eye sockets.
Cloud Crane looked at Ding Ling as if looking at a devil.
[Achievement Medal Earned: Intimidate Cloud Crane.]

[Note: Cloud Crane is extremely vicious and viciously immoral with unmatched Lightweight Skill in Jianghu. He serves no one, even those stronger than him. You are the only one who truly terrifies and frightens him from his heart!]
Upon hearing the prompt, Ding Ling paused slightly, then asked again:
"What kind of poison did you use?
His voice was calm and unperturbed, his face expressionless, merely looking down at him with indifference, much like a deity overlooking a mortal.
Cloud Crane’s heart went cold, knowing if he had any more tricks or hesitations, he might once again be tortured terribly by this man, thinking of the recent experience.
Cloud Crane shivered and hurriedly said trembling:
"It’s Grieving Butter Clear Wind!"
Indeed.
The legendary top poison with no color or taste.
Ding Ling thought it was some lethal poison that nearly poisoned him. Turns out it was the famous Grieving Butter Clear Wind.
"And what else?"
Ding Ling asked coldly.
"It’s, it’s Yin Yang Harmony Powder!"
Cloud Crane forced himself to speak despite his terror:
"I, I use it every time with women to fulfill my desires, I always mix two types of poison to make the woman helplessly limp and unable to move, yet have no choice but to cooperate with me..."
"You filthy thief!"
Cloud Crane’s voice was quite loud.

Zhong Ling and Ling Yanqiu were not far away and heard clearly. Zhong Ling was fine, but Ling Yanqiu, long accustomed to the Jianghu, felt an ominous premonition upon hearing the name, and upon thinking of her own feeling of heat, was alarmed and asked:
"What is Yin Yang Harmony Powder exactly?!"
"It’s, spring, spring drug..."
"Spring drug?!"
Ling Yanqiu’s face lost color:
"What will happen?"

Zhong Ling didn’t initially understand, being naive about such things, but she was a bright and clever girl who, through observation and slight inference, understood what the Yin Yang Harmony Powder was and turned pale, but quickly thought of something, couldn’t help but glance at Ding Ling, her eyes full of emotion as the Yin Yang Harmony Powder had unknowingly taken effect.
Zhong Ling, with weaker Kung Fu, was already paralyzed by Grieving Butter Clear Wind.
The effect of Yin Yang Harmony Powder had already unknowingly entered her internal organs deeply.
Now, with time passing.
She was the first to start reacting, flushing and heart racing, her gaze towards Ding Ling becoming shyer and hotter.
"Will, will..."
Cloud Crane glanced at Ding Ling, then Zhong Ling and Ling Yanqiu, straightforwardly saying:
"If good deeds aren’t timely done, afraid that the poison will be too deep for Immortals to save.
"What?!"

Ling Yanqiu shuddered, taking two steps back, remembering coming for that person lost in the Heaven-Ascending Ladder, and now being gravely poisoned with little time left, she couldn’t help but break into sorrow.
She drew out her sharp sword, placed it on her neck, about to commit suicide.
Zhong Ling, seeing this, though overwhelmed by a flame of irritability, compassionate, couldn’t help but startle and scream:
"Sister, what are you doing?!"
Ding Ling looked over, flicked his finger.
The Finger-Pointing Divine Technique’s Finger Force, from a distance, struck the sword out of Ling Yanqiu’s hand.
Without a weapon, Ling Yanqiu was still somewhat dejected.
Zhong Ling hurried over to embrace her:
"Sister, why can’t you think things through? Life is so good, why choose to die?!"
Her eyes were full of clear, naive, and adorable spirit, making Ling Yanqiu’s heart warm momentarily, followed by bitterness and sorrow:
"If this poison enters deeply into my organs, then my consciousness would be unclear, doing wrong things is absolutely not allowed. It’s better to end it myself beforehand."
Zhong Ling heard, but couldn’t persuade, as a woman’s reputation in this era was more important than anything; she couldn’t help but look at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling asked Cloud Crane for the antidote.
Cloud Crane smiled wryly:
"Why would I make an antidote for this stuff? It’s completely Divine Medicine to me; the antidote is myself. Why would there be any reason to prepare an antidote?"
Ding Ling had to admit, Cloud Crane spoke logically.
He was furious inside.
Yet his heart was inexplicably warming up.
Thinking of Duan Yu in Celestial Dragon Eight Books being Immune to All Poisons, yet also caught by such a drug.
Ding Ling couldn’t help but smile wryly.
Is this drug so divine?
What kind of drug got to Duan Yu isn’t discussed.
But this kind of drug he was caught by was a highly toxic poison, and even Ding Ling didn’t have a good solution for the moment.
He then again pointed at Cloud Crane’s acupoint, placing him back on horseback, as Cloud Crane’s Martial Arts weren’t found out yet, he didn’t kill him temporarily.
Ding Ling now thought about how to detoxify this poison.

Ding Ling couldn’t tell.

chapters.title: Chapter 498 - 497: Medicine Preparation
paragraphs: Ding Ling asked Zhong Ling to tell him where there was a mountain cave.
Zhong Ling told him.
At that moment, Ding Ling grabbed Zhong Ling and Ling Yanqiu with one hand each and sped towards the direction of the cave.
The Ferghana Horse, with its spiritual connection, followed Ding Ling’s silhouette, galloping wildly to catch up.
They arrived at the entrance of the cave.
Ding Ling set the two of them down.
At this moment.

Ling Yanqiu also began to feel somewhat dazed. After landing, she woke up briefly but was extremely sad and distressed. Without saying a word, she was about to smash her head against the wall to end her life. Fortunately, Zhong Ling held her tightly, preventing her suicidal impulse.
Ding Ling sighed deeply.
Compared to the two women, he was much better off.

Whenever the inner turmoil was too much to bear and he couldn’t hold on, a surge of Buddha Qi would emerge, sweeping away the anxiety in his heart, and Ding Ling would immediately feel much more at ease.
He couldn’t help but be secretly surprised; did Buddha Qi actually have this effect?

He glanced at Zhong Ling, who was also looking at him, her large, watery eyes containing a hint of shyness and heat. She called out ’Brother Ding’ with a face like a peach blossom, then almost uncontrollably let go of Ling Yanqiu’s arms and turned to hug Ding Ling, reaching out to touch his face, looking up at him and smiling foolishly.
Like a lovesick girl.
Though a hint of her past innocence could still be seen, it was clear she was already confused and unaware.
Ding Ling knocked her unconscious with a strike.
Then he knocked Ling Yanqiu unconscious as well.
Taking advantage of someone in their time of need.
Is not the conduct of a gentleman.
Ding Ling thought to himself he was no gentleman, but neither was he a villain.
Such despicable and shameless acts, he disdained to do.
He preferred love that was open and honest!
If he acted like the vile Yin Zhiping, whom he despised, what difference would there be between him and Yin Zhiping?!
Thinking this through.

Ding Ling carefully placed the two women to one side, executed Spiral Nine Shadows, and flew out of the cave like Xun Wind, soaring over a hundred meters in just a few breaths, landing in front of the Ferghana Horse.
Neigh!
The Ferghana Horse immediately stopped.
On its back, Cloud Crane observed Ding Ling’s extraordinary Lightweight Skill, amazed and in awe, for such mastery was unheard of and unseen before. Who on earth was this young man?!
So young, yet possessing such astonishing power?! Could he have been cultivating since birth?!

Though Cloud Crane’s abilities were not at the Innate level, he had traveled north and south, with uncommon knowledge and experienced insights. He could see Ding Ling’s Lightweight Skill was supreme, but what was most shocking was the incredible cultivation level of his Inner Power!
No matter how strong the Lightweight Skill, without a certain level of Inner Power cultivation, one couldn’t effortlessly leap, maneuver, and dodge like that.
"Speak."
Ding Ling flew forward, grabbed Cloud Crane by the collar, and threw him to the ground:
"What herbs did you use for that drug of yours?
Ding Ling’s medical skills combined the essences from several worlds.
Without a formula.
It was hard for him to deduce the antidote just by guessing.
But having a formula made it different.
"This, this..."
Cloud Crane stammered.
Ding Ling’s face darkened, raising his palm:
"If you don’t speak, I’ll kill you right now!"
"If I tell you, you’ll kill me anyway!"
Cloud Crane, feeling hopeless, retorted:
"Why should I tell you? Besides, I’m helping you achieve your goals; you should be thanking me, not killing me!"
He seemed a bit aggrieved as he spoke.
Ding Ling laughed in exasperation.
He’d seen shameless people before, but never someone so utterly shameless!
He reached out and pressed Cloud Crane’s acupoint.
This time, he pressed more acupoints, with firmer and heavier pressure.
In no time at all.
Cloud Crane started convulsing, foaming at the mouth, eyes rolling back, moaning, and seemed on the brink of death.
Only then did Ding Ling release his acupoints, saying with a steady face.
"You can choose not to speak. Want to try again?"
"I’ll talk!"
Cloud Crane was truly terrified of Ding Ling.
For someone so young to be this decisive and efficient was astonishing, far surpassing the Four Great Evils.
And to be able to torture someone like this?!
It was truly eye-opening!

He instantly realized that Ding Ling must have an intimate acquaintance with all the major acupoints of the body, and his mastery of the One Yang Finger and medical skills must have reached the Transformation Realm.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to torture him with such precision and effectiveness.
Cloud Crane quickly listed the names of the herbs used to concoct the drug.
Ding Ling used the vast, oceanic Full Level Medical Dao Secret Manual to carefully deduce the antidote’s formula.
He combined the knowledge points from top-tier Medical Dao Secret Manuals from several worlds.
In just a moment.
He figured out the solution.
Ding Ling secretly breathed a sigh of relief.

Luckily, in his previous world, he used the power of Jiuzhou to collect countless Secret Manuals, among which the Medical Dao Secret Manuals were vast. It was this deep foundation in Medical Dao that allowed Ding Ling to find the solution.
He was secretly grateful.
Further realizing the necessity to read more on various Secret Manuals, because he couldn’t predict when and what knowledge points might come in handy.
Learning more as a precaution was always beneficial.
Crack!

Ding Ling pressed Cloud Crane’s acupoint, then casually knocked him unconscious. Then he executed the Golden Swan Skill and Spiral Nine Shadows, flying into the depths of Wuliang Mountain in search of herbs.
He had extraordinary eyesight and exceptional vision, coupled with a full-level familiarity with various herbs.
After running through several mountains, he collected three sets of herbs.
He immediately entered a sect, took some bowls and stoves, and swiftly departed.
This region of Wuliang Mountain was extremely vast.
In the mountains, there were many sects and gangs.
Even among the mountains, there were some small farmers and households. After exploring several mountain ranges, Ding Ling naturally discovered these sects.
But even so.
He still failed to find the Scarlet Venom Toad.
Thinking of the urgency to cure Zhong Ling’s poison, he immediately rushed back to the cave.
Upon seeing them again.
He couldn’t help but be startled.
The two women were burning with fever and seemed almost beyond help.
Especially Zhong Ling.

Her power was extremely low, and she hadn’t practiced the Breathing Technique. Her physical condition was far inferior to Ling Yanqiu, and she was barely breathing, with no way to tell how far gone she was.
Ding Ling dared not delay, promptly approaching to release Zhong Ling’s Sleeping Acupoint.
He woke Zhong Ling.
Zhong Ling opened her large, watery eyes, saw Ding Ling, and couldn’t help but smile foolishly, sweetly calling ’Brother Ding,’ then rushed to hug him.
Ding Ling couldn’t bear to press her acupoint again; given her frail constitution, doing so might knock her out completely, causing her to die here.
So Ding Ling promptly began skillfully building a fire and brewing medicine, using the Burning Wood Saber Technique to ignite flames; starting a fire was extremely quick for Ding Ling.
Additionally.
His cultivation was extremely profound, and his skills in brewing and cooking medicine were at a full-level.

At this time, fully exercising his power, the combination of Nine Yang Divine Skill, Medicine King Breathing Technique, and Medical Saint Breathing Technique’s Fusion Qi made the pace of brewing medicine exceptionally fast.
In less than fifteen minutes, the medicine was ready. Ding Ling used the Profound Celestial Finger Technique to point, cooling the boiling concoction instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 499 - 498: A Maiden’s Heart
paragraphs: The Profound Celestial Finger Technique can freeze water into ice.
Ding Ling now has immeasurable power; controlling the Finger Force to cool a bowl of scalding potion to a refreshing yet non-icy state is not difficult.
Then Ding Ling administered the medicine to Zhong Ling.
Zhong Ling was uncooperative all along.
She just clung to Ding Ling, mumbling ’Brother Ding’ ’Brother Ding.’
Ding Ling had no choice but to force-feed her.
Fortunately, he had mastered the strength in this aspect to a fine degree.
He managed to ’feed’ Zhong Ling the antidote quite securely.

After the antidote entered her stomach, it was quickly dissolved by the True Qi of the Nine Yang Divine Skill and the Vigorous Qi of the Medicine King Breathing Technique, merging into Zhong Ling’s limbs and bones.
In just a moment.
The clarity returned to Zhong Ling’s large, watery eyes, and her face flushed like the morning glow as she called out ’Brother Ding.’
Her voice, crisp and tender, carried a softness unlike before, sounding increasingly pleasant and gentle. When it fell into Ding Ling’s ears, he felt as if a warm current passed through his heart.

He looked closely and saw that Zhong Ling no longer appeared so simple-minded; her eyes were bright like the moon, seemingly recovered, and he couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief, withdrawing the hand that was applying Fusion Qi on her back.
"How do you feel?"
Ding Ling finally asked.
"I’m fine now."

Zhong Ling, not knowing what came to her mind, covered her face, feeling as if she couldn’t face others, so ashamed that she wished to bury herself in a hole. Though her face was covered, her fingers were spread wide, occasionally sneaking peeks at Ding Ling. Seeing Ding Ling, her heart inexplicably raced with joy, but when Ding Ling turned away, she felt a faint sense of disappointment.
The thoughts of a young girl were like the tide, constantly shifting.
This was because she remembered everything that had happened during this period, clearer and more profound than anything before.
Had she ever done such things before?
She couldn’t help but lower her brows, feeling shy to the extreme.

Yet, in an era where purity was highly valued, Zhong Ling, having done so much for Ding Ling, despite initial shyness and awkwardness, was at a loss seeing Ding Ling no longer paying much attention to her and merely brewing medicine there, making her heart feel a bit unsettled.

But she was indeed an innocent, pure-hearted young girl. At an unintentional glance, seeing Ling Yanqiu’s state, she couldn’t help but be shocked, forgetting the turbulent emotions earlier, jumping up and holding Ling Yanqiu, calling out several times. Seeing no response, she couldn’t help but look at Ding Ling:
"Brother Ding, why is Sister like this?"
"She’s deeply poisoned."
"Is there still hope for her recovery?"
"There is hope."
"Brother Ding, you’re amazing."
Thinking that she too was saved by Ding Ling, she couldn’t help feeling admiration, gratitude, and a strange quickening of her heartbeat.
Things were different between the two now.
Zhong Ling called him Brother Ding, her voice still crisp and pleasant but softer and more gentle than before.
Perhaps Zhong Ling herself hadn’t realized this.
"Brother Ding, let me help you."
Seeing Ding Ling busy, Zhong Ling felt uneasy about not helping, stepping forward eagerly to assist.
Ding Ling signaled her to hold Ling Yanqiu instead.

Zhong Ling was a perceptive and clever person. Seeing Ding Ling brew and prepare medicine so quickly, as if lightning had passed, she was amazed and decided not to bring up helping anymore. Her helping would clearly just slow him down. For a while, thinking about the difference between herself and Ding Ling, she couldn’t help feeling anxious again.
The young girl was moved and in love.
Often, her eyes and her heart would uncontrollably follow the one she adored, wandering.
How could Zhong Ling know about these feelings, only vaguely finding Ding Ling more handsome, distinguished, accomplished, and charming, her mind still musing:
"Brother Ding is so perfect and outstanding, could he be married? If he’s married, then, then, I..."
"Alright."
Ding Ling’s voice interrupted, breaking Zhong Ling’s thoughts. Zhong Ling immediately started assisting Ding Ling with giving medicine to Ling Yanqiu.
A moment later.
Ling Yanqiu awoke.

She was heroic, a woman no less courageous than a man. Upon waking, she first checked herself, finding no irregularities, and remembering her actions during this time, she couldn’t help blushing and, with a somewhat unnatural expression, glanced at Ding Ling, stood up, and earnestly bowed:

"Hero Ding, you have saved me once again. Words cannot express my complex feelings at this moment. If you ever have a command, as long as it doesn’t go against my principles or original intentions, I will strive hard to fulfill it for you."
Ding Ling merely smiled and said no more.
He then turned back to prepare his own medicine.
With deep cultivation, superb physical constitution, and Buddha Qi protection,
This marvelous medicine, though formidable, could not easily harm him. But it wouldn’t be good to drag it out too long.

Ding Ling brewed two doses of medicine, then brewed a third, naturally with ease, and soon, having brewed it, took it himself. After clearing the heat from his body, he felt completely clear and refreshed.
"Hero Ding, didn’t that filthy thief say there was no antidote?"
Ling Yanqiu recalled something and couldn’t help asking.
She had changed her address for Ding Ling to Hero Ding.
This showed that she had placed Ding Ling on a level of a true hero and her respect and admiration for him had reached the pinnacle.
"I know a bit about the Medical Dao, so I concocted it myself.
Zhong Ling’s large, watery almond eyes widened:
"Brother Ding, you call that knowing a bit? Your medical skills are astonishing. It’s really unexpected that besides being formidable in Kung Fu, you’re also a Divine Doctor."
She was filled with admiration, reverence, and a bit of dejection:
"We’re probably not much different in age. How is there such a huge gap?"
"Among billions of people in the world, encountering an exceptionally talented person is quite normal."
Before Ding Ling could speak, Ling Yanqiu consoled:
"Your Brother Ding must indeed be a supremely talented, all-knowing figure."
Others mattered little to Zhong Ling.
The words your Brother Ding.
Filled her heart with sweetness, making her smile, revealing two dimples:
"Sister is right."
Ding Ling went back to interrogate Cloud Crane.
Cloud Crane was utterly terrified of Ding Ling.
In Ding Ling’s hands, not even death was an option. To avoid torture,
He obediently disclosed the Lightweight Skill he had learned, and after his acupoints were unlocked, he began to perform.
Midway, he wanted to escape, but just as he got a bit further away, a pebble from Ding Ling was shot at him, tap! hitting him on his body, causing both pain and itchiness.
Thinking of Ding Ling’s One Yang Finger technique.
Cloud Crane was frightened and dared not think of escaping again, obediently completing the demonstration.
The techniques passed through Ding Ling’s mind.
Instantly, a book appeared in the library.
In an instant.
[Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.4]
[Constitution +0.1]
Cloud Crane did not use any underhanded methods, nor did he arbitrarily alter the texts in the Technique.

sentences.text: The Profound Celestial Finger Technique can freeze water into ice.
Ding Ling now has immeasurable power; controlling the Finger Force to cool a bowl of scalding potion to a refreshing yet non-icy state is not difficult.
Then Ding Ling administered the medicine to Zhong Ling.
Zhong Ling was uncooperative all along.
She just clung to Ding Ling, mumbling ’Brother Ding’ ’Brother Ding.’
Ding Ling had no choice but to force-feed her.
Fortunately, he had mastered the strength in this aspect to a fine degree.
He managed to ’feed’ Zhong Ling the antidote quite securely.

After the antidote entered her stomach, it was quickly dissolved by the True Qi of the Nine Yang Divine Skill and the Vigorous Qi of the Medicine King Breathing Technique, merging into Zhong Ling’s limbs and bones.
In just a moment.
The clarity returned to Zhong Ling’s large, watery eyes, and her face flushed like the morning glow as she called out ’Brother Ding.’
Her voice, crisp and tender, carried a softness unlike before, sounding increasingly pleasant and gentle.
When it fell into Ding Ling’s ears, he felt as if a warm current passed through his heart.

He looked closely and saw that Zhong Ling no longer appeared so simple-minded; her eyes were bright like the moon, seemingly recovered, and he couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief, withdrawing the hand that was applying Fusion Qi on her back.
"How do you feel?"
Ding Ling finally asked.
"I’m fine now."
Zhong Ling, not knowing what came to her mind, covered her face, feeling as if she couldn’t face others, so ashamed that she wished to bury herself in a hole.
Though her face was covered, her fingers were spread wide, occasionally sneaking peeks at Ding Ling.
Seeing Ding Ling, her heart inexplicably raced with joy, but when Ding Ling turned away, she felt a faint sense of disappointment.
The thoughts of a young girl were like the tide, constantly shifting.
This was because she remembered everything that had happened during this period, clearer and more profound than anything before.
Had she ever done such things before?
She couldn’t help but lower her brows, feeling shy to the extreme.

Yet, in an era where purity was highly valued, Zhong Ling, having done so much for Ding Ling, despite initial shyness and awkwardness, was at a loss seeing Ding Ling no longer paying much attention to her and merely brewing medicine there, making her heart feel a bit unsettled.

"Brother Ding, why is Sister like this?"
"She’s deeply poisoned."
"Is there still hope for her recovery?"
"There is hope."
"Brother Ding, you’re amazing."

Things were different between the two now.
Zhong Ling called him Brother Ding, her voice still crisp and pleasant but softer and more gentle than before.
Perhaps Zhong Ling herself hadn’t realized this.

Ding Ling signaled her to hold Ling Yanqiu instead.

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - 499: Crane and Snake Eight Strikes Full Level
paragraphs: As a result, Ding Ling quickly reached full level in body technique.
His figure flickered in the void like clouds and smoke, straight up to the azure, flying higher than ever before, becoming increasingly agile.
With a light leap, he could vanish like smoke.
This was truly an exceptional lightweight skill.
Strongly surpassing the Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill.
Not inferior to the Golden Swan Skill at all.
Cloud Crane stared in disbelief:
"How, how, how is this possible?!"
Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique, Cloud Crane had practiced for decades, only achieving entering perfection, not yet reaching great perfection innate ability.
The difficulty of cultivating this body technique was akin to ascending the Celestial Palace.
Ding Ling instantly achieved mastery!
Or had he already practiced this body technique before?!
Cloud Crane was in a state of bewilderment.
Not far away, Zhong Ling couldn’t help clapping:
"Brother Ding is amazing!"
Ding Ling interrogated Cloud Crane, not avoiding Zhong Ling.
Ling Yanqiu was very proactive in avoiding suspicion, not eavesdropping.
Zhong Ling, however, couldn’t care less. Wherever Ding Ling went, she followed, like a little shadow.
So she saw everything clearly, understanding why Ding Ling was so remarkable at such a young age! More than anything, she was shocked and delighted.
Astonished by Ding Ling’s unmatched talent.
Delighted by Ding Ling’s prowess. The more powerful Ding Ling was, the more she was unconsciously excited and thrilled, though confused about what this meant.
But being naturally optimistic and pure, she didn’t overthink, just followed her heart instinctively.
Thinking about Ding Ling, she naturally followed him closely.
"Whew whew!"
Ding Ling swooped down from the high altitude, landing gracefully and elegantly like a stream of smoke. His eyes sparkled as he stared at Cloud Crane, saying:
"Continue."
Cloud Crane felt his scalp tingling, and proceeded to explain the Crane and Snake Eight Strikes martial arts.
Ding Ling listened to him once.
In moments afterwards.
[Crane and Snake Eight Strikes Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
Compared to Cloud Crane’s top level lightweight skill, the Crane and Snake Eight Strikes, though a high tier martial art, was inferior to some high tier cultivation techniques.
But Ding Ling didn’t mind, considering it as an enhancement to his foundation.
With a grab in the air, whoosh! A gust of wind blew, snatching Cloud Crane’s iron claw and steel staff into his hand. He immediately practiced the Crane and Snake Eight Strikes like the wind.

Seeing the iron claw and steel staff in his hand, sometimes crafty and poisonous like a spirit snake, sometimes elegant and agile like a flying crane, once they were in his hands, he wielded them like a seasoned master of Divine Weapon!
Cloud Crane’s face was filled with disbelief and shock.
A storm surged in his heart, looking at Ding Ling as if seeing a Ghost God!
"Brother Ding, amazing, truly amazing!"
Zhong Ling jumped and clapped with joy.

Ling Yanqiu heard the commotion, and upon observing the situation, couldn’t help but guess what had happened, deeply shocked and unable to believe it, planning to privately inquire about the details from Zhong Ling later.
Cloud Crane’s martial arts were all learned by Ding Ling.
After completing the Crane and Snake Eight Strikes.
He took out the Hongfei Inner Power Heart Method for a look.
[Hongfei Inner Power Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +80]
Rolling primordial qi and spiritual mechanism rushed in.
Overwhelming Ding Ling in an instant.
Ding Ling’s current fortune was truly remarkable, in mere moments, full level Nine Yang Divine Skill, etc., transformed this primordial qi into his own.
Cloud Crane was stunned, could cultivation be done like this?!
Zhong Ling was also greatly amazed, silently pondering:
"Isn’t inner power supposed to be cultivated step by step with focus and calmness?! How does Brother Ding seem to have succeeded just by reading the Inner Power Heart Method?!"
She couldn’t figure it out.
After finishing these tasks, Ding Ling prepared to deal with Cloud Crane.

Cloud Crane knew he was doomed. He only pleaded with Ding Ling not to torture him further, and Ding Ling fulfilled his wish. With a One Yang Finger, he pierced through his heart, killing him instantly.
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling signaled Zhong Ling and Ling Yanqiu to mount the horses.
But there were only two horses.
Zhong Ling immediately expressed her desire to ride a horse with Brother Ding.
Leaving the other horse to Sister Ling.
Seeing her joyful expression.
Ling Yanqiu couldn’t help but smile. Initially planning to leave, she thought of helping them and repaying kindness, and agreed to the proposal.
Ding Ling noted Zhong Ling’s excitement and repeatedly calling him over with a lively and charming demeanor.
He hesitated for a moment.
Then walked over.
Zhong Ling didn’t pretend to be shy, and as a man, he wouldn’t be coy either.
Clatter!
Amidst the sound of hooves.
The three people with two horses left the cave that would always bring a sweet smile to Zhong Ling whenever she recalled it.
Zhong Ling continued to lead the way.
Although Ding Ling could fly everywhere.
Finding a precise mountain stream was extremely difficult.

Because within the Wuliang Mountain Earth Realm, the mountains were endless. Although he could fly over a few mountains in a short time, finding the mountain stream that met his requirements among the numerous mountains would be time-consuming, exhausting, and challenging. Having a guide was much more convenient.
And Zhong Ling was indeed familiar with the place.
Leading the way all along.
After turning at the bends, they finally arrived at Thorn Ridge!
Looking around.

There were piles of rocks, steep slopes, very difficult to traverse. At the end of Thorn Ridge, there was a cliff, and beyond the cliff, a peak surrounded on three sides by mountains, with one side seemingly facing the river.
Even here, one could faintly hear the sound of surging waves from that direction.
At this moment, Zhong Ling was sitting behind Ding Ling, hugging him tightly, laughing like a flower, occasionally covering her mouth with soft giggles, evidently filled with joy.
With a brilliant smile, she pointed ahead, saying brightly:
"Brother Ding, look, there’s the second ravine that I know of! If this doesn’t meet your requirements, I truly have no more ideas."
Before this.
The three of them with two horses had gone to another mountain stream, where there were many poisonous creatures, shrouded in a dense woodland, not seeing the light of day.
The Ferghana Horses were frightened and refused to proceed.
But Ding Ling pulled the two women over to the mountain stream, yet it wasn’t the destination.
The three observed briefly and then returned, quickly arriving at Thorn Ridge.
Ding Ling rode forward.
The piles of rocks were difficult to traverse.
But the Ferghana Horses were equipped with the best horseshoes, fearless of the rocks, able to travel freely.
However, seeing the horses struggle to walk, Ding Ling jumped off, pulling Zhong Ling along as they flew forward.
Zhong Ling, experiencing this feeling of being flown again, couldn’t help but laugh, extremely joyful and excited.
Ling Yanqiu also dismounted, following closely behind. Her lightweight body technique was not very advanced, barely able to keep up with the two.
